papers.title: Kernel Renormalization in Bayesian Deep Neural Networks: the Equivalent Wishart Ansatz in the Proportional Regime
papers.abstract: The scaling limit where both the size of the training set $P$ and the width $N$ of a deep neural network grow at the same rate, the so-called proportional-width regime, has been intensely studied for shallow, single-hidden-layer networks. However, extending these non-perturbative results from shallow architectures to deep non-linear networks has proven very challenging. Here we present an effective approximate approach to predict the generalization performance of Bayesian multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) of fixed depth $L$ on arbitrary high-dimensional data. We propose an equivalent Wishart Ansatz to capture the dominant stochastic fluctuations of the hierarchical empirical kernels of MLPs. This allows us to perform a large deviation analysis for the partition function of MLPs in the proportional limit, expressed in terms of a renormalized NNGP kernel. In this description, even strong representation learning in the proportional limit is encoded in at most $L$ scalar order parameters, determined self-consistently. Extending the approach to convolutional architectures (CNNs), we identify a hierarchical local kernel renormalization mechanism, which allows to quantify more complex data-dependent transformations of the large-width kernel in CNNs due to finite-width effects. We test our effective theory against sampling experiments from the Bayesian posterior of finite deep neural networks with depths $L \sim O(10)$ and $P\sim O(10^3)$ on classic benchmark datasets, finding overall very good agreement together with two distinct types of systematic deviations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“effective approximate approach”“large deviation analysis”“effective theory”等理论框架描述，未提及实验或数值模拟（除验证性采样实验外）。；研究对象：贝叶斯深度神经网络（多层感知机MLP与卷积神经网络CNN）在“比例极限”（训练集大小P与网络宽度N同比例增长）下的泛化性能与核重整化机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出“等效Wishart假设”来捕捉深度神经网络中层次化经验核的主导随机涨落，从而在比例极限下将深度MLP的配分函数大偏差分析简化为至多L个标量序参量的自洽方程，并揭示了CNN中层次化局部核重整化机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出“等效Wishart假设”来捕捉深度神经网络中层次化经验核的主导随机涨落，从而在比例极限下将深度MLP的配分函数大偏差分析简化为至多L个标量序参量的自洽方程，并揭示了CNN中层次化局部核重整化机制。；创新点：将原本仅适用于浅层单隐层网络的比例极限非微扰结果推广至深度非线性网络（MLP与CNN），并首次在CNN中识别出层次化局部核重整化机制，量化了有限宽度效应对大宽度核的数据依赖变换。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于等效Wishart假设的统计力学大偏差分析，将深度贝叶斯神经网络的泛化性能用重整化的NNGP（神经正切高斯过程）核描述；验证手段：对深度L~O(10)、训练集大小P~O(10^3)的有限深度贝叶斯神经网络在经典基准数据集上进行后验采样实验。

papers.title: Channel-agnostic finite-temperature phase estimation averaged over variable grids: reconstruction of Green's function for dynamical mean-field theory
papers.abstract: For treating correlated electronic systems on quantum computers, we propose a quantum-classical hybrid scheme for dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). In the quantum part of the scheme, we use modified quantum phase estimation (QPE) circuits suitable for the one-particle Green's function (GF) at a finite temperature so that we can extract spectral amplitudes and the excitation energies without knowing the excitation channel invoked at each measurement. In the classical part of the scheme, we adopt an approach that estimates reasonably the GF based on the data collected from the QPE sampling. We dub the approach the QPE averaged over variable grids (QAVG), that may help one to reconstruct the GF via optimization of trial parameters and modeling the probability distributions for various settings of the QPE circuits. We apply the QAVG-DMFT scheme to SrVO$_3$ to demonstrate its validity via numerical simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+计算）。判断依据：提出了量子-经典混合方案（quantum-classical hybrid scheme），并进行了数值模拟（numerical simulations）。；研究对象：强关联电子体系（correlated electronic systems），具体以 SrVO₃ 为例进行验证。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为 QAVG（QPE averaged over variable grids）的新方法，该方法无需知道每次测量所激发的具体通道，即可从量子相位估计（QPE）采样数据中合理重建有限温度下的单粒子格林函数，从而将量子计算与动力学平均场理论（DMFT）有效结合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为 QAVG（QPE averaged over variable grids）的新方法，该方法无需知道每次测量所激发的具体通道，即可从量子相位估计（QPE）采样数据中合理重建有限温度下的单粒子格林函数，从而将量子计算与动力学平均场理论（DMFT）有效结合。；创新点：提出了一种与激发通道无关（channel-agnostic）的有限温度相位估计方法，并设计了基于可变网格平均的经典后处理方案（QAVG），以克服传统 QPE 在 DMFT 框架下需要识别激发通道的限制。
papers.method_zh: 量子-经典混合方案。量子部分：使用改进的量子相位估计（QPE）电路，用于提取有限温度下的单粒子格林函数的谱振幅和激发能。经典部分：采用 QAVG 方法，通过优化试探参数和对不同 QPE 电路设置下的概率分布进行建模，从 QPE 采样数据中重建格林函数。

papers.title: Error-corrected phase estimation averaged over variable grids on a trapped-ion quantum computer: hyperacuity spectra of a CO molecule adsorbed onto $χ$-Fe$_5$C$_2$
papers.abstract: Quantum phase estimation (QPE) is an underlying technology for extracting the excitation spectra of many-electron systems, yet its practical use on current hardware is hindered by low grid resolution and environmental noises. Here we propose QPE averaged over variable grids (QAVG), a vernier-type approach that combines low-resolution QPE with multiple origin shifts and physically motivated continuous parametrization to reconstruct the spectra accurately. We introduce this approach into an end-to-end workflow for the {\it ab initio}-based model system for a CO molecule adsorbed onto the $χ$-Fe$_5$C$_2$ surface. We perform experiments on Quantinuum H2-2 using both physical QPE circuits and logical QPE circuits encoded in the Steane code with offline bit-flip correction. We demonstrate that QAVG accurately reconstructs the spectra with deviations much smaller than the nominal QPE resolution, even when the noisy histograms are used. The cost landscapes averaged over the shifted grids substantially suppress the local minima arising from the spectral leakage, thereby stabilizing the optimization of trial parameters. These results indicate that QAVG provides a robust route to quantum simulations of correlated spectra toward the era of early-fault-tolerant quantum computers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论结合）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“提出QAVG方法”（理论/算法创新）和“在Quantinuum H2-2上进行实验”（物理量子硬件实验），并涉及逻辑量子比特编码（Steane码）与纠错。；研究对象：吸附在χ-Fe₅C₂表面的CO分子（CO molecule adsorbed onto χ-Fe₅C₂ surface）的激发谱（excitation spectra），作为基于第一性原理（ab initio）的模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出并实验验证了变网格平均量子相位估计（QAVG）方法，能够在量子比特分辨率低且存在环境噪声的情况下，以远低于名义QPE分辨率的误差精确重构光谱，并有效抑制由谱泄漏引起的局部极小值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出并实验验证了变网格平均量子相位估计（QAVG）方法，能够在量子比特分辨率低且存在环境噪声的情况下，以远低于名义QPE分辨率的误差精确重构光谱，并有效抑制由谱泄漏引起的局部极小值。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 1. 提出QAVG方法：一种游标卡尺式（vernier-type）方法，结合低分辨率QPE、多次原点平移（multiple origin shifts）及物理驱动的连续参数化（physically motivated continuous parametrization）进行光谱重构。2. 实验平台：Quantinuum H2-2离子阱量子计算机。3. 实验方案：同时运行物理QPE电路和基于Steane码编码的逻辑QPE电路（带离线比特翻转纠错）。4. 数据处理：对含噪声的直方图进行变网格平均，优化试验参数。

papers.title: Giant Photon Superbunching from Weak Nonlinearity
papers.abstract: Photon superbunching, which occurs when the second-order correlation satisfies $g^{(2)}> 2$, is typically associated with strong optical nonlinearities or collective multi-photon emission processes. We predict that extreme superbunching can also arise in systems of weakly-nonlinear photonic cavities, via the creation of a squeezed vacuum through interference engineering by fine-tuning inter-cavity couplings and drive parameters. We present numerical calculations indicating that a system of four photonic resonators containing representative Kerr media can achieve $g^{(2)}(0) = 135$ with a $80\,\text{kHz}$ emission rate. Unlike earlier superbunching schemes, this mechanism is highly compatible with integrated photonic platforms constructed using conventional optical media.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：预测、数值计算、理论机制。；研究对象：弱非线性光子腔系统中的光子超聚束现象（giant photon superbunching），具体为四个含Kerr介质的谐振腔耦合系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过干涉工程精细调控腔间耦合与驱动参数，可在弱非线性光子腔系统中产生极强的光子超聚束，二阶关联函数g^(2)(0)可达135，发射率80 kHz。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过干涉工程精细调控腔间耦合与驱动参数，可在弱非线性光子腔系统中产生极强的光子超聚束，二阶关联函数g^(2)(0)可达135，发射率80 kHz。；创新点：首次提出在弱非线性（而非强非线性或多光子集体发射）条件下，通过干涉工程实现极端光子超聚束，且该机制与基于常规光学介质的集成光子平台高度兼容。
papers.method_zh: 数值计算（numerical calculations），基于干涉工程（interference engineering）调控腔间耦合与驱动参数，在含Kerr非线性的光子谐振腔系统中模拟光子统计行为。

papers.title: Common Noise-Induced Group-Level Synchronization Between Uncoupled Groups of Oscillators
papers.abstract: We investigate group-level synchronization between oscillator groups induced by common noise in the absence of inter-group coupling. Each group receives a common noise shared by all its oscillators and independent local noise inputs to individual oscillators. The same common noise is applied to all groups. The system is studied with both identical and nonidentical oscillators, and with and without intra-group coupling. In the nonidentical case, natural frequencies are drawn from the same distribution for both groups, making them statistically equivalent. Through numerical simulations of this system, we find that the degree of synchronization within each group, measured by the absolute value of a complex Kuramoto order parameter, typically shows significant temporal fluctuations. Importantly, the complex order parameters representing the collective oscillations of the groups synchronize when the groups are driven by the same common noise. By deriving a phase density evolution mapping, we analytically explain how this group-level synchronization is achieved in the absence of intra-group coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“通过数值模拟”和“通过推导相位密度演化映射进行解析解释”。；研究对象：由共同噪声驱动的、无耦合的振荡器群体之间的群体级同步现象。具体体系为：多个振荡器群体，群体内振荡器共享一个共同噪声，群体间无直接耦合，但所有群体接收相同的共同噪声。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在没有群体间耦合的情况下，当不同振荡器群体被相同的共同噪声驱动时，代表各群体集体振荡的复序参量（Kuramoto序参量）会实现同步。摘要还发现，群体内部的同步程度通常表现出显著的时间涨落。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在没有群体间耦合的情况下，当不同振荡器群体被相同的共同噪声驱动时，代表各群体集体振荡的复序参量（Kuramoto序参量）会实现同步。摘要还发现，群体内部的同步程度通常表现出显著的时间涨落。；创新点：揭示了共同噪声本身即可诱导无耦合的振荡器群体之间产生群体级同步，而无需任何直接的群体间相互作用。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（具体方法未明确说明，但基于Kuramoto模型）和解析推导（通过推导相位密度演化映射来分析无群体内耦合的情况）。系统考虑了振荡器相同与不相同、以及有无群体内耦合等多种情形。

papers.title: Model-free estimation in scattering analysis of microscopy
papers.abstract: The mean squared displacement (MSD) of particles or probes is commonly estimated from microscopy videos using particle tracking approaches, which rely on tuning parameters manually, and are often unstable over the entire lag time range, especially in dense or low-contrast situations. In this work, we propose model-free ab initio uncertainty quantification (MF-AIUQ), a model-free method for scattering analysis of microscopy video based on a probabilistic framework, which estimates MSD without isolating particles and linking their trajectories. Based on the relationship between the intermediate scattering function (ISF) and the MSD derived from the cumulant theorem, MF-AIUQ estimates the MSD values by the marginal maximum likelihood estimator. To reduce the computational cost, the likelihood function is approximated by a subset of Fourier-transformed intensities. These intensities are equally spaced at the logarithmic values of Fourier basis functions and lag time points. We found that the ISF is smooth in this logarithmic input space, and the information of the ISF can be captured by this subset of inputs. We examine the method through simulation studies covering several representative stochastic processes and three experimental systems: a Newtonian fluid for evaluating performance in optically dense and bright-field settings, a gelation system with an evolving MSD shape, and snail mucin, a viscoelastic biopolymer, for modulus estimation. Across these studies, MF-AIUQ provides smooth and stable MSD estimates over the full lag time range and serves as a useful complementary approach in settings where particle tracking is unreliable or a parametric model of MSD is unavailable or unverifiable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：提出了一种基于概率框架的无模型方法（MF-AIUQ），并通过模拟研究和实验系统验证，未涉及新实验手段开发。；研究对象：显微镜视频中粒子或探针的均方位移（MSD）估计，具体应用于光学致密环境、凝胶化体系、粘弹性生物聚合物（如蜗牛粘液）等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MF-AIUQ方法无需分离粒子或追踪轨迹，即可在全滞后时间范围内获得平滑稳定的MSD估计，在粒子追踪不可靠或MSD参数模型未知/不可验证的场景中可作为有效补充。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MF-AIUQ方法无需分离粒子或追踪轨迹，即可在全滞后时间范围内获得平滑稳定的MSD估计，在粒子追踪不可靠或MSD参数模型未知/不可验证的场景中可作为有效补充。；创新点：提出一种无模型、从头算的不确定性量化方法，无需手动调参或粒子追踪，直接通过散射分析估计MSD，尤其适用于高密度或低对比度等传统方法不稳定的场景。
papers.method_zh: 基于累积量定理推导中间散射函数（ISF）与MSD的关系，采用边际最大似然估计器估计MSD；通过傅里叶变换强度子集（在对数空间中等间距选取）近似似然函数以降低计算成本。验证手段包括模拟代表性随机过程及三种实验系统（牛顿流体、凝胶化体系、蜗牛粘液）。

papers.title: Source-driven torsional optical activity in geometrically chiral media
papers.abstract: We develop an effective field-theoretical model for source-driven electromagnetic waves in a geometrically chiral optical medium described by a uniform axial torsion. Starting from the gauge-invariant electromagnetic field strength, we introduce a Chern--Simons-type coupling between the vector potential and the medium's axial contortion, thereby obtaining an inhomogeneous Maxwell system with prescribed external sources. For transverse cylindrical source profiles, we derive the coupled radial equations and solve them analytically for a circulating cylindrical-shell current. In the circular basis, the homogeneous problem diagonalizes, yielding torsion-split radial wavenumbers that give rise to longitudinal circular birefringence under guided-mode boundary conditions. In the weak-torsion regime, this birefringence produces a polarization rotation proportional to the propagation length and an oscillatory conversion between orthogonal linear polarizations. The source fixes the jump conditions and the relative excitation of the circular eigenmodes, thereby yielding measurable modal power and Poynting-flow signatures. A two-port scattering analysis shows that the apparent direction dependence remains Lorentz reciprocal, placing the effect in the class of reciprocal geometric optical activity rather than Faraday isolation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“develop an effective field-theoretical model”、“derive the coupled radial equations”、“solve them analytically”等关键词，表明工作核心是理论建模与解析求解。；研究对象：几何手性光学介质中的源驱动电磁波。具体而言，研究了一种由均匀轴向扭转（axial torsion）描述的几何手性介质，并分析了其中由外部源（如圆柱壳电流）激发的电磁波传播与偏振特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在几何手性介质中，轴向扭转会导致圆偏振本征模的径向波数分裂，从而在弱扭转条件下产生与传播长度成正比的偏振旋转，以及正交线偏振之间的振荡转换。该效应是洛伦兹互易的，属于互易几何光学活性，而非法拉第隔离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在几何手性介质中，轴向扭转会导致圆偏振本征模的径向波数分裂，从而在弱扭转条件下产生与传播长度成正比的偏振旋转，以及正交线偏振之间的振荡转换。该效应是洛伦兹互易的，属于互易几何光学活性，而非法拉第隔离。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异，但核心创新在于：将几何手性介质的“轴向扭转”这一结构特征，通过Chern-Simons型耦合引入电磁理论，并严格求解了源驱动下的电磁波模式，揭示了由源决定的本征模激发与可测量的功率/坡印廷流特征。
papers.method_zh: 采用有效场论模型。从规范不变的电磁场强出发，引入矢量势与介质轴向扭转（axial contortion）之间的Chern-Simons型耦合，构建了带有外部源的非齐次麦克斯韦方程组。针对横向圆柱形源分布（循环圆柱壳电流），推导并解析求解了耦合径向方程。在圆偏振基下，将齐次问题对角化，得到扭转分裂的径向波数。最后，通过双端口散射分析检验了互易性。

papers.title: Modular non-Hermitian topology and its application to critical sensing
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian topological systems have attracted a lot of research activities in recent times, both theoretically and experimentally, due to their unique physical properties and association with open quantum systems. We show that modular structures, where specific couplings at regular intervals take distinct values, enrich the unique topological attributes of these systems such as the non-Hermitian skin effect and the breakdown of conventional bulk-boundary correspondence. These systems also possess the capability of displaying criticality-enhanced sensitivity for precision metrology. We establish how the modular structure enhances their sensing performance near spectral topological phase transitions and show that the enhancement can be achieved in multi-parameter estimation scenarios as well.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、establish、theoretically（摘要中虽未明确写“理论”，但全文为理论推导与机制分析，无实验或计算细节描述）。；研究对象：非厄米拓扑系统中的模数结构（modular structures），以及其导致的非厄米趋肤效应、体边对应失效、临界增强传感等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 模数结构（特定间隔的耦合取不同值）能丰富非厄米拓扑系统的独特属性，如增强非厄米趋肤效应和体边对应失效，并可在谱拓扑相变附近实现临界增强的传感性能，且该增强可推广至多参数估计场景。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：模数结构（特定间隔的耦合取不同值）能丰富非厄米拓扑系统的独特属性，如增强非厄米趋肤效应和体边对应失效，并可在谱拓扑相变附近实现临界增强的传感性能，且该增强可推广至多参数估计场景。；创新点：首次提出模数结构可系统性地调控非厄米拓扑系统的传感性能，并证明其在多参数估计中也能实现临界增强，拓展了非厄米拓扑在精密测量中的应用潜力。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与模型构建。摘要未明确说明具体理论框架（如是否使用紧束缚模型、非布洛赫能带理论等），仅提及“modular structures”和“spectral topological phase transitions”。

papers.title: Dynamical Tsallis WIMP Freeze-Out and Residual Memory Channels in the Radiation Sector
papers.abstract: In this work we generalize the thermal decoupling, or freeze-out, of weakly interacting massive particle dark matter within the Tsallis nonextensive formalism. The generalization is implemented through $q$-deformed distribution functions obtained from the maximum entropy principle with Curado-Tsallis constraints. The Tsallis parameter $q$, which measures deviations from extensivity with respect to the limit $q=1$, is promoted to a dynamical quantity depending on the dimensionless variable $x=m_χ/T$, where $m_χ$ is the dark matter mass. This dynamical evolution is characterized by a relaxation toward extensivity, while requiring that the nonextensive deformation is not completely erased before freeze-out. We solve the Boltzmann equation assuming a sectorial deformation, where only the dark matter equilibrium abundance is generalized and the radiation background remains extensive. The relic abundance is computed for different dark matter masses and initial values of the Tsallis parameter. From this evolution, we extract the residual value $q_χ^{\rm fo}$ at freeze-out, which is then used as the initial input for a phenomenological memory channel. This channel propagates the residual nonextensivity into the radiation sector, specifically into the electron-positron plasma and neutrinos, while photons are kept extensive in order to avoid direct tensions with CMB physics. The resulting deformation modifies the neutrino energy density and the photon reheating contribution, producing a correction to $N_{\rm eff}$. We compare the predicted values with the compressed CMB+BAO constraint on $N_{\rm eff}$ and find that the residual-memory scenario can remain phenomenologically compatible with current bounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“推广了热退耦/冻结过程”、“求解玻尔兹曼方程”、“计算残余丰度”等理论推导和数值计算内容，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：弱相互作用大质量粒子（WIMP）暗物质的冻结过程，以及由此产生的非广延性残余对辐射扇区（电子-正电子等离子体、中微子）的影响，具体涉及有效中微子代数 \(N_{\rm eff}\) 的修正。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Tsallis非广延框架下，将Tsallis参数 \(q\) 推广为动力学变量后，WIMP暗物质冻结后残留的非广延性可通过记忆通道传播到辐射扇区，导致中微子能量密度和光子再加热贡献发生变化，从而修正 \(N_{\rm eff}\)。该残余记忆场景在压缩的CMB+BAO约束下仍可保持现象学兼容。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Tsallis非广延框架下，将Tsallis参数 \(q\) 推广为动力学变量后，WIMP暗物质冻结后残留的非广延性可通过记忆通道传播到辐射扇区，导致中微子能量密度和光子再加热贡献发生变化，从而修正 \(N_{\rm eff}\)。该残余记忆场景在压缩的CMB+BAO约束下仍可保持现象学兼容。；创新点：将Tsallis非广延参数 \(q\) 从常数推广为动力学变量，并引入“残余记忆通道”概念，将暗物质冻结后的非广延性传播到辐射扇区，从而在保持光子扇区广延性以避免与CMB直接冲突的前提下，预测对 \(N_{\rm eff}\) 的可观测修正。
papers.method_zh: 基于最大熵原理和Curado-Tsallis约束得到 \(q\)-变形分布函数；将Tsallis参数 \(q\) 视为依赖于无量纲变量 \(x=m_\chi/T\) 的动力学量，并假设其随演化趋向广延性（\(q=1\)）；求解扇区变形下的玻尔兹曼方程（仅暗物质平衡丰度采用非广延分布，辐射背景保持广延）；提取冻结时的残余 \(q_\chi^{\rm fo}\) 作为记忆通道的初始输入，计算其对辐射扇区（电子-正电子等离子体、中微子）的修正，并与CMB+BAO对 \(N_{\rm eff}\) 的约束进行比较。

papers.title: Local diagnostics for strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking and non-equilibrium phase transitions
papers.abstract: We construct strongly $\mathbb{Z}_2$-symmetric local Markov/Lindblad dynamics exhibiting transitions between strong-paramagnetic behavior and strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking. In 1+1d, an absorbing-state construction gives a transition with scaling consistent with the parity-conserving branching-annihilating random-walk universality class. In 2+1d, a pair-flip variant of Toom's rule provides evidence for a stable strong-paramagnetic/weakly symmetry-broken regime and a transition into an active SWSSB regime. We also introduce a marginal fidelity correlator of radius $R$, a local proxy for the usual SWSSB fidelity order parameter requiring tomography only on $\mathcal{O}(R^d)$-size regions. For broad classes of states, including symmetry-projected Gibbs-like states satisfying suitable local indistinguishability assumptions, we bound the error between the marginal and global fidelity correlators by terms decaying exponentially in $R$. These marginal fidelities provide a model-independent diagnostic of SWSSB in absorbing-state transitions, where microscopic notions of defects or activity are not universal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“构造动力学”、“提出关联子”、“给出误差界”等理论分析内容，未涉及实验或计算模拟的具体数据。；研究对象：强-弱自发对称性破缺（SWSSB）及其在非平衡相变中的局域诊断方法，具体研究1+1维和2+1维的马尔可夫/林德布拉德动力学系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构造了强Z₂对称的局域马尔可夫动力学，展示了从强顺磁行为到强-弱自发对称性破缺的相变；在1+1维中相变标度符合宇称守恒的分支-湮灭随机游走普适类，在2+1维中通过Toom规则的pair-flip变体发现了稳定的强顺磁/弱对称破缺区及向活跃SWSSB区的相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构造了强Z₂对称的局域马尔可夫动力学，展示了从强顺磁行为到强-弱自发对称性破缺的相变；在1+1维中相变标度符合宇称守恒的分支-湮灭随机游走普适类，在2+1维中通过Toom规则的pair-flip变体发现了稳定的强顺磁/弱对称破缺区及向活跃SWSSB区的相变。；创新点：提出了无需全局断层扫描的局域SWSSB诊断方法（边缘保真度关联子），并证明其在吸收态相变中具有模型无关性，克服了传统缺陷或活性微观定义的非普适性问题。
papers.method_zh: 采用局域马尔可夫/林德布拉德动力学框架，在1+1维使用吸收态构造，在2+1维使用Toom规则的pair-flip变体；引入半径R的边缘保真度关联子作为局域诊断工具，并利用对称投影吉布斯态等宽类态的可区分性假设，推导边缘与全局保真度关联子之间的指数衰减误差界。

papers.title: Comparing Spatially Periodic Feedback and Space-Time Modulation for Unidirectional Wave Propagation in a 1D Mass-Spring-Damper System
papers.abstract: Unidirectional wave propagation has emerged as a key concept in the dynamics of non-reciprocal mechanical and acoustic metamaterials. This work investigates two fundamentally distinct strategies for achieving directional wave propagation in a periodic one-dimensional mass-spring-damper lumped system: space-time modulation and spatially periodic feedback. In the first approach, the stiffness is modulated periodically in both space and time. The resulting space-time periodic system is analyzed using a Plane Wave Expansion (PWE) formulation based on the Bloch-Floquet theory to obtain the dispersion relation. The traveling modulation produces asymmetric dispersion diagrams and directional band gaps, within which elastic waves propagate preferentially in a single direction due to broken time-reversal symmetry. In the second approach, non-reciprocity is introduced through a spatially periodic feedback action. The force can depend on the displacement and/or its derivatives, such as velocity or acceleration, and is applied to the masses along the system. The lumped system with a finite number of unit cells is modeled using classical mechanics principles, yielding a state-space model of the system. The active mechanism can generate directional amplification or attenuation via the non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE), characterized by boundary-localized modes identified by a topological invariant, the winding number. The stability of the space-time periodic system is assessed through the Lyapunov-Floquet theory. In the periodic feedback case, stability is investigated using the eigenvalues of the state matrix. These results provide design guidelines for directional wave propagation in elastic waveguides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Plane Wave Expansion (PWE)、Bloch-Floquet理论、Lyapunov-Floquet理论、状态空间模型、拓扑不变量（绕数）。；研究对象：一维质量-弹簧-阻尼集总系统中的单向波传播现象，具体比较了两种实现策略：时空刚度调制与空间周期性反馈。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 时空调制通过打破时间反演对称性产生非对称色散关系和定向带隙，实现单向波传播；空间周期性反馈则通过非厄米趋肤效应（NHSE）产生边界局域模式，实现定向放大或衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：时空调制通过打破时间反演对称性产生非对称色散关系和定向带隙，实现单向波传播；空间周期性反馈则通过非厄米趋肤效应（NHSE）产生边界局域模式，实现定向放大或衰减。；创新点：首次在同一框架下系统比较了两种截然不同的非互易波传播机制（被动时空调制与主动反馈控制），并分别给出了稳定性判据和设计准则。摘要未突出说明两种方法在实验实现难度或适用频段上的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 1）时空调制系统：采用基于Bloch-Floquet理论的平面波展开法（PWE）求解色散关系，并用Lyapunov-Floquet理论分析稳定性。2）空间周期性反馈系统：基于经典力学建立有限单元集总系统的状态空间模型，通过状态矩阵特征值分析稳定性，并利用绕数（winding number）作为拓扑不变量识别边界局域模式。

papers.title: Material selection for mid-infrared thin-film coatings and windows
papers.abstract: We summarized the room-temperature optical properties for infrared-transparent materials, defining transparency windows for two different applications: thin-film coatings (absorption coefficient $α< 10 cm^{-1}$) and windows ($α< 1 cm^{-1}$). The transparency requirements for thin films are substantially less stringent, enabling the use of many more optical materials for a given wavelength range. To make an easy-to-use reference, we categorized materials by chemical group, crystallinity, and typical deposition technique, and discussed practical pros and cons such as chemical and thermal stability, mechanical hardness, and cost. The datasets and plotting scripts are provided so that users can regenerate transparency-window maps for different applications. If you do optical design at infrared wavelengths, we recommend that you print out the figures and stick them on your wall.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验/综述型文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“总结了室温光学性质”、“讨论了实际优缺点”，并提供了数据集和绘图脚本，属于对已有材料数据的系统整理与分类。；研究对象：红外透明材料，具体针对两种应用场景：薄膜涂层（吸收系数α<10 cm⁻¹）和窗口材料（α<1 cm⁻¹）。材料按化学组别、结晶度和典型沉积技术进行分类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 薄膜涂层对透明性的要求远低于窗口材料，因此在给定波长范围内，可用于薄膜涂层的光学材料种类显著更多。摘要提供了便于使用的透明度窗口参考图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：薄膜涂层对透明性的要求远低于窗口材料，因此在给定波长范围内，可用于薄膜涂层的光学材料种类显著更多。摘要提供了便于使用的透明度窗口参考图。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统综述或数据库工作的具体差异，但创新点可能在于：1）明确区分了薄膜涂层与窗口材料的不同透明度标准；2）提供了可复现的透明度窗口图生成工具，便于用户自定义应用场景。
papers.method_zh: 基于室温光学性质数据的系统总结与分类。作者按化学组别、结晶度和典型沉积技术对材料进行归类，并讨论了化学与热稳定性、机械硬度、成本等实际因素。提供了数据集和绘图脚本，供用户针对不同应用重新生成透明度窗口图。

papers.title: Nonlinear Dynamics of Rapidly Driven Systems
papers.abstract: We consider systems characterized by the presence of a rapidly oscillating force. A general method is presented for the construction of the effective action governing the large-scale nonlinear dynamics of such systems order by order in inverse powers of the oscillation frequency $ω$. The explicit expression for the effective Lagrangian is derived up to ${\cal O}(1/ω^6)$ next-to-next-to-leading approximation. The general structure of the high-frequency expansion reveals a broad class of nonlinear systems whose transition curves are identical to those of the linear Mathieu equation, which enables a fully nonperturbative stability analysis in the case of strong driving and nonlinearity. The method is generalized to velocity-dependent forces and configuration space with curvature, characteristic to systems with constraints. Several applications are discussed in detail, including the dynamical magnetic trapping of electric charges.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“提出一般方法”“推导有效拉格朗日量”“高频展开”等理论构建关键词，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：受快速振荡力驱动的非线性系统，包括速度依赖力系统、具有曲率的位形空间（约束系统），以及具体应用如电荷的动态磁囚禁。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现一大类非线性系统的转变曲线与线性Mathieu方程相同，从而可在强驱动和强非线性情况下进行完全非微扰的稳定性分析。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现一大类非线性系统的转变曲线与线性Mathieu方程相同，从而可在强驱动和强非线性情况下进行完全非微扰的稳定性分析。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用高频展开方法，按振荡频率ω的逆幂次逐阶构造描述系统大尺度非线性动力学的有效作用量，推导至O(1/ω^6)的次次领头阶有效拉格朗日量。

papers.title: Local Strong-to-Weak Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking
papers.abstract: We propose a local notion of strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SW-SSB), through a local one-point fidelity correlator. Compared with the previous definition in terms of a two-point fidelity correlator, our local formulation offers two key advantages: (1) it is easier to detect in large systems: for a system of size $N$ and with ${\rm poly}(N)$ amount of resources, one can detect the local fidelity order up to volume scale $O(\log(N))$; and (2) the local SW-SSB order remains well defined in the thermodynamic limit, where the density matrix itself is not well defined. We show that key features of SW-SSB, including stability under finite-depth symmetric channels and long-range conditional mutual information, persist within this local framework. Our definition is conceptually analogous to local thermalization, as exemplified by pure states obeying the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH). For critical states, the local one-point fidelity correlator defines an interesting class of defect problems. We demonstrate the applicability of the local formulation through several concrete examples, and derive the universal scaling behavior of the local fidelity correlator in a range of critical systems, including ground states of conformal field theories as well as ballistic and diffusive free-fermion metals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出理论概念（local notion of strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking），并基于理论框架（如ETH、CFT）进行分析，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：强到弱自发对称性破缺（SW-SSB）的局域化定义，以及其在量子多体系统（包括共形场论基态、弹道和扩散自由费米子金属）中的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于局域一点保真度关联函数的SW-SSB新定义，该定义在热力学极限下依然良好，且能在系统尺寸N下用poly(N)资源探测到体积尺度O(log(N))的局域保真度序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于局域一点保真度关联函数的SW-SSB新定义，该定义在热力学极限下依然良好，且能在系统尺寸N下用poly(N)资源探测到体积尺度O(log(N))的局域保真度序。；创新点：相比以往基于两点保真度关联函数的定义，新定义在热力学极限下仍有效，且更易于在大系统中探测（资源需求为poly(N)），并建立了与局域热化（如ETH）的概念类比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过局域一点保真度关联函数重新定义SW-SSB；利用有限深度对称信道稳定性、长程条件互信息等概念验证新定义的合理性；通过共形场论和自由费米子金属等具体例子推导局域保真度关联函数的普适标度行为。

papers.title: Constrained integrability and anyonic chains
papers.abstract: We review the notion of Yang-Baxter integrability for spin chains that have Hilbert spaces with constraints, such as a Rydberg blockade. We focus on anyonic chains, whose constraints arise from the fusion rules of the fusion categories on which they are based. We discuss the emergence of Temperley-Lieb algebras and present a new result on which types of anyonic chains exhibit them. We then give an overview of known results for integrable anyonic chains and extend them to several fusion categories up to rank $7$. Using a modification of the boost operator formalism, we find several new integrable anyonic chains and discuss some of their properties. These include spin-$\frac32$ models for $\mathfrak{su}(2)_k$ fusion categories, anyonic chains based on the Tambara-Yamagami fusion categories TY$(\mathbb{Z}_n)$, and product fusion categories Fib$\times$Fib and Fib$\times$Ising. We review recent results for spin chains based on the Haagerup-Izumi fusion category HI$(\mathbb{Z}_3)$, and present preliminary numerics for a HI$(\mathbb{Z}_5)$ model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“review”、“present a new result”、“using a modification of the boost operator formalism”、“present preliminary numerics”，以理论推导和模型分析为主，数值计算为辅。；研究对象：任意子链（anyonic chains），即基于融合范畴（fusion categories）的约束性自旋链，其希尔伯特空间受融合规则约束（如Rydberg阻塞效应）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改进的boost算子形式，发现了多个新的可积任意子链，包括基于su(2)_k融合范畴的自旋-3/2模型、Tambara-Yamagami融合范畴TY(Z_n)的任意子链，以及乘积融合范畴Fib×Fib和Fib×Ising的模型。同时，首次给出了Haagerup-Izumi融合范畴HI(Z_5)模型的初步数值结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过改进的boost算子形式，发现了多个新的可积任意子链，包括基于su(2)_k融合范畴的自旋-3/2模型、Tambara-Yamagami融合范畴TY(Z_n)的任意子链，以及乘积融合范畴Fib×Fib和Fib×Ising的模型。同时，首次给出了Haagerup-Izumi融合范畴HI(Z_5)模型的初步数值结果。；创新点：首次系统性地将可积性分析扩展到秩为7的多个融合范畴，并发现了若干新的可积任意子链，包括高自旋（自旋-3/2）和乘积范畴模型。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用Yang-Baxter可积性理论框架，分析约束性希尔伯特空间下的自旋链；使用Temperley-Lieb代数结构判定任意子链的可积性；通过改进的boost算子形式构造新的可积模型；对HI(Z_5)模型进行了初步数值计算。

papers.title: FunKit: A computer algebra toolkit for functional approaches
papers.abstract: We introduce FunKit, a Mathematica package for the derivation and tracing of functional equations from arbitrary master equations. FunKit provides an expression vocabulary and a set of rules that allow for derivations in any given field theory and master equation. It also allows users to add extensions for more specific equation systems. Therefore, it can be used in a wide range of situations, for example Dyson--Schwinger or functional RG equations, flowing reparametrisations, nPI equations, (modified) STIs and WTIs, functional Polchinski and Wegner flows, functional master equations with sources, and many others. Besides interfacing with the \FORM language to trace large tensor expressions efficiently, FunKit also provides facilities to export arbitrary Mathematica expressions to C++, Julia or Fortran code, including the results of derivations, which can then be evaluated numerically. Both the tracing and code generation can also be used independently and in combination with other packages.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Mathematica package、derivation、tracing、code generation。；研究对象：功能方法（functional approaches）中的方程推导与处理工具，不针对特定材料或物理体系，而是面向任意场论和主方程（master equation）的通用计算代数工具包。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体物理发现，主要介绍FunKit这一Mathematica软件包的功能：能够从任意主方程推导并追踪泛函方程，并支持导出到多种编程语言进行数值计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体物理发现，主要介绍FunKit这一Mathematica软件包的功能：能够从任意主方程推导并追踪泛函方程，并支持导出到多种编程语言进行数值计算。；创新点：提供了一个统一、可扩展的框架，适用于多种泛函方法（如Dyson-Schwinger方程、功能RG方程、nPI方程、STI/WTI、Polchinski/Wegner流等），并实现了推导、追踪与代码生成的一体化流程。摘要未突出说明与其他现有工具的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于Mathematica的符号计算包，提供表达式词汇和规则集用于泛函方程推导；集成FORM语言用于高效张量追踪；支持将Mathematica表达式导出为C++、Julia或Fortran代码。

papers.title: Analytic Bootstrap for $O(N)$ Boundary Conformal Field Theories with Interacting Boundaries
papers.abstract: We investigate $O(N)$ boundary conformal field theories (BCFTs) with boundary interactions in $d=4-ε$ and $d=3-ε$ employing the analytic bootstrap. By deriving universal constraints on conformal data, we show that infinitely many operator expansions can be expressed in terms of a finite set of inputs. Complementing the analytic bootstrap with a perturbative renormalization-group analysis, we identify totally new boundary fixed points in $d=4-ε$, including non-unitary ones, generated by a boundary cubic coupling, and compute their conformal data to leading order. Moreover, we leverage our solution in $d=3-ε$ to extract, for the first time, the boundary conformal data for the tricritical $O(N)$ model. Altogether, our approach provides a unified prescription for BCFTs with interacting boundaries and streamlines the determination of bulk and boundary operator expansions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytic bootstrap（解析自举法）、perturbative renormalization-group analysis（微扰重整化群分析）。；研究对象：具有边界相互作用的O(N)边界共形场论（BCFTs），具体在d=4-ε和d=3-ε维度下，包括由边界三次耦合生成的新边界固定点以及三临界O(N)模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过解析自举法推导出共形数据的普适约束，证明无穷多算子展开可由有限输入表达；在d=4-ε维度中发现了全新的边界固定点（包括非幺正固定点），并在d=3-ε维度中首次提取了三临界O(N)模型的边界共形数据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过解析自举法推导出共形数据的普适约束，证明无穷多算子展开可由有限输入表达；在d=4-ε维度中发现了全新的边界固定点（包括非幺正固定点），并在d=3-ε维度中首次提取了三临界O(N)模型的边界共形数据。；创新点：提供了一种统一的方案来处理具有相互作用边界的BCFTs，简化了体算子和边界算子展开的确定过程；首次在d=3-ε维度中提取了三临界O(N)模型的边界共形数据。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用解析自举法（analytic bootstrap）推导共形数据的普适约束，并结合微扰重整化群分析（perturbative renormalization-group analysis）识别边界固定点并计算其共形数据至领头阶。

papers.title: Learning quantum ground states in the space of measurement outcomes
papers.abstract: We investigate variational learning of quantum many-body ground states directly in measurement space using autoregressive neural networks. In particular, we represent quantum states via probability distributions of outcomes over a symmetric informationally complete positive operator-valued measure (SIC-POVM). The probability distribution is encoded in the parameters of an autoregressive neural-network-based on gated recurrent units (GRUs). Ground states are obtained by gradient descent that updates the probability distribution to minimize the energy with respect to a given Hamiltonian, while enforcing positivity constraints that ensure that the distribution of measurement outcomes correspond to a physical quantum state. We analyze the role of constraint enforcement (hierarchy of positivity conditions), variety of neural network architectures (multiple layers, dilation, and modifications of input data) in determining the success of this approach. We benchmark our approach on one-dimensional transverse-field Ising model and the Heisenberg model, along with gapping fields, for system sizes up to L=128, illustrating its efficacy across a wide variety of models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“variational learning”“autoregressive neural networks”“gradient descent”等计算与理论方法关键词。；研究对象：量子多体系统的基态，具体包括一维横场伊辛模型（transverse-field Ising model）和海森堡模型（Heisenberg model），以及带能隙场的变体，系统尺寸最大至L=128。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过自回归神经网络在对称信息完备正算子值测度（SIC-POVM）的测量结果空间中直接变分学习量子多体基态，能够有效获得多种模型的基态，且通过施加正性约束确保测量结果分布对应物理量子态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过自回归神经网络在对称信息完备正算子值测度（SIC-POVM）的测量结果空间中直接变分学习量子多体基态，能够有效获得多种模型的基态，且通过施加正性约束确保测量结果分布对应物理量子态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用基于门控循环单元（GRU）的自回归神经网络来编码SIC-POVM测量结果的概率分布；通过梯度下降最小化给定哈密顿量的能量来更新概率分布；同时施加正性条件（positivity constraints）的层次结构以确保分布对应物理量子态。还分析了不同神经网络架构（多层、扩张、输入数据修改）的影响。

papers.title: A local description of strong symmetries and strong-to-weak symmetry breaking in quantum many-body systems
papers.abstract: In mixed states of quantum systems, symmetries come in two types: strong and weak. Furthermore, it has been argued that in quantum many-body systems, strong symmetries can be "spontaneously broken" down to weak symmetries. An issue is that as previously formulated, such "strong-to-weak symmetry breaking" appears to be a fairly non-local effect. In this paper, we show how to understand and diagnose strong symmetries and strong-to-weak symmetry breaking in an explicitly local way. Our main technical tool is a rigorous definition of strong symmetry in the limit of infinite volume, which generalizes the conventional finite-volume definitions, and for which we give several equivalent formulations, including one involving the concept of "local charge coherence". Finally, we introduce von Neumann systems, which in infinite-volume symmetries are intermediate between strong and weak symmetries. We derive a Lieb-Schultz-Mattis type anomaly constraint for von Neumann symmetries (and therefore, in particular, strong symmetries) in quantum spin chains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：local description、rigorous definition、Lieb-Schultz-Mattis type anomaly constraint。；研究对象：量子多体混合态中的强对称性（strong symmetries）以及强到弱对称性破缺（strong-to-weak symmetry breaking）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 本文给出了强对称性在无穷体积极限下的严格局域定义，并证明了强到弱对称性破缺可以以一种显式局域的方式理解和诊断；此外，引入了介于强对称性与弱对称性之间的“冯·诺依曼对称性”，并推导了量子自旋链中该类对称性的Lieb-Schultz-Mattis型反常约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：本文给出了强对称性在无穷体积极限下的严格局域定义，并证明了强到弱对称性破缺可以以一种显式局域的方式理解和诊断；此外，引入了介于强对称性与弱对称性之间的“冯·诺依曼对称性”，并推导了量子自旋链中该类对称性的Lieb-Schultz-Mattis型反常约束。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与形式化定义：通过推广有限体积定义，给出无穷体积下强对称性的多种等价表述（包括“局域电荷相干性”概念），并利用von Neumann系统进行对称性分类与反常分析。

papers.title: The Funessian process: Non-Markovian dynamics shaped by the first event
papers.abstract: We construct a continuous-time, positively divisible non-Markovian process with memory of the initial state that satisfies the differential Chapman--Kolmogorov equation. In the stationary state, the correlation function exhibits exponential decay, a behavior typically regarded as characteristic of Markovian dynamics. Nevertheless, the memory is preserved throughout the evolution of the process, manifesting itself in observable statistical quantities. We further demonstrate that mutual information serves as a reliable measure of the non-Markovian character of the process. As an application, we study a random walk driven by the constructed process and show that the memory effect breaks ergodicity and modifies transport properties such as the diffusion coefficient.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct（构造）、satisfies the differential Chapman--Kolmogorov equation（满足微分Chapman-Kolmogorov方程）、demonstrate（证明）、study（研究）。；研究对象：一种具有初始状态记忆的连续时间、正可分的非马尔可夫过程，以及由其驱动的随机行走（random walk）的输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该非马尔可夫过程在稳态下相关函数呈指数衰减（通常被视为马尔可夫动力学特征），但记忆效应在整个演化过程中持续存在，并体现在可观测的统计量中；记忆效应会打破遍历性并改变扩散系数等输运性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该非马尔可夫过程在稳态下相关函数呈指数衰减（通常被视为马尔可夫动力学特征），但记忆效应在整个演化过程中持续存在，并体现在可观测的统计量中；记忆效应会打破遍历性并改变扩散系数等输运性质。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过构造满足微分Chapman-Kolmogorov方程的连续时间正可分非马尔可夫过程，利用互信息（mutual information）作为非马尔可夫性的可靠度量，并分析该过程驱动的随机行走的动力学行为。

papers.title: Towards standardisation of average grain size measurement of additively manufactured microstructures using EBSD
papers.abstract: Additively manufactured (AM) alloys have heterogeneous microstructures with broad grain size distributions and highly anisotropic and/or non-convex grain shapes. AM components can have complex geometries and porosity which may affect the local microstructure. Currently there is no electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD)-based grain size measurement standard suitable for typical AM materials. An interlaboratory comparison study was conducted to find out what grain size metrics and summary statistics are currently used to describe average grain size. Participants were asked to measure and report the average grain size from the same EBSD map dataset. Detailed reports have been published in Reference [1]. Based on these results, we have tested and propose recommendations for a new standard for measuring average grain size in AM materials. The present work demonstrates the suitability and limitations of the proposal across several different Ni and Al AM components.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：interlaboratory comparison study（实验室间对比研究）、EBSD（电子背散射衍射）、measurement（测量）。；研究对象：增材制造（AM）合金的微观结构，具体为Ni基和Al基增材制造部件中的晶粒尺寸测量标准化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于实验室间对比研究结果，提出了适用于增材制造材料平均晶粒尺寸测量的新标准建议，并验证了该建议在多种Ni和Al增材制造部件中的适用性与局限性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于实验室间对比研究结果，提出了适用于增材制造材料平均晶粒尺寸测量的新标准建议，并验证了该建议在多种Ni和Al增材制造部件中的适用性与局限性。；创新点：针对当前缺乏适用于典型增材制造材料的EBSD晶粒尺寸测量标准，首次提出并测试了专门面向增材制造非均匀微观结构（宽晶粒尺寸分布、高度各向异性/非凸晶粒形状）的平均晶粒尺寸测量标准化建议。
papers.method_zh: 采用电子背散射衍射（EBSD）技术进行晶粒尺寸测量，通过组织多个实验室对同一EBSD图谱数据集进行平均晶粒尺寸测量与报告，开展实验室间对比研究。

papers.title: Fermion Families and Pontryagin Class: Topological Field Theory via Colour Symmetry Extension
papers.abstract: Family puzzle asks why the Standard Model (SM) features exactly 3 families of quarks and leptons. Motivated by topological constraints, we study 4-dimensional fermionic anomalies with discrete $Z_n$ symmetry, classified by the 5d spin bordism group. We show that only the group-cohomology subclass H$^5(Z_n,U(1))\cong Z_n$ can be canceled by an anomalous $Z_n$-symmetric 4d $Z_n$-gauge topological quantum field theory (TQFT), while beyond-group-cohomology $A_{Z_n} p_1$ involving the Pontryagin class $p_1$ cannot (except $n=2,3$). More generally, we prove that any cocycle $α_d\in$H$^d(Z_n,U(1))$ in odd spacetime dimension $d\ge3$ is trivialised by the symmetry extension $1\to Z_n\to Z_{n^2}\to Z_n\to 1,$ and we construct the corresponding symmetric anomalous boundary TQFT. For $d=5$ and $n=3$, this yields a Spin$\times Z_3$-symmetric 4d $Z_3$-gauge TQFT that cancels the mixed discrete $(\bf B+L)$-gauge-gravitational anomaly of the SM in the absence of 3 "sterile" right-handed neutrinos $ν_R$. We further analyze a generalized SM with $N_c$ colors and $N_f$ families and argue that missing $N_f$ copies of the $ν_R$ can be naturally replaced by that 4d anomalous $Spin\times_{Z_2^F} Z_{2 N_f,{{\bf B} + {\bf L}}}$ symmetric $Z_{N_c}$-gauge TQFT under the anomaly cancellation, via an appropriate $Z_{N_c}$-color symmetry extension construction $1\to Z_{N_c}\to Spin\times Z_{N_cN_f}\to Spin\times_{Z_2^F} Z_{2N_f}\to1$ of anomalous topological order. For minimal nonzero positive integers $N_c$ and $N_f$, we find the minimal color extensions: $N_c=3, N_f \ge 3$; $N_c=4, N_f \ge 2$; and $N_c=12, N_f \ge 6$. If we further require that an SM baryon is a fermion so $N_c$ is odd, then $Z_{N_c}=Z($SU$(N_c))$ color center, we prove 3 families and 3 colors, $N_c=N_f=3$, is the unique case that stands out. We also prove that $A_{Z_3}p_1= 0\mod3$ for the mod 3 cohomology class in an appropriate context.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：拓扑场论、对称性扩展、群上同调、自旋配边群。；研究对象：标准模型中夸克和轻子恰好存在三代（家族）的“家族之谜”，以及与之相关的费米子反常、拓扑量子场论（TQFT）和颜色对称性扩展。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了标准模型中三代夸克和轻子的存在与颜色对称性扩展下的反常消除机制密切相关：在要求重子为费米子（即颜色中心为奇阶）的条件下，\(N_c=N_f=3\)（三色三代）是唯一自洽的解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了标准模型中三代夸克和轻子的存在与颜色对称性扩展下的反常消除机制密切相关：在要求重子为费米子（即颜色中心为奇阶）的条件下，\(N_c=N_f=3\)（三色三代）是唯一自洽的解。；创新点：提出用颜色对称性扩展构造的4维反常\(Z_{N_c}\)-规范TQFT来替代缺失的\(N_f\)份“惰性”右手中微子\(\nu_R\)，从而解释家族数；严格证明了在奇阶颜色中心条件下，\(N_c=N_f=3\)是唯一满足所有约束的整数解。
papers.method_zh: 利用5维自旋配边群对4维离散\(Z_n\)对称性下的费米子反常进行分类；通过群上同调\(H^d(Z_n,U(1))\)和庞特里亚金类\(p_1\)分析反常的拓扑性质；构造对称性扩展\(1\to Z_n\to Z_{n^2}\to Z_n\to1\)来平凡化上循环，并构建相应的边界TQFT；分析标准模型中混合\((\mathbf{B+L})\)-规范-引力反常的消除条件。

papers.title: Realization of the Ruby Lattice Antiferromagnet in Layered Transition-Metal Fluorides
papers.abstract: The antiferromagnet on the ruby lattice is expected to host a range of exotic emergent phenomena, yet its material realization has remained elusive. Here we show that the layered transition metal fluorides CsBaFe$_3$F$_{12}$ and CsBaCr$_3$F$_{12}$ with Fe$^{3+}$ and Cr$^{3+}$ ions realize only slightly distorted ruby lattice geometries with spin moments $S=5/2$ and $S=3/2$, respectively. Their microscopic Hamiltonians, calculated with DFT energy mapping, are dominated by short-ranged antiferromagnetic interactions within the ruby layers. Classical Monte Carlo simulations reveal strong frustration in both compounds, with local Néel correlations on the hexagonal plaquettes and distinct long-range ordering tendencies governed by weaker triangular links. For CsBaFe$_3$F$_{12}$, the calculated thermodynamic behaviour is consistent with the experimentally reported magnetic ordering scale. For CsBaCr$_3$F$_{12}$, classical Monte Carlo and Luttinger-Tisza analysis reveal competing low-energy ordering wave vectors, strong finite-size sensitivity, and a tendency toward incommensurate order. Overall, our results establish these fluorides as experimentally accessible ruby-lattice antiferromagnets and provide quantitative predictions for future neutron-scattering studies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算为主，辅以实验验证）。判断依据：DFT能量映射、经典蒙特卡洛模拟、Luttinger-Tisza分析等计算手段，并结合实验报道的磁有序标度进行验证。；研究对象：层状过渡金属氟化物CsBaFe₃F₁₂和CsBaCr₃F₁₂中的红宝石晶格反铁磁体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CsBaFe₃F₁₂和CsBaCr₃F₁₂分别以S=5/2和S=3/2的自旋矩实现了近乎完美的红宝石晶格几何，其微观哈密顿量由层内短程反铁磁相互作用主导，并表现出强阻挫特性。CsBaFe₃F₁₂的热力学行为与实验报道的磁有序标度一致，而CsBaCr₃F₁₂则显示出竞争性的低能有序波矢和趋向非公度有序的倾向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CsBaFe₃F₁₂和CsBaCr₃F₁₂分别以S=5/2和S=3/2的自旋矩实现了近乎完美的红宝石晶格几何，其微观哈密顿量由层内短程反铁磁相互作用主导，并表现出强阻挫特性。CsBaFe₃F₁₂的热力学行为与实验报道的磁有序标度一致，而CsBaCr₃F₁₂则显示出竞争性的低能有序波矢和趋向非公度有序的倾向。；创新点：首次在实验可及的层状过渡金属氟化物中实现了红宝石晶格反铁磁体，并提供了定量预测以指导未来中子散射实验。摘要未突出说明与已有理论模型或其它候选材料的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: DFT能量映射（计算微观哈密顿量）、经典蒙特卡洛模拟（研究阻挫与热力学行为）、Luttinger-Tisza分析（分析竞争有序波矢）。

papers.title: A GPU-based Solver for Polarization Dynamics in Ferroelectric Materials
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric materials can be used for the development of multiple device concepts combining non-volatility, small dimensions, low-power actuation, and electrical tunability. Such development demands efficient and precise design of simulation tools describing the polarization texture. However, most existing ferroelectric solvers are CPU-based and rely on simplified electrostatic treatments and reduced-dimensional representations of the polarization field. These approximations limit their ability to capture finite-size and boundary effects and restrict the range of domain structures and domain walls that can be realistically simulated. Here, we present a fully GPU (graphics processing units)-accelerated and scalable numerical solver, named PETASPIN_microelectrics, for computing the full polarization vector field of ferroelectric systems using the Ginzburg-Landau formalism. Our solver incorporates an optimized and validated calculation of the full electrostatic field and enables the parallel execution of multiple simulations. We systematically validated the solver with several benchmark problems, including phase transitions in BaTiO3 and ferroelectric domain wall profiles. Our simulations reproduce temperature-driven hysteretic phase transitions in BaTiO3. We also reproduce hysteresis loops and demonstrate stabilization of a three-dimensional hybrid skyrmion in a PbTiO3/SrTiO3 bilayer system. Our results show quantitative agreement with predictions from an analytical theory and prior experimental studies. The proposed solver provides an efficient, accurate platform for large-scale simulations of ferroelectric materials including stabilization of topological textures supporting predictive modeling for next-generation of ferroelectric device design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：GPU-accelerated solver、numerical solver、Ginzburg-Landau formalism。；研究对象：铁电材料中的极化动力学，具体包括BaTiO₃的相变、铁电畴壁轮廓，以及PbTiO₃/SrTiO₃双层体系中的三维混合斯格明子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发的全GPU加速求解器PETASPIN_microelectrics能够高效、准确地模拟铁电材料的全极化矢量场，定量复现了BaTiO₃的温度驱动滞后相变、电滞回线，并成功稳定了PbTiO₃/SrTiO₃双层中的三维混合斯格明子，结果与解析理论和实验研究定量一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发的全GPU加速求解器PETASPIN_microelectrics能够高效、准确地模拟铁电材料的全极化矢量场，定量复现了BaTiO₃的温度驱动滞后相变、电滞回线，并成功稳定了PbTiO₃/SrTiO₃双层中的三维混合斯格明子，结果与解析理论和实验研究定量一致。；创新点：该求解器完全基于GPU加速，克服了现有CPU求解器依赖简化静电处理和降维极化场表示的局限，能够更真实地捕捉有限尺寸效应和边界效应，并支持大规模并行模拟，为下一代铁电器件设计提供高效、精确的预测平台。
papers.method_zh: 基于Ginzburg-Landau形式论，采用全GPU加速的数值求解器（PETASPIN_microelectrics），包含优化且经过验证的全静电场计算，支持多模拟并行执行。通过BaTiO₃相变和铁电畴壁轮廓等基准问题进行系统验证。

papers.title: Synthesis and properties of bulk Mg$_3$WN$_4$ in a wurtzite-derived structure
papers.abstract: Experimental synthesis of theoretically predicted materials with controlled elemental coordination environments can lead to realization of useful properties, such as facile ion transport or ferroelectric switching. Among such materials are new ternary nitrides in the Mg-W-N composition space, where several new stable and metastable compounds have been predicted and synthesized recently in bulk and film forms. Here, we report for the first time on the bulk synthesis of Mg$_3$WN$_4$ in a wurtzite-derived crystal structure via a solid state metathesis reaction. $In$ $situ$ synchrotron powder X-ray diffraction shows how the ion exchange proceeds from Li$_6$WN$_4$ + 3 MgCl$_2$ precursors to Mg$_3$WN$_4$ + 6 LiCl products, with the reaction starting slowly near 380 $^\circ$C and completing by 600 $^\circ$C, including the presence of a competing disordered rocksalt-derived phase (Mg,W)N above 440 $^\circ$C. The follow up $ex$ $situ$ powder synthesis at 400 $^\circ$C for 0.5 hour with 10% excess MgCl$_2$ reveals the cation-ordered nature of the wurtzite-derived Mg$_3$WN$_4$ structure with polar symmetry confirmed by second harmonic generation measurements. Optical absorption spectra, chemical composition analysis, and electron microscopy imaging suggests that bulk wurtzite Mg$_3$WN$_4$ is prone to defect formation. Overall, this study shows that selective $ex$ $situ$ synthesis of the phase pure ternary nitrides, informed by \textit{in situ} measurements, is possible by carefully controlling the thermal budget of the reaction, and paves a way towards property characterization of wurtzite Mg$_3$WN$_4$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：bulk synthesis、solid state metathesis reaction、in situ synchrotron powder X-ray diffraction、ex situ powder synthesis、second harmonic generation measurements。；研究对象：三元氮化物Mg₃WN₄，具体为在纤锌矿衍生结构中的块体合成及其性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次通过固态复分解反应成功合成了块体纤锌矿衍生结构的Mg₃WN₄，并发现该材料具有极性对称性（由二次谐波产生测量证实），但易形成缺陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次通过固态复分解反应成功合成了块体纤锌矿衍生结构的Mg₃WN₄，并发现该材料具有极性对称性（由二次谐波产生测量证实），但易形成缺陷。；创新点：首次报道了块体纤锌矿衍生结构Mg₃WN₄的合成，并通过原位与非原位结合的方法实现了相纯三元氮化物的选择性合成，为后续性质表征铺平了道路。
papers.method_zh: 固态复分解反应（Li₆WN₄ + 3 MgCl₂ → Mg₃WN₄ + 6 LiCl）；原位同步辐射粉末X射线衍射（监测反应进程，380°C开始，600°C完成，中间出现竞争相）；非原位粉末合成（400°C、0.5小时、10%过量MgCl₂）；二次谐波产生测量（确认极性对称性）；光学吸收光谱、化学成分分析、电子显微镜成像（表征缺陷形成）。

papers.title: Non-invertible symmetry enriched string net topological orders
papers.abstract: We propose a definition of a non-invertible symmetry enriched topological order (NI-SETO), and we implement our definition for string net models. We do so in two ways, using full inclusions of unitary fusion categories (UFCs), as well as anyon condensation. In both cases, the NI-SETO is a relative center of UFCs. All NI-SETOs can be realized in either model, where we can use enriched UFCs to get chiral examples on the boundary of a 3D Walker-Wang model representing the anomaly. We describe several examples of NI-SETOs and compute the qualitative symmetry action on anyons and symmetry defects using tube algebra techniques.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“定义”、“实现”、“相对中心”、“管代数技术”等理论框架和数学工具，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：非可逆对称性富集的弦网拓扑序（NI-SETO）。具体体系为弦网模型（string net models），以及作为边界的3D Walker-Wang模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种非可逆对称性富集拓扑序（NI-SETO）的定义，并证明所有NI-SETO均可通过幺正融合范畴（UFC）的相对中心实现，且可在弦网模型或通过任意子凝聚两种方式构造。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种非可逆对称性富集拓扑序（NI-SETO）的定义，并证明所有NI-SETO均可通过幺正融合范畴（UFC）的相对中心实现，且可在弦网模型或通过任意子凝聚两种方式构造。；创新点：首次给出了非可逆对称性富集拓扑序（NI-SETO）的严格定义，并将其与UFC的相对中心建立联系，同时展示了在弦网模型和Walker-Wang模型边界上实现手征性例子的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：利用幺正融合范畴（UFC）的全包含（full inclusion）以及任意子凝聚（anyon condensation）两种方式实现NI-SETO的定义；使用管代数（tube algebra）技术计算任意子和对称缺陷上的定性对称性作用。

papers.title: Multiscale Vectorial Determination of Magnetic Order Parameters using Electron Magnetic Linear Dichroism
papers.abstract: We demonstrate electron magnetic linear dichroism as a quantitative probe of vectorial magnetic order parameters with nanometer resolution in transmission electron microscopy. Explicit inclusion of vectorial core-level exchange splitting into mixed dynamic form factor simulations accounting for dynamical diffraction enables direct reconstruction of the magnetic spin axis from momentum-resolved electron energy-loss spectra. The resulting dichroic signal is intrinsically separable from nonmagnetic anisotropy, exhibits a well-defined dependence on the Néel vector or magnetization orientation, and remains robust down to the atomic scale. Applied to the collinear antiferromagnetic and ferromagnetic phase of cubic FeRh, this approach allows quantitative real-space mapping of the magnetic vector. These results open a pathway to nanoscale spectroscopy and imaging of antiferromagnets and altermagnets where the generalized approach to electron dichroism provides direct access to different magnetic order parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrate、transmission electron microscopy、electron energy-loss spectra、applied to cubic FeRh）；研究对象：立方相FeRh的共线反铁磁和铁磁相中的磁有序参数（Néel矢量或磁化方向），以及更广义的反铁磁和交变磁体中的磁有序参数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子磁线性二色性可作为定量探测矢量磁有序参数的探针，在透射电子显微镜中实现纳米级分辨率，并可直接从动量分辨电子能量损失谱重建磁自旋轴。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子磁线性二色性可作为定量探测矢量磁有序参数的探针，在透射电子显微镜中实现纳米级分辨率，并可直接从动量分辨电子能量损失谱重建磁自旋轴。；创新点：首次将电子磁线性二色性发展为定量、矢量化的磁有序参数探测手段，其二色信号可与非磁性各向异性本征地分离，对Néel矢量或磁化方向具有明确依赖关系，且可保持至原子尺度。
papers.method_zh: 透射电子显微镜中的电子磁线性二色性实验，结合考虑动力学衍射的混合动态形状因子模拟，显式包含矢量级芯能级交换分裂。

papers.title: Avoided Stoner instability at a single ordinary Van Hove point
papers.abstract: When the Fermi surface and the Brillouin zone boundary touch at a Van Hove point, mean-field analysis predicts a ferromagnetic (Stoner) instability at finite $T_{MF}$ for any coupling strength due to the divergent density of states. However, the predicted effect has not been observed experimentally. Several qualitative theoretical proposals have been put forward to explain why the mean-field prediction fails. Based on numerically exact results for the two-dimensional Hubbard model with an ordinary Van Hove singularity, we uncover the mechanisms behind the suppression of the ferromagnetic instability. We employ two diagrammatic Monte Carlo approaches: (i) the four-channel self-consistent approximation and (ii) numerically exact method of combinatorial summation of diagrams with controlled resummation of the truncated expansion. We find that the system avoids the Stoner instability down to temperatures an order of magnitude below $T_{MF}$ due to the combination of the downward renormalization of the effective coupling and the suppression of the density of states by the loss of the quasiparticle residue.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：numerically exact results、diagrammatic Monte Carlo approaches、mean-field analysis。；研究对象：二维Hubbard模型中普通Van Hove奇点处的铁磁（Stoner）不稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统通过有效耦合的下行重整化以及准粒子权重损失导致的态密度抑制，将Stoner不稳定性抑制到远低于平均场预言的转变温度（低一个数量级）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统通过有效耦合的下行重整化以及准粒子权重损失导致的态密度抑制，将Stoner不稳定性抑制到远低于平均场预言的转变温度（低一个数量级）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 两种图解蒙特卡洛方法：(i) 四通道自洽近似；(ii) 数值精确的组合求和法（对截断展开进行受控重求和）。

papers.title: Absolute measurement of penetration depth of superconducting thin films using microwave stripline resonators
papers.abstract: Superconducting microstrip resonators, which leverage kinetic inductance to probe electrodynamics, are sensitive tools for studying superconducting thin films at microwave frequencies. However, extracting the absolute superconducting penetration depth from these measurements remains challenging. In this work, we present a hybrid method to determine the absolute value of penetration depth over a wide temperature range by combining resonator measurements with finite-element electromagnetic simulations in COMSOL Multiphysics. We demonstrate this approach by extracting the penetration depth of NbN films by fabricating resonators from films of various thicknesses. Furthermore, we extend the technique to materials with lower critical temperatures by employing a flip-film geometry. By placing a sample above a NbN resonator, separated by a thin Mylar dielectric, we create a coupled structure where changes in the sample's penetration depth shift the resonant frequency. This non-destructive method provides a reliable, high-sensitivity platform for characterizing the penetration depth of diverse superconducting thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“measurement”、“fabricating resonators”、“finite-element electromagnetic simulations in COMSOL Multiphysics”表明结合了实验测量与仿真模拟。；研究对象：超导薄膜（具体为NbN薄膜）的穿透深度（penetration depth）的绝对测量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种混合方法，通过结合微波微带谐振器测量与有限元电磁仿真，能够在宽温度范围内绝对测量超导薄膜的穿透深度，并成功应用于不同厚度的NbN薄膜以及通过翻转薄膜结构（flip-film geometry）测量低临界温度材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种混合方法，通过结合微波微带谐振器测量与有限元电磁仿真，能够在宽温度范围内绝对测量超导薄膜的穿透深度，并成功应用于不同厚度的NbN薄膜以及通过翻转薄膜结构（flip-film geometry）测量低临界温度材料。；创新点：解决了从微波谐振器测量中提取绝对穿透深度值的难题，并发展了一种非破坏性的翻转薄膜方法，可适用于多种超导薄膜材料（包括低Tc材料）。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用超导微带谐振器（利用其动能电感），结合COMSOL Multiphysics有限元电磁仿真进行数据提取。对于低临界温度材料，采用翻转薄膜结构：将待测样品置于NbN谐振器上方，中间用薄Mylar介质层隔开，通过谐振频率变化反推样品穿透深度。

papers.title: Universal Stability of Ga Split Vacancies across α-, β-, and κ-Ga2O3 Polymorphs: A Machine-Learning Accelerated Study
papers.abstract: Split Ga vacancies are the dominant native acceptor in $β$-$Ga_2O_3$; however, their role in $α$ and $κ$ phases has been largely overlooked or assumed to be unfavorable. A detailed understanding of these defects is critical for tailoring the electrical conductivity and optical properties and optimising $Ga_2O_3$-based devices. In this work, we used machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) to accelerate the discovery of non-local defect reconstructions, followed by HSE06 hybrid DFT to accurately quantify defect properties of single vacancy $V_{\text{Ga}}$, split vacancy $V_{\text{Ga}}^{\text{i}}$ and substitutional donors ($\mathrm{Hf_{Ga}}$ and $\mathrm{Si_{Ga}}$) across a wide range of experimentally relevant conditions for the oxygen chemical potential. We find that split vacancies are the ground-state vacancy for all studied polymorphs ($β$, $α$, and $κ$). Split vacancies are more stable than simple vacancies by ~0.75 eV ($β$), ~0.41 eV ($α$), and ~0.14 eV ($κ$). Notably, MLIPs correctly identified the specific split-vacancy ground states and yielded an energetic ordering of symmetry-inequivalent defect configurations in excellent agreement with HSE06 results. While Hf and Si show low formation energy and act as shallow donors, especially under oxygen-poor conditions, their efficiency is limited by split-vacancy compensation. The growth under oxygen-poor conditions is a universal requirement to suppress these defects and achieve high n-type conductivity across the $Ga_2O_3$ polymorph.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用了机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）加速发现，并结合HSE06混合泛函密度泛函理论（DFT）进行精确计算。；研究对象：Ga₂O₃三种多晶型（α、β、κ）中的镓分裂空位缺陷（split Ga vacancies）及其对电导率和光学性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在所有研究的α、β、κ三种多晶型中，分裂空位（split vacancy）都是基态空位缺陷，其稳定性显著高于简单空位（simple vacancy），且氧贫乏条件是抑制这些缺陷、实现高n型电导率的普适要求。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在所有研究的α、β、κ三种多晶型中，分裂空位（split vacancy）都是基态空位缺陷，其稳定性显著高于简单空位（simple vacancy），且氧贫乏条件是抑制这些缺陷、实现高n型电导率的普适要求。；创新点：首次系统揭示了分裂空位在α和κ相Ga₂O₃中同样为基态空位缺陷（此前常被忽视或认为不利），并证明了MLIPs能够正确识别分裂空位的具体基态构型及其能量排序，与HSE06结果高度一致。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）加速非局域缺陷重构的发现，随后采用HSE06混合泛函密度泛函理论（DFT）精确量化单空位（V_Ga）、分裂空位（V_Ga^i）以及替代施主（Hf_Ga和Si_Ga）的缺陷性质，并考虑了氧化学势的广泛实验相关条件。

papers.title: Odd spin symmetry and anisotropy switching in p-wave magnet CeNiAsO
papers.abstract: Odd-parity magnets, complementary to altermagnets, exhibit unique properties such as high efficiency in charge-spin conversion and compatibility with conventional superconductivity, of critical importance in the pursuit of energy-efficient spintronics and topological superconductors for quantum computation. For even-parity d-wave and g-wave altermagnets, the magnetic structure, spin-split band structure and physical properties are currently under intensive study. On the contrary, while hundreds of odd-parity magnets and the promising properties have been predicted in theory, experimental studies are scarce. Specifically, the magnetic structure and transport properties of candidates NiI2 and Ga3Ru4Al12 have been reported, yet the characteristic band structure and particularly the odd-parity spin symmetry remain elusive. Here we demonstrate experimentally the deterministic p-wave spin symmetry and resistance anisotropy switching for the prototype odd-parity magnet, CeNiAsO. Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) reveals two cleaved terminations with distinct surface band structure. By compensating the polar surface, we achieve intrinsic bulk band structure, for which the spin splitting can be well described by the p-wave magnetic structure through first-principles calculation. The bulk spin polarization measured by spin-resolved ARPES exhibits symmetry with only one degenerate plane, fingerprint of p-wave magnetism. We further demonstrate giant resistance anisotropy and switching between high-resistance and low-resistance states through modest field-induced domain selection, highlighting its potential for antiferromagnetic spin memory devices. The structural similarity between CeNiAsO and 1111-type Fe-based superconductors stimulates further exploration on the interplay between p-wave magnetism, superconductivity and band topology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：ARPES、spin-resolved ARPES、实验演示、电阻各向异性开关）；研究对象：奇宇称p波磁体CeNiAsO的磁结构、自旋对称性及输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验证实了原型奇宇称磁体CeNiAsO具有确定的p波自旋对称性，并实现了电阻各向异性的可逆开关，展示了其在反铁磁自旋存储器件中的潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验证实了原型奇宇称磁体CeNiAsO具有确定的p波自旋对称性，并实现了电阻各向异性的可逆开关，展示了其在反铁磁自旋存储器件中的潜力。；创新点：首次通过实验直接观测到奇宇称p波磁体的特征自旋对称性（仅有一个退化平面的自旋极化对称性），并实现了基于磁畴控制的巨大电阻各向异性开关效应。
papers.method_zh: 角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）探测表面能带结构；自旋分辨ARPES测量体相自旋极化；第一性原理计算描述p波磁结构下的自旋劈裂；通过磁场诱导磁畴选择实现电阻各向异性开关。

papers.title: Magnetic order, magnons, and crystal fields in van der Waals CeSiI
papers.abstract: We report neutron, X-ray absorption, and resonant X-ray spectroscopy of magnetic excitations in the new heavy-fermion van-der-Waals superconductor CeSiI. We determined effective Hamiltonians and ground states of crystal electric fields and magnons. Isotropic Heisenberg interactions on a quasi two dimensional lattice, including ferromagnetic nearest-neighbor exchange as the dominant interaction, provide an excellent account to the low-energy measured dynamics and stabilize a co-rotating spin cycloid. Our study provides the basis to model CeSiI from first principles, thereby laying the ground for microscopic understanding of heavy-fermion physics, their unconventional superconductivity, and quantum criticality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：neutron, X-ray absorption, resonant X-ray spectroscopy）；研究对象：新型重费米子范德瓦尔斯超导体CeSiI中的磁有序、磁振子与晶体场。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 确定了CeSiI的晶体电场基态与有效哈密顿量，发现准二维晶格上的各向同性海森堡相互作用（以铁磁最近邻交换为主导）能很好地描述低能动力学，并稳定一种共旋自旋摆线结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：确定了CeSiI的晶体电场基态与有效哈密顿量，发现准二维晶格上的各向同性海森堡相互作用（以铁磁最近邻交换为主导）能很好地描述低能动力学，并稳定一种共旋自旋摆线结构。；创新点：首次在重费米子范德瓦尔斯超导体CeSiI中系统确定了磁有序、磁振子与晶体场参数，为从第一性原理建模该材料、理解重费米子物理、非常规超导及量子临界性提供了微观基础。
papers.method_zh: 中子散射、X射线吸收谱、共振X射线谱（用于测量磁激发）；结合有效哈密顿量建模与准二维晶格上的海森堡相互作用分析。

papers.title: Topological lattice gauge theory enriched by non-invertible symmetry
papers.abstract: We use finite group topological lattice gauge theory, also known as the quantum double model, as a lens to explore a notion of topological order enriched by a non-invertible symmetry. For invertible symmetry enriched topological order, there is an established axiomatisation in terms of a G-crossed braided fusion category. We lay the foundations for a generalisation of this notion. By condensing an arbitrary algebra of charges in a quantum double model, we demonstrate that the category of localised excitations in the resulting theory forms a hypergroup-graded extension of the category of deconfined excitations. For every element in the hypergroup, the associated domain wall acts in a typically non-invertible way on these localised excitations. Both this action and the monoidal structure are compatible with the hypergroup grading. The actual categorical action is encoded in a Hopf monad on the category of localised excitations, and gauging the non-invertible symmetry amounts to computing the category of modules over this Hopf monad. Finally, we outline how this framework naturally extends to theories obtained by condensing algebras in a generic string-net model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：拓扑规范场论、范畴化、Hopf 单子、代数凝聚。；研究对象：非可逆对称性（non-invertible symmetry）富集的拓扑序，具体以有限群拓扑格点规范场论（量子双模型）为研究体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在量子双模型中凝聚任意电荷代数，局域激发的范畴形成超群（hypergroup）分次的退禁闭激发范畴的扩张；该超群中的每个元素对应的畴壁对局域激发的作用通常是非可逆的，且该作用与幺半结构均与超群分次相容。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在量子双模型中凝聚任意电荷代数，局域激发的范畴形成超群（hypergroup）分次的退禁闭激发范畴的扩张；该超群中的每个元素对应的畴壁对局域激发的作用通常是非可逆的，且该作用与幺半结构均与超群分次相容。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用范畴化理论框架，具体包括：在量子双模型中通过凝聚任意电荷代数构造新理论，利用超群分次扩展描述激发范畴，并引入Hopf单子编码非可逆对称性的范畴作用，最后通过计算该Hopf单子上的模范畴实现非可逆对称性的规范。

papers.title: Determinants of Phase-Separation Propensities, Material States, and Material Properties of Biomolecular Condensates
papers.abstract: Phase separation of various materials has been studied for one and a half centuries. In the last two decades, phase separation of proteins and nucleic acids has received enormous attention, due its relevance to cellular functions. However, many of the observations on the resulting biomolecular condensates lack a theoretical underpinning. The first goal of this Account is to put forward theoretical frameworks for the phase-separation propensities, material states, and material properties of biomolecular condensates. Using these frameworks, I rationalize mechanistic interpretations from our recent experimental and computational studies, and synthesize these studies with prior literature to draw new conclusions. For phase-separation propensities, I relate the threshold (or saturation) concentration to the excess chemical potential in the dense phase, which in turn depends on intermolecular interaction strength and valency. For material states, I posit that liquid droplets form via complete phase separation, whereas amorphous dense liquids, reversible aggregates, and gels arise from premature termination of spinodal decomposition, due to overly weak or overly strong interactions or directional interactions. In particular, gels and aggregates are different forms of dynamically arrested states, with gels driven by tip growth via directional interactions whereas aggregates driven by monomer addition at interior sites to maximize valency. For material properties, I highlight the crucial roles of the stress relaxation time, which is determined by the mean lifetime of intermolecular bonds in a condensate. This relaxation time dictates how the condensate manifests viscoelasticity, including shear thickening and shear thinning, and accounts for the wide variation in zero-shear viscosity among different condensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有对实验和计算研究的综合评述）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“put forward theoretical frameworks”（提出理论框架），并利用该框架“rationalize mechanistic interpretations from our recent experimental and computational studies”（合理化我们近期实验和计算研究的机制解释）。；研究对象：生物分子凝聚体（biomolecular condensates）的相分离倾向、材料状态（液态、凝胶、聚集体等）以及材料性质（如粘弹性）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文建立了将相分离阈值浓度与稠密相中过量化学势（取决于分子间相互作用强度和价数）联系起来的理论框架；指出液滴通过完全相分离形成，而凝胶和聚集体是旋节线分解过早终止导致的动力学阻滞态，其区别在于驱动机制（凝胶由定向相互作用的尖端生长驱动，聚集体由内部位点单体添加以最大化价数驱动）；强调应力松弛时间（由分子间键的平均寿命决定）是决定凝聚体粘弹性（如剪切增稠、剪切稀化）和零剪切粘度差异的关键因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文建立了将相分离阈值浓度与稠密相中过量化学势（取决于分子间相互作用强度和价数）联系起来的理论框架；指出液滴通过完全相分离形成，而凝胶和聚集体是旋节线分解过早终止导致的动力学阻滞态，其区别在于驱动机制（凝胶由定向相互作用的尖端生长驱动，聚集体由内部位点单体添加以最大化价数驱动）；强调应力松弛时间（由分子间键的平均寿命决定）是决定凝聚体粘弹性（如剪切增稠、剪切稀化）和零剪切粘度差异的关键因素。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新在于：1）将相分离倾向、材料状态和材料性质统一在一个理论框架下进行解释；2）对凝胶和聚集体作为不同形式的动力学阻滞态给出了基于分子间相互作用方向性和价数的明确区分机制；3）系统阐明了应力松弛时间在决定凝聚体宏观粘弹性行为中的核心作用。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架构建。具体包括：1）通过过量化学势分析相分离倾向；2）通过旋节线分解的终止机制区分不同材料状态（液态、凝胶、聚集体）；3）通过应力松弛时间（分子间键平均寿命）分析材料粘弹性。

papers.title: Geometric Origin of Macroscopic Alignment in Granular Flows
papers.abstract: Predicting the alignment of non-spherical particles in dense granular flows under shear remains a central challenge in soft matter physics. We demonstrate that the first-order behavior of granular fabric,the anisotropic distribution of contacts, is a direct consequence of particle boundary geometry. By assuming uniform contact probability along a particle's perimeter, we derive a mapping between local curvature and the macroscopic distribution of contact normals. This minimal geometric framework accurately predicts the uniaxial nematic order parameter S2 observed in both three-dimensional discrete element simulations and laboratory experiments using various particle geometries (e.g., rice, fibers, and disks) across a wide range of aspect ratios. Our results show that particle shape dictates the available orientation statistics, providing a purely geometric baseline for the emergence of fabric in dense granular systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：demonstrate、derive、mapping、geometric framework）；研究对象：密集颗粒流中非球形颗粒的宏观排列（fabric）与接触法向分布，具体涉及不同几何形状的颗粒（如米粒、纤维、圆盘）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 颗粒接触的宏观各向异性（即颗粒织构）的一阶行为直接源于颗粒边界的局部几何曲率，通过假设沿颗粒周界接触概率均匀，可仅从颗粒形状预测出单轴取向序参数S2。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：颗粒接触的宏观各向异性（即颗粒织构）的一阶行为直接源于颗粒边界的局部几何曲率，通过假设沿颗粒周界接触概率均匀，可仅从颗粒形状预测出单轴取向序参数S2。；创新点：提出了一个纯几何的基线模型，证明颗粒形状本身决定了可用的取向统计，无需引入复杂的力学或摩擦假设即可解释密集颗粒流中织构的涌现。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（基于颗粒周界曲率与接触法向的几何映射），并结合三维离散元模拟（DEM）与已有实验室实验数据验证。

papers.title: Photon correlation microscopy of quantum matter
papers.abstract: Light and matter share fundamental statistical properties, yet the experimental probes of quantum optics and many-body physics have largely evolved along separate trajectories. While many-body physics explores emergent collective phenomena, quantum optics has refined the measurement of correlations between individual photons. Here, we introduce photon correlation microscopy (PCM) - which bridges the two domains by leveraging correlations of emitted light to probe the correlations in quantum matter at mesoscopic scales. We demonstrate this approach using a one-dimensional (1D) ensemble of dipolar excitons confined at a lateral monolayer MoSe$_2$-WSe$_2$ heterojunction. We use gate-defined potentials to confine the 1D excitons to a mesoscopic lengthscale to enhance the visibility of matter correlations in the emitted photon field. Power-dependent spectroscopy reveals a transition from a compressible to an incompressible phase, signaled by the simultaneous saturation of the emission intensity and energy blueshift, which is supported by numerical simulations. Through this crossover, photon correlation measurements show a striking evolution from bunching at low densities to antibunching at high densities. This constitutes a many-body blockade of photon emission emerging directly from a number-stabilized state, driven by collective dipolar repulsion. Our results establish PCM as a powerful probe of many-body physics through the lens of quantum optics, extensible to a broad class of correlated electronic phases, while pointing toward a route to generating non-classical light through many-body correlations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrate、spectroscopy、measurements、numerical simulations）；研究对象：一维偶极激子体系，具体为横向单层MoSe₂-WSe₂异质结中通过门电压势垒限制的介观尺度激子系综，以及其从可压缩相到不可压缩相的转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过光子关联测量，观察到从低密度下的光子聚束到高密度下的反聚束的显著演化，揭示了由集体偶极排斥驱动的数稳定化态所导致的多体光子发射阻塞效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过光子关联测量，观察到从低密度下的光子聚束到高密度下的反聚束的显著演化，揭示了由集体偶极排斥驱动的数稳定化态所导致的多体光子发射阻塞效应。；创新点：将量子光学中的光子关联测量方法引入多体物理研究，通过探测发射光子的统计性质来直接揭示介观尺度量子物质中的关联行为，并展示了利用多体关联产生非经典光的途径。
papers.method_zh: 光子关联显微术（PCM）；功率依赖光谱学；数值模拟（摘要未明确具体计算方法，如是否使用DMRG等）。

papers.title: Ultrafast dynamics of excitons in black phosphorus
papers.abstract: Excitons are key quasiparticles determining the optical properties of solids. As such, they can be utilized to coherently control the electronic structure of materials using optical femtosecond pulses. Identifying the decoherence mechanism during the early non-equilibrium dynamics is crucial to achieve light-induced band-structure engineering in semiconductors. Here, we generate excitons in the direct band gap semiconductor black phosphorus with a resonant mid-infrared photoexcitation. Using time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we track their complex ultrafast dynamics on the few-picosecond time scale. We develop a quantum-kinetic theoretical framework to model the decoherence of excitons into dark excitons via phonon scattering. By combining simulation and experiment, we quantify key parameters describing the early dynamics of the excitons. Our work highlights phonon-mediated intravalley scattering as a fundamental limitation for coherent exciton phenomena in single-valley semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论）。判断依据：摘要中同时使用了“时间分辨和角分辨光电子能谱”（实验手段）和“量子动力学理论框架”（理论建模）。；研究对象：直接带隙半导体黑磷中的激子，特别是其超快非平衡动力学过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过共振中红外光激发产生的激子，在皮秒时间尺度上通过声子散射退相干为暗激子；声子介导的谷内散射是单谷半导体中相干激子现象的基本限制因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过共振中红外光激发产生的激子，在皮秒时间尺度上通过声子散射退相干为暗激子；声子介导的谷内散射是单谷半导体中相干激子现象的基本限制因素。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用时间分辨和角分辨光电子能谱（tr-ARPES）追踪激子动力学；理论上构建了量子动力学理论框架，用于模拟激子通过声子散射退相干为暗激子的过程。

papers.title: Fractional short-time dynamics in driven quantum gases
papers.abstract: Quantum gases with short-range attractive interaction have a tendency to form pairs. For time-dependent interaction we find that the pairing amplitude at small separation satisfies a fractional differential equation (FDE). We derive analytic solutions of the pairing evolution for sudden interaction quenches and power-law drives toward resonant scattering. We observe universal short-time dynamics governed by a conformal fixed point at which the momentum distribution exhibits nonthermal, self-similar scaling in time, in quantitative agreement with experiment. At longer times, many-body effects induce relaxation toward an equilibrium state. In this limit, the FDE turns into a Müller-Israel-Stewart type equation that describes a hydrodynamic attractor approaching equilibrium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“推导解析解”“满足分数阶微分方程”“理论框架”等关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：具有短程吸引相互作用的量子气体，在时间依赖相互作用下的配对动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在短时间尺度下，量子气体中配对振幅的演化满足分数阶微分方程，并表现出由共形固定点控制的普适动力学，其动量分布呈现非热、自相似的时间标度行为，与实验定量吻合；长时间尺度下，该方程退化为描述流体动力学吸引子的Müller-Israel-Stewart型方程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在短时间尺度下，量子气体中配对振幅的演化满足分数阶微分方程，并表现出由共形固定点控制的普适动力学，其动量分布呈现非热、自相似的时间标度行为，与实验定量吻合；长时间尺度下，该方程退化为描述流体动力学吸引子的Müller-Israel-Stewart型方程。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析推导。具体包括：对突然淬火和幂律驱动至共振散射的相互作用演化，求解配对振幅的分数阶微分方程；利用共形场论分析短时间标度行为；在长时间极限下将分数阶方程转化为Müller-Israel-Stewart型流体动力学方程。

papers.title: Thermodynamic properties of chemically disordered compounds via AI-driven estimation of partition function with the PULSE method
papers.abstract: In this article, we present an improved version of the PULSE method (Partition function Unsupervised Learning Sampling and Evaluation) for estimating the thermodynamic properties of chemically disordered compounds. The aim is to reduce the computational cost of Monte Carlo approaches for this type of material and to demonstrate that this generative tool can estimate thermodynamic properties by sampling and estimating the partition function of the system. To validate this innovative approach, we use the 2D Ising model as a benchmark. We demonstrate that our method accurately reproduces average properties with high precision and efficiency compared to traditional Monte Carlo sampling methods. Our results highlight the efficiency and adaptability of the PULSE method, making it a valuable tool for studying materials for which conventional methods are too inefficient to compute properties affected by chemical disorder at low cost.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“Monte Carlo approaches”、“generative tool”、“sampling and estimating the partition function”。；研究对象：化学无序化合物（chemically disordered compounds）的热力学性质，并以二维伊辛模型（2D Ising model）作为基准验证体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 改进后的PULSE方法能够以高精度和高效率重现化学无序化合物的平均热力学性质，相比传统蒙特卡洛方法显著降低了计算成本。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：改进后的PULSE方法能够以高精度和高效率重现化学无序化合物的平均热力学性质，相比传统蒙特卡洛方法显著降低了计算成本。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用改进的PULSE方法（Partition function Unsupervised Learning Sampling and Evaluation），这是一种基于无监督学习的生成式工具，用于对系统的配分函数进行采样和估计，从而计算热力学性质。

papers.title: Third rank permeability in chiral solids
papers.abstract: Effects of a third rank permeability term in chiral solids are studied. Fluid flow through such materials acquires vorticity upon emergence from the material. Materials of interest include chiral surface lattices such as the gyroid, chiral rib lattices, and granular materials comprised of sugar crystals, quartz sand, wheat or beans. A characteristic length scale is associated with the chirality. The length scale can be obtained by several methods. Contacts with nonlocal permeability, elasticity and piezoelectricity are explored.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Effects are studied, explored（理论分析）。；研究对象：手性固体中的三阶渗透率张量，以及由此引发的流体动力学现象。具体材料包括手性表面晶格（如螺旋体）、手性肋状晶格，以及由糖晶体、石英砂、小麦或豆类组成的颗粒材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当流体通过手性固体时，在流出材料后会获得涡度（vorticity）。手性特征与一个特征长度尺度相关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当流体通过手性固体时，在流出材料后会获得涡度（vorticity）。手性特征与一个特征长度尺度相关联。；创新点：研究了手性固体中三阶渗透率项（Third rank permeability）的物理效应，并建立了其与涡度产生、特征长度尺度以及非局域输运、弹性、压电等物理概念的关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。通过多种方法获取与手性相关的特征长度尺度，并探讨了三阶渗透率与非局域渗透率、弹性以及压电效应之间的联系。

papers.title: Electron-beam induced methane decomposition for in-situ carbon doping of hexagonal boron nitride
papers.abstract: Controlling the spatial incorporation of carbon into hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) is essential for engineering optically active defects, yet existing approaches lack nanoscale precision and control over the carbon supply. Here, we demonstrate a method for carbon doping of hBN using electron-beam irradiation in a low-pressure methane atmosphere, where the beam simultaneously generates vacancies and decomposes methane into individual carbon and hydrogen atoms. Using annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy, we show that increasing the methane partial pressure suppresses pore growth and drives the formation of triangular boron-terminated pores through preferential hydrogen etching of nitrogen. Time-resolved electron energy-loss spectroscopy (EELS) mapping reveals progressive carbon incorporation into the lattice, accompanied by boron and nitrogen depletion. Carbon clustering occurs predominantly within the irradiated area: 84+-7% of carbon-rich regions are confined to the area exposed to the electron beam, while some carbon atoms are also found to diffuse up to an average distance of 4.7+-0.5 nm beyond it. The incorporated carbon atoms arrange in a hexagonal pattern within the lattice, forming patches that do not exceed ~1 nm in size. Analysis of the EELS fine structure indicates modifications to the local electronic environment within these regions, with implications for the optical properties of the resulting carbon-related defects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：electron-beam irradiation、scanning transmission electron microscopy、electron energy-loss spectroscopy。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中碳掺杂的纳米级空间控制，具体为通过电子束诱导甲烷分解实现原位碳掺杂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低压甲烷气氛下，电子束辐照可同时产生空位并分解甲烷，实现碳原子在hBN晶格中的局域掺杂，碳原子主要（84±7%）局限于辐照区域，形成尺寸不超过~1 nm的六方排列碳团簇，并改变局域电子环境。
