papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低压甲烷气氛下，电子束辐照可同时产生空位并分解甲烷，实现碳原子在hBN晶格中的局域掺杂，碳原子主要（84±7%）局限于辐照区域，形成尺寸不超过~1 nm的六方排列碳团簇，并改变局域电子环境。；创新点：实现了在纳米尺度上对碳掺杂位置和碳源供给的精确控制，克服了现有方法缺乏纳米级精度的局限；揭示了甲烷分压对孔隙生长和氮优先刻蚀的调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 主要实验手段：环形暗场扫描透射电子显微镜（ADF-STEM）观察孔隙形貌；时间分辨电子能量损失谱（EELS）映射碳掺入过程及元素分布；EELS精细结构分析局域电子环境变化。

papers.title: Anisotropic magnetism and Kondo-lattice behavior in the frustrated antiferromagnet Ce3MgBi5
papers.abstract: We report the synthesis and physical characterization of single-crystalline Ce3MgBi5, a previously unexplored member of the Ce3MPn5 family. This compound crystallizes in the hexagonal P63/mcm structure, featuring an anisotropic Ce sublattice composed of zig-zag chains along the c axis and a distorted kagome-like network in the basal plane. Magnetization measurements reveal antiferromagnetic order below TN approximately 4.2 K, accompanied by strong magnetic anisotropy and multiple field-induced metamagnetic transitions for fields applied perpendicular to [001], leading to a dome-shaped H-T phase diagram. Electrical transport exhibits characteristic signatures of a Ce-based Kondo lattice, including broad resistivity maxima and pronounced field-dependent anomalies in the magnetoresistance and Hall response that track the magnetic phase boundaries. Specific-heat measurements confirm the magnetic transition and show that the full R ln 2 entropy expected for a Ce3+ Kramers doublet is recovered by 20 K, indicating an extended temperature range of magnetic fluctuations consistent with Kondo correlations. Our results establish Ce3MgBi5 as a platform within the Ce3MPn5 family for exploring the interplay of geometric frustration, magnetic anisotropy, and Kondo-lattice physics under applied magnetic fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词为“synthesis”（合成）、“physical characterization”（物理表征）、“Magnetization measurements”（磁化测量）、“Electrical transport”（电输运）、“Specific-heat measurements”（比热测量）。；研究对象：一种新型铈基化合物Ce3MgBi5，属于Ce3MPn5家族。具体研究其晶体结构、磁有序、磁各向异性、场致相变以及Kondo晶格行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ce3MgBi5在约4.2 K以下形成反铁磁有序，具有强磁各向异性和多个场致变磁相变，同时表现出典型的Ce基Kondo晶格行为，为研究几何阻挫、磁各向异性和Kondo晶格物理的相互作用提供了新平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ce3MgBi5在约4.2 K以下形成反铁磁有序，具有强磁各向异性和多个场致变磁相变，同时表现出典型的Ce基Kondo晶格行为，为研究几何阻挫、磁各向异性和Kondo晶格物理的相互作用提供了新平台。；创新点：首次合成了Ce3MgBi5单晶并对其物理性质进行了系统表征，揭示了该化合物中反铁磁序、强磁各向异性、场致变磁相变与Kondo晶格行为共存的独特物理图景。
papers.method_zh: 单晶合成、磁化率与磁化强度测量、电输运测量（电阻率、磁电阻、霍尔效应）、比热测量。

papers.title: Electrically driven Rabi dynamics of magnetic-field-induced corner states in a two-dimensional topological insulator
papers.abstract: We study coherent electric manipulation of magnetic-field-induced localized states at a double kink of a helical edge in a HgTe/CdHgTe quantum well. An in-plane magnetic field opens a gap in the one-dimensional edge spectrum, while changes in the edge orientation generate localized in-gap states at the kinks. We show that, for suitable geometry and magnetic-field direction, two such states form an effective lithographically defined two-level subsystem. Using an edge-state model that includes both the localized levels and the continuum states outside the magnetic-field-induced gap, we calculate the electric-dipole matrix elements and solve the time-dependent problem under resonant driving. The resulting dynamics exhibits Rabi oscillations with linear frequencies of $20$--$40$~GHz for realistic parameters. We find that the continuum states provide a leakage channel whose strength is strongly controlled by the driving amplitude: reducing the electric field suppresses leakage below the percent level while preserving GHz-scale coherent oscillations. These results establish a route from magnetic-field-induced corner-state physics to electrically driven two-level dynamics in a realistic two-dimensional topological-insulator edge geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：We study、calculate、solve the time-dependent problem、edge-state model。；研究对象：HgTe/CdHgTe量子阱中螺旋边缘态双扭结处由面内磁场诱导的局域态，以及这些局域态形成的可电控二能级子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在合适的几何结构和磁场方向下，两个磁场诱导的扭结局域态可构成一个有效二能级系统，在共振电驱动下可实现20–40 GHz的拉比振荡，且通过降低驱动电场可将泄漏（向连续态的耗散）抑制在1%以下，同时保持GHz量级的相干振荡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在合适的几何结构和磁场方向下，两个磁场诱导的扭结局域态可构成一个有效二能级系统，在共振电驱动下可实现20–40 GHz的拉比振荡，且通过降低驱动电场可将泄漏（向连续态的耗散）抑制在1%以下，同时保持GHz量级的相干振荡。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于包含局域能级和磁感应能隙外连续态的边缘态模型，计算电偶极矩阵元，并求解共振驱动下的含时问题。

papers.title: Wetting of quantum fluids: a route to free-standing shell-shaped quantum droplets
papers.abstract: We investigate wetting phenomena between self-bound quantum fluids in a three-component Bose mixture of $^{23}$Na, $^{39}$K, and $^{41}$K atoms. Within a density-functional approach including mean-field interactions and Lee-Huang-Yang quantum-fluctuation corrections, we consider two binary quantum liquids, formed by components $(1,2)$ and $(2,3)$, and study the adsorption of the softer $(1,2)$ liquid on a stiffer $(2,3)$ substrate. By tuning the interspecies scattering length $a_{12}$, we show that the surface tension of the $(1,2)$ liquid can be strongly varied, driving a transition from partial wetting to complete wetting of the $(2,3)$ phase. The contact angle extracted from cylindrical-cap geometries decreases continuously with increasing $a_{12}$ and vanishes near a critical value $a_{12}^{c}= -42\,a_0$. In the complete-wetting regime, a finite amount of $(1,2)$ liquid wraps around a spherical $(2,3)$ droplet, producing a self-bound core-shell droplet without external confinement, whose component-1 density has a shell-like, hollow projection. We further show that such shell-shaped quantum droplets can sustain quantized vortical excitations. These results identify wetting as a route to engineering free-standing shell-shaped quantum liquids and suggest new possibilities for studying capillarity, topology, and superfluidity in multicomponent quantum droplets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“density-functional approach”（密度泛函方法）进行理论计算，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：三元玻色混合物（²³Na、³⁹K、⁴¹K原子）中自束缚量子流体的浸润现象，具体研究较软的(1,2)二元量子液体在较硬的(2,3)二元量子液体基底上的吸附行为，以及由此形成的自由站立壳状量子液滴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节(1,2)液体间的散射长度a₁₂，可驱动(2,3)相从部分浸润到完全浸润的转变；在完全浸润区，有限量的(1,2)液体会包裹球形(2,3)液滴，形成无需外部约束的自束缚核-壳液滴，且该壳状量子液滴可维持量子化涡旋激发。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节(1,2)液体间的散射长度a₁₂，可驱动(2,3)相从部分浸润到完全浸润的转变；在完全浸润区，有限量的(1,2)液体会包裹球形(2,3)液滴，形成无需外部约束的自束缚核-壳液滴，且该壳状量子液滴可维持量子化涡旋激发。；创新点：首次提出利用量子流体间的浸润现象作为工程化制备自由站立壳状量子液滴的途径，为在多组分量子液滴中研究毛细现象、拓扑结构和超流性提供了新可能性。
papers.method_zh: 采用包含平均场相互作用和Lee-Huang-Yang量子涨落修正的密度泛函方法，通过计算圆柱帽几何构型中的接触角来表征浸润转变，并分析球形核-壳液滴的密度分布和涡旋激发。

papers.title: Substrate-driven topological engineering in plasmonic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chains
papers.abstract: We demonstrate the possibility of engineering the topological band structure of a plasmonic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain through the interaction with its electromagnetic environment. We find that the long-range interaction of the in-plane modes of the SSH chain with the surface plasmon polaritons of a planar substrate introduces a band hybridization connected to a change of the Zak phase. On the other hand, the short-range interaction with the substrate introduces a band touching, again with a change in the Zak phase. Surprisingly, this second mechanism enables the emergence of topologically protected edge modes for parameters which correspond to the topologically trivial phase for an isolated plasmonic SSH chain. We study these mechanisms by changing the chain-substrate distance and the dimerization parameter. Finally, we discuss the robustness against disorder and, as one example, the impact of the observed effects on the near-field radiative heat transfer along the chain. Our findings pave the way to the engineering of edge modes in plasmonic topological configurations via the coupling to a plasmonic environment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“demonstrate the possibility”、“study these mechanisms by changing”等表述，未提及具体实验手段，主要基于模型计算与理论分析。；研究对象：等离激元Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链与平面衬底耦合的拓扑能带结构。具体物理现象包括：长程与短程衬底相互作用导致的能带杂化、能带接触以及拓扑相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节SSH链与衬底的距离及二聚化参数，衬底的长程相互作用（与表面等离极化激元耦合）和短程相互作用均可改变体系的Zak相位，从而诱导拓扑相变。特别地，短程相互作用能使原本处于拓扑平庸相的孤立SSH链出现拓扑保护的边缘态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节SSH链与衬底的距离及二聚化参数，衬底的长程相互作用（与表面等离极化激元耦合）和短程相互作用均可改变体系的Zak相位，从而诱导拓扑相变。特别地，短程相互作用能使原本处于拓扑平庸相的孤立SSH链出现拓扑保护的边缘态。；创新点：揭示了通过耦合到等离激元环境（衬底）来工程化等离激元拓扑结构中边缘态的新机制，尤其是短程相互作用在拓扑平庸参数区间诱导拓扑保护边缘态的反直觉现象。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与分析。通过改变链-衬底距离和二聚化参数，研究等离激元SSH链与平面衬底表面等离极化激元之间的长程与短程相互作用对拓扑能带结构的影响。

papers.title: The Resetting Heat Engine: A Thermodynamic Cycle of Thermal Expansion and Compression
papers.abstract: We consider a Brownian particle confined by an external potential and subject to stochastic resetting to the origin. Motivated by the repetitive nature of the dynamics, we describe the process as a thermodynamic cycle of thermal expansion and collapse, analyzed via a framework based on the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between forward and reversed trajectory ensembles. While the entropy production generally depends on the full trajectory ensemble and cannot be reduced to thermodynamic state variables alone, we show that the harmonic potential constitute a special case, where the entropy production reduces exactly to a state-function-like expression determined solely by the distributions before and after resetting. Explicit analytical results are derived for periodic and Poissonian resetting. At low resetting rates $r$, the entropy production rate grows linearly with $r$ and is proportional to the symmetric KL divergence between the reset and equilibrium distributions. At very high rates, the resetting process becomes effectively perpetual and the entropy production vanishes. Langevin simulations for an anharmonic quartic potential display the same generic behavior, indicating that these features are not restricted to harmonic confinement. Our results establish a direct connection between stochastic resetting, thermodynamic cycles, and information-theoretic measures of irreversibility.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“描述为热力学循环”、“基于KL散度分析”、“推导解析结果”等理论分析关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟作为主要手段（Langevin模拟仅用于验证）。；研究对象：受随机重置（stochastic resetting）到原点约束的布朗粒子系统，具体研究其作为热力学循环（热膨胀与压缩循环）的热力学性质，包括谐振子势和四次非谐势下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在谐振子势的特殊情况下，熵产生可精确简化为仅由重置前后分布决定的状态函数形式；在低重置率下熵产生率与重置率线性相关，并正比于重置分布与平衡分布之间的对称KL散度，而在极高重置率下熵产生消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在谐振子势的特殊情况下，熵产生可精确简化为仅由重置前后分布决定的状态函数形式；在低重置率下熵产生率与重置率线性相关，并正比于重置分布与平衡分布之间的对称KL散度，而在极高重置率下熵产生消失。；创新点：建立了随机重置过程、热力学循环与不可逆性信息论度量（KL散度）之间的直接联系，并发现谐振子势下熵产生可简化为状态函数形式，突破了熵产生通常依赖完整轨迹系综的普遍认知。
papers.method_zh: 基于正向与反向轨迹系综之间的Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度框架，分析周期性重置和泊松重置下的热力学循环；对谐振子势推导解析结果，并用Langevin模拟验证四次非谐势下的普适行为。

papers.title: Symmetry-Selective Topological Magnon Engineering by Phonon Angular Momentum
papers.abstract: Dynamical control of Berry curvature remains an outstanding challenge in the engineering of topological phases. Here, we demonstrate control of magnon band structures via coherently driven phonons, based on \textit{ab initio} spin-lattice coupling and Floquet theory. We show that this control is symmetry selective: linearly polarized phonons leave the spectrum unchanged, whereas circular and elliptical phonons carrying finite phonon angular momentum (PAM) induce chiral interactions that open and tune gaps at Dirac points, generating and reversing topological magnon phases. The gap magnitude and Chern numbers are directly governed by the PAM, enabling handedness-selective topology control. Applied to monolayer CrI$_3$, and supported by symmetry analysis, our results establish driven lattice dynamics as a general route to engineering topological bosonic excitations and a versatile platform for Floquet control of magnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Floquet theory, ab initio spin-lattice coupling, symmetry analysis）；研究对象：单层CrI₃中由声子角动量驱动的拓扑磁振子能带工程
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 携带有限声子角动量的圆偏振或椭圆偏振声子可以诱导手性相互作用，在狄拉克点打开并调控能隙，从而产生和反转拓扑磁振子相；能隙大小和陈数直接由声子角动量决定，实现手性选择性拓扑控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：携带有限声子角动量的圆偏振或椭圆偏振声子可以诱导手性相互作用，在狄拉克点打开并调控能隙，从而产生和反转拓扑磁振子相；能隙大小和陈数直接由声子角动量决定，实现手性选择性拓扑控制。；创新点：揭示了声子角动量对拓扑磁振子能带的对称选择性调控机制（线偏振声子无影响，圆/椭圆偏振声子有效），并建立了通过驱动晶格动力学工程化拓扑玻色子激发的通用途径。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理的自旋-晶格耦合计算与Floquet理论分析，结合对称性分析。

papers.title: Can MACE Potentials Accurately Describe Magnetism and Phase Stability in Fe-Ni Alloys? A Systematic Benchmark
papers.abstract: We present a systematic benchmark of MACE potentials for iron-nickel alloys, focusing on structural, elastic, magnetic, and finite-temperature properties relevant to phase stability. The reference dataset comprises spin-polarized PBE density functional theory (DFT) calculations for chemically disordered special quasirandom structures (SQS), spanning compositions, bcc and fcc crystal structures, and volumetric and shear deformations. A system-specific MACE-sqs model trained on this dataset achieves validation errors of 2.0 meV/atom for energies and 24.3 meV/Angstrom for forces. Compared with several MACE foundation models, including models trained with Hubbard U corrections, MACE-sqs gives the most consistent agreement with DFT and experiment for equations of state, equilibrium volumes, elastic constants, and thermal expansion trends in bcc and fcc Fe-Ni alloys. For the bcc-to-hcp transition, MACE-sqs predicts a pure-Fe transition pressure closer to experiment than the tested foundation models, but all models predict an incorrect increase of transition pressure with Ni content. This failure indicates that high-pressure magnetic collapse and composition-dependent magnetoelastic effects are not yet fully captured. Overall, targeted SQS-based training substantially improves the accuracy of MACE potentials for Fe-Ni alloys, while phase stability under magnetic collapse remains a key limitation for future model development.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：systematic benchmark, DFT calculations, MACE potentials, training）；研究对象：铁镍（Fe-Ni）合金的结构、弹性、磁性和有限温度性质，特别是与相稳定性相关的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过针对特殊准随机结构（SQS）数据集训练的系统特定MACE-sqs模型，在描述Fe-Ni合金的状态方程、平衡体积、弹性常数和热膨胀趋势方面，与DFT和实验吻合最佳。然而，所有测试的MACE模型在预测bcc到hcp相变压力随Ni含量的变化趋势时均失败，表明模型尚不能完全捕捉高压下的磁塌缩和成分依赖的磁弹效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过针对特殊准随机结构（SQS）数据集训练的系统特定MACE-sqs模型，在描述Fe-Ni合金的状态方程、平衡体积、弹性常数和热膨胀趋势方面，与DFT和实验吻合最佳。然而，所有测试的MACE模型在预测bcc到hcp相变压力随Ni含量的变化趋势时均失败，表明模型尚不能完全捕捉高压下的磁塌缩和成分依赖的磁弹效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但工作本身的新意在于：系统性地评估了最先进的机器学习原子间势（MACE）在描述Fe-Ni合金复杂磁性和相稳定性方面的能力，并指出了当前模型在高压磁塌缩效应上的根本性局限。
papers.method_zh: 使用自旋极化的PBE密度泛函理论（DFT）计算生成参考数据集，该数据集包含化学无序的特殊准随机结构（SQS），覆盖不同成分、bcc和fcc晶体结构以及体积和剪切变形。在此基础上训练了一个系统特定的MACE-sqs势模型，并与多个MACE基础模型（包括使用Hubbard U校正训练的模型）进行了系统比较。

papers.title: Global magnetic phase diagram and multiple unconventional magnets in NiAs-type compounds
papers.abstract: NiAs-type compounds such as CrSb and MnTe host $g$-wave altermagnet (AM) state. In order to search other possible unconventional magnets in this system, we present a global magnetic phase diagram based on a classical $J_1$-$J_2$-$J_3$ Heisenberg model and density functional theory (DFT) calculations. We find another $g$-wave AM state and two $f$-wave OPMs in the phase diagram. Intriguingly, we show that a mixed-parity of the $f$-wave OPM and $g$-wave AM state can naturally emerge in an umbrella-like noncollinear magnetic structure. Our DFT calculations show that CrSe and CrTe$_{1-x}$Se$_x$ are generally in such mixing state with dominated $f$-wave component. The interlayer next-nearest-neighbor coupling $J_3$ is shown to be crucial in determining the phase diagram and in inducing strong competition between conventional and unconventional magnets. Inspired by this, we demonstrate that AM or OPM could be realized by applying chemical doping or strain to conventional magnets. Our results provide a guidance for design of both even- and odd-parity as well as mixed-parity unconventional magnets in NiAs-type compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论+计算文章。判断依据：基于经典Heisenberg模型和密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。；研究对象：NiAs型化合物（如CrSb、MnTe、CrSe、CrTe₁₋ₓSeₓ）中的非常规磁性态，包括g波交变磁体（AM）和f波奇宇称磁体（OPM），以及混合宇称非共线磁结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在NiAs型化合物的全局磁相图中，除了已知的g波AM态外，还发现了另一种g波AM态和两种f波OPM态；f波OPM与g波AM的混合宇称态可自然出现在伞状非共线磁结构中，且层间次近邻耦合J₃对相图及非常规磁态的竞争起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在NiAs型化合物的全局磁相图中，除了已知的g波AM态外，还发现了另一种g波AM态和两种f波OPM态；f波OPM与g波AM的混合宇称态可自然出现在伞状非共线磁结构中，且层间次近邻耦合J₃对相图及非常规磁态的竞争起关键作用。；创新点：首次在NiAs型化合物中系统构建了包含多种非常规磁态的全局磁相图，揭示了f波OPM与g波AM的混合宇称态的自然出现机制，并指出通过化学掺杂或应变可将常规磁体调控为交变磁体或奇宇称磁体。
papers.method_zh: 经典J₁-J₂-J₃ Heisenberg模型分析；密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Order by inertia in spinning active matter: holey fluids and spin-textured crystals
papers.abstract: Active matter sustains emergent flows at the expense of preserving structural order. The feedback between structure and viscous flows typically disrupts crystalline and liquid-crystalline organization by amplifying the very deformations they generate. Yet this destabilizing paradigm has recently been challenged by experiments showing that inertial fluid flows can stabilize few-body bound states of active spinners. Whether inertial active matter can sustain genuine cohesion and order at the many-body level, however, remains elusive. Here we investigate two-dimensional assemblies of macroscopic spinners operating at high Reynolds number and uncover two phase transitions leading to the emergence of a dilute percolating fluid and a dense spin-textured crystal. At low density, inertial flows generate two competing interactions: anisotropic attractions and transverse Magnus forces that continuously break and reconfigure bonds. Together they drive a percolation transition toward a dynamically rearranging holey liquid reminiscent of the empty-liquid states observed in equilibrium patchy colloids. At high density, the feedback between spin alignment and particle positions suppresses transverse rearrangements and yields a first-order transition toward a spin-ordered crystal. Our results demonstrate that, beyond the overdamped limit, hydrodynamic feedback can promote rather than destroy collective order, revealing a distinct regime of many-body active matter governed by inertial flows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：investigate、uncover、demonstrate，基于理论分析和数值模拟研究相变行为）；研究对象：高雷诺数下二维自旋活性粒子的多体组装体系，具体研究惯性驱动下的空穴流体和自旋织构晶体两种有序相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 惯性活性物质中，流体动力学反馈可驱动两种相变：低密度下形成动态重排的空穴液体（类似平衡态斑块胶体的空液态），高密度下发生一级相变形成自旋有序晶体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：惯性活性物质中，流体动力学反馈可驱动两种相变：低密度下形成动态重排的空穴液体（类似平衡态斑块胶体的空液态），高密度下发生一级相变形成自旋有序晶体。；创新点：突破了传统认为结构-粘性流反馈会破坏有序的范式，首次证明在过阻尼极限之外，惯性流可促进而非破坏多体活性物质中的集体有序，揭示了惯性流主导的活性物质新相区。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值模拟，具体包括：高雷诺数下宏观自旋粒子的二维组装动力学分析、相互作用（各向异性吸引与横向马格努斯力）的竞争机制研究、渗流相变与一级相变的表征。

papers.title: Unity-order coupling between free electrons and multiphoton waveguided Fock states
papers.abstract: Electron beams enable highly localized near-field excitation of waveguided optical modes, yet their coupling is typically limited by short interaction times along straight-line trajectories with fixed impact parameters. Here, we theoretically demonstrate that electrostatic steering overcomes this limitation by introducing a tunable turning point in grazing electron trajectories, thus controlling the minimum electron--waveguide separation and producing strong coupling to waveguided modes. Specifically, we consider a biased rectangular silicon waveguide, where a repulsive static field deflects a grazing electron. In this configuration, the electron turning point governs both the coupling strength and the modal selectivity, which can be dynamically tuned through the electron incidence angle and the applied bias. In addition, the aloof electron--waveguide interaction suppresses lossy high-energy channels (e.g., above the silicon band gap) while preserving substantial excitation of the targeted waveguided modes. Using a practical biasing configuration and 100~keV electrons, we predict an average yield exceeding ten photons per electron, with voltage-tunable control of the interaction. Our results establish electrostatic steering as a practical route for engineering and enhancing free-electron coupling to waveguided photonic modes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“theoretically demonstrate”“we consider”“we predict”等表述，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：自由电子与波导多光子Fock态之间的耦合，具体体系为偏置矩形硅波导中掠射电子与波导模式的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过静电偏转引入可调转向点，能够克服自由电子与波导模式耦合时间短的固有局限，实现单位阶跃量级的耦合强度，并预测每个电子可产生超过十个光子的平均产额。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过静电偏转引入可调转向点，能够克服自由电子与波导模式耦合时间短的固有局限，实现单位阶跃量级的耦合强度，并预测每个电子可产生超过十个光子的平均产额。；创新点：提出利用静电偏转（而非传统直线轨迹）实现自由电子与波导模式的可控强耦合，并同时抑制高能损耗通道（如硅带隙以上激发），实现电压可调的相互作用控制。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于静电偏转的电子轨迹控制，考虑偏置矩形硅波导中斥力静电场对掠射电子的偏转作用，通过电子入射角和偏置电压动态调控转向点，从而控制耦合强度与模式选择性。

papers.title: Engineering Molecular Rectification: Mechanisms, Modulation Strategies, and Device Integration
papers.abstract: Molecular rectifiers, as prototypical components of molecular electronics, present unique opportunities for pushing device miniaturization to its ultimate limits. Nevertheless, challenges including limited rectification ratios (RR), insufficient robustness, and poor reproducibility impede their practical deployment. To make molecular rectifiers competitive with silicon-based devices, it is important to fully understand the design principles and fabrication methods from both mechanistic and experimental perspectives. By holistically considering the transport mechanisms, modulation strategies, fabrication, characterization techniques, and theoretical simulations, this review provides a comprehensive overview of molecular rectifiers. Representative examples of conceptually significant and high-performance molecular rectifier systems are highlighted to illustrate the relationships between rectification mechanisms, molecular design strategies, and device realization. Building on these discussions, we present an outlook for current bottlenecks and future directions to guide the development of molecular rectifiers. This review aims to serve as both a conceptual framework and a technical reference for researchers working at the intersection of molecular electronics and nanoscale device engineering in the post-CMOS era.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（关键词：review, comprehensive overview, 讨论机制、策略、方法等，非单一实验/计算/理论）；研究对象：分子整流器（molecular rectifiers），即分子电子学中的原型器件，涉及电荷输运、整流效应及器件集成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 分子整流器在实现器件微型化方面具有独特潜力，但目前面临整流比有限、鲁棒性不足和可重复性差等挑战；通过全面理解输运机制、调制策略及制备方法，可推动其与硅基器件竞争。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：分子整流器在实现器件微型化方面具有独特潜力，但目前面临整流比有限、鲁棒性不足和可重复性差等挑战；通过全面理解输运机制、调制策略及制备方法，可推动其与硅基器件竞争。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（该文为综述，创新点在于系统整合了从机制到器件集成的多维度视角，并提供了概念框架与技术参考）。
papers.method_zh: 综述涵盖：输运机制分析、调制策略、制备与表征技术、理论模拟（摘要未明确具体计算方法，如DFT等，仅提及“theoretical simulations”）。

papers.title: SC-1 Etching of Niobium and Titanium Nitride Thin Films
papers.abstract: Dry etching techniques, ubiquitous in microelectronics fabrication, often result in challenging levels of undesired collateral plasma-induced damage. In this work, we demonstrate a wet etching alternative for the patterning of niobium (Nb) and titanium nitride (TiN) thin films using the Standard Cleaning 1 (SC-1) solution. We characterize the etching process through its time-evolution dynamics, supported by scanning-electron and atomic force microscopy assessment of the etched film morphology. The results suggest etch dynamics that are linked to native oxides and film microstructure. Overall, the manageable etch rates, the safe operation and the high material selectivity are attractive for practical use in microelectronics fabrication.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate a wet etching alternative”、“characterize the etching process”、“supported by scanning-electron and atomic force microscopy assessment”等实验手段。；研究对象：铌（Nb）和氮化钛（TiN）薄膜的湿法刻蚀工艺，具体使用标准清洗1号（SC-1）溶液进行图案化刻蚀。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SC-1溶液能够有效湿法刻蚀Nb和TiN薄膜，刻蚀动力学与薄膜的天然氧化物及微观结构相关，且刻蚀速率可控、操作安全、材料选择性高，适合微电子制造中的实际应用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SC-1溶液能够有效湿法刻蚀Nb和TiN薄膜，刻蚀动力学与薄膜的天然氧化物及微观结构相关，且刻蚀速率可控、操作安全、材料选择性高，适合微电子制造中的实际应用。；创新点：提出了一种替代干法刻蚀（易造成等离子体损伤）的湿法刻蚀方案，利用微电子制造中常用的SC-1溶液实现Nb和TiN薄膜的图案化，并揭示了刻蚀动力学与薄膜天然氧化物及微观结构的关联。
papers.method_zh: 使用SC-1溶液进行湿法刻蚀，通过扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和原子力显微镜（AFM）表征刻蚀后的薄膜形貌，并分析刻蚀过程的时间演化动力学。

papers.title: Energy and Scaling Limits of Phase-Change Memory
papers.abstract: Phase change memory (PCM) relies on a reversible transition between amorphous and crystalline states of a material, and stands as a promising candidate for next-generation, energy-efficient data storage and neuromorphic hardware. Here, we review key innovations that have driven PCM technology to achieve energy consumption down to only tens of femtojoules per bit, and could further advance it closer to its fundamental limits. Because PCM switching is induced thermally, we highlight improvements in energy-efficiency through two primary strategies: by minimizing the active phase change material region to sub-10 nm dimensions, and by enhancing heat confinement within PCM devices to reduce thermal dissipation into the surrounding environment. While the theoretical limits could reach single attojoules per cubic nanometer of memory material, realizing these limits in practice is significantly constrained by electrical and thermal parasitics, particularly at contacts and interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章。关键词：review、key innovations、strategies。；研究对象：相变存储器（PCM），具体涉及非晶态与晶态之间的可逆相变，以及实现低能耗存储的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将相变材料区域缩小至亚10纳米尺寸，并增强器件内的热约束以减少热耗散，PCM的能耗可降至每比特仅数十飞焦耳，理论上可接近每立方纳米单阿焦耳的基本极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将相变材料区域缩小至亚10纳米尺寸，并增强器件内的热约束以减少热耗散，PCM的能耗可降至每比特仅数十飞焦耳，理论上可接近每立方纳米单阿焦耳的基本极限。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有综述的具体新意，但强调了从能量效率和热耗散角度系统梳理PCM向理论极限推进的两条主要路径。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验或计算方法，主要基于对已有技术创新的综述，涉及器件尺寸缩小和热管理策略的分析。

papers.title: Dry Glass Reference Perturbation Theory: Development, Applications and Extensions
papers.abstract: This manuscript reviews the development, application and extensions of the dry glass reference perturbation theory (DGRPT) closure to the non-equilibrium thermodynamics of glassy polymers (NETGP). DGRPT was developed to allow for the self-consistent and accurate predictions of sorption from complex liquid mixtures into glassy polymers. DGRPT is applied in the context of diffusion theory to predict the membrane based separations of complex liquid mixtures with glassy polymer membranes. Several examples are given, including the membrane based fractionation of crude oil as well as the membrane based separation of highly non-ideal alcohol / hydrocarbon liquid mixtures. Extensions of the theory to higher order expansions are reviewed and evaluated.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：perturbation theory（微扰理论）、closure（闭合）、non-equilibrium thermodynamics（非平衡热力学）。；研究对象：玻璃态聚合物（glassy polymers）及其在复杂液体混合物中的吸附（sorption）与膜基分离（membrane based separations）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 干玻璃参考微扰理论（DGRPT）能够自洽且准确地预测复杂液体混合物在玻璃态聚合物中的吸附行为，并成功应用于原油分馏及非理想醇/烃液体混合物的膜分离预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：干玻璃参考微扰理论（DGRPT）能够自洽且准确地预测复杂液体混合物在玻璃态聚合物中的吸附行为，并成功应用于原油分馏及非理想醇/烃液体混合物的膜分离预测。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 干玻璃参考微扰理论（DGRPT）闭合方法，结合扩散理论（diffusion theory）应用于非平衡热力学框架（NETGP），并涉及高阶展开扩展。

papers.title: Nanoscale Confinement Enhances Ultrafast Demagnetization
papers.abstract: Nanoscale miniaturization has revolutionized the field of spintronics by enabling exponential growth in areal bit density. A similar leap is also expected in device speeds through successfully harnessing femtosecond magnetization dynamics. However, combining this with the miniaturization of realistic devices is challenging. To address this, we studied the effect of dimensional confinement on the femtosecond demagnetization of Fe. By gradually increasing the level of confinement while keeping excitation conditions constant, we found that Fe layers thinner than 10 nm exhibit enlarged demagnetization amplitudes, reaching a $\sim75\%$ increase at 2 nm. By combining ultrafast experiments sensitive to the spins, the charge carriers, and the phonons, we establish that this finite$\text{-}$size effect is magnetic in origin and is not phonon$\text{-}$driven. With the support of ab$\text{-}$initio calculations and atomistic spin dynamics simulations, we identify the enhancement effect as due to local weakening of spin order at the Fe$\text{'}$s interface, which becomes significant upon increased confinement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合计算与模拟）。判断依据关键词：ultrafast experiments、ab-initio calculations、atomistic spin dynamics simulations。；研究对象：纳米尺度限域效应对铁（Fe）薄膜飞秒退磁过程的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当Fe层厚度小于10 nm时，飞秒退磁幅度显著增强，在2 nm厚度处退磁幅度增加约75%；该有限尺寸效应源于磁性起源，而非声子驱动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当Fe层厚度小于10 nm时，飞秒退磁幅度显著增强，在2 nm厚度处退磁幅度增加约75%；该有限尺寸效应源于磁性起源，而非声子驱动。；创新点：首次在保持激发条件不变的情况下，系统研究维度限域对飞秒退磁的影响，并揭示界面处自旋有序的局部弱化是增强效应的物理根源。
papers.method_zh: 超快实验（同时探测自旋、载流子和声子动力学）、第一性原理计算（ab-initio calculations）、原子自旋动力学模拟（atomistic spin dynamics simulations）。

papers.title: High Temperature Jahn-Teller Distortion and Short Range Order in CsCuCl$_3$
papers.abstract: CsCuCl$_3$, chiral and Jahn-Teller distorted at room temperature, takes a more symmetric structure above 423K. Describing this 'simpler' high temperature structure is far from simple and has been the subject of many, sometimes contradicting, studies. Here we reinvestigate the high temperature structure of CsCuCl$_3$, its thermal stability, and its effect on room temperature chirality. In situ pair distribution function data from powder neutron diffraction confirms that CsCuCl$_3$ is Jahn-Teller distorted both below and above T$_c$, and provides a quantitative view of short range order in the high temperature structure. In situ powder x-ray diffraction shows that CsCuCl$_3$ does not undergo any additional structural changes above 423K and is congruently melting. In situ single crystal x-ray diffraction experiments reveal that the phase transition induces domains of mixed handedness in originally homochiral crystals. These findings contribute to a better understanding of phase transitions in Jahn-Teller distorted compounds, and highlight the potential use of phase transitions to control chiral domains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：in situ pair distribution function data、powder neutron diffraction、powder x-ray diffraction、single crystal x-ray diffraction。；研究对象：CsCuCl₃ 在高温（>423K）下的结构，特别是其Jahn-Teller畸变、短程有序性以及相变对室温手性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CsCuCl₃ 在高温相中仍然存在Jahn-Teller畸变（短程有序），且该化合物在423K以上无其他结构变化并一致熔融；相变会在原本单一手性的晶体中引入混合手性畴。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CsCuCl₃ 在高温相中仍然存在Jahn-Teller畸变（短程有序），且该化合物在423K以上无其他结构变化并一致熔融；相变会在原本单一手性的晶体中引入混合手性畴。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 原位粉末中子衍射（获取对分布函数PDF数据）、原位粉末X射线衍射、原位单晶X射线衍射。

papers.title: Photon-energy-programmable subnanometric electron birth-site control
papers.abstract: Optical control of electron-generation sites has broadly enabled ultrafast nanoscale imaging, spectroscopy, and functional control. Existing approaches achieve nanoscale site selectivity by shaping localised optical fields around nanostructures, thereby limiting independent site selectivity within the same local-field hotspot. Here, using a single-molecule electron emitter, we show that site selectivity can instead be encoded in the electronic excitation pathway, enabling subnanometric control of electron birth sites within the same local-field hotspot. By tuning the photon energy, we selectively access molecular states of different spatial symmetry and reversibly switch the electron birth site between distinct locations in the same emitter, with the change read out directly in the far-field emission pattern. The switching depends on photon energy alone and is absent under variations in intensity or polarisation. Our results establish optical birth-site selectivity that is not dictated by the local-field distribution, opening a route to electron birth-site control through the electronic excitation pathway.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“using a single-molecule electron emitter”、“we show”、“read out directly in the far-field emission pattern”等实验操作与观测描述。；研究对象：单分子电子发射器中的电子产生位置（electron birth site）控制，具体涉及通过光子能量调控分子激发态的空间对称性，实现亚纳米尺度的电子发射位点切换。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节光子能量，可以在同一局域场热点内选择性地激发不同空间对称性的分子态，从而可逆地切换电子发射位点，且该切换仅依赖于光子能量，而非光强或偏振。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节光子能量，可以在同一局域场热点内选择性地激发不同空间对称性的分子态，从而可逆地切换电子发射位点，且该切换仅依赖于光子能量，而非光强或偏振。；创新点：首次证明电子产生位点的选择性可以不依赖于局域光场分布（如纳米结构附近的光场整形），而是通过电子激发路径（即分子态的空间对称性）来实现，从而在亚纳米尺度上实现独立于局域场热点的位点控制。
papers.method_zh: 使用单分子电子发射器作为实验平台，通过改变入射光子能量来选择性激发分子中不同空间对称性的电子态，并通过远场发射图案直接读取电子产生位置的变化。

papers.title: Change in charge density wave order beyond the Lifshitz transition in 2H-Ta\textsubscript{1$\pmδ$}S\textsubscript{2}
papers.abstract: We investigate electronic instabilities in 2H-TaS\textsubscript{2} and a self-intercalated variant, 2H$^\dagger$-Ta\textsubscript{1+$δ$}S\textsubscript{2}. In conventional samples, which we determine to be slightly hole-doped, spectral gaps and backfolded features are found as fingerprints of the $3\times3$ charge density wave (CDW). Notably, the backfolded features emerge only at a temperatures below $T\approx$~65~K, substantially lower than the established CDW temperature of 78~K, suggesting an incommensurate-commensurate lock-in transition analogous to the phenomenology of the 2H-TaSe\textsubscript{2}. In contrast, the self-intercalated 2H$^\dagger$ sample exhibits substantial electron doping and signatures of a novel \tworootthree CDW. Using \textit{ab initio} calculations of the phonon spectrum, we demonstrate that the \threebythree instability ($\mathbf{q}=\sfrac{2}{3}\mathbf{ΓM}$) is highly sensitive to band filling. Furthermore, with increased interlayer spacing, a competing soft phonon mode emerges near $\mathbf{q}=\sfrac{1}{2}\mathbf{ΓK}$, corresponding to the superstructure observed in the 2H$^\dagger$ phase, although in our calculations this instability arises under hole doping rather than the electron doping inferred experimentally. These results establish band filling and interlayer spacing as key control parameters for CDW ordering vectors in 2H-TaS\textsubscript{2}, and highlight a route to engineering electronic instabilities in a prototypical layered material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：ARPES（隐含在“spectral gaps and backfolded features”中）、ab initio calculations of the phonon spectrum。；研究对象：2H-TaS₂及其自插层变体2H†-Ta₁₊δS₂中的电荷密度波（CDW）序，重点关注能带填充和层间距对CDW波矢的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在常规2H-TaS₂中，CDW背折叠特征仅在约65 K以下出现，低于已知的78 K CDW转变温度，暗示存在非公度-公度锁定转变；自插层样品中观察到电子掺杂和新型√3×√3 CDW。第一性原理计算表明，3×3 CDW不稳定性对能带填充高度敏感，而层间距增大则会在q=1/2ΓK处出现竞争性软声子模。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在常规2H-TaS₂中，CDW背折叠特征仅在约65 K以下出现，低于已知的78 K CDW转变温度，暗示存在非公度-公度锁定转变；自插层样品中观察到电子掺杂和新型√3×√3 CDW。第一性原理计算表明，3×3 CDW不稳定性对能带填充高度敏感，而层间距增大则会在q=1/2ΓK处出现竞争性软声子模。；创新点：首次在2H-TaS₂中区分出CDW序的锁相转变（类似2H-TaSe₂），并发现自插层可诱导出与常规3×3 CDW不同的√3×√3超结构，同时通过计算揭示了能带填充和层间距作为调控CDW波矢的关键参数。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）测量能谱间隙和背折叠特征；理论上采用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的声子谱第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Taming quantum interference: a route to high electrical conductance in carbon nanotube assemblies
papers.abstract: Miniaturized electronics require lightweight conductors that maintain high conductance under demanding conditions. CNT networks are promising candidates, but their transport is governed by inter-nanotube junctions where electron waves interfere. Controlling this interference requires understanding how junction architecture shapes transmission. We explore coherent transport through experimentally relevant junctions, from single and multiple single-walled CNT (SWCNT) contacts to double-walled CNT (DWCNT) and triple-walled CNT (TWCNT) junctions, with atomistic tight-binding non-equilibrium Green's-function calculations, also under a perpendicular magnetic field. We use analytically solvable minimal models to identify transport regimes expected for quasi-1D nanoscale junctions, and an electron-waveguide picture to interpret their CNT-specific manifestations. For single SWCNT--SWCNT junctions, high-transmission windows are set mainly by overlap length, doping and magnetic field. Gateway states can enhance conductance when some CNT subbands are gapped, and in some cases a magnetic field can restore transmission by lifting an interference blockade. In more complex architectures, added paths become selective: multi-junctions generate resonant filtering, while additional walls redistribute transmission instead of acting as independent channels. DWCNT junctions remain outer-wall dominated and SWCNT-like, whereas TWCNT junctions become genuinely multi-channel and more field-sensitive. This explains the lower, more field-sensitive conductance of multi-walled CNT (MWCNT) fibres, in accord with our ultrahigh-field measurements on SWCNT and MWCNT fibres. Ultimately, this work turns microscopic interference mechanisms into design principles for high-conductance, field-stable CNT conductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：使用“atomistic tight-binding non-equilibrium Green's-function calculations”（原子级紧束缚非平衡格林函数计算）和“analytically solvable minimal models”（可解析求解的最小模型）进行理论计算与分析，并结合“ultrahigh-field measurements”（超高场测量）进行实验验证。；研究对象：碳纳米管（CNT）组装体中的量子干涉效应及其对电导的影响，具体包括单壁碳纳米管（SWCNT）、双壁碳纳米管（DWCNT）和三壁碳纳米管（TWCNT）之间的结（junction）结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控碳纳米管结的几何结构（如重叠长度、掺杂）和施加垂直磁场，可以控制电子波的量子干涉，从而获得高电导。多壁碳纳米管（MWCNT）纤维的电导较低且对磁场更敏感，是因为其传输由外壁主导且多壁结构并未形成独立通道，而是重新分配传输。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调控碳纳米管结的几何结构（如重叠长度、掺杂）和施加垂直磁场，可以控制电子波的量子干涉，从而获得高电导。多壁碳纳米管（MWCNT）纤维的电导较低且对磁场更敏感，是因为其传输由外壁主导且多壁结构并未形成独立通道，而是重新分配传输。；创新点：将微观量子干涉机制转化为设计高电导、磁场稳定的碳纳米管导体的工程原则，揭示了多壁碳纳米管结中多通道传输的真实行为（外壁主导、非独立通道），并解释了实验上多壁碳纳米管纤维电导较低且对磁场敏感的原因。
papers.method_zh: 采用原子级紧束缚非平衡格林函数（tight-binding NEGF）方法进行相干输运计算，并辅以可解析求解的最小模型和电子波导图像进行物理机制分析。同时，结合对SWCNT和MWCNT纤维的超高场电导测量进行验证。

papers.title: Zero-Field Thermal Hall Effect in Insulator
papers.abstract: Fourier's law dictates that heat flow is usually parallel to the applied temperature gradient. However, under a high magnetic field, heat flow carried by both electrons in conductors and phonons in insulators can be deflected, a phenomenon known as thermal Hall effect. Intriguingly, we observe at zero field a spontaneous thermal Hall effect in an antiferromagnetic insulator. Despite a vanishingly small uncompensated magnetization, the magnitude of this effect is surprisingly large, comparable to typical responses induced by several teslas of external field. This zero-field behavior indicates that charge-neutral heat carriers can be governed by an intrinsic effective field arising from the unique spin arrangement. Our discovery challenges the centuries-old preconception of heat conduction and open up new avenues for exploring non-trivial topological responses in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we observe”（我们观察到）这一实验发现，并描述了测量结果（热霍尔效应的大小、与磁场的对比等）。；研究对象：反铁磁绝缘体中的零场热霍尔效应。具体物理现象是：在没有外加磁场的情况下，绝缘体中由声子（或其它中性热载流子）携带的热流自发产生横向偏转。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在反铁磁绝缘体中，尽管未补偿磁化强度极小，却在零磁场下观测到了显著的自发热霍尔效应，其大小与外加数特斯拉磁场诱导的典型响应相当。这表明电荷中性的热载流子受到来自独特自旋排列的内禀有效场的调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在反铁磁绝缘体中，尽管未补偿磁化强度极小，却在零磁场下观测到了显著的自发热霍尔效应，其大小与外加数特斯拉磁场诱导的典型响应相当。这表明电荷中性的热载流子受到来自独特自旋排列的内禀有效场的调控。；创新点：挑战了传统傅里叶定律中热流平行于温度梯度的基本认知，首次在零磁场下发现绝缘体中存在由自旋结构内禀有效场驱动的自发横向热输运，为探索量子材料中的非平庸拓扑响应开辟了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如使用的材料、测量装置、温度范围等），仅提及在零场下对反铁磁绝缘体进行了热霍尔效应的观测。

papers.title: Nonlinear Elasticity at the Damage Threshold of Semiconductor Nanocrystals
papers.abstract: The nonlinear photoacoustic response of indium phosphide nanocrystals on silicon nanotip arrays is investigated using time-resolved optical pump-probe spectroscopy and synchrotron-based X-ray diffraction. Femtosecond laser excitation triggers low-frequency and high-frequency radial breathing modes of the nanocrystals at 8 GHz and 10.3 GHz, respectively. At excitation fluences above 3 mJ/cm^2, nonlinear frequency mixing occurs, including sum- and difference-frequency generation, indicative of strain-induced nonlinear elasticity. A higher-order extension of Hooke's law models the fluence-dependent spectral response and yields a physically valid elastic energy potential. Ex-situ energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy reveals a correlation between nanocrystal oxidation and the emergence of nonlinear acoustic modes. Time-resolved X-ray diffraction confirms the nanocrystals as the origin of the low-frequency modes and supports the hypothesis of acoustic decoupling from the substrate. These findings provide insight into the mechanical limits of semiconductor nanostructures under intense optical excitation and suggest new pathways for material characterization and optomechanical control at the nanoscale. The results advance the understanding of nonlinear phonon dynamics in nanocrystals and highlight their potential for integration into next-generation photonic and quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到了“time-resolved optical pump-probe spectroscopy”、“synchrotron-based X-ray diffraction”、“Ex-situ energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy”等具体实验手段。；研究对象：半导体纳米晶体的非线性弹性行为，具体材料为硅纳米尖锥阵列上的磷化铟纳米晶体，物理现象为强光激发下的非线性光声响应和声学模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超过3 mJ/cm²的激发通量下，磷化铟纳米晶体出现非线性频率混合（和频与差频产生），表明存在应变诱导的非线性弹性；该非线性行为与纳米晶体的氧化相关，且纳米晶体是低频声学模式的来源，并与衬底声学解耦。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超过3 mJ/cm²的激发通量下，磷化铟纳米晶体出现非线性频率混合（和频与差频产生），表明存在应变诱导的非线性弹性；该非线性行为与纳米晶体的氧化相关，且纳米晶体是低频声学模式的来源，并与衬底声学解耦。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：首次在半导体纳米晶体中观察到由强光激发导致的非线性弹性效应（频率混合），并建立了其与纳米晶体氧化和声学解耦的关联，为理解纳米尺度下的非线性声子动力学和机械极限提供了新见解。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨光泵浦-探测光谱学、同步辐射X射线衍射、能量色散X射线光谱。理论建模方面，使用了胡克定律的高阶扩展模型来拟合随通量变化的光谱响应。

papers.title: Three-component superconductivity: the effect of second-order Josephson couplings
papers.abstract: Recently, a three-component Ginzburg-Landau (GL) model compatible with the 3Q pair-density-wave state has been proposed to explain the fractional quantum magnetic resistance oscillations of period $φ_0/3 = hc/6e$ observed in vanadium-based kagome superconductors. The physics of this model is governed by second-order Josephson-type couplings, which break both time-reversal symmetry and discrete $π$-phase flip symmetry. In this work, we theoretically derive the complete set of ground-state solutions and construct a comprehensive phase diagram in the GL parameter space, characterized by analytically determined phase boundaries. We identify five distinct ground states: an 8-fold degenerate frustrated state and four 4-fold degenerate non-frustrated phase-locked states. Four of these states spontaneously break time-reversal symmetry. Numerical analysis of the collective modes reveals the emergence of a Higgs-Leggett mode unique to the frustrated region, accompanied by mode softening near the phase boundaries. Our findings provide a comprehensive theoretical framework for understanding the multifaceted physics of multicomponent superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically derive”、“numerical analysis”、“Ginzburg-Landau model”。；研究对象：三组分超导体的基态与集体激发模式，具体针对与3Q配对密度波态兼容的三组分Ginzburg-Landau模型，用于解释钒基笼目超导体中观察到的分数量子磁阻振荡现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型在Ginzburg-Landau参数空间中存在五种不同的基态，其中四种自发破缺时间反演对称性；在阻挫区域出现独特的Higgs-Leggett集体模，并在相边界附近发生模式软化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型在Ginzburg-Landau参数空间中存在五种不同的基态，其中四种自发破缺时间反演对称性；在阻挫区域出现独特的Higgs-Leggett集体模，并在相边界附近发生模式软化。；创新点：首次完整推导了三组分超导模型（含二阶约瑟夫森耦合）的基态相图，并识别出阻挫区域特有的Higgs-Leggett模及其软化行为，为多组分超导体的复杂物理提供了统一理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：解析求解三组分Ginzburg-Landau模型的完整基态解集，并解析确定相边界；数值分析：计算集体激发模（Higgs-Leggett模）的行为。

papers.title: Barrier crossing in a two-state system: Effect of bias and stochastic fields
papers.abstract: We study barrier crossing in a two-state system, namely the kinetic Ising model, in the presence of a weak bias field and spatially homogeneous, but time-dependent, Gaussian random fields. We find that the bias field determines the location of the dominant maxima of the probability distribution function of the magnetization, whereas the noise intensity controls their sharpness and stability of the distribution. A moderate stochastic field lowers the effective energy barrier and facilitates transitions between ordered states, while strong noise induces broad distributions and significant backflow, which reduces directional selectivity. Our results suggest that efficient barrier crossing requires a balanced combination of moderate stochastic driving and controlled bias.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study（研究）、probability distribution function（概率分布函数）、effective energy barrier（有效能垒）。；研究对象：两态系统（具体为动力学伊辛模型）中的势垒穿越现象，涉及弱偏置场和空间均匀但时间依赖的高斯随机场的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 偏置场决定磁化概率分布函数主极大值的位置，而噪声强度控制分布的尖锐度和稳定性；适度的随机场可降低有效能垒并促进有序态间的跃迁，但强噪声会导致宽分布和显著回流，降低方向选择性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：偏置场决定磁化概率分布函数主极大值的位置，而噪声强度控制分布的尖锐度和稳定性；适度的随机场可降低有效能垒并促进有序态间的跃迁，但强噪声会导致宽分布和显著回流，降低方向选择性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于动力学伊辛模型（kinetic Ising model），引入弱偏置场（weak bias field）和空间均匀、时间依赖的高斯随机场（spatially homogeneous, time-dependent Gaussian random fields），通过概率分布函数分析磁化行为。

papers.title: Search for high-pressure phases of yttrium via a data assimilation approach
papers.abstract: We investigate the distorted face-centered-cubic (dfcc) phase of yttrium (Y) using a data-assimilation-based structure search that combines high-resolution powder x-ray diffraction (XRD) data with machine-learning interatomic potentials. By exploring supercells containing up to 128 atoms, we identify three low-enthalpy phases: the previously reported $I4_1/a$ structure and two additional structures, $Ibam$ and $R\overline{3}$. No data-assimilation-derived structure relaxes to the previously proposed $R\overline{3}m$ phase. Phonon calculations show that $I4_1/a$, $Ibam$, and $R\overline{3}$ are dynamically stable, whereas $R\overline{3}m$ exhibits imaginary modes near the $Γ$ point, indicating dynamical instability. Enthalpy calculations using both PBE and r$^{2}$SCAN place the four candidate structures within about 10 meV/atom, indicating a complex energy landscape with multiple competing minima, although $R\overline{3}m$ is consistently highest in enthalpy and r$^{2}$SCAN favors $I4_1/a$ throughout the dfcc pressure range. Rietveld refinements of the powder XRD profile at 60 GPa further narrow the viable structural models to $I4_1/a$ and $Ibam$, both of which reproduce the experimental data better than $R\overline{3}m$ and $R\overline{3}$. Taken together with the energetic ordering and dynamical stability, these results identify $I4_1/a$ as the most plausible structure of the dfcc phase of Y, with $Ibam$ remaining a close competing candidate, particularly toward the high-pressure side of the dfcc region.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算为主，实验为辅）。判断依据：结合了“machine-learning interatomic potentials”（机器学习原子间势）和“phonon calculations”（声子计算）等计算方法，以及“high-resolution powder x-ray diffraction (XRD) data”（高分辨率粉末X射线衍射数据）和“Rietveld refinements”（Rietveld精修）等实验手段。；研究对象：钇（Yttrium, Y）在高压下的畸变面心立方（dfcc）相及其可能存在的多种晶体结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过数据同化方法，发现钇的dfcc相最可能的结构是之前报道的 $I4_1/a$ 相，而此前提出的 $R\overline{3}m$ 相因存在动力学不稳定性而被排除。$Ibam$ 相是另一个有竞争力的候选结构，尤其在dfcc相的高压区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过数据同化方法，发现钇的dfcc相最可能的结构是之前报道的 $I4_1/a$ 相，而此前提出的 $R\overline{3}m$ 相因存在动力学不稳定性而被排除。$Ibam$ 相是另一个有竞争力的候选结构，尤其在dfcc相的高压区域。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该方法的核心创新在于将实验衍射数据与机器学习势相结合，通过数据同化（data assimilation）的方式，在包含多达128个原子的大超胞中系统性地搜索高压相，从而能够发现传统方法可能遗漏的复杂结构。
papers.method_zh: 1. **结构搜索**：采用基于数据同化的结构搜索方法，结合高分辨率粉末X射线衍射数据和机器学习原子间势。2. **计算验证**：对候选结构进行声子计算（判断动力学稳定性）和焓计算（使用PBE和r$^{2}$SCAN泛函）。3. **实验验证**：对60 GPa下的粉末XRD图谱进行Rietveld精修，比较不同结构模型的拟合优度。

papers.title: Cascade of magnetic-field-induced quantum spin states in a spin-1 honeycomb magnet
papers.abstract: Quantum fluctuations endow spin systems with surprisingly enriched magnetic phase diagrams. In frustrated magnets, strong quantum fluctuations boosted by either geometrical incompatibility or competitive exchange interactions stabilize cascades of unusual phases of matter. Here we reveal the presence of multiple quantum phases in the honeycomb antiferromagnet Na$_{3}$Ni$_{2}$BiO$_{6}$, both inside and beyond its field-induced one-third magnetization plateau. Comprehensive measurements of thermodynamic quantities demonstrate that the one-third plateau comprises at least three distinct spin states with nearly-degenerate net magnetization, separated by first-order transitions that likely involve sequential spin reconfiguration. Upon further increasing the magnetic field, the system evolves across a myriad of peculiar phases before reaching full polarization; these intermediate phases possess copious low-energy excitations, manifested by anomalous upturns of specific heat at ultralow temperatures -- probably hinting at the development of "hidden" ordered ground states. The complex magnetic phase diagram of Na$_{3}$Ni$_{2}$BiO$_{6}$ underlines the preponderant impact of quantum fluctuations on a honeycomb spin lattice with strong exchange frustration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Comprehensive measurements of thermodynamic quantities”（热力学量的综合测量），属于实验手段。；研究对象：自旋-1蜂窝状反铁磁体 Na₃Ni₂BiO₆ 在磁场诱导下的量子自旋态与相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Na₃Ni₂BiO₆ 中，磁场诱导的三分之一磁化平台实际上由至少三个净磁化近乎简并但通过一级相变分隔的不同自旋态组成；在更高磁场下，系统经历一系列中间相后才达到完全极化，这些中间相在极低温下表现出比热异常上升，暗示可能存在“隐藏”的有序基态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Na₃Ni₂BiO₆ 中，磁场诱导的三分之一磁化平台实际上由至少三个净磁化近乎简并但通过一级相变分隔的不同自旋态组成；在更高磁场下，系统经历一系列中间相后才达到完全极化，这些中间相在极低温下表现出比热异常上升，暗示可能存在“隐藏”的有序基态。；创新点：揭示了在强阻挫蜂窝状自旋晶格中，量子涨落导致磁场诱导的磁化平台内部存在多个精细的量子自旋态，并发现了平台外一系列具有丰富低能激发的中间相。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 通过综合测量热力学量（如比热、磁化率等）来表征不同磁场下的相变与激发行为，具体实验技术摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Analytical solution of the Langmuir model for moisture diffusion in cylindrical coordinates
papers.abstract: Moisture diffusion in polymers and bio-based materials frequently exhibits non-Fickian behavior that cannot be described by classical diffusion models. The Langmuir model, which accounts for the coexistence of mobile and bound water molecules, has been widely used to represent such phenomena. However, analytical solutions of this model are generally limited to planar geometries, while cylindrical systems are typically investigated using numerical methods. In this work, the Langmuir diffusion model is solved analytically in cylindrical coordinates. The resulting solution provides both the local evolution of moisture content within the cylinder and the corresponding global moisture uptake kinetics. The analytical solution is validated through comparison with an independent numerical solution based on a finite difference scheme, showing excellent agreement for both the global absorption kinetics and the radial moisture profiles. The proposed formulation therefore provides a simple and efficient analytical framework for studying non-Fickian moisture diffusion in cylindrical systems such as natural fibers, and facilitates the identification of model parameters from experimental data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical solution（解析解）、Langmuir model（Langmuir模型）、cylindrical coordinates（柱坐标）。；研究对象：非菲克型水分扩散现象，具体为聚合物和生物基材料（如天然纤维）中水分在圆柱形体系中的扩散行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作给出了Langmuir扩散模型在柱坐标下的解析解，能够准确描述圆柱体内局部水分含量随时间的演化以及整体吸湿动力学，并通过与数值解对比验证了其准确性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作给出了Langmuir扩散模型在柱坐标下的解析解，能够准确描述圆柱体内局部水分含量随时间的演化以及整体吸湿动力学，并通过与数值解对比验证了其准确性。；创新点：此前Langmuir模型的解析解仅限于平面几何，而圆柱形体系通常只能通过数值方法研究；本工作首次给出了该模型在柱坐标下的解析解，为天然纤维等圆柱形体系中的非菲克扩散提供了简单高效的分析框架，并有助于从实验数据中提取模型参数。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：在柱坐标系下解析求解Langmuir扩散模型（该模型考虑可移动水分子与结合水分子的共存）。验证方法：与基于有限差分格式的独立数值解进行对比。

papers.title: Hall effect in multi-leg bosonic ladders
papers.abstract: We use bosonization to analyze the ground state Hall response of interacting bosonic N-leg ladders threaded by a flux. We derive an explicit expression of the Hall imbalance in a perturbative expansion in the band curvature, retaining fully the interactions. For small magnetic field the Hall resistance is proportional to the derivative of the logarithm of the charge stiffness with respect to density, generalizing the result obtained in the two leg case. We also consider the effect of temperature, and establish that at low temperature, corrections to the Hall resistance are exponentially small in the Meissner phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“bosonization”（玻色化）、“perturbative expansion”（微扰展开）、“derive an explicit expression”（推导显式表达式）。；研究对象：多腿玻色梯子（multi-leg bosonic ladders）在通量（flux）下的基态霍尔效应，具体为相互作用玻色子N腿梯子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在小磁场下，霍尔电阻与电荷刚度（charge stiffness）对密度的对数导数成正比，将两腿情况的结果推广到了多腿情形；在低温下，迈斯纳相（Meissner phase）中霍尔电阻的修正呈指数小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在小磁场下，霍尔电阻与电荷刚度（charge stiffness）对密度的对数导数成正比，将两腿情况的结果推广到了多腿情形；在低温下，迈斯纳相（Meissner phase）中霍尔电阻的修正呈指数小。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用玻色化（bosonization）理论框架，在能带曲率（band curvature）下进行微扰展开，并完整保留相互作用效应。

papers.title: Effect of Vacancies on Hydrogen Mobility and Trapping in Elemental Fe and Cr: A DFT and kMC Study
papers.abstract: Hydrogen-vacancy interactions play an important role in governing hydrogen transport and embrittlement in body-centered cubic (BCC) metals. In this study, a multiscale approach combining density functional theory (DFT) and kinetic Monte Carlo (kMC) simulations is employed to investigate hydrogen behavior in BCC Fe and Cr. The DFT-calculated binding energies and Bader charge analysis indicate stronger hydrogen trapping in Cr than in Fe. Migration and detrapping energy barriers are determined using the climbing-image nudged elastic band method, showing that the detrapping energy generally decreases with increasing hydrogen occupancy. However, the sixth hydrogen atom in Fe exhibits a finite barrier, contrary to some previous reports. kMC simulations are then used to evaluate hydrogen diffusion over extended time and length scales. The results demonstrate that vacancy defects significantly reduce hydrogen mobility and increase the effective activation energy, with a more pronounced effect observed in Cr due to stronger trapping. The combined DFT-kMC framework provides detailed insight into the mechanisms of hydrogen trapping, detrapping, and diffusion in BCC metals, offering important implications for understanding hydrogen embrittlement in structural materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：DFT（密度泛函理论）、kMC（动力学蒙特卡洛）模拟、CI-NEB（爬坡弹性带方法）等计算与模拟方法。；研究对象：氢原子在体心立方（BCC）金属 Fe 和 Cr 中的行为，具体研究空位缺陷对氢迁移、捕获和扩散的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 空位缺陷显著降低氢在 BCC Fe 和 Cr 中的迁移率并提高有效激活能，且 Cr 中氢的捕获效应比 Fe 更强；此外，Fe 中第六个氢原子的脱陷能垒有限，与部分先前报道不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：空位缺陷显著降低氢在 BCC Fe 和 Cr 中的迁移率并提高有效激活能，且 Cr 中氢的捕获效应比 Fe 更强；此外，Fe 中第六个氢原子的脱陷能垒有限，与部分先前报道不同。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用多尺度方法：密度泛函理论（DFT）计算结合能、Bader 电荷分析；爬坡弹性带方法（CI-NEB）计算迁移和脱陷能垒；动力学蒙特卡洛（kMC）模拟评估长时间和大尺度下的氢扩散行为。

papers.title: Direction-selective intertwined charge, orbital, and lattice orders under uniaxial strain in hole-doped manganite: La0.75Ca0.25MnO3
papers.abstract: The complex interplay of charge, spin, orbital, and lattice degrees of freedom governs emergent phases in quantum materials, making strain a powerful control parameter. Recent advances in free-standing layer techniques have enabled extreme strains of nearly 8%, opening access to novel and often unexpected electronic and magnetic phases. Here, using a density functional theory approach, we investigate the effect of direction-selective uniaxial strain on the prototypical Jahn-Teller system La1-xCaxMnO3 (x = 0.25). We find that different strain directions stabilize qualitatively distinct structural, charge, and orbital responses, rather than merely different strengths of the same phase. In particular, extreme uniaxial strain selectively induces cooperative Jahn-Teller, breathing-like, and site-selective modulations, thereby enabling previously inaccessible intertwined orders in manganites. These results establish direction-selective uniaxial strain as a powerful and selective route for engineering emergent phases in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“using a density functional theory approach”（使用密度泛函理论方法）。；研究对象：空穴掺杂锰氧化物 La₀.₇₅Ca₀.₂₅MnO₃（即 La₁₋ₓCaₓMnO₃，x=0.25）在单轴应变下的电荷、轨道和晶格有序态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不同方向的单轴应变会稳定性质截然不同的结构、电荷和轨道响应，而非仅仅改变同一相位的强度；极端单轴应变可选择性地诱导合作型 Jahn-Teller 调制、呼吸型调制和位点选择性调制，从而在锰氧化物中实现此前无法获得的交织有序态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不同方向的单轴应变会稳定性质截然不同的结构、电荷和轨道响应，而非仅仅改变同一相位的强度；极端单轴应变可选择性地诱导合作型 Jahn-Teller 调制、呼吸型调制和位点选择性调制，从而在锰氧化物中实现此前无法获得的交织有序态。；创新点：揭示了方向选择性单轴应变（而非仅应变强度）可作为调控量子材料中新兴交织有序态的选择性工程手段，特别是实现了在传统应变条件下无法获得的电荷-轨道-晶格耦合新相。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Finite-size occupancy scaling of apparent fractal dimensions in stochastic trajectories
papers.abstract: Estimating a fractal dimension from a finite stochastic trajectory is a finite-size scaling problem: the apparent box-counting exponent is shaped by an occupancy crossover between the resolved range of scales and the finite number of sampled points, and need not equal the dimension of the limiting process. We model this crossover with a balls-in-boxes occupancy law, which predicts the box-count curve, the finite-size saturation scale, and a scaling function for the normalized local slope. Across random-walk traces, fractional Brownian graphs, and Levy flights, the normalized local slope collapses onto a single crossover curve, while the windowed box-counting bias collapses when the regression window is positioned relative to the saturation scale. Inverting the occupancy model gives a finite-size bias correction that reduces error on controlled stochastic trajectories and transfers across held-out model classes. Comparisons with correlation dimension, detrended fluctuation analysis, the variogram, and Higuchi's method show that the dominant bias is specific to point-sampled box-counting over finite scale windows, and that local-slope stability alone is not a reliable diagnostic. A DNA-walk example illustrates the workflow on measured data, and all figures, tables, and in-text numbers are regenerated from released single-seed code.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：finite-size scaling、occupancy model、scaling function、bias correction、code release。；研究对象：随机轨迹（random-walk traces、fractional Brownian graphs、Levy flights）的有限尺寸标度行为，具体研究从有限长度随机轨迹中估计分形维数时的有限尺寸效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限随机轨迹的表观盒计数分形维数受限于一个“占据数交叉”效应，该效应由采样点数与观测尺度共同决定，并不等于极限过程的分形维数。通过“球入盒”占据数模型可统一描述该交叉行为，并给出有限尺寸偏差校正方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限随机轨迹的表观盒计数分形维数受限于一个“占据数交叉”效应，该效应由采样点数与观测尺度共同决定，并不等于极限过程的分形维数。通过“球入盒”占据数模型可统一描述该交叉行为，并给出有限尺寸偏差校正方法。；创新点：提出了一个基于占据数模型的有限尺寸偏差校正方案，该校正可跨模型类迁移（在一种随机过程上训练后可用于其他类型轨迹），并指出局部斜率稳定性本身不是可靠的分形维数诊断指标。摘要未突出说明与已有理论模型的本质区别。
papers.method_zh: 采用“球入盒”（balls-in-boxes）占据数模型预测盒计数曲线、有限尺寸饱和尺度以及归一化局部斜率的标度函数。在随机游走、分数布朗运动、Levy飞行等轨迹上验证标度函数的数据塌缩，并与关联维数、去趋势波动分析、变异函数、Higuchi方法进行偏差对比。所有结果由单种子代码复现。

papers.title: Machine-learning-accelerated discovery of synthesizable high-temperature altermagnets with giant spin splitting
papers.abstract: Altermagnets offer a route to spin-polarized electronic states without macroscopic magnetization, because compensated magnetic order can generate momentum-dependent spin splitting through crystal-symmetry-controlled exchange fields. However, experimentally viable altermagnets combining large spin splitting, thermodynamic stability and high magnetic ordering temperatures remain scarce. Here, we develop a machine-learning-accelerated high-throughput framework to explore the tetragonal AB$_2$C$_2$D compounds. Screening 8640 variants identifies 1347 compensated antiferromagnetic candidates satisfying altermagnetic symmetry. An interpretable XGBoost model trained on first-principles spin-splitting data then isolates 34 low-hull-energy candidates,including four previously reported, with giant non-relativistic spin splittings exceeding 1.5 eV near the Fermi level. Detailed first-principles calculations of the representative RbMn$_2$Te$_2$O confirm a maximum spin splitting of $\sim$1.88 eV with dynamical stability and an estimated Néel temperature of $\sim$390 K. The giant splitting originates from symmetry-locked Mn-sublattice exchange fields amplified by directional Mn-d/Te-p hybridization. Furthermore, we uncover a profound soft-mode-driven structural transition associated with an interlayer dimensionality crossover in SrMn$_2$Te$_2$O, yet the unfolded electronic structure demonstrates that the altermagnetic spin splitting remains robust after lattice reconstruction. Hydrostatic pressure provides an additional tuning route, producing non-monotonic modulation of the spin-split Fermi surface governed by local coordination and orbital hybridization. These results establish tetragonal AB$_2$C$_2$D compounds as a tunable materials platform for stray-field-free spintronic devices and provide a general data-driven strategy for discovering robust giant-splitting altermagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（结合机器学习加速高通量筛选与第一性原理计算）。判断依据关键词：machine-learning-accelerated high-throughput framework、first-principles calculations、XGBoost model。；研究对象：四方晶系AB₂C₂D化合物中的交变磁体（altermagnets），具体关注具有大自旋劈裂、热力学稳定性和高磁有序温度的可合成候选材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过机器学习加速的高通量筛选，从8640种变体中识别出34种低形成焓候选材料，其中代表性材料RbMn₂Te₂O在费米能级附近具有约1.88 eV的非相对论性巨自旋劈裂，且奈尔温度估计约390 K，同时具备动力学稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过机器学习加速的高通量筛选，从8640种变体中识别出34种低形成焓候选材料，其中代表性材料RbMn₂Te₂O在费米能级附近具有约1.88 eV的非相对论性巨自旋劈裂，且奈尔温度估计约390 K，同时具备动力学稳定性。；创新点：建立了四方AB₂C₂D化合物作为可调控的无杂散场自旋电子学材料平台，并揭示了软模驱动的结构相变（如SrMn₂Te₂O中的层间维度交叉）下交变磁自旋劈裂的鲁棒性，以及静水压对自旋劈裂费米面的非单调调控机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用机器学习加速高通量筛选框架：先基于交变磁对称性筛选出1347种补偿反铁磁候选物；再使用可解释的XGBoost模型（基于第一性原理自旋劈裂数据训练）进一步筛选；最后对代表性材料进行详细的第一性原理计算（包括动力学稳定性、奈尔温度估算、电子结构分析及压力调控模拟）。

papers.title: Dark-Soliton Branch Blocking in Transonic Bose--Einstein Condensate Flows
papers.abstract: Acoustic horizons in Bose--Einstein condensates are usually characterized through long-wavelength Bogoliubov phonons. We study a nonlinear counterpart: whether a one-dimensional dark-soliton branch can sustain upstream laboratory motion in a stationary transonic flow. The mechanism is local at leading order. A regular dark soliton has a bounded fluid-frame velocity, limited by the local sound speed; therefore, in the supersonic region, the background flow exceeds the largest upstream velocity available to the soliton branch. The sonic point is thus the upstream edge of the local dark-soliton branch, rather than a hard wall or a soliton geodesic surface. We construct stationary transonic Gross--Pitaevskii backgrounds and evolve the full order parameter in an open, nonperiodic domain. The simulations show upstream propagation on the subsonic side, finite-depth stalling on the subsonic side, and downstream advection for defects initialized in the supersonic region with upstream velocity relative to the fluid. Convergence, branch-consistency, local-density, phase-jump, and a dense scan of dimensionless upstream attempts support the soliton-like interpretation. The result is a branch-existence constraint, not a rigorous lower bound on arbitrary density minima of the Gross--Pitaevskii field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：construct、evolve、simulations、Gross–Pitaevskii backgrounds、order parameter。；研究对象：玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（Bose–Einstein condensate）中的跨声速流动（transonic flow），具体研究一维暗孤子分支（dark-soliton branch）在该流动中的传播行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在跨声速流动中，暗孤子分支的上游传播被声学视界（sonic point）阻断，而非被硬边界或孤子测地线表面阻断；在亚声速区域孤子可向上游传播，在超声速区域则被下游平流带走。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在跨声速流动中，暗孤子分支的上游传播被声学视界（sonic point）阻断，而非被硬边界或孤子测地线表面阻断；在亚声速区域孤子可向上游传播，在超声速区域则被下游平流带走。；创新点：揭示了暗孤子分支在跨声速流中存在的约束条件（branch-existence constraint），而非对Gross–Pitaevskii场任意密度极小值的严格下界；将声学视界的描述从长波Bogoliubov声子推广到非线性暗孤子分支。
papers.method_zh: 基于Gross–Pitaevskii方程构建稳态跨声速背景，并在开放非周期域中演化完整序参量（order parameter）。通过数值模拟进行收敛性检验、分支一致性检验、局域密度与相位跳跃分析，以及对无量纲上游尝试速度进行密集扫描。

papers.title: Magneto-Optical Detection of Anisotropic Spin Currents in Altermagnetic RuO2
papers.abstract: Altermagnets are a recently identified class of collinear antiferromagnets that host large spin-split electronic bands, offering a promising platform for efficient spin-current generation. Among proposed candidates, the metallic oxide RuO2 is predicted to exhibit strong altermagnetic spin splitting; however, whether it sustains robust magnetic order beyond the ultrathin thickness limit remains unresolved. Here, we employ optical probes to investigate charge-to-spin conversion in a 12-nm-thick (101)-oriented RuO2 film grown on sapphire. Polarization-resolved second-harmonic generation reveals nonlinear optical responses consistent with the surface symmetry and Néel order of RuO2. Under an applied current, both second-harmonic generation and polar magneto-optical Kerr effect measurements detect a pronounced, directionally anisotropic spin polarization, exhibiting enhanced signals for current along [010] and strongly suppressed responses for current along [-101], in agreement with the symmetry of the altermagnetic spin-splitter effect. Non-magnetic or Rashba-type mechanisms cannot explain this symmetry-selective response. Scanning transmission electron microscopy further reveals that substantial strain persists even in relatively thick films, providing a possible explanation for the observed behavior. Therefore, these results establish RuO2 as an efficient spin source and demonstrate the potential of altermagnets for field-free spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“employ optical probes”、“measurements detect”、“Scanning transmission electron microscopy further reveals”等实验手段和观测结果。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是12纳米厚的(101)取向的RuO2薄膜（生长在蓝宝石衬底上），物理现象是交变磁体（altermagnet）中的各向异性自旋电流产生与探测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验证实了RuO2薄膜在12纳米厚度下仍能保持交变磁有序，并观测到与交变磁自旋劈裂效应（spin-splitter effect）对称性一致的方向各向异性自旋极化，确立了RuO2作为高效自旋源的地位。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验证实了RuO2薄膜在12纳米厚度下仍能保持交变磁有序，并观测到与交变磁自旋劈裂效应（spin-splitter effect）对称性一致的方向各向异性自旋极化，确立了RuO2作为高效自旋源的地位。；创新点：首次通过光学手段（SHG和MOKE）在较厚（12纳米）的RuO2薄膜中直接探测到交变磁体特有的各向异性自旋电流，排除了非磁性或Rashba型机制的解释，并揭示了残余应变对稳定磁有序的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用了偏振分辨二次谐波产生（SHG）、极向磁光克尔效应（MOKE）测量，以及扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）对薄膜应变进行表征。

papers.title: Quantum anomalous Hall effect in chiral semimetals
papers.abstract: The quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) effect is conventionally understood to exist only in Chern insulators, while a recent study has shown that ferromagnetic metals can also host the QAH effect. Between insulators and metals, we demonstrate that QAH can persist even in a chiral semimetal, where conduction and valence bands touch at zero energy. Transport calculations demonstrate that the Hall conductivity of such a system can be quantized in the presence of dephasing. Interestingly, its longitudinal conductivity remains finite and exhibits semimetallic behavior, in contrast to Chern insulators. This unusual transport behavior originates from the quantization of the Berry curvature integral over occupied states and the semimetallic band structure. This chiral semimetal can transition into a Chern insulator, accompanied by the vanishing of longitudinal conductivity and a reduction of the intrinsic length scale of the Hall response. Our results extend the concept of QAH and uncover the semimetallic QAH transport signatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、transport calculations、theoretical framework。；研究对象：手性半金属（chiral semimetal）中的量子反常霍尔效应（QAH effect），具体关注其输运行为与能带结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在手性半金属中，尽管导带和价带在零能处接触（即非绝缘态），量子反常霍尔效应仍可存在，其霍尔电导在退相干存在下可量子化，而纵向电导保持有限且呈现半金属行为，这与陈绝缘体截然不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在手性半金属中，尽管导带和价带在零能处接触（即非绝缘态），量子反常霍尔效应仍可存在，其霍尔电导在退相干存在下可量子化，而纵向电导保持有限且呈现半金属行为，这与陈绝缘体截然不同。；创新点：将量子反常霍尔效应的存在范围从陈绝缘体和铁磁金属拓展至手性半金属，揭示了半金属体系中量子反常霍尔效应的独特输运特征（有限纵向电导与量子化霍尔电导共存）。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与输运计算（transport calculations），通过分析贝里曲率在占据态上的积分量子化以及半金属能带结构，研究退相干条件下的霍尔电导与纵向电导行为。

papers.title: Spin-Hall-Like Magnon Transport in a Synthetic Antiferromagnetic Skyrmion Lattice
papers.abstract: We investigate spin-Hall-like magnon edge transport in a synthetic antiferromagnetic skyrmion lattice composed of two antiferromagnetically coupled skyrmion lattice layers with opposite magnetic textures. Based on a relaxed bilayer texture from micromagnetic simulations, we construct the bosonic Bogoliubov-de Gennes Hamiltonian within linear spin-wave theory and calculate the bulk and strip magnon spectrum. We find counterpropagating in-gap edge modes with opposite layer polarization, whose layer-resolved propagation is further confirmed by dynamical micromagnetic simulations. A symmetry analysis shows that the fully coupled system lacks the pseudo-time-reversal symmetry required for a genuine bosonic Z2 topological phase. Thus, the observed edge modes are not Z2-protected helical magnon edge states, but layer-polarized, spin-Hall-like modes originating from the opposite Hall tendencies of the two skyrmion lattice layers. These results establish synthetic antiferromagnetic skyrmion lattices as a platform for spin-Hall-like magnon transport beyond a strict bosonic Z2 classification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章（关键词：micromagnetic simulations、linear spin-wave theory、Bogoliubov-de Gennes Hamiltonian、symmetry analysis）；研究对象：由两个磁织构相反的反铁磁耦合斯格明子晶格层构成的人工反铁磁斯格明子晶格中的类自旋霍尔磁子边缘输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在该双层体系中发现了具有相反层极化的反向传播带隙边缘模，这些模式并非受Z2拓扑保护的螺旋磁子边缘态，而是源于两层斯格明子晶格相反霍尔趋势的层极化类自旋霍尔模。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在该双层体系中发现了具有相反层极化的反向传播带隙边缘模，这些模式并非受Z2拓扑保护的螺旋磁子边缘态，而是源于两层斯格明子晶格相反霍尔趋势的层极化类自旋霍尔模。；创新点：揭示了人工反铁磁斯格明子晶格中超越严格玻色子Z2分类的类自旋霍尔磁子输运机制，指出观测到的边缘模并非拓扑保护态，而是由层间相反霍尔效应导致。
papers.method_zh: 基于微磁模拟获得弛豫后的双层织构，在线性自旋波理论框架下构建玻色子Bogoliubov-de Gennes哈密顿量，计算体态和条带磁子能谱；并通过动力学微磁模拟验证层分辨的传播行为。

papers.title: Chirality in Structural Phase Transitions
papers.abstract: Chirality, defined by the absence of mirror and inversion symmetries, has attracted considerable attention owing to its unique physical phenomena, including cross-correlated responses such as current-induced magnetization (CIM) and chiral phonons. Recently, it has been established that chirality is characterized by electric toroidal (ET) multipoles: the ET monopole $G_0$ in cubic systems and the ET quadrupole $G_u$ in noncubic systems. In this paper, we investigate achiral-to-chiral (AtC) structural phase transitions driven by atomic displacements and construct $G_{0,u}$ as explicit functions of the displacement order parameter $η$ based on a group-theoretical approach. We show that the leading-order dependence of $G_{0,u}(η)$ is determined by the symmetry of the parent structure and the character of the displacive mode, providing a symmetry-based classification of AtC transitions beyond a binary distinction between achiral and chiral phases. We also demonstrate that $G_{0,u}(η)$ is directly reflected in observable quantities such as CIM and chiral phonon splitting (CPS), both of which scale consistently with $G_{0,u}(η)$. We further clarify the microscopic mechanism by which AtC transitions give rise to chiral phonons and CPS through the coupling between $G_{0,u}(η)$ and phonon degrees of freedom.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：group-theoretical approach（群论方法）、symmetry-based classification（基于对称性的分类）、microscopic mechanism（微观机制）。；研究对象：手性结构相变（achiral-to-chiral structural phase transitions），具体研究由原子位移驱动的手性相变，以及与之相关的电流诱导磁化（CIM）和手性声子分裂（CPS）等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 手性结构相变中，手性可由电环形（ET）多极子（立方体系中的ET单极子G₀和非立方体系中的ET四极子G_u）定量表征，且这些多极子作为位移序参量η的显式函数，其主导阶行为由母相对称性和位移模式性质决定，从而提供了超越二元手性/非手性分类的对称性分类方案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：手性结构相变中，手性可由电环形（ET）多极子（立方体系中的ET单极子G₀和非立方体系中的ET四极子G_u）定量表征，且这些多极子作为位移序参量η的显式函数，其主导阶行为由母相对称性和位移模式性质决定，从而提供了超越二元手性/非手性分类的对称性分类方案。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用群论方法（group-theoretical approach），构建电环形多极子G₀和G_u作为位移序参量η的显式函数，并分析其与电流诱导磁化（CIM）和手性声子分裂（CPS）的标度关系，以及通过G₀,u(η)与声子自由度的耦合阐明手性声子产生的微观机制。

papers.title: Lattice-Trapped Atom Interferometry with a Bose-Einstein condensate: Observation and Control of Interactions
papers.abstract: Precision interferometry with atomic wavepackets confined in a one-dimensional optical lattice is an emergent paradigm in quantum sensing of forces and fields, with applications in gravimetry, accelerometry, geophysics, and fundamental physics tests. We report on the realization of a lattice-trapped interferometer where the two arms are sourced from a weakly-interacting ytterbium Bose-Einstein condensate, coherently split and trapped by pulsed optical standing waves before recombination. We directly observe atomic interactions through contrast changes and phase shifts of the interferometer. By changing either the atom number or the sample volume to vary the density, we demonstrate control over interactions and optimize interferometer performance. Our observations are effectively captured by a mean-field theoretical model of the system. This work experimentally probes the boundary where improved performance from source brightening through higher phase space density transitions into a regime beyond single-atom physics in lattice-trapped atom interferometry, and opens a door to incorporating many-body effects for metrological advances in such platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We report on the realization”“We directly observe”“We demonstrate”等表述，描述了实验实现、观测和调控过程。；研究对象：一维光学晶格中囚禁的镱（Ytterbium）玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（Bose-Einstein condensate, BEC）构成的原子干涉仪，具体研究其中原子相互作用对干涉对比度和相位的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改变原子数或样品体积来调控密度，可以控制原子相互作用，从而优化干涉仪性能；实验观测到的对比度变化和相移可由平均场理论模型有效描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过改变原子数或样品体积来调控密度，可以控制原子相互作用，从而优化干涉仪性能；实验观测到的对比度变化和相移可由平均场理论模型有效描述。；创新点：该工作实验上探索了晶格囚禁原子干涉仪中，从通过提高相空间密度来增强源亮度（改善性能）过渡到超越单原子物理的相互作用主导区域之间的边界，为在该类平台上引入多体效应以实现计量学进步打开了大门。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用脉冲光学驻波对弱相互作用的镱BEC进行相干分束和囚禁，实现晶格囚禁原子干涉仪；通过改变原子数或样品体积来调控密度，从而控制相互作用；理论方面使用平均场模型对实验结果进行解释。

papers.title: On the Equivariant Learning of the $Q$-tensor Order Parameter
papers.abstract: We construct and evaluate group-equivariant neural networks for the prediction of the two-dimensional $Q$-tensor order parameter of nematic liquid crystals from synthetically generated microscopic textures. Seven architectures, equivariant to cyclic groups $C_k$ of order $k$ for $k=4,\,8,\,16,\,32,\,64,\,128,\, 256$, are built using a combination of weight-sharing constraints, equivariant activations and regularization techniques. To do this, we construct rotation-like permutation matrix groups with elements $\varrho_{C_k}(g)$ that act on row-wise vectorized images, thereby approximating a $\frac{2π}{k}$ rotation of the circular subdomain on square images. We show that all seven equivariant models satisfy the $Q$-tensor equivariance constraint to within single-precision floating point accuracy. Comparing against approximate parameter-matched non-equivariant benchmarks, with and without data augmentation, we find that the equivariant models consistently achieve lower errors and generalize more robustly to unseen defect configurations. Performance increases with group order, suggesting that the incorporation of finer rotational symmetry leads to lower errors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：neural networks（神经网络）、synthetically generated（合成生成）、architecture（架构设计）。；研究对象：二维向列相液晶的Q张量序参量，具体从合成生成的微观纹理图像中预测该序参量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构建的群等变神经网络模型能够以单精度浮点精度满足Q张量等变约束，且相比非等变模型（无论是否使用数据增强）均获得更低的预测误差，对未见缺陷构型的泛化能力更强；模型性能随群阶数（旋转对称性精细度）增加而提升。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构建的群等变神经网络模型能够以单精度浮点精度满足Q张量等变约束，且相比非等变模型（无论是否使用数据增强）均获得更低的预测误差，对未见缺陷构型的泛化能力更强；模型性能随群阶数（旋转对称性精细度）增加而提升。；创新点：首次将群等变神经网络系统应用于液晶Q张量序参量的预测，并系统研究了不同阶数循环群等变性对预测精度和泛化能力的影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用群等变神经网络架构，通过权重共享约束、等变激活函数和正则化技术构建了七种分别对C_k（k=4,8,16,32,64,128,256）循环群等变的模型。具体构造了作用于行向量化图像的旋转类置换矩阵群，近似实现方形图像上圆形子域的2π/k旋转。

papers.title: Spontaneous breaking of non-invertible symmetries and duality to beyond-Landau transitions
papers.abstract: Spontaneous symmetry breaking is a well-understood mechanism for generating distinct phases of matter. Recently, the notion of symmetry has been broadened to include operations without inverses, leading to the concept of non-invertible symmetries. How do symmetry-breaking phases associated with non-invertible symmetries differ from those arising from conventional invertible symmetries? We address this question using concrete lattice models of the gapped phases with non-invertible Rep($H_8$) symmetry as an example. We find that, despite the symmetry being non-invertible, the symmetry-breaking phases can still be characterized by the long-range correlation of local order parameters, which obey a more general algebraic structure than in the invertible setting. Furthermore, via generalized gauging, certain non-invertible symmetry-breaking transitions can be mapped to deconfined quantum critical points of invertible symmetries, and vice versa. We establish precise conditions under which this duality holds and illustrate them with several families of examples, providing a systematic route to studying beyond-Landau phase transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：lattice models、generalized gauging、duality。；研究对象：非可逆对称性自发破缺的相及其相变，具体以具有非可逆Rep($H_8$)对称性的能隙相为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非可逆对称性破缺相仍可由局域序参量的长程关联来刻画，但序参量满足比可逆对称性情形更一般的代数结构；通过广义规范变换，某些非可逆对称性破缺相变可映射为可逆对称性的退禁闭量子临界点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非可逆对称性破缺相仍可由局域序参量的长程关联来刻画，但序参量满足比可逆对称性情形更一般的代数结构；通过广义规范变换，某些非可逆对称性破缺相变可映射为可逆对称性的退禁闭量子临界点。；创新点：首次系统建立了非可逆对称性破缺相变与可逆对称性退禁闭量子临界点之间的对偶关系，并给出了该对偶成立的精确条件，为研究超越朗道相变提供了系统途径。
papers.method_zh: 使用具体格点模型构建具有非可逆Rep($H_8$)对称性的能隙相，通过广义规范变换（generalized gauging）建立非可逆对称性破缺相变与可逆对称性退禁闭量子临界点之间的对偶关系，并给出该对偶成立的精确条件。

papers.title: A supersymmetric study of charge and spin transport in Weyl semimetals under axionic electrodynamic response
papers.abstract: We investigate the charge and spin transport properties of a Weyl semimetal under an external magnetic field using a low-energy effective theory. By performing a chiral transformation, we remove the axial term from the fermionic Lagrangian, while its physical effects are retained through the system's electromagnetic response. This response, derived from integrating out the fermionic degrees of freedom, takes the form of axionic electrodynamics and enters the Dirac equation via minimal coupling. The resulting dynamics separate naturally into magnetic and electric components: the magnetic sector admits a supersymmetric factorization, while the electric part exhibits a PT-supersymmetric structure. Robin boundary conditions are applied to the spinor, setting the energy spectrum and defining exact spinor solutions. We obtain the chiral projections of probability and current densities, exhibiting a chiral imbalance in the material. We show that in the x-direction, only one chirality contributes to the chiral current ($j^x_l = 0$). Spin density and currents where also computed. Our results demonstrate how the interplay between axionic response and supersymmetry governs transport phenomena in our specific setup, offering novel insights into the effective field theory description of Weyl semimetals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“low-energy effective theory”（低能有效理论）、“supersymmetric factorization”（超对称分解）、“PT-supersymmetric structure”（PT超对称结构）、“Robin boundary conditions”（Robin边界条件）。；研究对象：外磁场下的外尔半金属（Weyl semimetal）中的电荷与自旋输运现象，特别是其轴子电动力学响应（axionic electrodynamic response）与超对称性（supersymmetry）的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过手征变换将费米子拉格朗日量中的轴子项转化为电磁响应后，系统的动力学自然地分解为具有超对称结构的磁部分和具有PT超对称结构的电部分。研究发现，在特定方向（x方向）上，手征电流仅由一种手性贡献（j^x_l = 0），揭示了材料中的手征不平衡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过手征变换将费米子拉格朗日量中的轴子项转化为电磁响应后，系统的动力学自然地分解为具有超对称结构的磁部分和具有PT超对称结构的电部分。研究发现，在特定方向（x方向）上，手征电流仅由一种手性贡献（j^x_l = 0），揭示了材料中的手征不平衡。；创新点：将超对称（SUSY）和PT超对称（PT-SUSY）结构系统地引入到外尔半金属的轴子电动力学响应研究中，并利用Robin边界条件解析求解了手征输运特性，揭示了特定方向上手征电流的单一手性贡献。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或先前理论工作的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用低能有效理论框架。具体步骤包括：1）通过手征变换（chiral transformation）移除费米子拉格朗日量中的轴子项；2）通过积分掉费米子自由度得到轴子电动力学形式的电磁响应；3）将该响应通过最小耦合（minimal coupling）纳入狄拉克方程；4）对旋量施加Robin边界条件（Robin boundary conditions）以求解能谱和精确旋量解；5）计算概率流和电流密度的手征投影。

papers.title: A method for calculating entropy production without knowing transition rates or dwell times
papers.abstract: The entropy production rate is central to the study of non-equilibrium systems. This parameter is closely connected to violation of time-reversal symmetry, energy consumption, efficiency, and other properties of interest; in short, it quantifies how far a system is from thermodynamic equilibrium.
