Standard formulas for the entropy production require knowledge of the system's underlying dynamics, but this knowledge may be hard to acquire in practice. Here, I present a method for inferring the entropy production rate of a Markovian system from the sequence of states that the system occupies on a single long trajectory or many shorter trajectories, and the total time of the trajectory or trajectories. The method does not require knowledge of the dwell times in the various states, the times at which transitions occur, or of the transition rates characterizing the Markov process.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：method for inferring、Markovian system、theoretical framework。；研究对象：非平衡马尔可夫系统的熵产生率（entropy production rate），具体为从系统状态序列推断熵产生率的方法，不涉及特定材料或化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种无需知道跃迁速率或停留时间，仅凭系统状态序列和总时间即可计算马尔可夫系统熵产生率的方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种无需知道跃迁速率或停留时间，仅凭系统状态序列和总时间即可计算马尔可夫系统熵产生率的方法。；创新点：该方法不需要知道系统在不同状态的停留时间、跃迁发生的时间或表征马尔可夫过程的跃迁速率，降低了熵产生率计算对微观动力学细节的依赖。
papers.method_zh: 基于马尔可夫过程的状态序列分析，利用单条长轨迹或多条短轨迹的状态序列及总时间，通过理论推导构建熵产生率的推断方法，未使用具体实验手段或数值计算框架。

papers.title: Zero modes of non-abelian Dirac operator in topologically non-trivial band insulator
papers.abstract: We show that the local gauge-invariance of the quantum geometric tensor (QGT) defined in the Block-momentum space of a generic $N$-level (sublattice degrees of freedom) band insulator implies the existence of zero modes of non-abelian Dirac operator in such momentum space. Solutions of these zero modes equations in the two-dimensional Brillouin zone torus, in terms of Jacobi Theta function determine the probability amplitudes associated with the $N$-component ground state wave-function under adiabatic approximation in this Hilbert space. These solutions subjected to normalization, defines a complex projective ($CP$) space of $N-1$ dimension ($CP^{N-1}$ space) when one or more degeneracy points exist in the dispersion spectrum of such band-isulator. We show how the non-abelian generalization of the vortexability criterion of Chern bands automatically follows from these zero-mode equations, and also demonstrate their connection with momentum space-version of Lowest landau level algebra. Subsequently we write an Euclidean action from which these zero mode equations follow. We point out that the non-interacting part of different paradigms used to understand fractional Chern insulator(FCI) like phases in a host of two-dimensional material can be understood within this approach. We analyse two effective hamiltonian : lattice Dirac (QZW) model and two-band model for rhombohedral $N$-layer graphene in our propsoed framework and obtain important conclusions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、define、demonstrate、write an Euclidean action、analyse。；研究对象：拓扑非平凡能带绝缘体中非阿贝尔狄拉克算子的零模，以及与之相关的量子几何张量、分数陈绝缘体（FCI）相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了布洛赫动量空间中量子几何张量的局域规范不变性意味着非阿贝尔狄拉克算子零模的存在；这些零模方程的解（用雅可比Theta函数表示）定义了CP^{N-1}空间，并自动导出了陈带的非阿贝尔涡旋判据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了布洛赫动量空间中量子几何张量的局域规范不变性意味着非阿贝尔狄拉克算子零模的存在；这些零模方程的解（用雅可比Theta函数表示）定义了CP^{N-1}空间，并自动导出了陈带的非阿贝尔涡旋判据。；创新点：将量子几何张量的局域规范不变性与非阿贝尔狄拉克算子零模联系起来，并展示了该零模方程与动量空间最低朗道能级代数的联系，为理解分数陈绝缘体相提供了一个统一的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于N能带绝缘体的量子几何张量，在二维布里渊区环面上求解非阿贝尔狄拉克算子零模方程，利用雅可比Theta函数构造波函数；通过欧几里得作用量推导零模方程；将框架应用于晶格狄拉克（QZW）模型和菱面体N层石墨烯的两带有效哈密顿量。

papers.title: MATBG Josephson diode as an universal thermal machine
papers.abstract: Magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene Josephson junctions (MATBG-JJ) with a gate-tunable valley-polarized weak link exhibit an intrinsic Josephson diode effect originating from broken symmetries associated with valley polarization and band-structure anisotropy. Exploiting this nonreciprocal superconducting platform, we construct quantum Stirling (QSC), Otto (QOC), and Carnot (QCC) thermodynamic cycles, where the valley-polarization potential $Δ_v$ acts as the principal control parameter, in contrast to conventional Josephson thermal machines driven by superconducting phase bias. We systematically compare the performance of MATBG-based Josephson diode thermal machines (MATBG-JDTM) with MATBG-based Josephson junction thermal machines (MATBG-JJTM) and AA-stacked bilayer graphene Josephson junction thermal machines (AABLG-JJTM). Owing to the flat-band-enhanced density of states and electrically tunable nonreciprocal transport in MATBG, both MATBG-JDTM and MATBG-JJTM exhibit significantly enhanced work output and efficiency over a broad operating regime compared to AABLG-JJTM. In particular, the gate-controlled MATBG-JDTM provides a flux-free alternative to conventional phase-driven architectures, mitigating limitations associated with magnetic-flux control and flux-noise effects. Our results establish MATBG Josephson diode platforms as a promising route toward electrically tunable quantum thermal machines and nonreciprocal superconducting caloritronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中描述构建热力学循环、比较性能、分析机制，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：魔角扭曲双层石墨烯（MATBG）约瑟夫森二极管，以及基于该器件的量子热机（斯特林、奥托、卡诺循环）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用MATBG约瑟夫森二极管中由谷极化和能带各向异性导致的非互易超导特性，构建了以谷极化势为控制参数的热力学循环，其功输出和效率显著优于基于AA堆叠双层石墨烯的约瑟夫森结热机。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用MATBG约瑟夫森二极管中由谷极化和能带各向异性导致的非互易超导特性，构建了以谷极化势为控制参数的热力学循环，其功输出和效率显著优于基于AA堆叠双层石墨烯的约瑟夫森结热机。；创新点：提出了基于MATBG约瑟夫森二极管的电控热机方案，利用谷极化势替代传统超导相位偏置作为控制参数，实现了无需磁通调控的“无磁通”热机架构，避免了磁通噪声和磁通控制带来的限制。
papers.method_zh: 理论构建与性能比较。具体包括：构建量子斯特林（QSC）、奥托（QOC）和卡诺（QCC）热力学循环；以谷极化势Δ_v作为主控制参数；系统比较MATBG约瑟夫森二极管热机（MATBG-JDTM）、MATBG约瑟夫森结热机（MATBG-JJTM）和AA堆叠双层石墨烯约瑟夫森结热机（AABLG-JJTM）的性能。

papers.title: Relaxation-driven topological domains in moiré materials
papers.abstract: Spatial control of topology is highly desirable for realizing tunable quantum functionalities in materials. Moiré superlattices formed by twisting van der Waals heterostructures provide a natural platform for spatially modulated electronic phases, yet the emergence of tunable topological domains in these systems remains largely unexplored. Here we show that structural relaxation in twisted bilayer BiSb drives the formation of a distinct moiré topological phase, characterized by coexisting topologically nontrivial (Z$_2$ = 1) and trivial (Z$_2$ = 0) domains within a single moiré unit cell. As the twist angle is reduced, relaxation-induced modulation of the interlayer separation stabilizes an expanding network of topological regions embedded within trivial backgrounds of the moiré unit cell. The resulting internal domain boundaries host topologically-protected gapless 1D edge states that are directly visible in our simulated scanning-tunnelling microscopy maps.Furthermore, we demonstrate that the real-space topological domain structure and associated gapless edge states can be reversibly tuned by an out-of-plane electric field. Together, these results establish twisted BiSb as a promising platform for programmable topological domain patterning, where intrinsic networks of edge channels can be continuously tuned and electrically reconfigured in moiré materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章（关键词：simulated scanning-tunnelling microscopy maps、structural relaxation、Z₂拓扑不变量计算）；研究对象：扭曲双层BiSb（twisted bilayer BiSb）形成的莫尔超晶格中的拓扑畴结构
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 结构弛豫驱动扭曲双层BiSb形成单个莫尔原胞内共存的拓扑非平庸（Z₂=1）与平庸（Z₂=0）畴，畴边界处存在拓扑保护的边缘态，且该拓扑畴结构可通过垂直电场可逆调控。

papers.title: Atomic-Scale Observation of Symmetry Breaking in Altermagnetic MnTe
papers.abstract: The recent discovery of altermagnetism has sparked growing interest in compensated magnetic systems as promising platforms for highly scalable spintronics. Altermagnetism is a distinct magnetic order where opposite spin sublattices are connected by rotation, yielding zero net magnetization but momentum-dependent spin splitting. To date, experimental verification of altermagnetic order has been achieved predominantly through bulk-sensitive techniques, including spin-dependent electronic spectra and transport responses. However, direct atomic-scale evidence that explicitly correlates crystal symmetry, local structural distortions, and magnetic ordering has remained unexplored. Here, we report the direct atomic-scale observation of coexisting polar distortions and altermagnetic order in MnTe, combining atomic resolution scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) imaging with electron magnetic chiral dichroism (EMCD) measurements. We reveal that MnTe is not an ideal uniform P63/mmc g-wave altermagnet at the atomic scale. Instead, it hosts ubiquitous inversion-symmetry-breaking distortions that lower the spin-space-group (SSG) symmetry, admits d-wave altermagnetic components, and in lower-symmetry regimes, even allow s-wave spin splitting (net magnetization). The coexistence of ferroelectric signatures and altermagnetic order establishes local lattice symmetry in MnTe as a control knob for altermagnetic spin splitting, spin current generation, and multiferroic memory applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“atomic resolution scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) imaging”和“electron magnetic chiral dichroism (EMCD) measurements”等实验手段。；研究对象：反铁磁材料MnTe中的交变磁性（altermagnetism）及其与晶格对称性破缺的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在原子尺度上直接观察到MnTe中同时存在极性畸变和交变磁序，且局域晶格对称性破缺会降低自旋空间群对称性，引入d波甚至s波自旋劈裂（净磁化），表明MnTe并非理想的均匀g波交变磁体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在原子尺度上直接观察到MnTe中同时存在极性畸变和交变磁序，且局域晶格对称性破缺会降低自旋空间群对称性，引入d波甚至s波自旋劈裂（净磁化），表明MnTe并非理想的均匀g波交变磁体。；创新点：首次在原子尺度上直接建立晶格对称性、局域结构畸变与交变磁序之间的明确关联，揭示了MnTe中普遍存在的反演对称性破缺及其对自旋劈裂模式的调控作用，为多铁性存储和自旋电流生成提供了新思路。

papers.title: Emergence of an antiferromagnetic topological Anderson insulator in the interacting Haldane model
papers.abstract: We examine the emergence of topological Anderson insulating phases in the spinful Haldane model with Hubbard and next-neighbor density-density interactions, subject to Anderson disorder. Using finite-size exact diagonalization, we characterize the phases that arise from the interplay between topology, interactions, and disorder. In addition to standard $C=2$ topological Anderson phases, we observe an antiferromagnetic $C=1$ topological Anderson phase, consistent with the antiferromagnetic quantum anomalous Hall insulator previously identified in the clean model at finite staggered mass. We further analyze these phases using a neural network trained on the exact diagonalization data. Our results support the hypothesis that an explicit charge imbalance is required to induce the $C=1$ phase, generated by Anderson disorder rather than by a staggered mass.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：exact diagonalization（精确对角化）、neural network（神经网络）、模型计算。；研究对象：自旋简并的Haldane模型，包含Hubbard相互作用、次近邻密度-密度相互作用以及Anderson无序，研究拓扑、相互作用与无序共同作用下的物相。

papers.title: Inelastic Neutron Scattering of the layered Kitaev ferromagnet Li$_3$Co$_2$SbO$_6$
papers.abstract: Cobalt-based quantum magnets forming layered honeycomb arrangements have attracted much attention recently, as they are considered as a potential platform for materials with exotic Kitaev spin exchange. Amongst the discussed candidate materials are Na$_3$Co$_2$SbO$_6$ and Na$_2$Co$_2$TeO$_6$, both possessing a low-temperature ground state with magnetic zigzag ordering, similar to Na$_2$IrO$_3$ and $α$-RuCl$_3$. Here we report inelastic neutron scattering experiments on the quantum magnet Li$_3$Co$_2$SbO$_6$, which features ferromagnetic honeycomb planes with opposite magnetizations in neighboring planes. By comparing with linear spin wave theory, we show that the magnetic properties of Li$_3$Co$_2$SbO$_6$ can be well-modelled by an extended Kitaev--Heisenberg model, establishing it as a Kitaev-ferromagnet, or more specifically, as a Kitaev A-type antiferromagnet. Our analysis is complemented by magnetic field measurements and simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：inelastic neutron scattering experiments、magnetic field measurements and simulations）；研究对象：层状Kitaev铁磁体Li₃Co₂SbO₆，一种具有反铁磁型层间耦合的钴基蜂窝状量子磁体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Li₃Co₂SbO₆的磁性质可由扩展的Kitaev-Heisenberg模型很好地描述，被确认为Kitaev铁磁体（更具体地说是Kitaev A型反铁磁体）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Li₃Co₂SbO₆的磁性质可由扩展的Kitaev-Heisenberg模型很好地描述，被确认为Kitaev铁磁体（更具体地说是Kitaev A型反铁磁体）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 非弹性中子散射实验，结合线性自旋波理论进行对比分析，并辅以磁场测量与模拟。

papers.title: Quantum criticality of the ferromagnetic Dicke-Ising model
papers.abstract: We describe the quantum phase transitions in the ferromagnetic Dicke-Ising model using a Landau theory approach. The theory quantitatively captures the change from a second- to a first-order transition between the normal and superradiant phases through a tricritical point. We identify virtual correlated nearest-neighbor double spin-flip processes as the crucial mechanism responsible for this behavior. The tricritical point constitutes a quantum phase transition above the upper critical dimension. We discuss the modifications to finite-size scaling required for the correct interpretation of numerical data at the tricritical point. Our results emphasize the need for adapted finite-size scaling forms in all-to-all interacting quantum systems and establish the ferromagnetic Dicke-Ising model as a paradigmatic platform for quantum phase transitions above the upper critical dimension, encompassing both standard $φ^4$ criticality and beyond.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Landau theory approach”（朗道理论方法）、“finite-size scaling”（有限尺寸标度）等理论分析工具，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：铁磁Dicke-Ising模型中的量子相变行为，特别是正常相与超辐射相之间的相变，以及三临界点处的量子临界性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型通过朗道理论定量描述了从二级相变到一级相变的转变，并识别出虚关联的最近邻双自旋翻转过程是导致这一行为的关键机制。三临界点构成了高于上临界维度的量子相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型通过朗道理论定量描述了从二级相变到一级相变的转变，并识别出虚关联的最近邻双自旋翻转过程是导致这一行为的关键机制。三临界点构成了高于上临界维度的量子相变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但指出该工作强调了在全连接量子系统中需要采用适配的有限尺寸标度形式，并将铁磁Dicke-Ising模型确立为研究高于上临界维度量子相变的范例平台，涵盖标准φ⁴临界性及更广范围。

papers.title: Atomic Structure of Amorphous Optical Coatings of TiO$_2$-doped GeO$_2$ by Grazing-Incidence Total X-ray Scattering Measurements
papers.abstract: Reducing coating thermal noise in future gravitational-wave detectors requires identifying the atomic motifs that control mechanical loss in amorphous optical coatings. We combine grazing-incidence X-ray pair distribution function measurements with atomic-structure modeling to study amorphous TiO$_2$-doped GeO$_2$ films over Ti cation concentrations from $\sim$11 % to $\sim$48 %, before and after annealing. The structural analysis reveals systematic composition- and annealing-dependent changes in short- and intermediate-range order. Increasing Ti content raises the average Ti coordination and promotes edge- and face-sharing polyhedral connections, while Ge remains predominantly fourfold coordinated. Annealing reduces these compact shared-polyhedron motifs and sharpens the first sharp diffraction peak, indicating a more relaxed intermediate-range network. Among the structural descriptors examined, the clearest correlation with the annealing-induced reduction in mechanical loss is the decrease in edge- and face-sharing polyhedra. These results connect composition, annealing, atomic structure, and mechanical dissipation in TiO$_2$-doped GeO$_2$, providing microscopic guidance for optimizing low-noise mirror coatings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合原子结构建模）。判断依据：grazing-incidence X-ray pair distribution function measurements（掠入射X射线对分布函数测量）、atomic-structure modeling（原子结构建模）。；研究对象：非晶TiO₂掺杂GeO₂光学薄膜（amorphous TiO₂-doped GeO₂ films），具体研究其作为引力波探测器低噪声镜面涂层时的原子结构与力学损耗之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在TiO₂掺杂GeO₂非晶薄膜中，退火处理导致的力学损耗降低与结构中边共享和面共享多面体（edge- and face-sharing polyhedra）的减少之间存在最清晰的相关性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在TiO₂掺杂GeO₂非晶薄膜中，退火处理导致的力学损耗降低与结构中边共享和面共享多面体（edge- and face-sharing polyhedra）的减少之间存在最清晰的相关性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作通过系统关联组分、退火工艺、原子尺度结构（特别是短程和中程有序）与宏观力学损耗，为优化低噪声镜面涂层提供了微观层面的指导。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用掠入射X射线全散射测量（Grazing-Incidence Total X-ray Scattering）获取原子对分布函数（pair distribution function, PDF），并结合原子结构建模（atomic-structure modeling）进行分析。研究了Ti阳离子浓度从~11%到~48%的样品在退火前后的结构变化。

papers.title: Competition for Survival and the Maximum Entropy Production Principle in Self-Organized Silver Particle Chains
papers.abstract: The maximum entropy production (MEP) principle is a hypothetical law of physics which dictates that complex systems, far from equilibrium, evolve into an ordered dissipative structure (DS) which generates as much entropy per second as possible. An important problem is whether the natural competition for resources, limits the ability of DS to achieve the maximum of the entropy production rate (EPR). We investigate this competition between DS by performing high precision electrical measurements on suspensions of silver particles under electric fields. To establish the impact of competition on MEP principle, precise electrical measurements are performed on two Ag suspension samples connected in parallel. The samples are able to self-organize, dissipate energy, generate entropy, and compete with each other for resources, i.e., electrical current. Our findings are as follows: (1) There is a competition between the two samples, which prevents both systems from achieving their maximum possible contribution to the global entropy production rate. (2) Due to this competition, we find that only one out of two samples can self-organize, while the other deteriorates and approaches zero EPR. (3) The global EPR, i.e., the entropy produced by the samples and the energy supply circuit, is also reduced from its possible maximum due to the competition between the sub-systems. Based on these observations, we propose that the competition effect constitutes an essential constraint that must be incorporated into formulations of the MEP. This principle parallels real-world phenomena, reflecting the competition for resources observed among species and individual organisms in natural systems. We also examine the global implications of the MEP and propose that it serves as a driving mechanism propelling the hypothetical ascent of civilizations along the Kardashev scale.

papers.title: High-temperature instability of artificial cuprorivaite: a study using thermal analysis, X-ray powder diffractometry and polarized light microscopy
papers.abstract: CaCuSi$_4$O$_{10}$ powder was studied by differential scanning calorimetry and thermogravimetry methods in the range from room temperature to 1450$\,^{\circ}$C at heating and cooling rates of 20$\,^{\circ}$C/min. The process of decomposition of cuprorivaite, the composition and transformations of its decomposition products during successive heat treatments were also studied by powder X-ray diffraction and polarization optical microscopy techniques. It was found that CaCuSi$_4$O$_{10}$ starts to decompose by incongruent melting at a temperature of about 1020$\,^{\circ}$C, with the minimum of the endothermic DSC peak associated with this process being at 1064.4$\,^{\circ}$C. CaCuSi$_4$O$_{10}$ decomposes irreversibly and subsequent cyclic annealings up to a temperature of 1450$\,^{\circ}$C at heating and cooling rates of 20$\,^{\circ}$C/min do not cause its re-synthesis. CaCuSi$_4$O$_{10}$ transforms into a two-phase system consisting of acicular crystals of monoclinic tridymite fused with green glass with the composition CuO$\,-\,$Cu$_2$O$\,-\,$CaO$\,-\,$SiO$_2$, with the weight ratio of tridymite to glass being about $12:13$, as a result of two successive annealings up to the temperature of 1450$\,^{\circ}$C.

papers.abstract_summary_zh: CaCuSi₄O₁₀在约1020°C开始通过不一致熔融发生不可逆分解，最终形成由单斜鳞石英针状晶体与含CuO-Cu₂O-CaO-SiO₂的绿色玻璃组成的双相体系（鳞石英与玻璃质量比约12:13），且后续循环退火至1450°C无法使其重新合成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CaCuSi₄O₁₀在约1020°C开始通过不一致熔融发生不可逆分解，最终形成由单斜鳞石英针状晶体与含CuO-Cu₂O-CaO-SiO₂的绿色玻璃组成的双相体系（鳞石英与玻璃质量比约12:13），且后续循环退火至1450°C无法使其重新合成。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。

papers.title: Dirac-Line Criticality and Emergent Horizons in Weyl Lifshitz Transitions
papers.abstract: Type-II Weyl fermions may emerge behind the event horizon of black holes. We employ the Painlevé-Gullstrand metric to study the surface of the Lifshitz transition at the horizon, equivalent to the interface separating the type-I and type-II Weyl states. We find several analogies between the black hole horizon and the transformation of type-I to type-II Weyl fermions through the Dirac line. We analyze the symmetry-protected topological order at the Lifshitz transition originating in semimetals. The emergence of Hawking radiation in Weyl semimetals is discussed. We show that the transition state from type-I to type-II Dirac fermions can be viewed as a black-hole horizon, which exhibits unique characteristics, including a Dirac-line Fermi surface with a nontrivial topological invariant and a critical chiral anomaly effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“我们采用...度量”、“我们分析...拓扑序”、“我们讨论...现象”等理论推导和概念类比的语言，未提及任何实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：论文研究的是Weyl半金属中从第一类（type-I）Weyl费米子到第二类（type-II）Weyl费米子的Lifshitz相变过程，特别是相变界面处的物理现象。该界面被类比为黑洞的事件视界。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文发现，第一类到第二类Weyl费米子的转变态可以视为一个黑洞视界，该视界具有独特的性质，包括一个具有非平凡拓扑不变量的狄拉克线费米面以及临界手征反常效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文发现，第一类到第二类Weyl费米子的转变态可以视为一个黑洞视界，该视界具有独特的性质，包括一个具有非平凡拓扑不变量的狄拉克线费米面以及临界手征反常效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明该工作相对于已有研究的具体新意，但核心创新在于将黑洞视界（特别是通过Painlevé-Gullstrand度规描述的视界）与Weyl半金属中第一类到第二类费米子的Lifshitz相变界面进行了精确的物理类比，并揭示了该转变态具有狄拉克线费米面和临界手征反常等独特性质。

papers.title: A cryogenic apparatus for coupling two-dimensional materials to a confocal multimode optical cavity
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional van der Waals materials exhibit a variety of correlated electron phases, and optical driving offers a promising route toward manipulating them. For example, cavity-enhanced, continuous-wave (CW) Raman excitation has been suggested as a way to coherently and superradiantly populate phonons or charge density waves via material excitons. A steady-state phonon population may be sustained with sufficiently strong electron-phonon coupling to drive novel collective response. We describe an apparatus built to meet the requirements of such an experimental program: Namely, an ultrahigh-vacuum system housing a length-tunable confocal Fabry-Pérot cavity with an intracavity sample, both cryogenically cooled and stabilized against vibrations. A four-axis nanopositioner aligns the sample and supports electrical leads for sample carrier density modulation and transport measurements. Transmission through the multimode cavity enables in situ sample imaging for alignment; the sample is a transition metal dichalcogenide in this work. Operating near the confocal geometry concentrates the optical field into a localized supermode that substantially enhances light-matter coupling. This enhancement is preserved despite the millimeter-scale cavity length, which provides room for sample alignment and exchange.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“apparatus”、“built”、“ultrahigh-vacuum system”、“nanopositioner”、“measurements”。；研究对象：二维范德华材料（具体为过渡金属硫族化合物）与共焦多模光学腔的耦合系统，以及通过光驱动（特别是腔增强连续波拉曼激发）操控其关联电子相（如声子或电荷密度波）的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功搭建了一套低温、超高真空、振动稳定的实验装置，该装置通过将二维材料置于可调谐共焦法布里-珀罗腔内，利用近共焦几何结构产生的局域超模显著增强了光-物质耦合，为通过腔增强拉曼激发实现声子或电荷密度波的相干布居提供了实验平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功搭建了一套低温、超高真空、振动稳定的实验装置，该装置通过将二维材料置于可调谐共焦法布里-珀罗腔内，利用近共焦几何结构产生的局域超模显著增强了光-物质耦合，为通过腔增强拉曼激发实现声子或电荷密度波的相干布居提供了实验平台。；创新点：该工作的主要新意在于设计并实现了一套满足特定实验要求的装置：在毫米级腔长（为样品对准和更换留出空间）的共焦腔中，通过局域超模实现了显著的光-物质耦合增强，同时集成了低温、超高真空、样品操控和电学测量功能，为研究二维材料中光驱动下的集体量子现象提供了前所未有的实验条件。
papers.method_zh: 实验装置搭建。具体包括：1）一套包含长度可调谐共焦法布里-珀罗腔的超高真空系统，样品置于腔内，整体进行低温冷却和振动稳定化处理；2）一个四轴纳米定位器用于样品对准，并集成电引线以进行载流子密度调制和输运测量；3）利用多模腔的透射光进行原位样品成像以辅助对准。

papers.title: How reproducible are first-principles simulations of liquid water?
papers.abstract: Liquid water is fundamentally important, and its accurate computer simulation has been the driving force for myriad methodological developments. Ab initio molecular dynamics with forces obtained from density functional theory (DFT) is now a standard tool widely used by researchers. However, we reveal that previous studies of liquid water using the same widely-used density functional (revPBE-D3) exhibit significant discrepancies with one another, varying by over 20% in the diffusion coefficient and 10% in the density, raising fundamental questions about reproducibility. By combining modern long-range machine-learning interatomic potentials that enable robust statistical sampling with carefully converged DFT training data, we resolve these discrepancies, achieving consensus across six diverse community codes. Our predictions differ markedly from previous literature: we show that most previous results overestimate the density and underestimate the diffusion coefficient of revPBE-D3 water due to basis set incompleteness and pseudopotential inconsistencies, coupled with limitations in statistical sampling (in some cases). These benchmark values provide a reliable reference for validating current and future implementations of DFT-based ab initio molecular dynamics. Reaching agreement establishes confidence and credibility and serves as a prerequisite for the systematic assessment of new density functionals and numerical approximations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles simulations、ab initio molecular dynamics、density functional theory (DFT)、machine-learning interatomic potentials。；研究对象：液态水（liquid water），具体为使用revPBE-D3密度泛函描述的液态水体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 以往使用相同密度泛函（revPBE-D3）对液态水的第一性原理模拟结果之间存在显著差异（扩散系数差异超过20%，密度差异超过10%），而通过结合现代长程机器学习原子间势与严格收敛的DFT训练数据，可以消除这些分歧，得到跨六个不同社区代码的共识结果，且该结果与以往文献显著不同：以往结果普遍高估密度、低估扩散系数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：以往使用相同密度泛函（revPBE-D3）对液态水的第一性原理模拟结果之间存在显著差异（扩散系数差异超过20%，密度差异超过10%），而通过结合现代长程机器学习原子间势与严格收敛的DFT训练数据，可以消除这些分歧，得到跨六个不同社区代码的共识结果，且该结果与以往文献显著不同：以往结果普遍高估密度、低估扩散系数。；创新点：揭示了使用相同泛函（revPBE-D3）的液态水模拟在文献中存在的严重不可重复性问题，并通过机器学习势与严格收敛的DFT数据相结合的方法，首次实现了跨多种代码的定量一致，提供了可靠的基准值，为评估DFT基第一性原理分子动力学实现及新泛函提供了可信参考。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）中的revPBE-D3泛函进行第一性原理分子动力学模拟，并利用长程机器学习原子间势（long-range machine-learning interatomic potentials）实现稳健的统计采样，同时确保DFT训练数据严格收敛。研究涉及六个不同的社区代码进行交叉验证。

papers.title: Three-dimensional orbital-free density functional theory description of nuclear pasta in the inner crust of neutron stars
papers.abstract: Background: In the bottom layer of the inner crust of neutron stars, various crystalline structures are expected to emerge that are collectively called ``nuclear pasta.'' It is desired to know properties of nuclear pasta in a wide variety of conditions for astrophysical applications. However, three-dimensional fully-microscopic calculations require huge computational effort that makes it still challenging to carry out systematic calculations. Purpose: In this paper, we propose an efficient method to calculate various nuclear pasta configurations in a non-empirical manner, based on three-dimensional orbital-free density functional theory (OF-DFT). We demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed approach by applying it to densities throughout the inner crust of neutron stars. Methods: As a first application of OF-DFT for nuclear pasta, we employ the second-order extended Thomas-Fermi (ETF) expansion of Skyrme energy density functional (EDF) to construct an EDF that depends only on neutron and proton number densities. Based on the variational principle, we derive Euler-Lagrange equations to determine optimal neutron and proton density distributions and solve them self-consistently. In this work, we call this approach the self-consistent ETF (SC-ETF) method. Results: We perform three-dimensional SC-ETF calculations with various box sizes. We successfully obtain various pasta structures, depending on given average nucleon number densities, consistent with earlier studies. Moreover, we find other exotic structures, such as bending and/or connected rods, slabs with a hole, etc., underlining the advantage of the self-consistent formalism. Conclusions: We demonstrate that the SC-ETF method proposed in this study, which can be regarded as a realization of OF-DFT, is a promising tool that can efficiently describe complex pasta structures without empirical assumptions on geometric shapes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“three-dimensional orbital-free density functional theory (OF-DFT)”、“self-consistent ETF (SC-ETF) method”等理论计算方法，并强调“demonstrate the feasibility”和“perform calculations”。；研究对象：中子星内壳底层的“核意面”（nuclear pasta）结构，即各种预期出现的晶体状核物质构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于三维无轨道密度泛函理论（OF-DFT）的自洽扩展Thomas-Fermi（SC-ETF）方法能够高效、非经验地描述多种核意面结构，包括弯曲/连接的棒状、带孔板状等奇异构型，且结果与早期研究一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于三维无轨道密度泛函理论（OF-DFT）的自洽扩展Thomas-Fermi（SC-ETF）方法能够高效、非经验地描述多种核意面结构，包括弯曲/连接的棒状、带孔板状等奇异构型，且结果与早期研究一致。；创新点：首次将三维无轨道密度泛函理论（OF-DFT）应用于核意面计算，提出SC-ETF方法，无需对几何形状做经验假设即可自动获得复杂构型（如弯曲/连接的棒、带孔板等），显著提高了计算效率，有望实现系统性的非经验研究。
papers.method_zh: 采用Skyrme能量密度泛函（EDF）的二阶扩展Thomas-Fermi（ETF）展开，构建仅依赖于中子和质子数密度的EDF；基于变分原理导出Euler-Lagrange方程，自洽求解最优的中子和质子密度分布（即SC-ETF方法），并在三维空间中进行不同盒子尺寸的计算。

papers.title: Heatomics
papers.abstract: Living cells are energy- and information-processing systems that sustain a nonequilibrium steady state (NESS) by continuously consuming energy and dissipating heat, as required by the second law of thermodynamics. The rate of heat dissipation, or the entropy production rate $σ$, is the universal primal life signal and a unique descriptor of the cellular state. Living matter dissipates $P_{\mathrm{life}} \sim 1$ Watt/kilogram (W/kg), a remarkably conserved value across scales, from molecular reactions to entire organisms. Surprisingly, this high power density is $10^{4}$ times larger than that of the Sun and comparable to the universe's average, $P_U = c^2 H_0 \sim 1$ W/kg, where $c$ is the speed of light and $H_0$ the Hubble constant, a striking coincidence that aligns with Dirac's large number hypothesis. We hypothesize that this large $P_{\mathrm{life}}$ sets the scale for generating negentropy, the negative contribution to the overall positive $σ$ that sustains biological organization, distinguishing animate from inanimate matter. Here, I introduce heatomics, the science of studying $σ$ at the cellular and molecular scales, and the Variance Sum Rule, an experimental--theoretical framework that extracts $σ$ from fluctuations of a dynamical probe combined with the equation of state for a NESS. The emerging field of heatomics aims to elucidate the fundamental principles governing heat power generation, optimization of energy resources, and negentropy in living systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：introduce（提出）、hypothesize（假设）、experimental–theoretical framework（实验-理论框架）。；研究对象：生命系统中细胞和分子尺度的热耗散（熵产生率σ），以及生命物质与宇宙平均功率密度的对比关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 生命物质的功率密度（约1 W/kg）是太阳的10⁴倍，且与宇宙平均功率密度（c²H₀ ≈ 1 W/kg）惊人地一致，这一巧合与狄拉克大数假说相符。该功率密度为生命系统产生“负熵”（negentropy）设定了标度，从而区分生命与非生命物质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：生命物质的功率密度（约1 W/kg）是太阳的10⁴倍，且与宇宙平均功率密度（c²H₀ ≈ 1 W/kg）惊人地一致，这一巧合与狄拉克大数假说相符。该功率密度为生命系统产生“负熵”（negentropy）设定了标度，从而区分生命与非生命物质。；创新点：首次将生命系统的热耗散功率密度与宇宙学常数（哈勃常数）联系起来，并系统性地提出“热组学”作为研究细胞和分子尺度熵产生率的新学科。
papers.method_zh: 提出了“热组学”（heatomics）这一研究框架，以及“方差求和规则”（Variance Sum Rule），该规则通过结合动力学探针的涨落与非平衡稳态（NESS）的状态方程，从实验数据中提取熵产生率σ。

papers.title: Formation of bound composite vortices of a singly-quantized $^1$S$_0$ vortex and half-quantized $^3$P$_2$ vortices in the $^1$S$_0$-$^3$P$_2$ coexisting phase in neutron stars
papers.abstract: Pulsar glitches are believed to originate from the dynamics of quantized vortices in the neutron superfluid interior. The outer core of a neutron star hosts a $^3\text{P}_2$ spin-triplet superfluid, whose half-integer quantum vortices (HQVs) are qualitatively different from the $^1\text{S}_0$ singly quantized vortices (SQVs) in the inner crust. It has recently been proposed that the coupling between these two vortex species gives rise to a large-scale vortex network, providing a candidate mechanism for the diversity of observed pulsar glitch phenomena. Using the Gross--Pitaevskii equations for the $^1\text{S}_0$ and $^3\text{P}_2$ condensates, we perform two-dimensional simulations of one SQV and two HQVs in a coexistence phase near the crust-core boundary, varying the density--density and Josephson coupling constants. We find that the Josephson term, arising from the relative phase between the two condensates, induces a strong attractive interaction between the two HQVs and the SQV, which dominates over the density--density coupling. When pinning potentials are applied to the HQVs and the SQV at spatially separated locations, this attraction is found to be sufficiently strong to drive vortex depinning. These results suggest that two HQVs and one SQV can form a tightly bound composite vortex at the crust-core boundary, with implications for the glitch mechanism in neutron stars.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Gross–Pitaevskii方程、二维模拟、理论分析。；研究对象：中子星内部$^1$S$_0$超流与$^3$P$_2$超流共存相中，单量子化涡旋（SQV）与半量子化涡旋（HQV）之间的相互作用及复合涡旋的形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 约瑟夫森耦合项在$^1$S$_0$与$^3$P$_2$凝聚体之间诱导出强吸引作用，使得两个HQV与一个SQV能够形成紧密束缚的复合涡旋；该吸引力足够强，可驱动涡旋从钉扎势中脱出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：约瑟夫森耦合项在$^1$S$_0$与$^3$P$_2$凝聚体之间诱导出强吸引作用，使得两个HQV与一个SQV能够形成紧密束缚的复合涡旋；该吸引力足够强，可驱动涡旋从钉扎势中脱出。；创新点：揭示了约瑟夫森耦合（而非密度-密度耦合）在两种超流涡旋之间起主导吸引作用，并首次证明该吸引可导致涡旋脱钉扎，从而为脉冲星自转突变（glitch）机制提供新的微观图像。
papers.method_zh: 基于$^1$S$_0$和$^3$P$_2$凝聚体的Gross–Pitaevskii方程，在壳-核边界附近的共存相中进行二维数值模拟，改变密度-密度耦合常数和约瑟夫森耦合常数，并施加钉扎势。

papers.title: Orbital Altermagnetic Photonic Crystal
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism features momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization, extending spintronics beyond conventional ferromagnetism and antiferromagnetism. However, the photonic realization of altermagnetism has remained a formidable challenge due to the fundamental differences between fermionic electrons and bosonic photons. Here, we report the first experimental realization of an orbital altermagnetic photonic crystal, based on an antiunitary $C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$ symmetry enforced correspondence between a local $p$-orbital $σ/π$ doublet and crystal momentum. We experimentally demonstrate that the resulting system exhibits momentum-dependent spin splitting with alternating pseudospin polarization and a $d_{xy}$-wave form factor, as confirmed by measured band structures and iso-frequency contours. Moreover, we show that the orbital altermagnetic photonic crystal supports unique pseudospin-selective transport of electromagnetic waves, including photonic pseudospin splitting and pseudospin filtering. Our results extend the field of alternagnetism to photonic systems, opening a new avenue for designing spinphotonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“first experimental realization”（首次实验实现）、“measured band structures”（测量能带结构）等关键词。；研究对象：轨道交变磁性光子晶体（Orbital Altermagnetic Photonic Crystal）。具体体系是基于反幺正 $C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$ 对称性构建的、具有局域 $p$ 轨道 $\sigma/\pi$ 二重态的光子晶体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在实验上实现了光子体系中的交变磁性（altermagnetism），证明了该光子晶体具有动量依赖的自旋劈裂（表现为交替赝自旋极化和 $d_{xy}$ 波形式因子），并展示了独特的赝自旋选择性电磁波输运（包括光子赝自旋劈裂和赝自旋滤波）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在实验上实现了光子体系中的交变磁性（altermagnetism），证明了该光子晶体具有动量依赖的自旋劈裂（表现为交替赝自旋极化和 $d_{xy}$ 波形式因子），并展示了独特的赝自旋选择性电磁波输运（包括光子赝自旋劈裂和赝自旋滤波）。；创新点：将交变磁性（altermagnetism）的概念从电子费米子系统首次拓展到光子玻色子系统，实现了光子交变磁性，为设计自旋光子学器件开辟了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过测量能带结构和等频轮廓来表征系统的性质。理论框架基于反幺正 $C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$ 对称性所强制的局域 $p$ 轨道 $\sigma/\pi$ 二重态与晶体动量之间的对应关系。

papers.title: Thermodynamic-limit dispersion relations on trapped-ion quantum hardware
papers.abstract: We run a numerical linked-cluster expansion with a quantum algorithm (NLCE+QA), computing ground-state energies and one quasi-particle dispersions in the thermodynamic limit using a 20-qubit trapped-ion quantum processing unit (QPU). The NLCE+QA framework extracts thermodynamic-limit properties from small-cluster calculations, making it naturally suited for near-term quantum devices. Projector-based block-diagonalization schemes such as projective cluster-additive transformation (PCAT) are essential to NLCE+QA, and they involve matrix inversion and square root operations that amplify measurement noise. A central question is therefore whether current hardware can provide expectation values that are accurate enough to withstand non-linear classical post-processing. We explore this challenge for the transverse-field Ising model (TFIM) in one dimension, on a ladder geometry, as well as in a longitudinal field in one dimension. For the quantum algorithm, we consider adiabatic state preparation (ASP), as well as a variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) trained on a classical device. The final expectation values are obtained from the QPU, using a novel alternative to the Hadamard test that we name the CX-test. We explore the regimes currently attainable on quantum devices and comment on the improvements needed for quantum computers to achieve results beyond classical reach.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。关键词：quantum algorithm（量子算法）、trapped-ion quantum processing unit（离子阱量子处理器）、numerical linked-cluster expansion（数值链接簇展开）。；研究对象：横场伊辛模型（TFIM）在一维、梯子几何以及一维纵场下的热力学极限基态能量和单准粒子色散关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在20量子比特离子阱量子处理器上，通过数值链接簇展开结合量子算法（NLCE+QA）成功提取了热力学极限下的基态能量和准粒子色散，并验证了当前硬件能否提供足够精确的期望值以承受非线性经典后处理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在20量子比特离子阱量子处理器上，通过数值链接簇展开结合量子算法（NLCE+QA）成功提取了热力学极限下的基态能量和准粒子色散，并验证了当前硬件能否提供足够精确的期望值以承受非线性经典后处理。；创新点：首次在离子阱量子硬件上实现NLCE+QA框架，并引入CX-test作为Hadamard测试的替代方案，系统评估了当前量子器件在非线性后处理下的精度极限。
papers.method_zh: 数值链接簇展开+量子算法（NLCE+QA），使用投影簇可加变换（PCAT）进行块对角化；量子算法包括绝热态制备（ASP）和经典训练的变分量子本征求解器（VQE）；采用一种名为CX-test的新方法替代Hadamard测试来获取期望值。

papers.title: Surface Contact Approximation for Magneto-Thermal Finite Element Analysis of No-Insulation HTS Coils
papers.abstract: High-temperature superconducting (HTS) coated conductors (CCs) can be wound into no-insulation (NI) coils, in which electrical current can partially bypass local normal zones via turn-to-turn contact layers (T2TCLs). Accurate magneto-thermal simulation of such coils, therefore, requires an efficient representation of the electrical and thermal behavior of the T2TCLs. This paper introduces a magneto-thermal surface contact approximation (SCA) for finite element analysis of NI HTS coils. The formulation is derived as a special case of the more general thin shell approximation (TSA) by introducing suitable approximations such as negligible tangential surface currents and eddy-current effects inside the T2TCL. The resulting SCA formulation replaces the thin volumetric contact layer with a dedicated surface weak formulation based on the electric contact resistance and thermal contact conductance. In contrast, the TSA formulation requires the definition of electric resistivities and thermal conductivities as well as the thickness of the T2TCL. The SCA is implemented in the Pancake3D module of the free and open-source Finite Element Quench Simulator. It is verified through transient magneto-thermal simulations of a model NI pancake coil. Numerical results are compared against the established TSA formulation. The results show that the SCA accurately reproduces the relevant electromagnetic and thermal behavior. For the TSA, there is a trade-off between choosing large (potentially unphysical) thicknesses with low resistivities leading to inaccurate results, or small thicknesses with large resistivities making the linear system harder to solve, increasing the computational effort. In contrast, the SCA, thanks to using contact resistances and conductances directly without the necessity to define a thickness, is easy to use and robust.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：finite element analysis（有限元分析）、magneto-thermal simulation（磁热模拟）、formulation（公式推导）。；研究对象：无绝缘（NI）高温超导（HTS）线圈中的匝间接触层（T2TCL）的电磁与热行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种表面接触近似（SCA）方法，能够在不定义接触层厚度的情况下，准确再现无绝缘线圈的电磁与热行为，且比传统的薄壳近似（TSA）更易用、更鲁棒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种表面接触近似（SCA）方法，能够在不定义接触层厚度的情况下，准确再现无绝缘线圈的电磁与热行为，且比传统的薄壳近似（TSA）更易用、更鲁棒。；创新点：将原本需要定义厚度、电阻率和热导率的薄体积接触层，替换为直接基于接触电阻和接触热导的表面弱形式，避免了TSA中厚度选择带来的精度与计算效率之间的权衡问题。
papers.method_zh: 基于薄壳近似（TSA）引入简化假设（如忽略切向表面电流和涡流效应），推导出表面接触近似（SCA）公式；在开源有限元淬火模拟器（Finite Element Quench Simulator）的Pancake3D模块中实现；通过瞬态磁热模拟对模型无绝缘饼式线圈进行验证，并与TSA结果对比。

papers.title: A nonlinear beam model for photoresponsive thermoelastic solids driven by localised heating
papers.abstract: Asymptotic methods are used to derive a geometrically nonlinear beam model for thermoelastic solids with a spatially localised heat source. The asymptotic reduction is based on collapsing the heated region to a point. Away from the point of heating, the governing equations reduce to a pair of beam equations with nonlinear von Kármán strains. The effects of the localised heat source are captured through asymptotically consistent jump conditions that hold at the point of heating. The model accounts for changes in beam length due to longitudinal thermal expansion and bending moments produced by transverse thermal gradients. The model is used to study light-induced actuation of photoresponsive hydrogel beams with localised heating arising from laser irradiation. Two loading scenarios are considered. In the first, the ends of the beam are assumed to be free, resulting in a V-shaped deformation upon heating. An analytical expression for the fold angle of the V is provided. In the second, the beam is assumed to be in a pre-buckled configuration due to clamped end conditions. The critical conditions leading to light-driven snap-through are calculated. Offsetting the laser from the mid-point of the beam is found to inhibit the onset of snap through.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用渐近方法推导模型，并给出解析表达式和临界条件计算。；研究对象：光响应热弹性固体中的光束模型，具体应用于激光照射下光响应水凝胶梁的光致驱动变形。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出适用于局部热源加热的几何非线性梁模型，揭示了局部加热导致梁产生V形折叠变形，并发现激光偏离梁中点会抑制快跳失稳的发生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出适用于局部热源加热的几何非线性梁模型，揭示了局部加热导致梁产生V形折叠变形，并发现激光偏离梁中点会抑制快跳失稳的发生。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用渐近方法将加热区域坍缩为一点，推导出包含von Kármán非线性应变的梁方程，并通过渐近一致的跳跃条件描述局部热源效应。模型考虑了纵向热膨胀引起的长度变化和横向热梯度产生的弯曲力矩。

papers.title: LEIA: Learned Environment for Interactive Architected Materials
papers.abstract: World models have enabled interactive exploration of game environments and robotic manipulation, but physical engineering remains beyond their reach: real materials exhibit nonlinear constitutive laws, carry history-dependent internal state, undergo inertial dynamics, and may possess hierarchical structures spanning multiple length scales. We present LEIA (Learned Environment for Interactive Architected materials), a world model that lets engineers apply boundary conditions step by step and observe the resulting deformation and stress fields in real time. LEIA handles large three-dimensional unstructured meshes and generates autoregressive responses to user-specified loading. We introduce MicroPlate, a benchmark of architected plates spanning two regimes of microstructure modeling: architected lattices that resolve microstructure explicitly through three-dimensional geometry, and a homogeneous plate where microstructural change is modeled implicitly through internal degrees of freedom. MicroPlate is used to assess LEIA alongside four baseline methods across both regimes. Finally, we demonstrate that LEIA enables efficient candidate generation and ranking for fast surrogate-guided search for de novo designs of architected materials, with stress-accurate candidate ranking validated by finite element ground truth.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：world model、autoregressive responses、surrogate-guided search、finite element ground truth）；研究对象：建筑化材料（architected materials），具体包括两类微结构模型：通过三维几何显式解析微结构的建筑化晶格，以及通过内部自由度隐式建模微结构变化的均匀板。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为LEIA的世界模型，能够实时交互式预测建筑化材料在用户逐步施加边界条件时的变形和应力场，并可用于快速生成和排序候选设计，实现高效的替代模型引导的从头设计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为LEIA的世界模型，能够实时交互式预测建筑化材料在用户逐步施加边界条件时的变形和应力场，并可用于快速生成和排序候选设计，实现高效的替代模型引导的从头设计。；创新点：将世界模型从游戏环境和机器人操作扩展到物理工程领域，首次实现了对具有非线性本构律、历史依赖内状态、惯性动力学及多尺度层次结构的真实建筑化材料的交互式实时模拟与设计优化。
papers.method_zh: 基于世界模型（world model）的机器学习方法，处理大型三维非结构化网格，对用户指定的加载条件进行自回归响应。同时构建了名为MicroPlate的基准数据集，包含两种微结构建模机制的板结构，并采用有限元模拟作为地面真值进行验证。

papers.title: Dissipative Spectral Form Factor of the Complex Elliptic Ginibre Ensemble across Various Non-Hermiticity Regimes
papers.abstract: We study the dissipative spectral form factor (DSFF) at complex time $T e^{iθ}$ for the complex elliptic Ginibre ensemble with non-Hermiticity parameter $τ\in [0,1)$. As the matrix dimension $N \to \infty$, we consider the natural scalings in both the time variable and the non-Hermiticity parameter, namely $T = O(N^γ)$ and $1 - τ= O(N^{-α})$. For all regimes $γ\ge 0$ and $α\ge 0$, we derive the precise asymptotic behaviour of both the disconnected and connected components of the DSFF. In particular, we explicitly characterise the dip--ramp--plateau structure, including the dip time and the Heisenberg time. In addition, we identify the mesoscopic regime $α\in (0,1)$, which interpolates between the behaviour of the DSFF of non-Hermitian random matrices and the spectral form factor (SFF) of Hermitian ensembles. We further provide an explicit description of the phase diagram, in which the ramp exhibits quadratic, linear, or intermediate behaviour depending on the scaling parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确涉及随机矩阵理论、渐近分析、相图推导等理论框架，无实验或计算模拟描述。；研究对象：复椭圆Ginibre系综（complex elliptic Ginibre ensemble）的耗散谱形因子（DSFF），重点研究其在非厄米性参数τ∈[0,1)下的不同非厄米性区间中的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在矩阵维度N→∞时，通过时间变量T和非厄米性参数1-τ的适当标度（T=O(N^γ)，1-τ=O(N^{-α})），精确推导了DSFF的断开与连接分量的渐近行为，并明确刻画了“dip-ramp-plateau”结构（包括dip时间和海森堡时间）。此外，识别出介于非厄米随机矩阵DSFF与厄米系综谱形因子（SFF）之间的介观区间α∈(0,1)，并给出了相图，其中ramp根据标度参数呈现二次、线性或中间行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在矩阵维度N→∞时，通过时间变量T和非厄米性参数1-τ的适当标度（T=O(N^γ)，1-τ=O(N^{-α})），精确推导了DSFF的断开与连接分量的渐近行为，并明确刻画了“dip-ramp-plateau”结构（包括dip时间和海森堡时间）。此外，识别出介于非厄米随机矩阵DSFF与厄米系综谱形因子（SFF）之间的介观区间α∈(0,1)，并给出了相图，其中ramp根据标度参数呈现二次、线性或中间行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机矩阵理论中的复椭圆Ginibre系综，通过解析方法研究DSFF在复时间T e^{iθ}下的渐近行为。具体涉及对断开与连接分量的精确渐近分析，以及针对不同标度指数γ和α的相图分类。

papers.title: AtomComposer: Discovering Chemical Space from First Principles with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Discovering novel stable molecules without training data remains a grand scientific challenge. Current molecular generative models are trained on large, pre-curated datasets, which introduce biases and limit exploration of novel chemistry. In contrast, we propose a new paradigm: autonomous, generalized agents capable of mapping vast, unknown chemical spaces without any pretraining. For the first time, we present AtomComposer, a self-guided agent that autonomously constructs valid 3D isomers under stoichiometric constraints and is trained exclusively online using reinforcement learning. Unlike existing approaches that generally overfit to a specific chemical formula, we establish a multi-composition training scheme that enables a broad generalization across diverse chemistry, guided by energy- and validity-based rewards. Our agent can discover up to an order of magnitude more valid isomers on unseen test formulas than existing single-composition reinforcement-learning baselines trained with per-step energy rewards. These results fulfill the promise of online reinforcement learning as a powerful paradigm for scalable, from-scratch exploration of chemical configuration space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：reinforcement learning、first principles、online training、generative models）；研究对象：化学空间中的稳定分子，具体为满足化学计量约束的有效3D异构体（isomers）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种无需预训练数据的自引导智能体AtomComposer，通过在线强化学习，能在未见过的测试化学式上发现比现有单组分强化学习基线多一个数量级的有效异构体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种无需预训练数据的自引导智能体AtomComposer，通过在线强化学习，能在未见过的测试化学式上发现比现有单组分强化学习基线多一个数量级的有效异构体。；创新点：首次实现无需任何预训练数据、不依赖特定化学式的自引导分子生成，通过多组分训练实现跨化学式的广泛泛化，克服了现有方法对单一化学式过拟合的局限。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理（first principles）的在线强化学习（online reinforcement learning），采用多组分训练方案（multi-composition training scheme），以能量和有效性为奖励（energy- and validity-based rewards）指导智能体自主构建3D异构体。

papers.title: Quantum Spin Squeezing Enhanced by Critical Exceptional Points
papers.abstract: Critical exceptional points (CEPs) are nonequilibrium critical points in open many-body systems at which multiple collective excitation modes coalesce. CEPs are known to amplify classical fluctuations, but their effect on genuinely \textit{quantum} fluctuations remains unclear. Here, we show that dissipative collective-spin systems hosting CEPs exhibit parametrically enhanced steady-state \textit{quantum} spin squeezing. Close to the CEP, the optimally squeezed variance scales as $|Z|$, whereas the anti-squeezed variance diverges as $|Z|^{-1}$, with $Z$ the dimensionless order parameter. Importantly, the anti-squeezed fluctuation direction asymptotically aligns with the coalescing eigenvector of the stability matrix, reflecting the defective nature of the CEP dynamics. These scalings are robust against dephasing channels generated by spin components orthogonal to the coalesced critical collective mode. Our results identify CEPs as a route to engineering steady-state anisotropic quantum fluctuations and correlations in driven-dissipative platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we show that”、“scales as”、“reflects”等理论推导和标度分析表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：开放多体系统中的临界异常点（Critical Exceptional Points, CEPs）及其对量子自旋压缩（quantum spin squeezing）的影响。具体体系为耗散性集体自旋系统（dissipative collective-spin systems）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 临界异常点能够参数化地增强稳态量子自旋压缩：在CEP附近，最优压缩方差按|Z|标度（Z为无量纲序参量），而反压缩方差按|Z|^{-1}发散。反压缩涨落方向与稳定性矩阵的合并本征矢渐近对齐，体现了CEP动力学的缺陷性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：临界异常点能够参数化地增强稳态量子自旋压缩：在CEP附近，最优压缩方差按|Z|标度（Z为无量纲序参量），而反压缩方差按|Z|^{-1}发散。反压缩涨落方向与稳定性矩阵的合并本征矢渐近对齐，体现了CEP动力学的缺陷性。；创新点：首次揭示了临界异常点对量子涨落（而非经典涨落）的增强作用，并建立了稳态量子自旋压缩与CEP缺陷动力学之间的定量标度关系。摘要未突出说明与具体实验平台的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，包括对耗散集体自旋系统的稳定性矩阵本征结构分析、量子涨落的标度律推导，以及对抗退相干通道（由与合并临界集体模正交的自旋分量产生）的鲁棒性检验。

papers.title: Primary hemostasis and dynamics of clot formation after microvascular injury
papers.abstract: Primary hemostasis is initiated by platelet adhesion and aggregation at a site of vascular injury and is strongly regulated by local hydrodynamic conditions. At elevated shear rates, platelet capture is mediated by von Willebrand factor (vWF), a multimeric protein that undergoes shear-induced unfolding and becomes adhesive. We investigate early-stage clot formation under physiological high-shear-flow conditions by employing particle-based mesoscale hydrodynamics simulations with explicitly resolved red blood cells, platelets, and mechano-sensitive vWF in a microchannel geometry. The model incorporates vWF-mediated adhesion of platelets to a hemostatic surface, together with non-periodic inflow-outflow boundary conditions that allow continuous material supply and transport. We analyze the dynamics of platelet-vWF aggregation, clot growth dynamics, clot geometry and internal stresses, and thrombo-embolization across a range of elevated flow rates. Our results demonstrate that clot formation proceeds through the establishment of platelet-vWF aggregates at the hemostatic site, and that the clot reaches a finite size determined solely by hydrodynamic forces, without invoking biochemical stabilization mechanisms. Beyond a critical size, increased drag from fluid flow leads to recurrent embolization events that limit further growth. These findings highlight the central role of hydrodynamic stresses in regulating primary hemostasis and provide a mechanistic framework for understanding clot stability under physiological flow conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“particle-based mesoscale hydrodynamics simulations”（基于粒子的介观流体动力学模拟）。；研究对象：微血管损伤后的初级止血过程及血凝块形成的动力学。具体研究在生理高剪切流条件下，血小板、血管性血友病因子（vWF）和红细胞在损伤位点的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 血凝块的形成和最终尺寸完全由流体动力学力决定，而非生化稳定机制。当血凝块超过临界尺寸时，流体拖拽力会引发反复的栓塞事件，从而限制其进一步生长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：血凝块的形成和最终尺寸完全由流体动力学力决定，而非生化稳定机制。当血凝块超过临界尺寸时，流体拖拽力会引发反复的栓塞事件，从而限制其进一步生长。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于粒子的介观流体动力学模拟。模型中明确解析了红细胞、血小板和机械敏感的vWF，并包含了vWF介导的血小板与止血表面的粘附，以及允许连续物质供应和运输的非周期性流入-流出边界条件。

papers.title: Environment-Enhanced Single-Photon Absorption in a Nano-Ring of Dipole-Coupled Quantum Emitters
papers.abstract: Decoherence is mostly detrimental in quantum information and quantum optics applications. However, the interplay between environment-induced incoherent dynamics and unitary evolution can give rise to novel quantum many-body phenomena that can be harnessed as a useful resource. As is well known, in dense subwavelength atomic arrays only a single collective eigenmode in the single-excitation manifold couples strongly to free-space radiation, exhibiting superradiant spontaneous emission. Most of the remaining eigenstates form a manifold of weakly radiative modes, giving rise to long-lived subradiant excitations. Here we demonstrate that populating these subradiant modes via additional decoherence mechanisms, such as dephasing or coupling to phonons, can significantly enhance single-photon absorption in a nanoring of quantum emitters. Such nanoring geometry is particularly appealing due to its unique optical properties and its resemblance to natural light-harvesting complexes, which serve as efficient antennas in photosynthesis. Our findings may shed light on fundamental aspects of energy absorption in nature; despite the much greater complexity of biological systems, they may nonetheless operate according to similar underlying optical principles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：demonstrate、theoretical framework、collective eigenmode、unitary evolution。；研究对象：由偶极耦合量子发射体构成的纳米环（nano-ring）中的单光子吸收过程，以及环境诱导退相干（如退相位或声子耦合）对其的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过额外的退相干机制（如退相位或声子耦合）填充弱辐射的亚辐射模式，可以显著增强纳米环中量子发射体的单光子吸收效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过额外的退相干机制（如退相位或声子耦合）填充弱辐射的亚辐射模式，可以显著增强纳米环中量子发射体的单光子吸收效率。；创新点：揭示了环境诱导的退相干（通常被认为有害）在特定纳米环几何结构中可被利用为增强单光子吸收的资源，并指出该机制可能与自然界光合作用中光捕获复合体的光学原理相似。摘要未突出说明与已有亚辐射激发方案的具体定量比较。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于偶极耦合量子发射体阵列的集体激发态模型，考虑单激发子空间中的超辐射与亚辐射模式，并引入环境诱导的退相干动力学（如退相位或声子耦合）与幺正演化的相互作用。

papers.title: Geometry near rank-changing points on the mixed-state manifold: Bures metric, conical singularities, and Lindblad dynamics
papers.abstract: We elucidate the Bures metric in quantum state space near a rank-changing point of the density matrix and show contrasting behavior for two-level ($N=2$) systems versus higher-level systems. Due to the smooth pure-state boundary for $N=2$, we prove the apparent metric divergences to be merely coordinate artifacts and present three Lindblad processes exhibiting qualitatively different evolution near rank-changing points, showing geodesic approach, power-law scaling, and pure-state escape law. For higher-dimensional ($N\ge 3$) systems, the geometry near a rank-changing point differs fundamentally. Under suitable restrictions of the density matrix and its approach towards a pure state, the Bures metric reduces to a conical metric with the pure state at the cone tip. Such a conic geometry leads to genuine curvature singularities: A two-dimensional cone exhibits a Dirac delta-function curvature near the tip while a higher-dimensional cone shows a power-law divergence of the curvature towards the cone tip. A construction of Lindblad evolution for $N=3$ systems with conic singularities is presented, along with possible implications for future experimental and theoretical research.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：elucidate（阐明）、prove（证明）、construction（构建）、implications（意义）。；研究对象：量子态空间中密度矩阵秩变化点附近的几何性质，具体研究Bures度规、锥形奇点以及Lindblad动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于两能级系统（N=2），Bures度规的表观发散仅是坐标伪迹；对于高维系统（N≥3），秩变化点附近的几何本质不同，Bures度规退化为锥形度规，导致真实的曲率奇点（二维锥为狄拉克δ函数曲率，高维锥为幂律发散曲率）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于两能级系统（N=2），Bures度规的表观发散仅是坐标伪迹；对于高维系统（N≥3），秩变化点附近的几何本质不同，Bures度规退化为锥形度规，导致真实的曲率奇点（二维锥为狄拉克δ函数曲率，高维锥为幂律发散曲率）。；创新点：首次系统区分了N=2与N≥3系统在秩变化点附近Bures度规的几何差异，揭示了高维系统中锥形奇点的真实存在性及其与Lindblad动力学的关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：推导Bures度规在秩变化点附近的表达式；构造Lindblad主方程动力学过程（N=2时给出三种不同演化行为，N=3时给出含锥形奇点的演化）；几何分析（锥形度规、曲率奇点分类）。

papers.title: Polymer extension at stagnation points governs flow thickening of polymer solutions in ordered porous media
papers.abstract: Polymer solutions exhibit anomalous flow thickening -- marked by an abrupt increase in the macroscopic flow resistance -- above a threshold flow rate in a porous medium, but not in bulk solution. This phenomenon has evaded a mechanistic description for over half a century. Here, we develop a model that quantitatively links pore-scale flow fields and fluid rheology to macroscopic flow thickening, and validate it in experiments in two- and three-dimensional (2D and 3D) porous media. We find that flow thickening in ordered media is governed by polymer extension at stagnation points -- in contrast to disordered media, where viscous dissipation by unsteady flow fluctuations also contributes substantially. Our results provide a foundation to predict and control such flows in energy, environmental, industrial, and microfluidic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论建模结合）。关键词：develop a model、validate it in experiments、2D and 3D porous media。；研究对象：聚合物溶液在有序多孔介质中的流动增稠现象（flow thickening），即宏观流动阻力在超过某一阈值流速后急剧增加。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有序多孔介质中，流动增稠主要由驻点（stagnation points）处聚合物的拉伸（extension）控制；而在无序介质中，非稳态流动涨落引起的粘性耗散也起重要作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有序多孔介质中，流动增稠主要由驻点（stagnation points）处聚合物的拉伸（extension）控制；而在无序介质中，非稳态流动涨落引起的粘性耗散也起重要作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模（将孔隙尺度流场与流体流变学定量关联至宏观流动增稠）结合二维和三维有序多孔介质中的实验验证。

papers.title: Full Quantum and Mixed Quantum--Classical Dynamics of Hot Exciton Cooling in Semiconductor Nanocrystals
papers.abstract: Hot-exciton relaxation in semiconductor nanocrystals (NCs) is often described using perturbative theories, but their accuracy is difficult to assess for realistic exciton--phonon Hamiltonians. Here, we benchmark the perturbative quantum master equation (QME) and several mixed quantum--classical (MQC) methods against fully quantum mechanical dynamics. Using atomistically parameterized models for CdSe core and CdSe/CdS core--shell NCs, we find that bare CdSe exhibits an ultrafast initial decay followed by slower cooling, whereas the core--shell system is dominated by the slower component. Analysis of reduced models shows that the ultrafast component arises from rapid diabatic state mixing driven by thermal fluctuations of low-frequency phonons, rather than from nuclear-assisted energy relaxation. The QME captures the initial fast decay but can fail for the slower relaxation in the diabatic representation, while the mapping approach to surface hopping (MASH) gives the most consistent agreement with both benchmark dynamics and equilibrium populations. These results establish a benchmark for exciton-cooling dynamics in NCs and clarify the physical regimes in which widely used approximate methods are reliable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：benchmark（基准测试）、fully quantum mechanical dynamics（全量子动力学）、mixed quantum–classical methods（混合量子-经典方法）。；研究对象：半导体纳米晶（NCs）中热激子冷却（hot-exciton cooling）的动力学过程，具体体系为CdSe核纳米晶和CdSe/CdS核壳纳米晶。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 裸CdSe纳米晶中激子冷却呈现超快初始衰减后接较慢冷却的双阶段特征，而核壳体系以慢冷却为主；超快成分源于低频声子热涨落驱动的快速非绝热态混合，而非核辅助能量弛豫。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：裸CdSe纳米晶中激子冷却呈现超快初始衰减后接较慢冷却的双阶段特征，而核壳体系以慢冷却为主；超快成分源于低频声子热涨落驱动的快速非绝热态混合，而非核辅助能量弛豫。；创新点：首次系统评估了微扰QME和多种MQC方法在真实激子-声子哈密顿量下描述纳米晶热激子冷却动力学的准确性，并揭示了超快冷却的物理起源（非绝热态混合而非能量弛豫）。
papers.method_zh: 采用原子级参数化模型，对比了微扰量子主方程（QME）、多种混合量子-经典（MQC）方法（包括映射方法到表面跳跃MASH）与全量子力学动力学基准结果。

papers.title: Exceptional points in diamond optomechanics
papers.abstract: Multimode cavity optomechanical systems allow light to couple otherwise non-interacting mechanical resonators, enabling non-Hermitian phenomena such as exceptional points, where eigenfrequencies and eigenvectors of coupled modes coalesce. Accessing an exceptional point and its nearby parameter space is a first step towards chiral mode dynamics and topological state transfer. Diamond optomechanical devices support strong coherent optomechanical coupling required to tune resonances to an exceptional point, as well as strain-coupling to spin-defects for hybrid quantum technologies, but have not yet been used for multimode non-Hermitian physics. Here we tune to an exceptional point in a diamond optomechanical crystal, which uses structural symmetry breaking to produce two high-frequency mechanical resonances coupled to an optical cavity. The exceptional point is reached within a stable operating window below the phonon-lasing threshold, and we observe asymmetric redistribution of optomechanical damping and anti-damping between hybridized modes. These results establish diamond optomechanical crystals as a platform for non-Hermitian optomechanics, opening routes to topological mechanical dynamics in hybrid spin-phonon interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“we tune to an exceptional point”“we observe asymmetric redistribution”等描述实验操作与观测结果的表述。；研究对象：金刚石光机械晶体中的非厄米光机械系统，具体研究其中两个高频机械共振模式与光学腔耦合形成的奇异点（exceptional point）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在金刚石光机械晶体中，通过结构对称性破缺实现了两个机械模式与光学腔的耦合，并在声子激射阈值以下的稳定工作窗口内调谐至奇异点，观测到杂化模式间光机械阻尼与反阻尼的不对称重新分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在金刚石光机械晶体中，通过结构对称性破缺实现了两个机械模式与光学腔的耦合，并在声子激射阈值以下的稳定工作窗口内调谐至奇异点，观测到杂化模式间光机械阻尼与反阻尼的不对称重新分布。；创新点：首次将金刚石光机械晶体用于多模非厄米物理研究，建立了该平台在非厄米光机械学中的应用，为混合自旋-声子界面中的拓扑机械动力学开辟了途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上利用金刚石光机械晶体，通过结构对称性破缺产生两个高频机械共振模式，并使其与光学腔耦合；通过调谐参数使系统达到奇异点，并在声子激射阈值以下进行稳定操作与观测。

papers.title: A multilevel tensor network compression technique for simulating Lindblad dynamics in superconducting circuits
papers.abstract: Designing superconducting quantum hardware requires simulation tools that can account for various deviations from ideal scenarios. This, in turn, requires approaches that automatically detect certain structures and leverage them to make the computation affordable. Here, we develop a tensor network based technique to simulate the Lindblad dynamics of a few interacting bosonic modes with a focus on superconducting quantum circuits. The technique detects and takes advantage of two very common situations: (i) the density matrix being pure or not far from pure and (ii) the entanglement between different modes being moderate (typically qubit-like). However, (iii) the occupation of the modes can be arbitrarily high (making naïve truncations inefficient). To leverage these features, we use three different nested levels of tensor network compression: (i) we work with a global purification of the density matrix, (ii) we compress the connection between different modes to account for the moderate entanglement and (iii) we use a quantics representation of the Fock occupation number. We showcase the technique for the simulation of large cat qubits as well as for the ionization of transmon qubits, demonstrating orders-of-magnitude speed-up with respect to brute force approaches. In the latter example, it brings the simulation, previously reported on a large supercomputing infrastructure, to laptop level. The favorable scaling with system size should bring genuine computer assisted design of these systems within scope.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“simulation tools”、“tensor network based technique”、“simulate the Lindblad dynamics”。；研究对象：超导量子电路中的少模玻色子系统。具体包括：大猫量子比特（large cat qubits）和Transmon量子比特的电离过程（ionization of transmon qubits）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一种基于多层级张量网络压缩的技术，能够高效模拟超导量子电路中Lindblad主方程描述的耗散动力学，相比暴力方法实现了数量级的加速，甚至将原本需要大型超算的模拟任务降至笔记本电脑级别。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一种基于多层级张量网络压缩的技术，能够高效模拟超导量子电路中Lindblad主方程描述的耗散动力学，相比暴力方法实现了数量级的加速，甚至将原本需要大型超算的模拟任务降至笔记本电脑级别。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，其创新在于针对超导量子电路模拟中常见的三种情况（密度矩阵接近纯态、模式间纠缠适中、占据数可任意高）设计了一种多层级嵌套的张量网络压缩策略，特别是将量子化张量网络（quantics）用于处理高占据数问题，从而在保持精度的同时大幅降低计算复杂度。
papers.method_zh: 张量网络方法。具体包括：1）使用全局纯化（global purification）表示密度矩阵；2）压缩不同模式之间的连接以处理中等程度的纠缠；3）采用量子化表示（quantics representation）处理福克占据数（Fock occupation number）。该方法嵌套了三个不同层级的压缩。

papers.title: Charting causal set configuration space with graph observables
papers.abstract: The configuration space of causal sets is vast. It is a critical goal to map out this space. Here, we take a practical step towards this goal. We investigate nine classes of causal sets, most of them not studied before. These include manifoldlike causal sets with inhomogeneous Ricci curvature, both topologically trivial and nontrivial. We also study classes of non-manifoldlike causal sets, including lattices, layered orders as well as Lorentzian quasicrystals. Finally, we study classes of causal sets that are not manifoldlike, but are expected to become manifoldlike under a suitable coarse-graining process. We use this broad range of distinct classes of causal sets as a testbed for observables. Rather than focusing on continuum-geometry inspired observables, such as curvature invariants, which often exhibit large fluctuations and are computationally very expensive, we focus on graph observables, including some observables that constitute subgraph statistics and some that are global. We find that three observables, namely the link degree distribution, the eigenvalues of the graph Laplacian of the symmetrized Hasse diagram and the recently proposed abundance of causal intervals, can distinguish between the distinct classes of causal sets. This is made possible by the small fluctuations that these observables have in most classes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、classes、observables、graph observables（基于图论的可观测量分析，无实验或计算模拟细节）。；研究对象：因果集（causal sets）的构型空间，包括流形类因果集（含非均匀里奇曲率、拓扑平凡与非平凡）、非流形类因果集（如晶格、分层序、洛伦兹准晶），以及通过粗粒化可变为流形类的因果集。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三种图可观测量——链接度分布、对称化哈塞图的图拉普拉斯特征值、以及近期提出的因果区间丰度——能够区分九类不同的因果集，且这些可观测量在大多数类中涨落较小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三种图可观测量——链接度分布、对称化哈塞图的图拉普拉斯特征值、以及近期提出的因果区间丰度——能够区分九类不同的因果集，且这些可观测量在大多数类中涨落较小。；创新点：首次系统研究多种此前未被探索的因果集类别（如非均匀曲率流形类、洛伦兹准晶等），并证明基于图论的可观测量（而非计算昂贵的曲率不变量）能有效区分这些类别，为因果集构型空间的结构化映射提供了实用工具。
papers.method_zh: 采用图可观测量（graph observables）而非连续几何启发的可观测量（如曲率不变量），具体包括子图统计类可观测量和全局可观测量，对九类因果集进行系统性测试与区分能力分析。

papers.title: Many-Body Quantum Chaos At All Time Scales
papers.abstract: We describe the dynamics of many-body quantum chaotic systems at all time scales by studying the Green's and out-of-time order correlation (OTOC) functions of the four-body, $N$-Majorana Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model. By combining the scramblon formalism and random-matrix-theory techniques, we obtain analytical expressions for these functions at all times. The early exponential growth of the OTOC is followed by an exponential decay at a rate governed by that of the Green's function (the real part of the leading complex Ruelle-Pollicott resonances). For late times that scale exponentially with $N$, both functions have a dip-ramp-plateau pattern for $N \mathrm{mod}8 = 2, 6$ that deviates substantially from the ergodic prediction due to local-in-energy correlations of matrix elements and eigenvalues, even after the Heisenberg time.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：scramblon formalism、random-matrix-theory techniques、analytical expressions。；研究对象：多体量子混沌系统，具体为四体、N-Majorana Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（SYK）模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合scramblon形式与随机矩阵理论，获得了所有时间尺度上Green函数和out-of-time order correlation（OTOC）函数的解析表达式。在Heisenberg时间之后，当N mod 8 = 2, 6时，函数呈现dip-ramp-plateau模式，且由于矩阵元和特征值的局域能量相关性，该模式显著偏离遍历预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合scramblon形式与随机矩阵理论，获得了所有时间尺度上Green函数和out-of-time order correlation（OTOC）函数的解析表达式。在Heisenberg时间之后，当N mod 8 = 2, 6时，函数呈现dip-ramp-plateau模式，且由于矩阵元和特征值的局域能量相关性，该模式显著偏离遍历预测。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用scramblon形式论和随机矩阵理论技术，解析推导了四体N-Majorana SYK模型中Green函数和OTOC函数在所有时间尺度上的表达式。

papers.title: Efficient ensemble randomization by tuning chaos in a nonlinear spin-1 system
papers.abstract: We present an efficient scheme to randomize a spin-state ensemble in a nonlinear spin-1 system by tuning chaos with an external periodic drive. Without modulation, the system exhibits a mixed phase space featuring regular islands embedded in a chaotic sea, where global mixing is inhibited by energy conservation. Using numerical simulations, we demonstrate that weak modulation of a linear Zeeman field not only facilitates transport between different energy shells but also drives ensembles toward a Haar-random distribution over spin states. Under optimized conditions, complete randomization is achieved on a timescale set by the inverse nonlinear interaction energy. In the overdriven regime, randomization is unexpectedly suppressed at specific modulation amplitudes, accompanied by the formation of sticky regions in phase space. We attribute this behavior to the dynamical cancellation of the leading low-order harmonic component of the periodic drive. These results illustrate how time-periodic driving can be used to engineer chaotic systems and achieve controllable randomization in nonlinear spin systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：numerical simulations、phase space、dynamical cancellation。；研究对象：非线性自旋-1系统中的自旋态系综随机化过程，具体通过调节混沌实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过弱调制线性塞曼场，可驱动自旋态系综在非线性相互作用能量倒数时间尺度上达到Haar随机分布；在过驱动区域，特定调制幅度会意外抑制随机化，并伴随相空间中粘性区域的形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过弱调制线性塞曼场，可驱动自旋态系综在非线性相互作用能量倒数时间尺度上达到Haar随机分布；在过驱动区域，特定调制幅度会意外抑制随机化，并伴随相空间中粘性区域的形成。；创新点：揭示了时间周期驱动可工程化调控混沌系统，实现非线性自旋体系中可控的随机化，并首次发现过驱动下因低阶谐波动力学抵消导致的随机化抑制现象。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟。具体包括：分析无调制时的混合相空间（规则岛嵌入混沌海），施加周期性驱动调制线性塞曼场，研究系综在不同能量壳层间的输运及随机化效率，并分析过驱动区域中低阶谐波分量的动力学抵消效应。

papers.title: Quantum Interference Amplifies Weak Chirality into Giant Quantum Nonreciprocity
papers.abstract: Quantum nonreciprocity at few-photon level typically requires strong symmetry breaking, posing significant experimental challenges. Here we demonstrate that phase-controlled quantum interference can amplify weak chirality into giant quantum nonreciprocity. We consider two phase-programmable atoms coupled to a spinning whispering-gallery-mode resonator, where interference dramatically amplifies the effect of weak Fizeau splitting. This mechanism generates pronounced directional asymmetry in photon statistics, featuring bright antibunched emission in one direction and strongly bunched emission in the opposite direction. Remarkably, both correlation and brightness isolations obey phase-controlled power-law scaling with Fizeau splitting, reaching up to 65~dB and 17.3~dB, respectively. Our results establish interference-enhanced weak chirality as a powerful route toward directional nonclassical light sources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：demonstrate、consider、phase-controlled quantum interference、theoretical framework）；研究对象：由两个相位可编程原子与一个旋转的耳语回廊模式谐振器耦合构成的量子系统，研究弱手性（Fizeau分裂）通过量子干涉放大为巨大量子非互易性的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过相位控制的量子干涉，弱手性（Fizeau分裂）可被放大为巨大量子非互易性，产生方向依赖的光子统计：一个方向为明亮反聚束发射，相反方向为强聚束发射，且相关隔离度和亮度隔离度分别可达65 dB和17.3 dB。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过相位控制的量子干涉，弱手性（Fizeau分裂）可被放大为巨大量子非互易性，产生方向依赖的光子统计：一个方向为明亮反聚束发射，相反方向为强聚束发射，且相关隔离度和亮度隔离度分别可达65 dB和17.3 dB。；创新点：提出利用相位控制的量子干涉放大弱手性，而非依赖强对称性破缺，从而在少光子水平实现巨大量子非互易性，并揭示相关隔离度与Fizeau分裂之间的相位控制幂律标度关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体涉及相位可编程原子与旋转耳语回廊模式谐振器的耦合模型，以及基于量子干涉放大弱Fizeau分裂的机制。

papers.title: Efficient dispersal of submicron solid particles for stratospheric aerosol injection
papers.abstract: Stratospheric aerosol injection (SAI) using solid particles has been proposed as an alternative to sulfate aerosols for solar radiation modification, but practical deployment faces challenges in efficiently deagglomerating and dispersing powders as submicron particles. Here we experimentally demonstrate pneumatic dispersal of particles in optically optimal size ranges for SAI. Using spherical amorphous silica particles, we find that applying a hydrophobic surface treatment substantially improves dispersibility, with 50-85% of treated particle mass achieving submicron sizes compared to 10% for untreated particles. We compare the dispersal of treated particles of different sizes and find that 300 nm particles provide superior deagglomeration than 500 nm particles for the same air consumption. Theoretical modeling of the adhesion forces between particles, combined with surface roughness parameters extracted from atomic force microscopy, successfully predicted the relative dispersibility across different particle types. The pneumatic dispersal system achieved optimal performance at air-to-powder mass ratios of about 10:1. Using the measured dispersed particle sizes, we provide a scaling analysis suggesting that a feasibly sized fleet of dispersal aircraft could provide an aerosol layer sufficient for meaningful climate intervention. These results demonstrate that hydrophobic surface treatment and pneumatic dispersal can overcome the agglomeration challenge for SAI with solid particles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimentally demonstrate”、“measured”、“atomic force microscopy”等实验关键词。；研究对象：用于平流层气溶胶注入（SAI）的亚微米固体颗粒（具体为球形无定形二氧化硅颗粒）的分散与输送。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对二氧化硅颗粒进行疏水表面处理可显著提高其气动分散性，使50-85%的颗粒质量达到亚微米尺寸（未处理颗粒仅10%）；300 nm颗粒比500 nm颗粒在相同空气消耗下具有更好的解团聚效果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对二氧化硅颗粒进行疏水表面处理可显著提高其气动分散性，使50-85%的颗粒质量达到亚微米尺寸（未处理颗粒仅10%）；300 nm颗粒比500 nm颗粒在相同空气消耗下具有更好的解团聚效果。；创新点：首次实验证明疏水表面处理结合气动分散可有效克服固体颗粒用于平流层气溶胶注入时的团聚难题，并提供了从实验室分散到实际气候干预规模的可行性分析。
papers.method_zh: 气动分散实验（pneumatic dispersal）；原子力显微镜（AFM）提取表面粗糙度参数；理论建模颗粒间粘附力；基于分散粒径的缩放分析（scaling analysis）。

papers.title: Unified resonant-manifold framework for dynamical quantum phase transitions
papers.abstract: Dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) are an exciting paradigm of out-of-equilibrium criticality in many-body systems manifested in nonanalytic behavior in the return rate to the initial state following a sudden quench. While previous work has tried to distinguish between distinct types of DQPTs, such as regular and anomalous, or manifold and branch, a comprehensive understanding of why each type appears in a given scenario is still lacking. In this work, we propose a unified framework addressing this gap in terms of the energy structure of different product state configurations. In particular, while manifold DQPTs are governed by resonances within the initial state manifold, branch DQPTs are governed by resonances with a transitional manifold of states dynamically connected to the initial manifold by low-order processes. We show that the (ir)regularity of branch DQPTs is related to the multiplicity of this transitional manifold, and we also observe exotic periods of extended degeneracy in the return rate (beyond the conventional level crossing of a DQPT) which are also conditioned on the structure of this transitional manifold. We demonstrate this by studying quenches of two different configurations in the 1 + 1D Z_2 LGT to various parameter regimes. Our findings provide a dynamical mechanism underlying branch DQPTs and frames DQPTs as probes of resonant connectivity in constrained Hilbert spaces, paving the way to a more complete understanding of the multifaceted nature of dynamical criticality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a unified framework、theoretical framework、demonstrate by studying。；研究对象：动力学量子相变（DQPTs），特别是其不同类型（如规则与反常、流形与分支）的统一理解，以及1+1维Z₂格点规范理论（1+1D Z₂ LGT）中的量子淬火过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个统一框架，将分支型DQPTs归因于初始态流形与由低阶过程动态连接的过渡流形之间的共振，并发现分支DQPTs的（不）规则性与过渡流形的多重性相关，且可观察到返回率中超越传统能级交叉的扩展简并周期。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个统一框架，将分支型DQPTs归因于初始态流形与由低阶过程动态连接的过渡流形之间的共振，并发现分支DQPTs的（不）规则性与过渡流形的多重性相关，且可观察到返回率中超越传统能级交叉的扩展简并周期。；创新点：首次从能量结构共振的角度统一解释了流形型与分支型DQPTs的起源，揭示了分支DQPTs背后的动力学机制，并将其与约束希尔伯特空间中的共振连通性联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：基于不同乘积态构型的能量结构，通过共振机制区分流形型与分支型DQPTs。具体应用：对1+1维Z₂格点规范理论中两种不同构型的量子淬火进行参数扫描研究。

papers.title: Spontaneous persistent currents and time-reversal symmetry breaking in thick-walled Weyl semimetal cylinders
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the Aharonov-Bohm effect in a thick-walled Weyl semimetal (WSM) cylinder subject to an external axial magnetic field. By employing a low-energy effective Hamiltonian, we analytically solve the eigenvalue problem for both infinite and finite-length cylindrical geometries. We apply infinite-mass boundary conditions at the radial walls and MIT bag boundary conditions at the cylinder caps to properly account for intra-node confinement and inter-valley scattering, respectively. Our numerical results demonstrate that the spatial separation of the Weyl nodes acts as an internal chiral gauge field. This geometric field intrinsically breaks time-reversal (TR) symmetry, lifting the chiral degeneracy even at zero external flux. This symmetry breaking manifests as spontaneous persistent currents and the unfolding of conductance channels. Furthermore, longitudinal confinement induces propagation-direction-dependent energy splitting, altering the partial density of states and causing spatio-chiral current imbalances.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretically investigate、analytically solve、numerical results。；研究对象：厚壁外尔半金属圆柱体中的Aharonov-Bohm效应，以及由几何结构引起的时间反演对称性破缺和自发持续电流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 外尔半金属圆柱体的径向几何约束（厚壁结构）会引入一个内禀手征规范场，该场在零外磁通下也能自发打破时间反演对称性，产生自发持续电流并改变导电通道的展开行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：外尔半金属圆柱体的径向几何约束（厚壁结构）会引入一个内禀手征规范场，该场在零外磁通下也能自发打破时间反演对称性，产生自发持续电流并改变导电通道的展开行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用低能有效哈密顿量，对无限长和有限长圆柱几何分别解析求解本征值问题。在径向壁施加无限质量边界条件，在圆柱端帽施加MIT袋边界条件，以分别处理节点内约束和节点间散射。

papers.title: Quantum Resistance Paradox of Low-Dimensional Superfluids
papers.abstract: Resistance in standard conductors decreases with increasing cross-section. Yet, in low-dimensional superconductors and superfluids residual resistance arises from topological fluctuations of the order parameter manifesting as phase slips in one-dimensional (1D) and vortices in two-dimensional (2D) systems. How resistance and dissipation evolve as geometry interpolates between these regimes remains an open question. This evolution is masked in solid-state experiments by disorder, impurities, and geometric imperfections, and poses theoretical challenges due to competing dissipative processes and pronounced finite-size effects. Here, we use a defect-free unitary Fermi gas in a digitally programmable transport geometry to isolate geometric effects on superfluid dissipation and discover a paradox: in the crossover from 1D to 2D, the resistance reaches a minimum. There, widening a channel increases its resistance. Narrower, quasi-1D channels show dissipation described by Langer-Ambegaokar-McCumber-Halperin theory of phase slips. In this regime, varying the channel width yields the predicted exponential scaling of the activation factor over more than ten orders of magnitude. Wider, quasi-2D channels show dissipation consistent with a finite-size vortex model. The minimal dissipation in the dimensional crossover reflects a transition in the dominant dissipative mechanism, with both phase slips and vortices simultaneously suppressed. Our measurements suggest a route to minimizing dissipation in superconducting devices and provide a benchmark for theoretical efforts aimed at describing the dimensional crossover.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述“使用无缺陷均匀费米气体在数字可编程输运几何结构中”进行实验测量。；研究对象：低维超流体的量子电阻悖论，具体研究一维（1D）到二维（2D）维度交叉过程中超流体的耗散与电阻行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在从一维到二维的维度交叉过程中，电阻出现最小值，即加宽通道反而增加电阻，形成“量子电阻悖论”。最小耗散对应相滑移和涡旋两种耗散机制同时被抑制的过渡区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在从一维到二维的维度交叉过程中，电阻出现最小值，即加宽通道反而增加电阻，形成“量子电阻悖论”。最小耗散对应相滑移和涡旋两种耗散机制同时被抑制的过渡区。；创新点：首次在无缺陷、无杂质的干净体系中，通过精确控制几何维度，实验揭示了一维到二维超流体耗散机制的转变，并验证了Langer-Ambegaokar-McCumber-Halperin相滑移理论在准一维区域的指数标度（激活因子跨越十个数量级），同时发现准二维区域耗散与有限尺寸涡旋模型一致。
papers.method_zh: 使用无缺陷的均匀费米气体（unitary Fermi gas），结合数字可编程输运几何结构（digitally programmable transport geometry），通过改变通道宽度实现从一维到二维的连续维度交叉，并测量电阻与耗散。

papers.title: Phase-Topology Classification of Memristor Hysteresis Loops via Self-Crossings
papers.abstract: Memristive devices have revolutionized non-volatile memory and neuromorphic computing, yet the geometry of their hysteresis loops -- in particular, the occurrence and robustness of multiple self-crossings -- remains poorly understood. Here we introduce a topological and algebraic framework that treats the number of transverse self-intersections of a memristor hysteresis loop as a robust integer-valued invariant. Drawing on differential topology, singularity theory, and cusp catastrophe, we employ discriminants and resultants to stratify the six-dimensional parameter space. This approach partitions the parameter space into structurally stable regions separated by explicitly computable catastrophe surfaces.
