We demonstrate that the crossing number remains strictly invariant under continuous deformations and changes only at self-tangencies or cusp singularities, thereby providing a complete classification of all multi-lobed hysteresis behaviors. These insights bridge device physics with modern singularity theory and suggest a clear roadmap for exploiting higher-order memory effects in next-generation electronics and brain-inspired hardware.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“引入拓扑和代数框架”、“运用微分拓扑、奇点理论和尖点突变”、“判别式和结式”等理论工具，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：忆阻器（memristive devices）的磁滞回线（hysteresis loops）的几何拓扑性质，特别是回线中多个自交叉点的出现与鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 忆阻器磁滞回线的自交叉数量是一个稳健的整数值拓扑不变量，在连续形变下严格保持不变，仅当回线出现自切或尖点奇异性时才会改变。该发现将忆阻器物理与奇点理论联系起来，为所有多瓣磁滞行为提供了完整分类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：忆阻器磁滞回线的自交叉数量是一个稳健的整数值拓扑不变量，在连续形变下严格保持不变，仅当回线出现自切或尖点奇异性时才会改变。该发现将忆阻器物理与奇点理论联系起来，为所有多瓣磁滞行为提供了完整分类。；创新点：首次将磁滞回线的自交叉数量作为拓扑不变量引入忆阻器研究，并利用奇点理论对六维参数空间进行完整分类，揭示了自交叉数变化仅发生在自切或尖点奇异性处的严格数学条件。
papers.method_zh: 采用微分拓扑、奇点理论和尖点突变理论，利用判别式（discriminants）和结式（resultants）对六维参数空间进行分层，将参数空间划分为结构稳定区域，这些区域由可显式计算的突变曲面分隔。

papers.title: Microstructure-Aware Deep Learning Bridges Atomistics to Macroscale for Shock-to-Detonation Prediction
papers.abstract: The shock-to-detonation transition in energetic materials is governed by coupled processes spanning Angstroms to millimeters and femtoseconds to microseconds, where traditional multiscale models fail due to the lack of scale separation. We address this grand challenge by directly bridging large-scale molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with continuum finite-element (FE) models using MISTnetX, a convolutional deep neural network. Trained on MD simulations of shock propagation through complex microstructures, MISTnetX captures shock-microstructure interactions, hotspot formation, and the transition to deflagration, supplying critical sub-grid information to FE simulations of mechanics, shocks, thermal transport, and chemistry. Applied to a synthetic but realistic nanostructured plastic-bonded RDX composite, MISTnetX enables parameter-free prediction of the full run-to-detonation transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：deep learning、molecular dynamics (MD) simulations、finite-element (FE) models、convolutional deep neural network。；研究对象：含能材料（energetic materials）中冲击到爆轰的转变（shock-to-detonation transition），具体体系为纳米结构塑料粘结RDX复合材料（nanostructured plastic-bonded RDX composite）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过深度学习网络MISTnetX，将大尺度分子动力学模拟与连续介质有限元模型直接桥接，实现了对冲击-微结构相互作用、热点形成、爆燃转变以及完整爆轰过程的参数无关预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过深度学习网络MISTnetX，将大尺度分子动力学模拟与连续介质有限元模型直接桥接，实现了对冲击-微结构相互作用、热点形成、爆燃转变以及完整爆轰过程的参数无关预测。；创新点：提出了一种微结构感知的深度学习框架，直接跨越原子尺度（埃、飞秒）到宏观尺度（毫米、微秒），解决了传统多尺度模型因缺乏尺度分离而失效的难题，实现了对冲击到爆轰全过程的参数无关预测。
papers.method_zh: 采用卷积深度神经网络MISTnetX，基于复杂微结构中冲击传播的大尺度分子动力学（MD）模拟数据进行训练，并将训练好的网络作为子网格模型，输入到连续介质有限元（FE）模拟中，耦合力学、冲击、热输运和化学反应。

papers.title: Absence of a Superradiant Phase Transition in Dirac Landau Polaritons
papers.abstract: The condensation of photons into a macroscopically populated ground state, a superradiant phase transition (SRPT), is one of the most striking predictions of cavity quantum electrodynamics (cQED), yet has resisted experimental realization in equilibrium for over fifty years. Whether such a transition can survive at all in light-matter coupled systems is still debated, with a widely established \textit{No-Go} theorem ruling it out across several models. Graphene cyclotron transitions ultrastrongly coupled to terahertz (THz) cavities have been at the heart of this debate. At leading order, the linear Dirac dispersion of electrons does not generate the diamagnetic $\vec{A}^2$ term that enforces the theorem, making graphene the cleanest candidate for a No-Go-evading phase transition. Here, we present the first THz spectroscopic measurements of an encapsulated monolayer graphene flake ultrastrongly coupled to a single complementary split-ring resonator. By tuning the carrier density we sweep the system from weak coupling into the ultrastrong regime, reaching a normalized coupling $Ω_\text{R}/ω_\text{cav} \approx 0.4$. This is well into the range where a second order SRPT would manifest by a softening of the lower polariton branch, which we do not observe. The full polariton dispersion is instead quantitatively reproduced by a Hopfield Hamiltonian derived from first principles using a near-field model that accounts for the sub-wavelength character of the cavity. Our results establish an experimental baseline for predictions of cavity-driven phase transitions in two-dimensional Dirac systems, and rule out a No-Go-evading SRPT in graphene Landau polaritons up to the strongest couplings accessible today, with direct implications for proposals invoking vacuum-induced order in solid-state cQED.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：THz spectroscopic measurements、experimental baseline、first THz spectroscopic measurements）；研究对象：石墨烯朗道极化子（Dirac Landau polaritons）在超强耦合太赫兹腔中的超辐射相变（SRPT）是否存在。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在归一化耦合强度达到Ω_R/ω_cav ≈ 0.4的超强耦合区域，未观察到下极化子支的软化（即二阶超辐射相变的特征），因此排除了石墨烯朗道极化子中规避No-Go定理的超辐射相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在归一化耦合强度达到Ω_R/ω_cav ≈ 0.4的超强耦合区域，未观察到下极化子支的软化（即二阶超辐射相变的特征），因此排除了石墨烯朗道极化子中规避No-Go定理的超辐射相变。；创新点：首次在实验上对石墨烯朗道极化子体系进行太赫兹超强耦合光谱测量，直接检验了该体系中是否存在规避No-Go定理的超辐射相变，并给出了当前最强耦合条件下的否定结论。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用太赫兹光谱测量，对封装单层石墨烯薄片与单个互补开口谐振环（complementary split-ring resonator）构成的超强耦合系统进行载流子密度调控，从弱耦合扫描至超强耦合；理论上使用基于近场模型的第一性原理推导的Hopfiled哈密顿量定量再现完整极化子色散。

papers.title: Geometry and relaxation dynamics of nematic loops
papers.abstract: Disclination lines in three-dimensional nematic liquid crystals generically form closed loops whose topology is classified by homotopy theory. While this classification successfully captures global topological features, it does not encode the geometry of the defect profile along the loop, which can strongly influence defect dynamics. Here, we propose a geometric description of nematic disclination loops using the Clifford algebra Cl(3,0). This approach naturally captures the geometry of the local defect profile, as well as changes along the loop, which is mathematically a SU(2) holonomy. Simulations of the dynamics of defect loops with specified geometries embedded in nematic liquid crystals demonstrate that loops nucleate the growth of "topological blobs" of defects, which later dissipate leaving uniform nematic textures. Self-twist of the defect profile leads to nucleation of additional linking disclination lines, with a simple arithmetic relation between total self-twist and linking number. In contrast, loops with an even number of discrete profile transitions generate patterns with threading between loops, but no linking. These results establish a direct connection between the geometric holonomy of a disclination loop and its subsequent evolution, and may be extendable to more complex order parameter manifolds, such as cholesterics or smectics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（结合计算模拟）。判断依据：摘要提及“Clifford代数Cl(3,0)的几何描述”、“SU(2)和乐”等理论框架，以及“动力学模拟”作为验证手段。；研究对象：三维向列相液晶中向错环的几何结构与弛豫动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 向错环的局部缺陷轮廓几何（由SU(2)和乐描述）强烈影响其动力学演化：特定几何构型可导致“拓扑团块”的成核与消散，而缺陷轮廓的自扭转会按简单算术关系成核额外的链接向错线。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：向错环的局部缺陷轮廓几何（由SU(2)和乐描述）强烈影响其动力学演化：特定几何构型可导致“拓扑团块”的成核与消散，而缺陷轮廓的自扭转会按简单算术关系成核额外的链接向错线。；创新点：首次将向错环的局部缺陷轮廓几何（而非仅全局拓扑）与动力学演化直接关联，建立了几何和乐与后续演化模式（如拓扑团块成核、链接数生成）之间的定量联系。
papers.method_zh: 采用Clifford代数Cl(3,0)对向错环的局部缺陷轮廓几何进行数学描述，并通过数值模拟研究具有指定几何构型的缺陷环在向列相液晶中的动力学演化。

papers.title: Three Quantum-Geometric Contributions to Cubic Orbital Magnetization
papers.abstract: In noncentrosymmetric metals such as $C_{3v}$ topological-insulator surfaces, moiré heterobilayers, and zincblende crystals, point-group symmetry can forbid the linear and quadratic electric-field-induced orbital magnetization, leaving the cubic response as the leading signal. Using a Ward-complete finite-momentum cubic Kubo kernel with an antisymmetric linear-in-$q$ projection, we show that the dc response separates into three quantum-geometric channels. These are a mixed electric-magnetic positional-shift quadrupole, a quantum-metric drift term, and an orbital-moment octupole. The three contributions share the same point-group symmetry but differ in their lifetime, frequency, and gate fingerprints. For a warped $C_{3v}$ surface the metric channel obeys the cutoff-independent law $\barχ_G \propto μ^{-2}$. We propose third-harmonic magneto-optical Kerr spectroscopy as an experimental route.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We show”“We propose”等理论推导和提议性表述，涉及Kubo核、量子几何通道等理论框架，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：非中心对称金属中的三次轨道磁化响应，具体体系包括 \( C_{3v} \) 拓扑绝缘体表面、莫尔异质双层、闪锌矿晶体等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非中心对称金属中，电场诱导的轨道磁化线性项和二次项被对称性禁止，三次响应成为主导信号。该响应可分解为三个量子几何通道：混合电磁位置位移四极矩、量子度量漂移项和轨道矩八极矩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非中心对称金属中，电场诱导的轨道磁化线性项和二次项被对称性禁止，三次响应成为主导信号。该响应可分解为三个量子几何通道：混合电磁位置位移四极矩、量子度量漂移项和轨道矩八极矩。；创新点：首次将三次轨道磁化响应分解为三个具有不同量子几何起源的贡献，并指出它们在寿命、频率和栅极调控特征上存在差异。提出三次谐波磁光Kerr光谱作为实验探测手段。
papers.method_zh: 采用Ward完备的有限动量三次Kubo核，结合反对称线性-in-\( q \) 投影，推导出直流响应分离为三个量子几何通道。对翘曲的 \( C_{3v} \) 表面，得到度量通道的截断无关定律 \( \bar{\chi}_G \propto \mu^{-2} \)。

papers.title: Non-stationary current fluctuations in 1D boundary-driven diffusive systems via Macroscopic Fluctuation Theory
papers.abstract: While Macroscopic Fluctuation Theory (MFT) has been highly successful in analyzing non-equilibrium steady states, its application to non-steady-state processes remains limited. In this study, we apply MFT to the relaxation process of one-dimensional boundary-driven diffusive systems coupled to particle reservoirs at both ends. We exactly derive the current variance for systems with a constant diffusion coefficient and arbitrary mobility, as well as the cumulant generating function for the current in Reflective Brownian Motion (RBM). Our results demonstrate that non-steady current fluctuations during the approach to a steady state can be quantitatively described within the MFT framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Macroscopic Fluctuation Theory (MFT)、exactly derive、theoretical framework。；研究对象：一维边界驱动扩散系统（耦合于两端粒子库）在弛豫过程中的非稳态电流涨落。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在恒定扩散系数和任意迁移率条件下，精确推导了电流方差；对于反射布朗运动（RBM）体系，推导了电流的累积生成函数。证明MFT框架可以定量描述系统趋近稳态过程中的非稳态电流涨落。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在恒定扩散系数和任意迁移率条件下，精确推导了电流方差；对于反射布朗运动（RBM）体系，推导了电流的累积生成函数。证明MFT框架可以定量描述系统趋近稳态过程中的非稳态电流涨落。；创新点：将MFT从稳态分析拓展到非稳态弛豫过程，并给出了电流涨落的精确解析结果。
papers.method_zh: 宏观涨落理论（MFT）应用于非稳态弛豫过程，结合精确解析推导。

papers.title: Resolving Capillary Mode Transitions in Microparticles at Fluid Interfaces
papers.abstract: Capillarity-driven self-assembly at fluidic interfaces offers a scalable route to large, reconfigurable materials. Microscale particles with high horizontal-to-vertical aspect ratios become attractive building blocks for shape-directed organization, but the capillary rules governing their assembly remain incompletely understood. Here, we combine experiments and theory to explain the transition between two capillary regimes: monopolar interactions arising from millimeter-scale curved interfaces, and quadrupolar interactions arising from local contact-line distortions. We show that the conventional Bond number is insufficient to predict this transition because it omits key material and surface-topography effects. Instead, we identify a new dimensionless parameter that captures the coupled roles of particle size, density, surface roughness, contact angle, and quadrupolar strength. This criterion correctly predicts when gravitationally induced monopolar attraction or surface-pinning-induced quadrupolar attraction dominates, providing a general design rule for interfacial particle assembly. The resulting model explains how particles self-organize across length scales and offers guiding principles for engineering next-generation interfacial materials from miniaturized particulate building blocks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“combine experiments and theory”。；研究对象：流体界面上微米级颗粒（microparticles）的毛细作用模式转变，具体涉及由单极（monopolar）相互作用向四极（quadrupolar）相互作用的转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统邦德数（Bond number）不足以预测毛细作用模式的转变，因为其忽略了材料与表面形貌效应。作者识别出一个新的无量纲参数，该参数综合了颗粒尺寸、密度、表面粗糙度、接触角和四极强度，能正确预测主导的毛细作用模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统邦德数（Bond number）不足以预测毛细作用模式的转变，因为其忽略了材料与表面形貌效应。作者识别出一个新的无量纲参数，该参数综合了颗粒尺寸、密度、表面粗糙度、接触角和四极强度，能正确预测主导的毛细作用模式。；创新点：提出了一个超越传统邦德数的新无量纲参数，该参数首次系统性地将颗粒表面粗糙度、接触角等微观形貌因素与宏观重力效应耦合，从而为预测和设计界面颗粒自组装提供了通用的设计规则。
papers.method_zh: 实验与理论建模相结合。实验上观察了流体界面上颗粒的毛细作用行为；理论上通过分析颗粒尺寸、密度、表面粗糙度、接触角及四极强度等参数，推导并验证了一个新的无量纲判据。

papers.title: Atomically precise mechanosynthesis of carbon structures on hydrogenated Si(100) by inverted-mode STM
papers.abstract: The ability to build atomically precise structures on surfaces with complete control over both atomic placement and chemical bonding remains a central challenge in nanoscale fabrication. Here, we demonstrate simultaneous spatial and chemical control over the mechanosynthetic fabrication of carbon structures. Using inverted-mode STM, C$_2$ units are donated from surface-deposited molecules to pre-patterned reactive sites on a hydrogen-passivated Si(100) surface. We demonstrate single-site C$_2$ donation, spatially patterned multi-site C$_2$ donation, and the stepwise assembly of polyyne structures through successive C-C bond formation. Together, these results establish controlled mechanosynthetic donation as a foundational capability for programmable atomically precise fabrication.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用STM（扫描隧道显微镜）进行实验操作和观察。；研究对象：氢钝化Si(100)表面上的碳结构，具体为通过机械合成方式构建的碳原子链（polyyne结构）及C₂单元。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用倒置模式STM，实现了对碳结构在原子尺度上的空间位置和化学键合的同时控制，包括单点C₂捐赠、多点图案化捐赠以及通过连续C-C键形成逐步组装聚炔结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用倒置模式STM，实现了对碳结构在原子尺度上的空间位置和化学键合的同时控制，包括单点C₂捐赠、多点图案化捐赠以及通过连续C-C键形成逐步组装聚炔结构。；创新点：首次在氢钝化Si(100)表面上实现了对碳结构机械合成过程中原子位置和化学键合的同步控制，建立了可控机械合成捐赠作为可编程原子精度制备的基础能力。
papers.method_zh: 倒置模式扫描隧道显微镜（inverted-mode STM），通过从表面沉积的分子向氢钝化Si(100)表面预图案化的反应位点捐赠C₂单元，实现机械合成。

papers.title: At-Scale Data-Driven Exploration of High-Voltage Cathode-Active Materials for Sodium Batteries
papers.abstract: Sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) share similar electrochemistry with Li but offer several advantages, including high abundance in nature and low cost, as well as suitability for fast charging due to a Na-ion mobility higher than that of Li. The development of high-voltage SIBs heavily relies on the discovery of novel, robust cathode-active materials (CAMs). All-inorganic materials represent the most mature and practical choice as CAMs for next-generation SIBs; however, their family spans a vast and chemically diverse space. In this work, we present a large-scale, chemically validated database of stable materials for SIB cathode discovery, curated from four major databases: Materials Project, AFLOW, OQMD, and GNoME. Generalizable and transferable descriptor-based machine learning (ML) models are developed based on a dataset of charged-only structures rather than charged/discharged pairs. Using a committee of the top four trained ML models, average voltage and specific capacity are predicted as target properties. Finally, a subset of top-ranked candidate CAMs is validated through explicit, high-throughput first-principles calculations of voltage profiles, phase stability, structural robustness upon sodiation/desodiation, and electronic properties. Together, this integrated data curation, ML ranking and predictions, and first-principles validation strategy establishes a scalable and transferable framework for accelerating the discovery of stable, high-voltage CAMs for SIBs and beyond.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：data-driven exploration、machine learning models、first-principles calculations、high-throughput）；研究对象：钠离子电池中用于高电压正极的全无机正极活性材料（cathode-active materials, CAMs），涵盖从多个材料数据库中筛选的稳定化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过构建大规模化学验证的材料数据库，并结合描述符机器学习模型与高通量第一性原理计算，建立了一套可扩展、可迁移的框架，用于加速发现稳定、高电压的钠离子电池正极材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过构建大规模化学验证的材料数据库，并结合描述符机器学习模型与高通量第一性原理计算，建立了一套可扩展、可迁移的框架，用于加速发现稳定、高电压的钠离子电池正极材料。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 1. 从Materials Project、AFLOW、OQMD和GNoME四个数据库整合并筛选稳定的全无机材料；2. 基于仅充电态结构的数据集，开发可泛化、可迁移的描述符机器学习模型（采用前四个最优模型的集成）；3. 预测平均电压和比容量作为目标性能；4. 对排名靠前的候选材料进行高通量第一性原理计算验证，包括电压曲线、相稳定性、钠化/脱钠过程中的结构鲁棒性及电子性质。

papers.title: Amorphous vs. Short-Range-Ordered Complexions: Consequences for Grain-Boundary-Mediated Plasticity in Nanocrystalline Al-Ni Alloys
papers.abstract: Amorphous grain-boundary (GB) complexions in thermally stable nanocrystalline alloys are commonly assumed to be structurally homogeneous, yet their disordered nature makes them susceptible to local short-range ordering (SRO). The influence of local SRO on GB-mediated plasticity mechanisms in such complexions remains poorly understood. This article employs large-scale Monte Carlo and molecular dynamics simulation to address this gap through simulations of nanocrystalline Al-Ni alloys at two Ni concentrations, 2 at.% and 4 at.%. Annealing at 913 K produces thick uniform amorphous intergranular film complexions, while annealing at 378 K produces semi-amorphous complexions containing FCC-type and BCC-type SRO. These two complexion states produce fundamentally different mechanical responses. Amorphous complexions act as dislocation sinks, suppressing shear localization and promoting homogeneous plasticity through shear transformation zones, but at the cost of lower strength. SRO complexions generate higher strength but also promote heterogeneous stress concentrations across the GB network, leading to intense shear localization regardless of Ni concentration. This contrast reflects a fundamental shift in governing mechanism, from shear-transformation-zone-controlled behavior in amorphous complexion alloys to GB-stress-heterogeneity-controlled behavior in SRO complexion alloys. These findings highlight the potential of complexion engineering to tailor the mechanical properties of nanocrystalline materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“large-scale Monte Carlo and molecular dynamics simulation”（大规模蒙特卡洛和分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：纳米晶Al-Ni合金中晶界复合物的非晶态与短程有序态，以及它们对晶界介导塑性机制的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非晶态晶界复合物作为位错阱，抑制剪切局域化并通过剪切转变区促进均匀塑性，但强度较低；而短程有序复合物则导致更高的强度，但会引发晶界网络上的不均匀应力集中，造成强烈的剪切局域化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非晶态晶界复合物作为位错阱，抑制剪切局域化并通过剪切转变区促进均匀塑性，但强度较低；而短程有序复合物则导致更高的强度，但会引发晶界网络上的不均匀应力集中，造成强烈的剪切局域化。；创新点：揭示了非晶态与短程有序晶界复合物在纳米晶合金中导致根本不同的塑性机制（从剪切转变区控制转变为晶界应力不均匀性控制），并指出通过“复合物工程”调控纳米晶材料力学性能的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 采用大规模蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo）和分子动力学（Molecular Dynamics）模拟，对两种Ni浓度（2 at.%和4 at.%）的纳米晶Al-Ni合金进行退火处理（913 K和378 K）以制备不同复合物状态，并模拟其力学响应。

papers.title: High-mobility inertial domain walls driven by spin-transfer torque in a ferrimagnetic spinel oxide
papers.abstract: Efficient electrical manipulation of domain walls is key to developing magnetic devices with fast switching capabilities and low energy consumption. Here we demonstrate Bloch-type domain wall velocities exceeding 1 km s$^{-1}$ in the single-layer ferrimagnetic spinel oxide NiCo$_2$O$_4$ induced by spin-transfer torque at a current density of $2 \times 10^{11}$ A m$^{-2}$. This exceptional domain wall mobility is attributed to the combination of giant nonadiabatic spin-transfer torque, low magnetization, and high spin polarization. Additionally, we report a pronounced domain wall inertia effect in this ferrimagnet due to the large nonadiabaticity of the torque. The characteristic time for domain wall acceleration and deceleration is $\sim 1$ ns, shorter than that reported for typical ferromagnets. Our findings highlight the potential of spinel oxides as a promising platform for engineering high-performance domain wall devices that take advantage of ultrafast ferrimagnetic dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate”（演示）、“report”（报告）等实验性动词，并给出了具体的速度、电流密度等实验测量数据。；研究对象：单层铁磁尖晶石氧化物 NiCo₂O₄ 中的布洛赫型磁畴壁，以及自旋转移力矩驱动的畴壁动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在电流密度为 2×10¹¹ A m⁻² 时，畴壁速度超过 1 km/s，且观察到显著的畴壁惯性效应，其加速/减速特征时间（~1 ns）短于典型铁磁体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在电流密度为 2×10¹¹ A m⁻² 时，畴壁速度超过 1 km/s，且观察到显著的畴壁惯性效应，其加速/减速特征时间（~1 ns）短于典型铁磁体。；创新点：首次在单层铁磁尖晶石氧化物中实现超高速（>1 km/s）畴壁运动，并将其归因于巨大的非绝热自旋转移力矩、低磁化强度和高自旋极化率的协同作用；同时揭示了该铁磁体中因大非绝热性导致的显著畴壁惯性效应。
papers.method_zh: 通过自旋转移力矩驱动畴壁运动，测量畴壁速度与电流密度的关系，并分析畴壁加速/减速的时间特性。具体实验手段摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Orbital and Spin-Orbit Torque Interplay in Ta/W-based Magnetic Tunnel Junctions with Vertical Non-local Switching
papers.abstract: Spin-orbit torque (SOT) enables ultra-fast, energy-efficient magnetization switching, making it a promising mechanism for introducing MRAMs for cache memory applications. However, current SOT-MRAM devices face write efficiency limitations, with charge-to-spin conversion ($ξ_{DL}$) reaching $\sim$ 45\%, far below the projected $\sim$ 80\% needed to comply with the current delivery of advanced transistor nodes. Recent advances in orbital current physics, evidenced in a wide class of materials, offer a path to enhance $ξ_{DL}$. Here, we study the Ta(3-30 nm)\slash W(1-4 nm) system, revealing a large additional spin-orbit torque contribution arising from Ta, a four-fold increase compared to the spin Hall effect in Ta alone, attributed to the orbital Hall contribution. This system exhibits larger $ξ_{DL}$ than W-based SOT systems with more robust perpendicular magnetic anisotropy and compatibility with 400$^\circ$C annealing. Leveraging these advantages, we integrate the Ta/W system into 3-terminal SOT-MTJ devices, showing a level of performance similar to that of W-based systems. Our results show that orbital physics can be easily integrated into SOT-MTJ systems, offering a viable strategy to enhance SOT-MRAM efficiency. In addition, we propose and demonstrate a proof-of-concept for vertical non-local switching of SOT-MTJ using orbital torques, simplifying bottom-pinned SOT-MRAM fabrication.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we study”、“we integrate”、“we propose and demonstrate”等实验性描述，并涉及器件制备与性能测试。；研究对象：Ta(3-30 nm)/W(1-4 nm)双层薄膜体系及其在自旋轨道矩磁隧道结（SOT-MTJ）中的应用，重点研究轨道电流与自旋轨道矩的相互作用，以及垂直非局域磁化翻转现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Ta/W双层体系中，由于Ta的轨道霍尔效应贡献，自旋轨道矩效率（ξ_DL）相比纯Ta的自旋霍尔效应提升了四倍，且该体系具有更强的垂直磁各向异性和400°C退火兼容性。此外，首次实验验证了利用轨道矩实现SOT-MTJ的垂直非局域磁化翻转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Ta/W双层体系中，由于Ta的轨道霍尔效应贡献，自旋轨道矩效率（ξ_DL）相比纯Ta的自旋霍尔效应提升了四倍，且该体系具有更强的垂直磁各向异性和400°C退火兼容性。此外，首次实验验证了利用轨道矩实现SOT-MTJ的垂直非局域磁化翻转。；创新点：首次将轨道霍尔效应引入Ta/W体系，显著增强自旋轨道矩效率；提出并实验演示了基于轨道矩的垂直非局域SOT-MTJ翻转方案，简化了底部钉扎型SOT-MRAM的制备工艺。
papers.method_zh: 制备了不同厚度的Ta(3-30 nm)/W(1-4 nm)薄膜及三端SOT-MTJ器件，通过电输运测量表征自旋轨道矩效率（ξ_DL），并结合退火实验评估热稳定性。采用垂直非局域翻转方案进行概念验证。

papers.title: Electride States and Superconductivity in Dense Potassium Carbides
papers.abstract: Metal carbides have attracted a great deal of attention due to their diverse geometric motifs, remarkable physicochemical properties, and widespread practical applications. However, there is still a lack of systematic understanding regarding the phase diagram of pressurized potassium carbide. Employing first-principles swarm-intelligence structure prediction approach, we comprehensively explore the binary potassium-carbon phases under compression and identify a series of new K-rich and C-rich stoichiometric compounds. Among them, K7C with high K concentration manifests a monoclinic structure with space group C2/m and is predicted to be an electride with zero-dimensional (0D) interstitial electrons. C-abundant KC has an orthorhombic configuration with symmetry Imma, with the carbon atoms arranged in a zigzag pattern. Strikingly, KC3, belonging to a monoclinic C2/m structure, possesses the highest carbon content and features a crumpled honeycomb carbon layer. Furthermore, calculations of electron-phonon coupling reveals that K7C is a 0D electride superconductor with a transition temperature (Tc) of 0.6 K at a pressure of 25 GPa. By contrast, KC exhibits a maximum Tc of 21.4 K at 25 GPa, which is primarily attributed to the robust coupling between low-frequency K- and C-derived phonon modes and C 2p electrons at the Fermi level. In addition, KC3 is calculated to have a Tc value of 6.7 K at 25 GPa. This study provides valuable insights into K-C compounds and broadens the diversity of metal carbide superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：采用第一性原理（first-principles）和群智结构预测方法（swarm-intelligence structure prediction approach），以及电子-声子耦合计算（calculations of electron-phonon coupling）。；研究对象：加压下钾-碳（K-C）二元化合物的相图、电子结构及超导电性，具体包括K7C、KC和KC3等新化学计量比化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高压下预测了多种新型钾碳化合物，其中K7C是零维（0D）间隙电子化合物（electride），并在25 GPa下具有0.6 K的超导转变温度；而KC在相同压力下具有高达21.4 K的超导转变温度，主要源于低频K和C声子模式与费米面处C 2p电子的强耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高压下预测了多种新型钾碳化合物，其中K7C是零维（0D）间隙电子化合物（electride），并在25 GPa下具有0.6 K的超导转变温度；而KC在相同压力下具有高达21.4 K的超导转变温度，主要源于低频K和C声子模式与费米面处C 2p电子的强耦合。；创新点：系统揭示了加压下钾-碳二元体系的相图，发现了多种新化学计量比化合物，并首次报道了其中K7C作为零维电子化合物超导体以及KC的高温超导电性，拓宽了金属碳化物超导体的多样性。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理群智结构预测方法进行相图搜索，结合电子-声子耦合计算预测超导转变温度（Tc）。

papers.title: Quantum fluctuations and chaos in fully connected spin models
papers.abstract: We investigate beyond-mean-field dynamics in a fully connected $\mathrm{SU}(3)$ spin-exchange model, focusing on the interplay between chaotic dynamics and quantum fluctuations. Using the two-particle irreducible (2PI) effective action formalism, we derive equations of motion that systematically account for higher-order correlations generated by interactions, and demonstrate how quantum fluctuations can regularize chaotic dynamics displayed by macroscopic observables. Our results show that an accurate treatment of fluctuations is essential for describing macroscopic dynamics in quantum many-body systems and promote 2PI as a robust framework for connecting microscopic correlations to macroscopic nonequilibrium phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“two-particle irreducible (2PI) effective action formalism”等理论框架，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：全连接SU(3)自旋交换模型中的量子多体动力学，特别是混沌动力学与量子涨落的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子涨落能够有效正则化宏观可观测量所展现的混沌动力学；准确处理涨落对于描述量子多体系统的宏观动力学至关重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子涨落能够有效正则化宏观可观测量所展现的混沌动力学；准确处理涨落对于描述量子多体系统的宏观动力学至关重要。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用双粒子不可约（2PI）有效作用量形式，推导出系统考虑相互作用产生的高阶关联的运动方程。

papers.title: Algebras of order parameters in one-dimensional spin systems
papers.abstract: We study order parameters in one-dimensional quantum lattice models with finite invertible or non-invertible symmetry. We investigate what properties a string operator must satisfy in order to acquire a non-vanishing expectation value in a given gapped phase. We deduce that multiplets of string order parameters organise into a Lagrangian algebra in the Drinfel'd centre of the symmetry category. In particular, we highlight the role of the multiplication rule as governing the fusion of the twisted sector local operators that constitute the string operator in the infrared limit. Our derivations exploit the tensor network approach to the classification of gapped phases and its reformulation in terms of module categories over the symmetry category. Within this framework, a gapped phase is associated with a pattern of spontaneous symmetry breaking wherein a Morita class of algebras of topological lines is preserved in the ground state subspace. The crux of the proof is to show that the expectation value of any string operator explicitly depends on the tube algebra module associated with the Lagrangian algebra, which is realised as the full centre of the corresponding module category. Finally, we demonstrate that these techniques extend to phases of symmetric mixed states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study、deduce、derivations、tensor network approach、classification of gapped phases、reformulation。；研究对象：一维量子晶格模型中的序参量，特别是具有有限可逆或不可逆对称性的系统，以及有能隙相中的弦序参量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 弦序参量的多重态在对称范畴的Drinfel'd中心中组织成一个拉格朗日代数，其乘法规则控制着构成弦序参量的扭曲扇区局域算子在红外极限下的融合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：弦序参量的多重态在对称范畴的Drinfel'd中心中组织成一个拉格朗日代数，其乘法规则控制着构成弦序参量的扭曲扇区局域算子在红外极限下的融合。；创新点：揭示了弦序参量多重态与拉格朗日代数之间的组织关系，并阐明了乘法规则在红外极限下对局域算子融合的支配作用。此外，该方法被证明可扩展到对称混合态的相。
papers.method_zh: 采用张量网络方法对有能隙相进行分类，并将其重新表述为对称范畴上的模范畴理论。关键证明步骤是展示弦序参量的期望值显式依赖于与拉格朗日代数相关的管代数模，该拉格朗日代数被实现为相应模范畴的全中心。

papers.title: Overcoming contact resistance at metal-2D semiconductor interfaces: atomically clean MoS2/Au ohmic junctions
papers.abstract: The application of two-dimensional (2D) semiconductors, such as monolayer MoS2, is limited by the high contact resistance commonly attributed to interfacial barriers at metal contacts. Furthermore, the dependence of electrical conductivity on MoS2 thickness is still unsettled, as both increasing and decreasing trends with layer number have been reported. By showing the contrast between electrical transport of mono- and multilayer MoS2 exfoliated on Au under ultra-high vacuum (UHV) and ambient conditions, we experimentally prove that, contrary to the prevailing view in the literature, the intrinsic MoS2/Au junction is highly conductive and exhibits ohmic behaviour. Our results indicate that interfacial contamination is responsible for the high contact resistances reported to date and affects the thickness dependence of electrical transport, explaining the discrepancies observed in the literature. We rationalize those findings using electrical transport simulations. Lastly, we show that local force-mediated lamination on lightly contaminated contacts can recover pristine, ohmic contacts, offering a route towards nanoscale patterning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：exfoliated on Au under ultra-high vacuum (UHV) and ambient conditions, electrical transport measurements, electrical transport simulations）；研究对象：金属（Au）与二维半导体（单层及多层MoS2）界面的接触电阻问题，具体为原子级洁净的MoS2/Au欧姆接触。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超高真空环境下制备的、无界面污染的MoS2/Au接触本质上是高导电性的欧姆接触，而非文献中普遍认为的高接触电阻。此前报道的高接触电阻和MoS2厚度依赖性的矛盾，均源于界面污染。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超高真空环境下制备的、无界面污染的MoS2/Au接触本质上是高导电性的欧姆接触，而非文献中普遍认为的高接触电阻。此前报道的高接触电阻和MoS2厚度依赖性的矛盾，均源于界面污染。；创新点：通过实验证明，在排除界面污染（即实现原子级洁净接触）后，MoS2/Au界面本身是欧姆性的，推翻了文献中关于该界面存在高肖特基势垒的普遍观点。同时，揭示了界面污染是导致文献中关于MoS2厚度与电导率关系（随层数增加而增加或减少）存在矛盾的根本原因。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上，在超高真空（UHV）和大气环境下，对剥离在Au基底上的单层和多层MoS2进行电输运测量对比。理论上，采用电输运模拟对实验结果进行解释。

papers.title: Microwave-driven Floquet-Fano interference in a ring-chord quantum dot structure for enhanced spin-caloritronic performance
papers.abstract: We investigate photon-assisted thermoelectric transport in four--quantum-dot nanostructures featuring ring and ring--chord geometries coupled to ferromagnetic leads. Focusing on the interplay between microwave-induced Floquet sidebands and geometry-driven Fano interference, we employ the nonequilibrium Green's function formalism combined with Floquet theory and a self-consistent Hartree treatment of electron-electron interactions within the linear response regime. The inclusion of a longitudinal interdot chord bridging the lead-coupled dots introduces a discrete interference pathway that competes with the continuum of ring-mediated states, giving rise to pronounced Fano resonances. Microwave irradiation dynamically reshapes these resonances through photon absorption and emission processes, enabling tunable control of electrical conductance, thermopower, and electronic thermal conductance. Quantitatively, at an intermediate temperature of $T=0.3Γ_0$ (where $Γ_0$ denotes the dot-lead coupling strength), the microwave-driven ring-chord geometry exhibits an exceptional thermoelectric figure of merit of ZT $\approx$ 12 and an optimal efficiency--power trade-off, reaching nearly $62\%$ of the Carnot efficiency with an output power of $6.24~\mathrm{fW}$. Crucially, the combination of spin-polarized injection from the leads and Zeeman splitting within the dots induces a robust spin-dependence within this Floquet--Fano interference. This cooperative interplay results in an enhanced spin Seebeck response and a maximum spin thermoelectric figure of merit of nearly $Z_sT \approx 18$. Our findings establish microwave-driven engineering of Fano interference as an effective strategy for modulating spin-caloritronic behavior in multi-quantum-dot devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“nonequilibrium Green's function formalism combined with Floquet theory and a self-consistent Hartree treatment”（非平衡格林函数结合Floquet理论和自洽Hartree处理）等理论计算方法。；研究对象：由四个量子点构成的环和弦（ring-chord）几何结构纳米器件，该器件与铁磁电极耦合，用于研究光子辅助的热电输运和自旋-热-电（spin-caloritronic）性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过微波驱动，在环-弦量子点结构中实现了Floquet-Fano干涉的协同调控，获得了极高的热电优值（ZT ≈ 12）和自旋热电优值（Z_sT ≈ 18），并实现了接近62%卡诺效率的最优效率-功率权衡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过微波驱动，在环-弦量子点结构中实现了Floquet-Fano干涉的协同调控，获得了极高的热电优值（ZT ≈ 12）和自旋热电优值（Z_sT ≈ 18），并实现了接近62%卡诺效率的最优效率-功率权衡。；创新点：首次将微波驱动的Floquet边带效应与几何结构诱导的Fano干涉相结合，作为一种主动调控多量子点器件中自旋-热-电行为的有效策略。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用非平衡格林函数形式论结合Floquet理论，并在线性响应框架内对电子-电子相互作用进行自洽Hartree处理。

papers.title: Impact of Stoichiometry of MoSi Thin Films for Enhanced Sensitivity of Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detectors
papers.abstract: We report on the impact of the stoichiometry of superconducting MoSi thin films on the performance of superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs). Specifically, we investigate the relation between the film parameters critical temperature Tc , sheet resistance Rs and superconductor thickness d and observe a universal scaling behavior. To benchmark the performance of SNSPDs fabricated from films having different stoichiometry, we measure the bias dependent count rate curves, while the detector is illuminated with wavelengths between 780 nm and 1550 nm. The detector performance as a function photon energy for different nanowire widths reveals a linear relation between the detection current and the photon energy. Furthermore, we determine the interfacial thermal boundary conductance $β$ between the superconducting thin film and the substrate, by measuring the return current of the SNSPD and find an increase of $β$ with increasing Mo concentration. The highest sensitivity amongst all compared devices is achieved for Mo$_{0.53}$Si$_{0.47}$, with low Tc (4.1 K) and high Rs (397$Ω$/sq) at a film thickness of 5.4 nm.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“measure”（测量）、“fabricated”（制备）、“illuminated”（光照）等实验操作关键词。；研究对象：超导MoSi薄膜的化学计量比（stoichiometry）对超导纳米线单光子探测器（SNSPD）性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MoSi薄膜的临界温度Tc、方块电阻Rs与厚度d之间存在普适标度行为；探测器探测电流与光子能量呈线性关系；界面热边界导率β随Mo浓度增加而增大。最优性能出现在Mo₀.₅₃Si₀.₄₇薄膜（Tc=4.1 K，Rs=397 Ω/sq，厚度5.4 nm）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MoSi薄膜的临界温度Tc、方块电阻Rs与厚度d之间存在普适标度行为；探测器探测电流与光子能量呈线性关系；界面热边界导率β随Mo浓度增加而增大。最优性能出现在Mo₀.₅₃Si₀.₄₇薄膜（Tc=4.1 K，Rs=397 Ω/sq，厚度5.4 nm）。；创新点：系统研究了MoSi薄膜化学计量比对SNSPD性能的影响，并建立了探测电流与光子能量之间的线性关系，以及β随Mo浓度变化的规律。
papers.method_zh: 制备不同化学计量比的MoSi超导薄膜，测量其临界温度Tc、方块电阻Rs和厚度d；制备SNSPD器件，在780 nm至1550 nm波长范围内测量偏压依赖的计数率曲线；通过测量SNSPD的回流电流（return current）确定薄膜与衬底之间的界面热边界导率β。

papers.title: Quantum criticality and factorization in a constrained Rydberg spin chain
papers.abstract: We investigate the zero-temperature phase diagram of a one-dimensional constrained quantum spin chain realized in coherently driven Rydberg-atom arrays with competing local Rabi driving and dipole-dipole exchange interactions. Projecting onto the blockade-constrained Hilbert space yields an effective model in which local and nonlocal quantum fluctuations compete on equal footing. Combining exact diagonalization, the density-matrix renormalization group, and variational uniform matrix-product-state calculations, we establish a complete phase diagram comprising a Luttinger liquid, an antiferromagnetic ordered phase, and a polarized paramagnet. We identify two distinct mechanisms for the destruction of antiferromagnetic order: a conventional Ising transition at strong driving and a continuous quantum melting into the Luttinger liquid at weak driving, characterized using entanglement-based diagnostics and finite-entanglement scaling. In addition, we uncover an exact ground-state factorization line embedded within the ordered phase, providing an analytically tractable zero-entanglement reference point for experiments with programmable Rydberg quantum simulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：关键词“investigate”、“exact diagonalization”、“density-matrix renormalization group”、“variational uniform matrix-product-state calculations”。；研究对象：一维约束量子自旋链，具体由相干驱动的里德伯原子阵列实现，涉及局域拉比驱动与偶极-偶极交换相互作用的竞争，以及由此产生的量子临界性与基态因子化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了包含Luttinger液体、反铁磁有序相和极化顺磁相的完整相图；识别了两种不同的反铁磁序破坏机制（强驱动下的常规Ising相变和弱驱动下的连续量子熔化）；并在有序相内发现了一条精确的基态因子化线，提供了零纠缠参考点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了包含Luttinger液体、反铁磁有序相和极化顺磁相的完整相图；识别了两种不同的反铁磁序破坏机制（强驱动下的常规Ising相变和弱驱动下的连续量子熔化）；并在有序相内发现了一条精确的基态因子化线，提供了零纠缠参考点。；创新点：在约束里德伯自旋链中同时揭示了两种不同的反铁磁序失稳机制，并首次在有序相内发现可解析处理的基态因子化线，为可编程里德伯量子模拟器提供了零纠缠的理论基准。
papers.method_zh: 采用精确对角化、密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）以及变分均匀矩阵乘积态（uniform MPS）计算，结合基于纠缠的诊断和有限纠缠标度分析。

papers.title: Rapid estimation of synthesizability windows of inorganic materials from first principles
papers.abstract: Fast prediction of the synthesizability conditions of materials remains challenging, even assuming synthesis under thermodynamic equilibrium. Approaches solely based on convex stability hulls neglect finite-temperature effects, while phonon-based phase diagram calculations are computationally demanding. Here, we demonstrate high-throughput generation of phase predominance diagrams as a function of temperature and partial pressures of gaseous reactants, helping bridge the gap between computational predictions and experimental synthesis. We employ fitting of elemental phase reference energies to zero-temperature total energies for improved calculation of formation enthalpies, along with machine-learned interatomic potentials for rapid determination of vibrational entropy and heat capacity. The resulting predominance diagrams can be intuitively understood by experimentalists and can be used to translate energies above stability hulls into synthesis conditions. Predominance diagrams are generated for selected oxide, nitride, sulfide, and phosphide systems, as well as for 48 more complex ternary metal phosphosulfide systems. The calculated predominance diagrams generally show good agreement with the experimental synthesis literature, with a drastic reduction in computational cost compared to a conventional approach relying on DFT-based phonon calculations. We identify several compounds predicted to be stable under well-defined thermodynamic windows, even though they appear as metastable in a zero-temperature stability hull picture. The method can be applied to rapidly estimate synthesis conditions for any inorganic material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“first principles”、“high-throughput generation”、“machine-learned interatomic potentials”、“DFT-based phonon calculations”等计算与理论方法关键词。；研究对象：无机材料的合成条件窗口，具体包括氧化物、氮化物、硫化物、磷化物以及三元金属磷硫化物体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高通量生成温度与气体分压依赖的相优势图，可以快速且低成本地预测无机材料的合成条件，并能识别出在零温稳定性凸包中表现为亚稳态、但在特定热力学窗口下可稳定合成的化合物。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高通量生成温度与气体分压依赖的相优势图，可以快速且低成本地预测无机材料的合成条件，并能识别出在零温稳定性凸包中表现为亚稳态、但在特定热力学窗口下可稳定合成的化合物。；创新点：提出了一种基于相优势图的高通量方法，在显著降低计算成本（相比传统基于DFT声子计算的方法）的同时，能够将“高于稳定性凸包的能量”转化为实验可理解的合成条件，填补了计算预测与实验合成之间的鸿沟。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算（零温总能）拟合元素相参考能，以改进生成焓计算；结合机器学习原子间势能快速计算振动熵与热容；生成温度与气体反应物分压的函数相优势图。

papers.title: Identifying and designing altermagnetic crystals in real space
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism is a compensated magnetic phase characterized by zero net magnetization and exchange-driven spin splitting. However, identifying altermagnets among collinear antiferromagnets usually requires full magnetic-space-group or spin-group analysis, which is not intuitive. Here we formulate a simple real-space criterion based on how the crystallographic operations of the host nonmagnetic structure permute the two opposite-spin sublattices. For simplicity, we focus on collinear compensated antiferromagnets commonly described by type-III magnetic space groups, whose magnetic primitive cell coincides with the host nonmagnetic crystallographic primitive cell. In this class, altermagnetic spin splitting is generally allowed unless inversion operation exists which transfer between the two opposite-spin sublattices. First-principles calculations on representative noncentrosymmetric and centrosymmetric materials demonstrate these criterions. Similar rules can also be applied to low-dimensional crystals or pseudocrystals. Our work reduces the identification of altermagnetism to a transparent real-space symmetry test and provides a practical route for discovering altermagnetic crystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“formulate a simple real-space criterion”（提出实空间判据）和“First-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：交变磁性（altermagnetism）晶体，具体为共线补偿反铁磁体中由III类磁空间群描述的材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在共线补偿反铁磁体中，若存在将两个自旋相反的子格相互转换的反演操作，则禁止交变磁自旋劈裂；否则一般允许交变磁自旋劈裂。该判据可简化为实空间对称性检验。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在共线补偿反铁磁体中，若存在将两个自旋相反的子格相互转换的反演操作，则禁止交变磁自旋劈裂；否则一般允许交变磁自旋劈裂。该判据可简化为实空间对称性检验。；创新点：将交变磁性的识别从完整的磁空间群或自旋群分析简化为直观的实空间对称性测试，并推广至低维晶体或赝晶体。摘要未突出说明与已有交变磁性识别方法的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于晶体学操作对两个自旋相反子格的置换关系，建立实空间对称性判据；并通过代表性非中心对称和中心对称材料的第一性原理计算进行验证。

papers.title: Subdiffusion equation with Cattaneo effect
papers.abstract: The ordinary subdiffusion equation, with a fractional time derivative of at most first order, describes a process in which the propagation velocity of diffusing molecules is unlimited. To avoid this non-physical property different forms of the Cattaneo subdiffusion equation have been proposed. We define the Cattaneo effect as a delay of the ordinary subdiffusion flux activation by a random time. By incorporating this effect into the flux equation we get a Cattaneo--type subdiffusion equation (CTSE). We consider a subdiffusion process in which the Cattaneo effect is generated by the time-delay probability distribution controlled by the Mittag-Leffler function. Then, CTSE differs from the ordinary subdiffusion equation by a term with a fractional time derivative, whose order can be independent of the subdiffusion exponent. The influence of the Cattaneo effect on the solutions to the CTSE is discussed. We show that the process described by CTSE is subdiffusion in the entire time domain even though the temporal evolution of the mean square displacement of diffusing particle in the short-time limit is typical for superdiffusion. The delay in the flux activation in the subdiffusion equation should also cause a flux delay in a boundary condition. As an example, we study subdiffusion with the Cattaneo effect in a system with a partially absorbing wall at which the Robin boundary condition is assumed. We also propose a method for experimentally identifying the Cattaneo effect in a subdiffusive system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要讨论方程推导、模型定义和理论分析（如“定义Cattaneo效应”、“得到Cattaneo型次扩散方程”、“讨论解的影响”），未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：次扩散过程中的Cattaneo效应，具体研究由Mittag-Leffler函数控制的时间延迟概率分布所引发的次扩散方程修正及其物理行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入Cattaneo效应后，次扩散方程增加了一个分数阶时间导数项，其阶数可独立于次扩散指数；尽管在短时间极限下粒子的均方位移表现出超扩散特征，但整个过程在全部时间域内仍为次扩散。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入Cattaneo效应后，次扩散方程增加了一个分数阶时间导数项，其阶数可独立于次扩散指数；尽管在短时间极限下粒子的均方位移表现出超扩散特征，但整个过程在全部时间域内仍为次扩散。；创新点：提出Cattaneo效应由Mittag-Leffler函数控制的时间延迟概率分布生成，使得CTSE中新增的分数阶导数阶数可独立于次扩散指数，并揭示了短时超扩散与全域次扩散共存的反直觉行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：通过将Cattaneo效应定义为普通次扩散通量激活的随机时间延迟，并将其纳入通量方程，得到Cattaneo型次扩散方程（CTSE）；采用Mittag-Leffler函数描述时间延迟概率分布；结合Robin边界条件分析部分吸收壁系统中的次扩散行为；提出实验识别Cattaneo效应的方法。

papers.title: Light-induced Faraday effect from dynamical breakdown of Kleinman symmetry
papers.abstract: The observation of anomalously large polarization rotations in pump-probe experiments with circularly polarized light has recently challenged the conventional understanding of the inverse Faraday effect. The striking magnitude of these responses implies the generation of effective magnetic fields orders of magnitude larger than theoretical expectations, raising fundamental questions about the nature of light-induced time-reversal symmetry breaking. In this work we demonstrate that a static polarization rotation can originate entirely from the antisymmetric component of the third-order optical susceptibility, without generating a macroscopic magnetization of the material. We show that this light-induced Faraday effect is inherently dynamical, emerging when Kleinman symmetry breaks down. Using a minimal sp tight-binding model on a square lattice, we demonstrate that the light-induced Faraday response can be sizable even far from dissipative resonances. While the effect emerges at a purely electronic level, we show that resonant coupling with phonons can significantly enhance the pump-probe response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“demonstrate”“show”“using a minimal sp tight-binding model”等表述，属于理论建模与计算分析。；研究对象：光诱导法拉第效应，具体为圆偏振光泵浦-探测实验中观测到的异常大的偏振旋转现象，以及与之相关的逆法拉第效应和Kleinman对称性动态破缺。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 静态偏振旋转可以完全来源于三阶光学极化率的反对称分量，而不需要产生材料的宏观磁化；这种光诱导法拉第效应本质上是动态的，在Kleinman对称性破缺时出现，且即使在远离耗散共振的电子能级下也可能显著。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：静态偏振旋转可以完全来源于三阶光学极化率的反对称分量，而不需要产生材料的宏观磁化；这种光诱导法拉第效应本质上是动态的，在Kleinman对称性破缺时出现，且即使在远离耗散共振的电子能级下也可能显著。；创新点：指出光诱导法拉第效应可以不依赖于宏观磁化（即不依赖逆法拉第效应的传统机制），而是源于三阶光学极化率的反对称分量，并强调其动态本质源于Kleinman对称性的破缺。
papers.method_zh: 采用最小sp紧束缚模型在正方晶格上进行理论建模与分析，研究纯电子层面的效应，并进一步考虑与声子的共振耦合对泵浦-探测响应的增强作用。

papers.title: Origin of the Temperature-Induced Gap Bowing of Formamidinium-Methylammonium Lead Iodide Perovskites: Role of Cationic Rattlers
papers.abstract: A thorough understanding of the temperature dependence of semiconductor band gaps is essential for optimizing optoelectronic devices. In this respect, the origin of the pronounced temperature-induced gap bowing observed in low-temperature phases of formamidinium-methylammonium (FA-MA) lead iodide perovskites has remained elusive until now. By combining temperature and pressure-dependent photoluminescence measurements on a series of FA$_x$MA$_{1-x}$PbI$_3$ mixed-cation single crystals with $x\in[0,1]$, we unravel the origin of this bowing. Both thermal expansion as well as electron-phonon interaction effects are responsible. However, the latter is the leading term, driven by the activation of an anomalous electron-phonon coupling mechanism linked to mixed vibrational modes, which combine inorganic-cage phonons involving octahedral tilting with low-frequency FA librations, i.e., FA rattler modes. This occurs in the orthorhombic and (pseudo)tetragonal low-temperature phases, presumably featuring stripe domains with alternating octahedral tilt-axis patterns for FA concentrations between 20\% and 90\%. In this way, we have shed light on an intriguing behavior of lead halide perovskites that directly affects their optoelectronic properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“temperature and pressure-dependent photoluminescence measurements”（变温变压光致发光测量）以及“series of single crystals”（系列单晶样品）。；研究对象：FAₓMA₁₋ₓPbI₃混合阳离子钙钛矿单晶中低温相的温度诱导带隙弯曲（gap bowing）现象及其物理起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 温度诱导的带隙弯曲主要由电子-声子相互作用主导，其机制源于无机笼八面体倾斜声子与FA阳离子低频摆动模式（rattler modes）耦合产生的反常电子-声子耦合，热膨胀效应为次要贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：温度诱导的带隙弯曲主要由电子-声子相互作用主导，其机制源于无机笼八面体倾斜声子与FA阳离子低频摆动模式（rattler modes）耦合产生的反常电子-声子耦合，热膨胀效应为次要贡献。；创新点：首次揭示了FA-MA混合阳离子铅碘钙钛矿低温相中温度诱导带隙弯曲的微观机制，即FA阳离子作为“rattler”与无机笼振动模式的耦合导致反常电子-声子耦合，并指出该效应发生在正交相和（赝）四方相中，且与20%-90%FA浓度范围内可能存在的条纹畴结构相关。
papers.method_zh: 对一系列不同FA/MA比例（x∈[0,1]）的FAₓMA₁₋ₓPbI₃混合阳离子单晶进行变温与变压光致发光测量。

papers.title: Antisymmetric spontaneous resistivity anisotropy due to hard-axis collapse in polycrystalline Co thin films
papers.abstract: We investigate magnetoresistance phenomena associated with the magnetization hard-axis collapse in polycrystalline Co thin films. Transport measurements reveal that, for specific orientations of the applied magnetic field, the system exhibits distinct remanent resistance levels in both the in-plane longitudinal and transverse voltage responses. In particular, the planar Hall resistance shows multiple stable and reproducible levels at room temperature, enabling the identification of at least three remanent states that can be distinguished and used for information storage. These resistance levels originate from non-uniform magnetic configurations stabilized after the application and removal of the external magnetic field in the hard-axis region. Since this phenomenon remains largely unexplored, we present an incipient study addressing its potential implications from an applied-physics perspective. The observation of such behavior in polycrystalline Co thin films grown on Si substrates suggests a simple and low-cost platform for spintronic memory and sensing devices based on the remanent planar Hall effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：Transport measurements、voltage responses、planar Hall resistance。；研究对象：多晶钴（Co）薄膜中与磁化难轴坍塌相关的磁电阻现象，特别是平面霍尔效应中的剩余电阻态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多晶Co薄膜中，当外加磁场沿特定方向施加并撤除后，系统在纵向和横向电压响应中表现出多个稳定且可区分的剩余电阻态，至少三个剩余态可用于信息存储。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多晶Co薄膜中，当外加磁场沿特定方向施加并撤除后，系统在纵向和横向电压响应中表现出多个稳定且可区分的剩余电阻态，至少三个剩余态可用于信息存储。；创新点：首次报道了多晶Co薄膜中因难轴坍塌导致的反对称自发电阻率各向异性现象，并指出该现象在室温下可产生多个稳定剩余态，为基于剩余平面霍尔效应的自旋电子存储和传感提供了低成本平台。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 输运测量（包括面内纵向和横向电压响应），具体通过测量平面霍尔电阻在不同磁场取向下的剩余电阻水平。

papers.title: Electron Polaron at Neutral 180$^\circ$ Domain Wall in PbTiO$_3$: Stability, Trapping Energies, and Transverse Polarization
papers.abstract: We use density-functional theory with a Hubbard correction to investigate Ti-centered electron polarons at neutral PbO-centered $180^\circ$ domain walls in tetragonal PbTiO$_{3}$. The Hubbard parameter for Ti $3d$ states is determined using the finite-size-corrected polaronic energy-level alignment procedure, yielding stable electron-polaron formation in bulk PbTiO$_3$ with a trapping energy of $-$0.06 eV. In the domain-wall supercell, the excess electron localizes on Ti and forms a Ti$^{3+}$ center with an occupied $d_{xy}$ orbital in-gap state. Comparison of bulk-like and near-wall Ti sites shows that their trapping energies differ by only about 0.01 eV, indicating that this neutral domain wall does not provide a significant thermodynamic driving force for electron-polaron segregation. While the Ising-like reversal of the out-of-plane polarization is preserved, the localized electron induces a finite transverse polarization component normal to the wall, enhancing a local Néel-like distortion that is strongest when the polaron is located at the wall. These results show that neutral $180^\circ$ domain walls in PbTiO$_3$ do not substantially alter the stability of Ti-centered electron polarons, but they can couple to the polaron-induced lattice distortion through a localized transverse polarization response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用密度泛函理论（density-functional theory）加Hubbard修正（Hubbard correction）进行计算研究。；研究对象：四方相钛酸铅（PbTiO₃）中中性PbO中心180°畴壁处的Ti中心电子极化子（electron polaron），具体研究其稳定性、俘获能及横向极化响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 中性180°畴壁对Ti中心电子极化子的热力学稳定性影响极小（俘获能差异仅约0.01 eV），但极化子会在畴壁处诱导出垂直于壁的有限横向极化分量，增强局域类Néel畸变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：中性180°畴壁对Ti中心电子极化子的热力学稳定性影响极小（俘获能差异仅约0.01 eV），但极化子会在畴壁处诱导出垂直于壁的有限横向极化分量，增强局域类Néel畸变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论加Hubbard修正（DFT+U），通过有限尺寸校正的极化子能级对齐程序确定Ti 3d态的Hubbard参数U，在体相和畴壁超胞中进行电子极化子形成能计算与电子局域化分析。

papers.title: Molecular Dynamics Study of Defect Evolution Mechanisms in 3C-SiC for Quantum Technologies
papers.abstract: The migration of point defects and formation of spin defects in 3C-SiC were investigated using molecular dynamics simulations, with migration barriers obtained from Nudged Elastic Band (NEB) calculations and finite temperature diffusivities evaluated using both mean square displacement (MSD) and jump frequency approaches. While both methods reproduce Arrhenius behavior, the jump frequency formulation exhibits improved statistical stability. Activation energies of 2.12~eV for carbon vacancies and 0.88~eV for carbon interstitials are obtained, consistent with literature. The resulting mobility hierarchy governs defect evolution and complex formations. Interstitial vacancy recombination competes with vacancy aggregation into divacancies, influencing the stabilization of spin active defect centers. The study also provides a consistent framework for diffusion analysis in atomistic simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：分子动力学模拟、Nudged Elastic Band (NEB) 计算、均方位移 (MSD) 与跳跃频率方法。；研究对象：3C-SiC（立方碳化硅）中的点缺陷（碳空位、碳间隙原子）迁移与自旋缺陷形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 碳空位与碳间隙原子的迁移能垒分别为2.12 eV和0.88 eV，两者迁移能力的差异决定了缺陷演化与复合体形成；间隙原子-空位复合与空位聚集成双空位相互竞争，影响自旋活性缺陷中心的稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：碳空位与碳间隙原子的迁移能垒分别为2.12 eV和0.88 eV，两者迁移能力的差异决定了缺陷演化与复合体形成；间隙原子-空位复合与空位聚集成双空位相互竞争，影响自旋活性缺陷中心的稳定性。；创新点：系统比较了MSD与跳跃频率两种扩散分析方法，发现跳跃频率方法具有更好的统计稳定性，并为原子尺度模拟中的扩散分析提供了一致性框架。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子动力学模拟研究点缺陷迁移与自旋缺陷形成；通过Nudged Elastic Band (NEB) 计算获得迁移能垒；利用均方位移 (MSD) 和跳跃频率两种方法评估有限温度下的扩散系数。

papers.title: Quantum Geometric Origin of Hall Viscosity and Nonlocal Hall Conductivity in Lattice Bands
papers.abstract: We show that Hall viscosity in lattice bands is governed by a band-projected electric quadrupole encoded within the quantum geometry: Berry curvature sets the projected-coordinate algebra, while the quantum metric determines the quadrupolar spread of a wave packet. The same structure enters the quadratic wave-vector coefficient of the nonlocal Hall conductivity, yielding a lattice viscosity-conductivity relation. In ideal bands, the deviation from the Landau-level form is quantified by Berry curvature fluctuations. Our results establish the nonlocal Hall response as an electrical signature of the quantum geometry underlying Hall viscosity and as a transport diagnostic of geometric idealness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We show that”“Our results establish”等理论推导和结论表述，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：晶格能带中的霍尔粘滞度（Hall viscosity）和非局域霍尔电导率（nonlocal Hall conductivity）的量子几何起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 霍尔粘滞度由能带投影的电四极矩（band-projected electric quadrupole）决定，该四极矩编码于量子几何中：贝里曲率决定投影坐标代数，量子度量决定波包的四极展宽。非局域霍尔电导率的二次波矢系数与霍尔粘滞度存在对应关系，从而建立了晶格中的粘滞度-电导率关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：霍尔粘滞度由能带投影的电四极矩（band-projected electric quadrupole）决定，该四极矩编码于量子几何中：贝里曲率决定投影坐标代数，量子度量决定波包的四极展宽。非局域霍尔电导率的二次波矢系数与霍尔粘滞度存在对应关系，从而建立了晶格中的粘滞度-电导率关系。；创新点：揭示了霍尔粘滞度在晶格能带中的量子几何起源，并建立了其与非局域霍尔电导率的直接联系；在理想能带中，偏离朗道能级形式的行为由贝里曲率涨落定量刻画，从而将非局域霍尔响应作为量子几何理想性的输运诊断工具。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于量子几何（贝里曲率与量子度量）和波包动力学框架，推导了霍尔粘滞度与非局域霍尔电导率之间的解析关系。

papers.title: Individual Characterization of Fast-Responding Trap States at the NO-Annealed SiO$_2$/4H-SiC Interface
papers.abstract: Fast-responding trap states introduced by NO-annealing are suspected to limit the channel mobility of 4H-SiC MOSFETs, yet their microscopic characterization remains challenging because conventional electrical methods are spatially averaged and do not readily isolate such fast processes. Here, we visualize and analyze individual fast-responding trap states at the NO-annealed SiO$_2$/4H-SiC interface using the energy dissipation signal in frequency-modulation atomic force microscopy (FM-AFM), which selectively probes charge-exchange dynamics on sub-$μ$s time scales. Ring-shaped dissipation patterns were observed in the NO-annealed sample but not in the control sample without NO-annealing, indicating that the detected states are associated with nitridation. Spectroscopic measurements were also performed to determine the dependence of energy dissipation on the tip bias and the tip-sample distance. Combined with finite-element electrostatic calculations, this analysis allowed us to determine trap energies relative to the Fermi level, $E_t - E_f$, and revealed that the trap-energy distribution extends toward the interfacial conduction-band edge. These results provide microscopic evidence that NO-annealing generates fast-responding trap states near the SiO$_2$/4H-SiC interface.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了使用频率调制原子力显微镜（FM-AFM）进行实验观测和分析。；研究对象：NO退火处理的SiO₂/4H-SiC界面处的快速响应陷阱态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NO退火会在SiO₂/4H-SiC界面附近产生快速响应的陷阱态，其能量分布延伸至界面导带边缘，这些陷阱态是限制4H-SiC MOSFET沟道迁移率的可能原因。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NO退火会在SiO₂/4H-SiC界面附近产生快速响应的陷阱态，其能量分布延伸至界面导带边缘，这些陷阱态是限制4H-SiC MOSFET沟道迁移率的可能原因。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 频率调制原子力显微镜（FM-AFM）的能量耗散信号，用于选择性探测亚微秒时间尺度的电荷交换动力学；结合有限元静电计算进行能级分析；同时进行了依赖针尖偏压和针尖-样品距离的光谱测量。

papers.title: Designing Multivalent Copolymers for Selective Targeting of Multicomponent Surfaces
papers.abstract: Selective targeting of membranes with a specific receptor profile is an ongoing challenge in targeted drug delivery. We investigate the adsorption of copolymers on a multicomponent receptor-covered surface using grand-canonical Monte Carlo simulations and demonstrate that polymers can be designed to target a particular receptor density profile. To achieve this, the ligand profile on the polymers should match the targeted receptor profile, and the ligand--receptor affinity should be inversely proportional to the ligand profile. While the same can be obtained using multivalent nanoparticles, the entropic effects due to polymer conformations significantly enhance the binding selectivity of multivalent polymers compared to nanoparticles. Surprisingly, the ligand distribution on the polymer plays a crucial role, whereas the persistence length does not. The optimal selectivity to the overall receptor concentration is obtained by the Poisson distribution of ligands (random copolymer), whereas the maximal selectivity to a specific receptor profile is obtained by a defined sequence of grouped alternating ligands (regular copolymer). Interestingly, the regular copolymer can become anti-selective when ligands of the same type are in homogenous blocks, showing that specific ligand distribution qualitatively affects the targeting ability. These findings suggest that sequence control is necessary to selectively target a specific density profile of membrane receptors using linear copolymers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：grand-canonical Monte Carlo simulations）；研究对象：多组分受体覆盖表面上的共聚物吸附，具体涉及共聚物对特定受体密度分布膜的选择性靶向。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 共聚物可通过设计其配体分布与受体分布匹配，并令配体-受体亲和力与配体分布成反比，实现对特定受体密度分布的选择性靶向；与多价纳米颗粒相比，聚合物构象的熵效应显著增强了结合选择性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：共聚物可通过设计其配体分布与受体分布匹配，并令配体-受体亲和力与配体分布成反比，实现对特定受体密度分布的选择性靶向；与多价纳米颗粒相比，聚合物构象的熵效应显著增强了结合选择性。；创新点：揭示了配体分布（而非持续长度）对选择性的关键作用：随机共聚物对整体受体浓度选择性最优，而规则共聚物（特定交替序列）对特定受体分布选择性最强，且同种配体形成均匀嵌段时会出现反选择性。摘要未突出说明与实验或理论模型的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用巨正则蒙特卡洛模拟（grand-canonical Monte Carlo simulations）研究共聚物在含多组分受体表面上的吸附行为。

papers.title: Anomaly-Induced Hybrid Bulk Electromagnetic Mode in Weyl Semimetals
papers.abstract: Collective modes provide direct fingerprints of quantum matter. We predict a previously unidentified hybrid bulk electromagnetic mode in Weyl semimetals arising from the interplay between the chiral anomaly and the orientation of its associated chiral magnetic response relative to the direction of the wave-vector. When the anomaly-induced chiral magnetic current has a component along the propagation direction, oscillations of valley imbalance hybridize with plasmonic charge oscillations, producing a linearly dispersing mode that undergoes avoided crossing with the bulk plasmon, producing a hybrid bulk excitation absent in ordinary metals. The hybrid mode provides a direct signature of Weyl semimetals and a probe of the chiral anomaly and its associated chiral magnetic effect, with observable features in electron energy-loss spectroscopy. Studying this interplay can uncover various optical and electronic properties of Weyl semimetals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“predict”（预测）、“interplay”（相互作用）、“producing”（产生）等，表明该工作基于理论推导和预测，未提及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：Weyl半金属中的一种新型混合体电磁模式，具体涉及手征反常（chiral anomaly）及其相关的手征磁响应（chiral magnetic response）与波矢方向的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 预测了一种在Weyl半金属中由手征反常与手征磁电流方向共同诱导的、与体等离激元发生避免交叉的线性色散混合体电磁模式，该模式在普通金属中不存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：预测了一种在Weyl半金属中由手征反常与手征磁电流方向共同诱导的、与体等离激元发生避免交叉的线性色散混合体电磁模式，该模式在普通金属中不存在。；创新点：首次预测了由手征反常与波矢方向相对取向共同诱导的、与体等离激元发生避免交叉的混合体电磁模式，该模式可作为Weyl半金属的直接指纹特征，并用于探测手征反常及手征磁效应。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体框架基于手征反常（chiral anomaly）与手征磁效应（chiral magnetic effect）的物理图像，结合等离激元（plasmon）与谷极化振荡（valley imbalance oscillations）的耦合理论。

papers.title: Kinetic Superselectivity in Multivalent Binding
papers.abstract: Multivalent binding employs multiple simultaneous supramolecular interactions, increasing avidity and selectivity compared with monovalent binding. While equilibrium aspects of multivalency are well characterized, non-equilibrium behavior remains poorly understood. By combining experiments on hyaluronic acid polymers with kinetic modeling based on stochastic chemical kinetics and molecular dynamics simulations, we systematically investigate the kinetics of multivalent binding. Notably, we find that both association and dissociation kinetics can be more selective than equilibrium binding. We explain this behavior using a two-step binding model featuring a combination of fast, weak and slow, strong interactions. These findings demonstrate a new approach: superselective targeting based on the association rate instead of the equilibrium state. The kinetic theory and experiments presented here provide a fundamental understanding of multivalent kinetics and establish design rules for superselective targeting in out-of-equilibrium systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“结合实验”、“动力学建模”和“分子动力学模拟”。；研究对象：多价结合的动力学过程，具体以透明质酸聚合物为实验体系，研究其结合与解离的动力学选择性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多价结合中，结合与解离的动力学过程可以比平衡态结合具有更高的选择性，并可通过两步结合模型（快速弱相互作用与慢速强相互作用组合）解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多价结合中，结合与解离的动力学过程可以比平衡态结合具有更高的选择性，并可通过两步结合模型（快速弱相互作用与慢速强相互作用组合）解释。；创新点：提出了一种基于结合速率而非平衡态的超选择性靶向新策略，并建立了非平衡系统中超选择性靶向的设计规则。摘要未突出说明与已有平衡态多价性研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用透明质酸聚合物进行结合实验；理论上采用基于随机化学动力学的动力学建模；计算上使用分子动力学模拟。

papers.title: Temperature dependence of the magnon-phonon coupling in yttrium iron garnet/gadolinium gallium garnet high overtone bulk acoustic resonators
papers.abstract: Weexperimentally study the temperature dependence of the magnon-phonon coupling in a yttrium iron garnet (YIG)/gadolinium gallium garnet (GGG) heterostructure. More specifically, we use broadband ferromagnetic resonance to investigate the magneto-elastic coupling between the Kittel mode of a YIG thin film and the transverse acoustic phonon modes of the YIG/GGG high overtone bulk acoustic wave acoustic resonator for in and out-of-plane field directions in the temperature range between T = 5K and 300K. We find that for a magnetic field applied normal to the film surface, magneto-elastic coupling decreases with decreasing temperature, whereas it increases for the in-plane magnetic field configuration. The observed temperature dependence differs from earlier observations on bulk YIG samples, which might be due to the temperature dependent stress imposed by the GGG substrate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“experimentally study”、“broadband ferromagnetic resonance”、“investigate”。；研究对象：钇铁石榴石（YIG）/钆镓石榴石（GGG）异质结构中的磁振子-声子耦合，具体为YIG薄膜的Kittel模与YIG/GGG高泛音体声波谐振器的横向声学声子模之间的磁弹耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在垂直膜面磁场下，磁弹耦合随温度降低而减弱；在面内磁场下，磁弹耦合随温度降低而增强。该温度依赖性与块体YIG样品的早期观测结果不同，可能源于GGG衬底施加的温度依赖性应力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在垂直膜面磁场下，磁弹耦合随温度降低而减弱；在面内磁场下，磁弹耦合随温度降低而增强。该温度依赖性与块体YIG样品的早期观测结果不同，可能源于GGG衬底施加的温度依赖性应力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用宽带铁磁共振（broadband ferromagnetic resonance）技术，在5K至300K温度范围内，分别对垂直膜面和面内磁场方向进行测量。

papers.title: Inter-Landau-Level Pair Tunneling Rigidifies the Long-Wavelength Structure Factor of the ν=1/3 Laughlin State
papers.abstract: A textbook chain of reasoning, originating with Girvin, MacDonald, and Platzman, predicts that Landau-level mixing (LLM) at nu=1/3 should soften the long-wavelength structure factor S(L): virtual excitations suppress V_1, the magnetoroton gap closes, and the single-mode approximation then forces S(L) to increase. We test this chain on the Haldane sphere at nu=1/3, N=6, 2Q=15. (i) Perturbatively, via first-order Schrieffer-Wolff dressing of the LLL Laughlin state, fed Lowdin-renormalised pseudopotentials: the dressed state gives Delta S(1) at kappa=10 of approximately +21%, consistent with the GMP prediction (~19% softening of V_1^eff). (ii) Non-perturbatively, via rigorous two-Landau-level (LLL+SLL) exact diagonalisation using a repaired DiagHam 2LL module that retains, for the first time on the sphere, the full inter-LL scattering channels. The response reverses sign: S(1) rigidifies monotonically from 0.118 at kappa->0 to 0.080 at kappa=10, a 32% suppression. Perturbative and non-perturbative results thus disagree in sign, with a gap of ~53 percentage points between +21% (SW) and -32% (full ED). Channel-mask ablation localises the reversal to the DD<->UU pair-tunneling channel (98% of the shift). A four-way decomposition shows the three-body coherent content overpowers the perturbative admixture by ~2.5x. Repaired code: https://github.com/Cannan-1/DiagHamOnSphereOpenSource (v2.0).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：perturbatively、non-perturbatively、exact diagonalisation、pseudopotentials、code）；研究对象：ν=1/3 Laughlin态在朗道能级混合（LLM）下的长波结构因子S(L)行为，具体体系为Haldane球面上的N=6电子系统（2Q=15）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非微扰的严格对角化结果显示，朗道能级混合导致长波结构因子S(1)从0.118（κ→0）单调刚性化至0.080（κ=10），抑制了32%，与微扰理论预测的软化（+21%）符号相反。这一反转主要由DD↔UU对隧穿通道（占98%的偏移）驱动，三体相干效应以约2.5倍强度压制了微扰混合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非微扰的严格对角化结果显示，朗道能级混合导致长波结构因子S(1)从0.118（κ→0）单调刚性化至0.080（κ=10），抑制了32%，与微扰理论预测的软化（+21%）符号相反。这一反转主要由DD↔UU对隧穿通道（占98%的偏移）驱动，三体相干效应以约2.5倍强度压制了微扰混合。；创新点：首次在球面上通过严格对角化完整保留层间散射通道，发现非微扰结果与经典GMP微扰链预测定性相反，并精确定位反转机制为DD↔UU对隧穿通道的三体相干效应。
papers.method_zh: 采用两种方法对比：(i) 微扰方法：通过一阶Schrieffer-Wolff变换对LLL Laughlin态进行修饰，并输入Löwdin重整化赝势；(ii) 非微扰方法：使用修复的DiagHam 2LL模块在球面上进行严格对角化，首次完整保留LLL+SLL之间的所有层间散射通道。还使用了通道掩膜消融（channel-mask ablation）和四路分解分析。

papers.title: A tridiagonal matrix-valued process with stochastic resetting for arbitrary Dyson index $β>0$
papers.abstract: We introduce a symmetric tridiagonal matrix-valued process ($β$-TMP) $H(t)$ whose diagonal entries $H_{k,k}(t)$ evolve independently via an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process starting at the origin and the off-diagonal entries $H_{k,k+1}(t)$ evolve independently via the Cox-Ingersoll-Ross process, starting at the origin and with parameters that depend on the row index $k$. We show that the joint distribution of the entries of the matrix can be computed exactly at all times and moreover, the joint distribution of its $N$ real eigenvalues can be computed exactly at all times too. We then subject this time-evolving matrix-valued process to stochastic resetting with rate $r$ in two different settings: (i) simultaneous resetting of the matrix entries to the origin with rate $r$ ($β$-SRTMP process) and (ii) independent resetting of the matrix entries to the origin with rate $r$ ($β$-IRTMP process). We show that the joint distribution of the eigenvalues of the $β$-SRTMP process at long times can be computed analytically and it coincides with the joint distribution of the positions of the resetting Dyson Brownian motion in its stationary state for arbitrary $β>0$. For the $β$-IRTMP stationary ensemble, computing analytically the joint distribution of eigenvalues or even the average density of eigenvalues is difficult. However, generating the stationary $β$-IRTMP ensemble numerically is relatively straightforward and we compare its numerical average eigenvalue density to the corresponding analytical results for the $β$-SRTMP stationary ensemble with same parameter values, showing that they are quite different from each other. Finally, we provide a simple and concrete application of this tridiagonal matrix-valued process in computing the annealed partition function of a disordered quantum tight-binding Hamiltonian on a one-dimensional lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：论文引入并分析了一个随机矩阵过程（β-TMP），并进行了精确的解析计算和数值模拟，属于理论物理与随机过程交叉研究。；研究对象：一个具有随机重置（stochastic resetting）的对称三对角矩阵值过程（β-TMP），其矩阵元由Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程和Cox-Ingersoll-Ross过程驱动，用于描述任意Dyson指数β>0的随机矩阵系综的动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文发现，在同时重置（β-SRTMP）设定下，长时间后特征值的联合分布与重置Dyson布朗运动稳态下的特征值分布一致，且可解析计算；而在独立重置（β-IRTMP）设定下，特征值分布难以解析求解，但可通过数值生成，且与β-SRTMP的稳态分布显著不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文发现，在同时重置（β-SRTMP）设定下，长时间后特征值的联合分布与重置Dyson布朗运动稳态下的特征值分布一致，且可解析计算；而在独立重置（β-IRTMP）设定下，特征值分布难以解析求解，但可通过数值生成，且与β-SRTMP的稳态分布显著不同。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析计算与数值模拟相结合的方法。解析上，精确计算了矩阵元及特征值的联合分布；数值上，生成了β-IRTMP稳态系综并计算平均特征值密度。具体理论框架包括Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程、Cox-Ingersoll-Ross过程、随机重置以及Dyson布朗运动。

papers.title: Long-range deformations in Gaussian States
papers.abstract: Imaginary-time evolution by a local Hamiltonian cannot induce a phase transition in one dimension, but longer-range interactions may subvert such constraints. Starting from the ground state of the Kitaev Majorana chain, we modify the wave function by an imaginary-time evolution generated by a quadratic Hamiltonian with power-law couplings that enhance pairing correlations, typically of the form $1/r^α$, where $r$ is the distance between two sites. As the state remains Gaussian, entanglement and correlation functions can be computed analytically. We find that the decay exponent $α$ controls three distinct infrared regimes: for $α>1$, the deformation produces only smooth crossovers at finite deformation strength, while the topological regime is reached only asymptotically as the deformation strength tends to infinity. At $α=1$, the deformation induces an immediate flow to the topological phase: an infinitesimal deformation strength drives the system to a topological regime, and in a particular case, an emergent Kramers-Wannier symmetry enforces Ising-like scaling at long distances. For $α<1$, the deformed state shows the same critical-like behavior for all non-zero deformation strength. We observe that even with arbitrarily long-range interactions, these models do not display a sharp phase transition at non-zero deformation strength.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Gaussian States、Imaginary-time evolution、解析计算。；研究对象：Kitaev Majorana链的基态在长程二次型哈密顿量虚时演化下的变形行为，重点研究配对关联的幂律衰减（1/r^α）对量子态性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 变形强度非零时，系统不会出现尖锐的相变；但长程相互作用的幂指数α决定了三种不同的红外行为：α>1时仅出现平滑交叉，α=1时无穷小变形即可驱动系统进入拓扑相，α<1时所有非零变形强度下均呈现类临界行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：变形强度非零时，系统不会出现尖锐的相变；但长程相互作用的幂指数α决定了三种不同的红外行为：α>1时仅出现平滑交叉，α=1时无穷小变形即可驱动系统进入拓扑相，α<1时所有非零变形强度下均呈现类临界行为。；创新点：系统揭示了长程相互作用（1/r^α）在无相变条件下如何通过改变幂指数α调控拓扑相变的涌现方式，特别是α=1时发现涌现的Kramers-Wannier对称性导致长程Ising类标度行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用二次型哈密顿量（具有幂律耦合）生成虚时演化，对Kitaev Majorana链基态进行高斯态变形；通过解析计算纠缠和关联函数分析系统性质。

papers.title: Structure and energetics of grain boundaries in self-assembled double-gyroid block copolymer networks
papers.abstract: Grain boundaries (GBs) are ubiquitous defects in crystalline materials. However, they remain less explored in block copolymer ordered phases. Here, we develop a self-consistent field theory framework to investigate GB structure and energetics in double-gyroid (DG) diblock copolymer networks. The GB energy landscape is obtained as a function of GB orientation, which reveals multiple local minima representing distinct network-switching GBs. Remarkably, the global minimum is a previously unidentified asymmetric-tilt network-switching GB (ATNS), exhibiting a lower energy than the experimentally observed $(422)$ twin boundary (TB). Comparative analyses of representative low- (ATNS, $(422)$ TB) and high-energy twist ($(0\bar{1}\bar{1})$, $(100)$ TNSs) GBs reveal that, unlike enthalpy-dominated hard matter, GB stability in DG networks is predominantly entropy-driven. Twist-type GBs generate new nodes and disrupt nodal coplanarity, causing chain packing frustration and large entropy penalties. Conversely, the ATNS preserves favorable network connectivity and minimizes conformational constraints on polymer chains, making it the energetically preferred GB.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：self-consistent field theory framework（自洽场理论框架）、energetics（能量学分析）。；研究对象：双螺旋（double-gyroid, DG）嵌段共聚物网络中的晶界（grain boundaries, GBs）结构与能量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种此前未被识别的非对称倾斜网络切换晶界（ATNS），其能量低于实验上已观测到的(422)孪晶界（TB）；双螺旋网络中的晶界稳定性主要由熵驱动，而非焓驱动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种此前未被识别的非对称倾斜网络切换晶界（ATNS），其能量低于实验上已观测到的(422)孪晶界（TB）；双螺旋网络中的晶界稳定性主要由熵驱动，而非焓驱动。；创新点：首次系统计算了双螺旋嵌段共聚物网络的晶界能量景观，并揭示了熵在决定晶界稳定性中的主导作用，这与传统硬物质中焓主导的晶界行为形成鲜明对比。
papers.method_zh: 自洽场理论（self-consistent field theory, SCFT）框架，用于计算不同取向晶界的能量景观，并对代表性低能和高能晶界进行对比分析。

papers.title: Dynamics of ring polymer melts: Memory function approach
papers.abstract: We investigated the static and dynamic properties of a Rouse ring polymer modified by introducing an effective, spherically symmetric, attractive potential of entropic nature and a memory function describing the effect of dynamic entanglement. Renormalized Rouse formalism is used to approximate the time dependence of the memory matrix. The results obtained are in good agreement with existing experimental data and the results of computer simulations of ring polymer ring with , , where N_e is the number of Kuhn segments in linear polymer melts between neighboring entanglements and , the number of Kuhn segments. For large molecular weights, a refined self-consistent approximation is proposed to describe the time dependence of the memory function. It is shown that this approximation allows us to describe an exponential decrease in the self-diffusion coefficient with molecular weight of the rings, i.e., the effect of dynamic localization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“Renormalized Rouse formalism”、“self-consistent approximation”等理论方法，未提及实验或计算模拟的具体操作。；研究对象：环状聚合物熔体的动力学行为，特别是通过引入有效吸引势和记忆函数来研究其静态与动态性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过重正化Rouse形式论和自洽近似，成功描述了环状聚合物熔体中自扩散系数随分子量指数衰减的动态局域化效应，且理论结果与实验及计算机模拟数据吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过重正化Rouse形式论和自洽近似，成功描述了环状聚合物熔体中自扩散系数随分子量指数衰减的动态局域化效应，且理论结果与实验及计算机模拟数据吻合良好。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用重正化Rouse形式论（Renormalized Rouse formalism）近似记忆矩阵的时间依赖性；对于高分子量体系，进一步提出了改进的自洽近似（self-consistent approximation）来描述记忆函数的时间演化。

papers.title: Active learning of collinear magnetic Moment Tensor Potentials using the spin-MLIP package from soft-constrained spin-polarized DFT calculations: a case study of Fe-Pd
papers.abstract: Explicit incorporation of magnetic degrees of freedom in machine-learning interatomic potentials (magnetic MLIPs) plays a crucial role in the correct description of magnetic materials and their properties. An important ingredient for fitting of magnetic MLIPs is spin-polarized density functional theory (DFT) calculations with non-equilibrium magnetic moments, i.e. DFT calculations with constraints on magnetic moments. In this study, we present a workflow for active learning of magnetic Moment Tensor Potential (mMTP) during molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. Magnetic MTP and its active learning algorithm were implemented in the open-source spin-MLIP code, DFT soft-constrained spin-polarized calculations were performed with the VASP code, and MD simulations were conducted in the open-source LAMMPS code. We test our workflow on the Fe-Pd crystal. The dependencies of magnetization and density of states (DOSs) on the volume of a supercell (or, pressure) are in good agreement with those calculated with DFT. Furthermore, the calculated DOSs correspond to the experimental ones.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learning interatomic potentials、spin-polarized DFT calculations、active learning、MD simulations。；研究对象：Fe-Pd晶体中的磁性原子间势（magnetic Moment Tensor Potential, mMTP）的主动学习构建。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过主动学习流程训练的磁性MTP能够准确描述Fe-Pd晶体的磁化强度和态密度（DOS）随体积（或压力）的变化，计算结果与DFT及实验数据吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过主动学习流程训练的磁性MTP能够准确描述Fe-Pd晶体的磁化强度和态密度（DOS）随体积（或压力）的变化，计算结果与DFT及实验数据吻合良好。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用软约束自旋极化DFT计算（VASP代码）生成非平衡磁矩数据；基于spin-MLIP开源代码实现磁性MTP及其主动学习算法；分子动力学模拟在LAMMPS代码中进行。

papers.title: Orbital Magnetization from Uniform and Periodic Magnetic Fields
papers.abstract: Magnetization is thermodynamically defined as the derivative of the grand potential with respect to a uniform magnetic field. However, a uniform magnetic field makes the kinetic momentum operators noncommuting and Landau-quantizes the electron motion. This changes the zero-field momentum-space to Landau-levels and raises a fundamental question: how can the thermodynamic response to a uniform field be reproduced by a linear-response calculation carried out in the momentum space of the zero-field problem? We address this question analytically in a quantum Hall ferromagnet that allows the orbital magnetization $M$ to be computed in a closed form. We first compute $M$ from the local Hartree--Fock projector response to a periodic magnetic field with zero net flux. We then compute $M$ from the derivative of the grand potential with respect to a uniform magnetic field along the Středa line. The two approaches give the same result, even though the first keeps the Hilbert space fixed while the second changes the Landau-level degeneracy. Their agreement suggests that we should view orbital magnetization as the energy associated with the spectral flow that gives rise to the Středa formula. Our work provides a tutorial introduction to orbital magnetization and its relation to the Středa formula.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“analytically”“Hartree-Fock projector response”“grand potential derivative”等理论推导术语，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：轨道磁化（orbital magnetization）在均匀磁场与周期性磁场下的热力学定义与计算，具体以量子霍尔铁磁体（quantum Hall ferromagnet）为模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过两种不同方法（周期性磁场下的局域Hartree-Fock投影响应、均匀磁场下沿Středa线的巨势导数）计算轨道磁化，得到相同结果，表明轨道磁化应被理解为与产生Středa公式的谱流（spectral flow）相关的能量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过两种不同方法（周期性磁场下的局域Hartree-Fock投影响应、均匀磁场下沿Středa线的巨势导数）计算轨道磁化，得到相同结果，表明轨道磁化应被理解为与产生Středa公式的谱流（spectral flow）相关的能量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论推导：使用Hartree-Fock近似下的局域投影算符响应方法处理周期性磁场（零净通量），以及基于巨势对均匀磁场的导数沿Středa线计算轨道磁化。

papers.title: Self-Consistent Spectral Quadrature Approach to Many-Body Green Functions
papers.abstract: We develop a self-consistent spectral quadrature (sc-SQ) framework for the calculation of many-body Green functions. The method approximates the Källén--Lehmann spectral measure by Gauss--Christoffel (GC) quadrature, yielding a rational Green function representation with guaranteed spectral positivity that exactly reproduces the first $2N$ spectral moments at pole order $N$. A key component is an SVD-based rank-selection criterion on the Hankel matrix, which identifies the numerically resolvable pole rank $N^*$ from the singular-value gap and acts as a precision-guided diagnostic of correlation complexity. The scheme is made self-consistent by requiring that the spectral function used to evaluate expectation values coincides with the spectral function generated by the quadrature reconstruction. This defines a fixed-point hierarchy that connects systematically to established approximations, including Hartree--Fock and Hubbard-I, and incorporates non-perturbative features such as multi-peak spectral structure. We benchmark the approach for the Anderson impurity model against numerical renormalization group (NRG) results and apply it within dynamical mean-field theory for the Hubbard model on the Bethe lattice. The method captures the three-peak Anderson impurity spectrum and the suppression of quasiparticle weight in the half-filled Hubbard model on the Bethe lattice, including Mott-gap formation on the insulating branch for $N\geqslant 5$, in qualitative agreement with NRG references.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：self-consistent spectral quadrature (sc-SQ) framework、many-body Green functions、dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT)。；研究对象：多体格林函数，具体应用于Anderson杂质模型和Bethe晶格上的Hubbard模型（通过动力学平均场理论）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该方法能够通过自洽谱求积精确再现多体格林函数的前2N个谱矩，并捕捉到Anderson杂质模型的三峰谱结构以及半满Hubbard模型在Bethe晶格上的准粒子权重抑制和Mott能隙形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该方法能够通过自洽谱求积精确再现多体格林函数的前2N个谱矩，并捕捉到Anderson杂质模型的三峰谱结构以及半满Hubbard模型在Bethe晶格上的准粒子权重抑制和Mott能隙形成。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 提出了自洽谱求积（sc-SQ）框架，利用Gauss-Christoffel（GC）求积近似Källén-Lehmann谱测度，得到有理函数形式的格林函数；通过Hankel矩阵的SVD奇异值间隙确定数值可分辨的极点阶数N*；通过自洽条件（谱函数与求积重构一致）定义不动点层次，连接至Hartree-Fock和Hubbard-I等近似。

papers.title: Ultrafast signatures of Dirac / flat-band hybrid states from time-resolved ARPES
