papers.abstract: Hybridization of highly itinerant Dirac electrons with localized flat-band states is predicted to yield emergent phenomena such as exotic heavy-fermion behaviour. Epitaxial graphene on two-dimensional adsorbate structures on SiC(0001), which host flat bands, offers a promising platform to explore these effects. However, direct experimental evidence of interlayer hybridization in such systems has so far been lacking. Here, we address this gap using time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (trARPES) where interlayer hybridization manifests in three key observations: (1) accelerated Dirac-carrier relaxation arising from additional electronic and phononic decay channels provided by the flat-band subsystem, (2) transient charging of the Dirac cone enabled by direct optical excitation from the flat bands, and (3) ultrafast back-transfer of charge into the flat bands on timescales governed by the interlayer coupling strength. We further demonstrate that the degree of hybridization can be tuned via the atomic number of the atoms intercalated at the graphene-SiC interface, establishing a controllable platform for investigating exotic correlated ground states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用时间分辨角分辨光电子能谱（trARPES）作为主要实验手段，并涉及样品制备（外延石墨烯、插层原子）。；研究对象：SiC(0001)上外延石墨烯与二维吸附层（平带宿主）形成的异质体系，具体研究狄拉克电子与平带态杂化导致的超快动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过trARPES首次直接观测到石墨烯狄拉克电子与平带态之间的层间杂化，表现为三个关键超快特征：狄拉克载流子弛豫加速、狄拉克锥瞬态充电、以及电荷超快回传至平带。杂化强度可通过插层原子序数调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过trARPES首次直接观测到石墨烯狄拉克电子与平带态之间的层间杂化，表现为三个关键超快特征：狄拉克载流子弛豫加速、狄拉克锥瞬态充电、以及电荷超快回传至平带。杂化强度可通过插层原子序数调控。；创新点：首次通过trARPES提供石墨烯/平带体系中层间杂化的直接实验证据，并展示了通过插层原子种类可调谐杂化强度，为研究奇异关联基态（如重费米子行为）建立了可控平台。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨角分辨光电子能谱（trARPES），结合SiC(0001)上外延石墨烯与二维吸附层体系的样品制备，以及不同原子（如不同原子序数）的插层调控。

papers.title: Electronic properties governing the phase stability and elastic anisotropy of C14 and C15 Cr-Hf-Nb Laves phases
papers.abstract: This study utilizes Density Functional Theory (DFT) to investigate the thermodynamic stability, elastic anisotropy, and electronic properties of C14 and C15 Laves phases within the Cr--Hf--Nb system. Both formation enthalpies and comprehensive elastic property analyses confirm the energetic and mechanical stability of the C14 (HfNb$_2$, HfCr$_2$, NbCr$_2$) and C15 (HfCr$_2$, NbCr$_2$) phases. Furthermore, the evaluation of elastic anisotropy reveals a descending order of HfCr$_2$ > NbCr$_2$ > HfNb$_2$ for the C14 phase, contrasting with NbCr$_2$ > HfNb$_2$ > HfCr$_2$ for the C15 phase. Finally, electronic structure and COHP analyses indicate that strong anti-bonding behavior near the Fermi level within the XM$_2$ M--M bonds acts as a primary destabilization mechanism for both of these Laves phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“Density Functional Theory (DFT)”、“formation enthalpies”、“electronic structure and COHP analyses”。；研究对象：Cr-Hf-Nb 体系中的 C14 和 C15 型 Laves 相（具体包括 HfNb₂、HfCr₂、NbCr₂ 等化合物）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: C14 和 C15 型 Laves 相在热力学和力学上均稳定，但费米能级附近 XM₂ 中 M-M 键的强反键行为是导致这两种 Laves 相失稳的主要机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：C14 和 C15 型 Laves 相在热力学和力学上均稳定，但费米能级附近 XM₂ 中 M-M 键的强反键行为是导致这两种 Laves 相失稳的主要机制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，结合形成焓分析、弹性常数与弹性各向异性评估、电子结构分析以及晶体轨道哈密顿布居（COHP）分析。

papers.title: Radiative electronic bound states in the continuum from defects in semiconductors
papers.abstract: Continuum-buried defect states in semiconductors are generally expected to be optically inactive due to their strong coupling to continuum bands. Here, we show that such defects can instead host radiative electronic bound states in the continuum (BICs), using the silicon G-center as a prototypical example. Hybrid-functional first-principles calculations with a Hubbard $U$ correction reveal that a localized defect state, initially buried below the valence band maximum (VBM) in the ground state, undergoes exchange-driven energy-level reordering under optical excitation and shifts above the VBM. This exchange-induced transition suppresses nonradiative decay and enables robust radiative emission. By computing temperature-dependent nonradiative lifetimes and comparing them with experimental photoluminescence (PL) lifetimes, we quantitatively reproduce the observed temperature dependence of the emission. These results uncover a stabilization mechanism for continuum-embedded defect states and establish electronic BICs as a general paradigm for designing defect-based optical systems, including quantum emitters and qubits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles calculations、hybrid-functional、Hubbard \(U\) correction）；研究对象：半导体中缺陷形成的连续谱束缚态（continuum-buried defect states），以硅中的G中心（silicon G-center）为具体体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 原本被认为因与连续谱强耦合而光学惰性的连续谱埋藏缺陷态，在光激发下可因交换作用驱动的能级重排而转变为辐射性电子束缚态（electronic BICs），从而抑制非辐射衰减并实现稳定发光。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：原本被认为因与连续谱强耦合而光学惰性的连续谱埋藏缺陷态，在光激发下可因交换作用驱动的能级重排而转变为辐射性电子束缚态（electronic BICs），从而抑制非辐射衰减并实现稳定发光。；创新点：揭示了连续谱嵌入缺陷态的一种稳定化机制，并首次将电子型束缚态（electronic BICs）确立为设计基于缺陷的光学系统（如量子发射器、量子比特）的通用范式。摘要未突出说明与以往BIC研究（通常针对光子或声子体系）的具体区别。
papers.method_zh: 采用含Hubbard \(U\)修正的杂化泛函第一性原理计算（hybrid-functional DFT+\(U\)），计算温度依赖的非辐射寿命，并与实验光致发光（PL）寿命进行定量对比。

papers.title: Terahertz spin-current transparency through rough interfaces
papers.abstract: Spin transport across interfaces is critical for spintronic devices, yet remains difficult to probe on ultrafast timescales. We use terahertz emission spectroscopy on Co|Pt heterostructures whose interface roughness is tuned through the thickness of an underlying Au buffer layer, while leaving other growth parameters unchanged. From the measured THz electric field, we extract the interface spin-current transparency ts after correcting for the changes in sample impedance and optical absorption of the stack. Surprisingly, we find that ts decreases by only approximately 30% as the interface root-mean-square roughness and the lateral grain size both increase by a factor of three, with no measurable change in the THz spectrum. These results demonstrate that interfacial spin transport is relatively robust against morphological variations on ultrafast timescales, establishing terahertz emission spectroscopy as a reliable probe of spin dynamics across imperfect interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：terahertz emission spectroscopy（太赫兹发射谱）、measured THz electric field（测量太赫兹电场）、extract（提取）。；研究对象：Co|Pt异质结中界面粗糙度对自旋输运的影响，具体研究界面自旋电流透明度（interface spin-current transparency）在超快时间尺度上的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 界面自旋电流透明度在界面均方根粗糙度和横向晶粒尺寸均增大三倍的情况下仅下降约30%，且太赫兹频谱无显著变化，表明超快时间尺度上的界面自旋输运对形貌变化相对鲁棒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：界面自旋电流透明度在界面均方根粗糙度和横向晶粒尺寸均增大三倍的情况下仅下降约30%，且太赫兹频谱无显著变化，表明超快时间尺度上的界面自旋输运对形貌变化相对鲁棒。；创新点：首次利用太赫兹发射光谱定量研究界面粗糙度对超快自旋输运的影响，并发现界面自旋输运在形貌变化下具有鲁棒性，从而验证了太赫兹发射光谱可作为探测非理想界面自旋动力学的可靠手段。
papers.method_zh: 太赫兹发射光谱（terahertz emission spectroscopy），通过改变底层Au缓冲层厚度来调控Co|Pt界面粗糙度，同时保持其他生长参数不变；在修正样品阻抗和光学吸收变化后，从测量的太赫兹电场中提取界面自旋电流透明度。

papers.title: Influence of helicoidal spin-orbit coupling and Rabi coupling in dynamics of 2D Bose-Einstein Condensates
papers.abstract: This study explores the dynamics of Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs) with helicoidal spin-orbit coupling (SOC) and Rabi coupling, confined under a two-dimensional harmonic potential. The relationship between helicoidal SOC, non-linear interactions along with Rabi coupling and their impact on the stability and non linear trapped modes of the condensate is analyzed using a coupled Gross-Pitaevski (GP) framework. A linearized GP equation is used to investigate modulation instability (MI), demonstrating the impact of strong coupling effects and anisotropic confinement on the instability dynamics. It has been shown that the modulation instability in the condensate is predominantly governed by the competition between the attractive and repulsive mean-field interactions. Additionally, stability regimes are altered by the harmonic confinement, enhancing their susceptibility to SOC-induced asymmetry and intra- and intercomponent interactions. These results shed light on the possibility for unique quantum phases and emergent characteristics of helicoidal SOC-driven condensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“coupled Gross-Pitaevski (GP) framework”“linearized GP equation”等理论框架，并分析“modulation instability”和“stability regimes”，未提及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：二维谐波势阱中具有螺旋自旋-轨道耦合（helicoidal SOC）和拉比耦合（Rabi coupling）的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 螺旋自旋-轨道耦合与拉比耦合共同作用下，凝聚体的调制不稳定性主要由平均场吸引与排斥相互作用之间的竞争主导；谐波束缚会改变稳定性区域，增强对SOC诱导不对称性及组分内/间相互作用的敏感性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：螺旋自旋-轨道耦合与拉比耦合共同作用下，凝聚体的调制不稳定性主要由平均场吸引与排斥相互作用之间的竞争主导；谐波束缚会改变稳定性区域，增强对SOC诱导不对称性及组分内/间相互作用的敏感性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用耦合Gross-Pitaevskii（GP）方程框架分析非线性束缚模的稳定性；通过线性化GP方程研究调制不稳定性（MI），并考察强耦合效应和各向异性束缚对不稳定动力学的影响。

papers.title: Defect engineering of ultrathin gallium nitride via electric fields for advanced electronic, magnetic, and gas sensing applications
papers.abstract: Scaling wide-band-gap semiconductors to the ultrathin limit offers a transformative pathway for power electronics, with gallium nitride (GaN) representing a cornerstone material in this class. However, the operational resilience and functional tunability of its two-dimensional form (g-GaN) remain underexplored. This work shifts the focus from idealized systems to the complex materials behavior under realistic conditions, investigating how the synergistic effects of point vacancy defects, strain, and external electric fields govern its electronic, magnetic, and sensing landscapes. We demonstrate that these factors are not merely perturbations but are fundamental to modulating the material response. Our first-principles calculations suggest g-GaN maintains electronic stability under intense electric fields; notably, gallium vacancies are predicted to further extend the theoretical stability limit. While in-plane tension preserves the band gap evolution under an electric field, in-plane compression facilitates low-field metallization. Using nitrogen monoxide (NO) adsorption as a prototype, we find that the interaction is defect-modulated and potentially tunable by electric fields. Analysis of adsorption energetics and diffusion barriers suggests the gallium vacancy may act as a thermodynamic trap for NO. Targeted hybrid-functional (HSE06) validation confirms the reliability of observed adsorption trends and theoretical metallization thresholds, while revealing that precise electronic-exchange treatment is critical for capturing the magnetic ground state of nitrogen vacancies. By systematically examining the geometry, energetics, band structure, density of states, magnetic response, and charge transfer, this study clarifies the interplay between defects and external electric fields, providing insights into theoretical upper bounds for property tuning and semiconductor device engineering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）、“hybrid-functional (HSE06) validation”（杂化泛函验证）。；研究对象：超薄氮化镓（g-GaN）二维材料，具体研究其点缺陷（镓空位、氮空位）、应变与外加电场协同作用下的电子、磁性和气体传感特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超薄氮化镓在强电场下能保持电子稳定性，且镓空位可进一步扩展其理论稳定极限；氮氧化物（NO）的吸附行为受缺陷调控，并可通过电场进行调节。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超薄氮化镓在强电场下能保持电子稳定性，且镓空位可进一步扩展其理论稳定极限；氮氧化物（NO）的吸附行为受缺陷调控，并可通过电场进行调节。；创新点：将研究焦点从理想化系统转向真实条件下的复杂材料行为，系统揭示了点缺陷、应变和外部电场三者协同效应对超薄氮化镓电子、磁性和传感性能的调控机制，而非仅将其视为微扰。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（密度泛函理论，DFT），并使用杂化泛函（HSE06）对吸附趋势、金属化阈值及氮空位的磁基态进行验证。分析了几何结构、能量、能带结构、态密度、磁响应和电荷转移。

papers.title: Neural Autoregressive Control Variates for the Quantum Monte Carlo Sign Problem
papers.abstract: We train a pair of autoregressive models to construct zero-mean control variates to mitigate the sign problem in quantum Monte Carlo simulations. The two autoregressive networks are confined to the positive- and negative-sign sectors with strictly disjoint support, and each is exactly normalized over its sector. Their difference is therefore structurally zero-mean, providing an unbiased auxiliary observable whose correlation with the sign estimator controls the variance reduction. We implement the method within the stochastic series expansion framework, which we extend to frustrated lattices by developing an incremental loop-topology update. Sign-ergodic sampling is achieved through a twist channel, which is the unique sign-changing mechanism on non-bipartite lattices. We implement the control variates as autoregressive transformers with an end-of-sequence parity mask that enforces exact sign-sector resolution, while the incremental loop-count change and cumulative frustration parity are incorporated as topological features. On the triangular-lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet, we benchmark the method in the small-$N$ limit. The control variate reduces the standard error of the average sign by up to an order of magnitude and that of the energy estimator by a factor of three to five, remaining effective even when the average sign drops below $10^{-3}$. This work lays out the framework and provides a proof-of-principle demonstration that autoregressive control variates can effectively mitigate the sign problem. Scaling to larger systems with physics-informed architectures is the subject of future work.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：quantum Monte Carlo simulations, autoregressive models, control variates, stochastic series expansion。；研究对象：量子蒙特卡洛模拟中的符号问题（sign problem），具体以三角晶格海森堡反铁磁体（triangular-lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet）为基准体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 训练一对自回归模型作为零均值控制变量，可将平均符号的标准误差降低一个数量级，能量估计器的标准误差降低三到五倍，即使在平均符号低于10⁻³时仍有效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：训练一对自回归模型作为零均值控制变量，可将平均符号的标准误差降低一个数量级，能量估计器的标准误差降低三到五倍，即使在平均符号低于10⁻³时仍有效。；创新点：首次将自回归控制变量方法系统性地应用于量子蒙特卡洛符号问题，并证明其在受挫晶格体系中的有效性；开发了适用于受挫晶格的增量环拓扑更新算法。
papers.method_zh: 采用自回归变压器（autoregressive transformers）构建两个严格分离的正负符号扇区上的归一化概率模型，其差值作为零均值辅助可观测量；在随机级数展开（stochastic series expansion）框架内实现，并针对受挫晶格开发了增量环拓扑更新（incremental loop-topology update）；通过扭曲通道（twist channel）实现符号遍历采样；利用序列结束奇偶掩码（end-of-sequence parity mask）强制符号扇区分辨，并将增量环计数变化和累积受挫奇偶性作为拓扑特征嵌入。

papers.title: Tunable competing optical excitation pathways in the topological surface states of Bi$_2$Te$_3$
papers.abstract: Understanding coherent optical responses of topological surface states (TSSs) requires disentangling excitation pathways from the electronic band structure. Here, using angle-resolved two-photon photoemission spectroscopy, we identify two distinct excitation pathways in the TSSs of Bi$_2$Te$_3$: an off-resonant transition via virtual states and a resonant transition via unoccupied intermediate states. A pronounced modulation of the spectral response is observed, revealing a competition between the two coherent pathways. This competition is tunable via temperature-induced shifts of the chemical potential, which selectively modify the resonant channel. These results provide microscopic insight into the optical excitation mechanisms of TSSs and highlight the potential for controlling their optical responses, relevant for future spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：angle-resolved two-photon photoemission spectroscopy（角分辨双光子光电子能谱）、observed、spectral response。；研究对象：Bi₂Te₃拓扑绝缘体的拓扑表面态（TSSs）中的相干光学激发过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Bi₂Te₃的拓扑表面态中识别出两种不同的光学激发路径：通过虚态的非共振跃迁和通过未占据中间态的共振跃迁，两者之间存在可调谐的竞争关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Bi₂Te₃的拓扑表面态中识别出两种不同的光学激发路径：通过虚态的非共振跃迁和通过未占据中间态的共振跃迁，两者之间存在可调谐的竞争关系。；创新点：首次在拓扑表面态中区分并直接观测到两种相干激发路径（共振与非共振）的竞争，并发现该竞争可通过温度诱导的化学势移动进行调控。摘要未突出说明与以往研究在理论模型或材料选择上的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 角分辨双光子光电子能谱（angle-resolved two-photon photoemission spectroscopy）。

papers.title: Superconductivity-enhanced phonon angular momentum
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the properties of phonon angular momentum in the superconducting state, using fulleride compounds in an external magnetic field as a model system. The electron orbital angular momentum injected by an external field is transferred to the phonon subsystem via electron--phonon coupling. We show that this field-induced phonon angular momentum is significantly enhanced and undergoes a sign reversal upon entering the superconducting state. In the normal state, the dominant energy scale governing the response function is the electronic bandwidth $D$. In the superconducting state, the phonon energy scale $ω_1$ enters the denominator, leading to an enhancement of order $D/ω_1$. The observed sign change in the response can be explained by the competition between Fermi surface and Fermi volume contributions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretically investigate、model system、response function。；研究对象：超导态中声子角动量的性质，以富勒烯化合物（fulleride compounds）在外磁场中作为模型系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在外磁场诱导下，超导态中的声子角动量相比正常态显著增强，并发生符号反转。增强幅度约为电子带宽 \( D \) 与声子能量 \( \omega_1 \) 之比 \( D/\omega_1 \)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在外磁场诱导下，超导态中的声子角动量相比正常态显著增强，并发生符号反转。增强幅度约为电子带宽 \( D \) 与声子能量 \( \omega_1 \) 之比 \( D/\omega_1 \)。；创新点：揭示了超导态中声子角动量被显著增强并发生符号反转的新效应，并指出其物理根源在于超导态下响应函数的主导能量尺度从电子带宽转变为声子能量。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于电子-声子耦合框架，通过比较正常态与超导态中响应函数的能量尺度（电子带宽 \( D \) 与声子能量 \( \omega_1 \)）来推导增强机制，并利用费米面与费米体积贡献的竞争解释符号变化。

papers.title: Weak first-order phase transition out of the classical kagome spin liquid
papers.abstract: The low-temperature fate of the spin-liquid regime in the classical kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet has been debated for over three decades. Using an expansion in the number of spin components, we show that, contrary to earlier Monte Carlo simulations, the spin liquid terminates at a weak first-order phase transition into the $\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3}$ phase which ordered moment saturates at zero temperature. Adding second-neighbor interactions, this transition belongs to a line of first-order phase transitions that ends at a critical point. For comparison, the pyrochlore antiferromagnet remains disordered at all temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用“expansion in the number of spin components”（自旋分量数展开）进行理论分析，并与蒙特卡洛模拟结果对比。；研究对象：经典kagome晶格海森堡反铁磁体中的自旋液体态及其低温相变行为，同时涉及与pyrochlore反铁磁体的比较。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典kagome自旋液体在低温下通过一个弱一级相变进入√3×√3有序相，该有序相的磁矩在零温下饱和；而pyrochlore反铁磁体在所有温度下均保持无序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典kagome自旋液体在低温下通过一个弱一级相变进入√3×√3有序相，该有序相的磁矩在零温下饱和；而pyrochlore反铁磁体在所有温度下均保持无序。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用自旋分量数展开（large-N expansion）理论方法，并结合对次近邻相互作用的分析，研究相变线的性质（一级相变线终止于临界点）。

papers.title: Relationship between heat effects and shear modulus relaxation during structural relaxation of a telluride glass
papers.abstract: We performed parallel measurements of heat effects and shear modulus relaxation for glassy Te$_{75}$Ge$_{15}$Ga$_{10}$ taken as a representative of practically important non-metallic glasses with covalent bonding. It is shown that the heat effects occurring upon heating are quantitatively linked to the shear moduli in the glassy and crystalline states and their temperature derivatives as implied by Eq.(1), which was originally derived for metallic glasses. This relationship provides a good description of exo- and endothermal reactions using shear modulus relaxation data as an input. This is the first application of this approach to a non-metallic glass with directional interatomic bonding. The obtained results suggest that relaxation phenomena are governed by elastic dipoles -- atomic configurations with the symmetry lower than that of surrounding matrix.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“parallel measurements”（并行测量）、“heat effects”（热效应）、“shear modulus relaxation”（剪切模量弛豫）。；研究对象：碲化物玻璃 Te₇₅Ge₁₅Ga₁₀，作为具有共价键的实用非金属玻璃的代表。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 加热过程中产生的热效应与玻璃态和晶态下的剪切模量及其温度导数之间存在定量关系，该关系最初针对金属玻璃推导，首次成功应用于非金属玻璃。结果表明弛豫现象由弹性偶极子（对称性低于周围基质的原子构型）主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：加热过程中产生的热效应与玻璃态和晶态下的剪切模量及其温度导数之间存在定量关系，该关系最初针对金属玻璃推导，首次成功应用于非金属玻璃。结果表明弛豫现象由弹性偶极子（对称性低于周围基质的原子构型）主导。；创新点：首次将原本为金属玻璃建立的热效应-剪切模量关系应用于具有方向性共价键的非金属玻璃，并验证其有效性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 并行测量热效应（热分析）和剪切模量弛豫（力学谱或动态力学分析），利用公式(1)建立两者定量联系。

papers.title: MatFormBench: A Benchmarking Evaluation Framework for Target-Driven Materials Formulation
papers.abstract: Inverse design of materials has significantly advanced target-driven formulation optimization, yet existing materials machine learning benchmarks remain limited to forward property prediction, failing to systematically evaluate inverse optimization and generation algorithms, a critical gap that hinders the progress of target-driven materials design. To address this limitation, we propose MatFormBench, a novel benchmarking ecosystem tailored to evaluate and guide generative strategies for target-driven formulation. MatFormBench integrates a physics-driven formulation generation scheme to generate synthetic samples that faithfully emulate realistic materials structure-property response relationships, complemented by five escalating difficulty levels to quantify the complexity of these relationships. To rigorously assess algorithm performance, we further propose MatFormScore, a multi-dimensional metric that comprehensively quantifies performance across five critical axes: target success, search efficiency, exploratory capacity, robustness, and stability. We validate MatFormBench by evaluating 39 diverse inverse design algorithms, covering classical surrogate-assisted black-box search, state-of-the-art deep generative models, and increasingly popular Large Language Model (LLM)-based recommendation strategies. Across 1170 standardized algorithm-task evaluations, diffusion-based models demonstrate the strongest overall performance, while Variational Autoencoder (VAE)-based and Genetic Algorithm (GA)-based methods exhibit distinct advantages in specific scenarios. By establishing a unified evaluation standard for target-driven materials formulation, MatFormBench enables reproducible benchmarking, principled algorithm comparison, and diagnostic analysis of inverse design strategies, providing a foundational tool for advancing materials inverse design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（关键词：benchmarking evaluation framework, inverse design algorithms, generative models, machine learning）；研究对象：材料配方（materials formulation）的逆向设计，具体为通过目标驱动（target-driven）优化生成材料配方，而非特定化合物或物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 扩散模型（diffusion-based models）在整体性能上表现最强，而变分自编码器（VAE）和遗传算法（GA）在特定场景下具有独特优势；MatFormBench框架可系统评估逆向设计算法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：扩散模型（diffusion-based models）在整体性能上表现最强，而变分自编码器（VAE）和遗传算法（GA）在特定场景下具有独特优势；MatFormBench框架可系统评估逆向设计算法。；创新点：首次提出专门针对目标驱动材料配方逆向设计的统一基准测试框架，填补了现有材料机器学习基准仅局限于正向性质预测的空白，并引入多维度评价指标和标准化难度分级。
papers.method_zh: 提出MatFormBench基准测试框架，包含物理驱动的配方生成方案（physics-driven formulation generation scheme）以合成模拟样本，并设置五个递增难度等级；同时提出MatFormScore多维评价指标，涵盖目标成功率、搜索效率、探索能力、鲁棒性和稳定性五个维度。验证中评估了39种逆向设计算法，包括经典代理辅助黑箱搜索、深度生成模型和基于大语言模型（LLM）的推荐策略，共进行1170次标准化算法-任务评估。

papers.title: Visualizing Degradation in Anode-Free High-Utilization Aqueous Batteries Across Cell Lifetime
papers.abstract: Operando microscopy has unveiled key mechanistic insights in battery materials during early cycling, but long-term characterization to unveil material evolution, degradation, and failure remain limited. To address this gap, we develop a custom operando optical microscope that captures images across hundreds of cycles and hours using optically accessible, anode-free pouch cells. We image through-plane, bulk-representative electrodeposition behavior of aqueous tin metal anodes, which are promising due to their high energy density but whose reactivity limits practical cycle life. We show that substrate governs the morphology and stability of plated tin, particularly at high plated capacities. Specifically, copper substrates exhibit a multi-stage tin growth mode, which results in high overpotentials and irreversible active material loss at high plated capacities. In contrast, graphite substrates display a single-stage growth mode with slower kinetics. Using this insight, we balance performance and stability to demonstrate a high-utilization (70%, 630 mAh g$^{-1}_{Sn}$) porous graphite substrate Sn anode with high efficiency and long lifetime. Our results underscore the importance of material and device optimization guided by operando characterization across device lifetime with broad applicability to electrochemical systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“operando microscopy”、“custom operando optical microscope”、“imaging”等表明主要采用实验手段。；研究对象：无负极水系电池中锡金属负极的沉积行为及其退化机制，具体研究铜和石墨基底上的锡电沉积形态与稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基底材料决定了锡沉积的形态和稳定性：铜基底上锡呈现多阶段生长模式，导致高过电位和不可逆活性物质损失；石墨基底上为单阶段生长模式，动力学较慢。基于此，采用多孔石墨基底实现了高利用率（70%，630 mAh g⁻¹_Sn）且长寿命的锡负极。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基底材料决定了锡沉积的形态和稳定性：铜基底上锡呈现多阶段生长模式，导致高过电位和不可逆活性物质损失；石墨基底上为单阶段生长模式，动力学较慢。基于此，采用多孔石墨基底实现了高利用率（70%，630 mAh g⁻¹_Sn）且长寿命的锡负极。；创新点：开发了能够跨电池全寿命周期（数百次循环）进行原位成像的显微镜技术，填补了长期表征材料演化、退化和失效的空白，并将该技术应用于高能量密度但反应性强的锡金属负极体系。
papers.method_zh: 定制原位光学显微镜（operando optical microscope），在可光学访问的无负极软包电池中，对数百个循环和数小时内的锡电沉积行为进行面外、体相代表性的成像观察。

papers.title: Chirality-Driven Hierarchical Morphologies in Self-Assembled Biaxial Amphiphiles
papers.abstract: Chirality plays a crucial role in determining the structure of many systems in nature. Twisted or helical aggregates as a consequence of self-assembly can be seen in many biological and synthetic materials. Despite extensive theoretical and experimental efforts, how molecular-scale chirality gives rise to complex twisted morphologies in amphiphiles still remains unexplored. Here we study the interplay between molecular hydrophobicity, shape anisotropy and chirality using molecular dynamics simulation. Variation of relative molecular concentration and intrinsic chirality of molecules drive a sequence of twisted liquid crystalline variants of lamellar, cylindrical and vesicular phases. These structures emerge spontaneously under equilibrium conditions and are characterized by orientational correlation functions. We demonstrate that variation in molecular chirality gives rise to the development of hierarchical chiral order within the system. Further increment of chirality competes with hydrophobic interactions, leading to morphological instabilities. Our findings establish a direct link between microscopic chirality and mesoscale structure formation and their instabilities. Qualitative comparison of liquidity and pitch of the observed phase morphologies with the amount of chirality has been reported.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：molecular dynamics simulation、orientational correlation functions）；研究对象：双亲性分子（amphiphiles）在自组装过程中由分子手性驱动的层级扭曲形态，具体涉及层状、柱状和囊泡相的液晶变体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 分子手性的变化驱动了从层状到柱状再到囊泡相的扭曲液晶变体序列的自发形成，并导致系统内层级手性有序的发展；进一步增加手性会与疏水相互作用竞争，引发形态不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：分子手性的变化驱动了从层状到柱状再到囊泡相的扭曲液晶变体序列的自发形成，并导致系统内层级手性有序的发展；进一步增加手性会与疏水相互作用竞争，引发形态不稳定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulation），通过改变相对分子浓度和分子固有手性，并利用取向关联函数（orientational correlation functions）表征结构。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Structures of Parametrically Driven Nonlinear Lattices
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the effects of parametric driving on the one-dimensional Frenkel-Kontorova model, a nonlinear many-body lattice system. It is numerically found that a parametric vibration induces spatiotemporal ordering characterized by the subharmonic frequency $ω_{\mathrm{ex}}/2$ and wavenumber $k$ which takes nontrivial values depending on the vibration strength $P_{\mathrm{ac}}$ and frequency $ω_{\mathrm{ex}}$. With increasing $P_{\mathrm{ac}}$, $k$ gradually increases and discontinuously jumps up to $k=π$. Based on an extended linear stability analysis, we show that the former $k$ resonance (the latter $π$ resonance) corresponds to the unstable (stable) mode and that the $k$ resonance is made possible by the interplay between the parametric amplification and the collective fluctuation developing through the nonlinear effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：theoretically investigate、numerically found、extended linear stability analysis。；研究对象：一维Frenkel-Kontorova模型（非线性多体晶格系统）在参量驱动下的时空结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 参量振动可诱导出以亚谐频率ω_ex/2和特定波数k为特征的时空有序结构；随着驱动强度P_ac增加，波数k逐渐增大并发生不连续跳变至k=π，其中k共振（π共振）分别对应不稳定（稳定）模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：参量振动可诱导出以亚谐频率ω_ex/2和特定波数k为特征的时空有序结构；随着驱动强度P_ac增加，波数k逐渐增大并发生不连续跳变至k=π，其中k共振（π共振）分别对应不稳定（稳定）模式。；创新点：揭示了参量放大与通过非线性效应发展的集体涨落之间的相互作用如何导致k共振的形成。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（数值发现亚谐频率与波数依赖关系）；扩展线性稳定性分析（解析解释共振模式的不稳定性与稳定性）。

papers.title: Quantum statistical mechanics: Gauge invariance, operator shifting, hyperdensity functionals, and nonequilibrium sum rules
papers.abstract: We provide an extended acount of the recent statistical mechanical theory of gauge invariance against operator shifting in quantum many-body systems (arXiv:2509.20494). The gauge transformation is enacted by a shifting superoperator that displaces the fundamental position and momentum degrees of freedom. The shifting superoperator constitutes a map between Hilbert space operators and it features Lie algebra commutator structure. Averages of general observables remain invariant under the shifting both in and out of thermal equilibrium, as well as in groundstates. The gauge invariance induces exact sum rules that interconnect global observables and associated locally resolved correlation functions. In particular we describe the resulting one-body force, hyperforce, product, and two-body sum rules. We relate the shifting superoperator to a previously formulated quantum canonical transformation and present the generalization of quantum shifting to multi-component systems. The gauge theory respects fundamental fermionic and bosonic particle properties, as we demonstrate by proving the compatibility of operator shifting and exchange symmetry. We formulate the quantum version of hyperdensity functional theory to provide formal access to hyperforces as well as to general averaged quantum observables via universal density functionals. For time-dependent situations, we describe quantum dynamical gauge invariance and prove exact dynamical sum rules for nonequilibrium situations, as generated by Hamiltonian time dependence. We argue for the fundamental status of statistical mechanical gauge invariance based on the compliance of the underlying geometry with canonical quantization according to Dirac's correspondence principle. Analogies and differences of the quantum mechanical sum rules with their classical counterparts remain indicative of the respective levels of description.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：统计力学理论、规范不变性、超算符、李代数对易子结构、密度泛函理论。；研究对象：量子多体系统，包括平衡态、非平衡态及基态下的统计力学规范不变性，以及费米子和玻色子多组分系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了量子多体系统中针对算符平移的规范不变性理论，证明该规范变换下可观测量平均值在平衡态、非平衡态及基态中均保持不变，并由此导出一系列精确求和规则（如单体力、超力、乘积及两体求和规则）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了量子多体系统中针对算符平移的规范不变性理论，证明该规范变换下可观测量平均值在平衡态、非平衡态及基态中均保持不变，并由此导出一系列精确求和规则（如单体力、超力、乘积及两体求和规则）。；创新点：将经典统计力学中的规范不变性思想系统推广到量子多体系统，建立了量子版本的超密度泛函理论，严格证明了平移超算符与费米子/玻色子交换对称性的兼容性，并首次给出了非平衡情形下的精确动力学求和规则。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：超算符平移变换（shifting superoperator）、量子超密度泛函理论（quantum hyperdensity functional theory）、哈密顿量含时演化下的动力学规范不变性分析，并与狄拉克正则量子化及经典统计力学求和规则进行对比。

papers.title: Geometric Protection of Bipartite Entanglement in Hopf-Linked Quantum Rings
papers.abstract: We determine the bipartite entanglement bounds of two interacting electrons in deeply interlocked Hopf-linked quantum rings via exact diagonalization of the unexpanded 3D Coulomb interaction. This identifies an exact continuous spatial symmetry that geometrically isolates the positive-parity Bell state, preventing classical interaction-driven localization. A non-coplanar geometric tilt ($α> 0$) is essential to lift the exchange degeneracy and maintain this maximally entangled manifold as a state of frozen entanglement. However, a higher-order Schrieffer-Wolff transformation demonstrates this geometric protection is fundamentally bounded; uncancelled inter-orbital momentum transitions inevitably induce dynamical parity mixing. This defines a critical interaction threshold ($λ_{crit}$) for irreversible entanglement collapse. Our analysis shows that the resulting bounding conditions reveal scaling limitations in mesoscopic semiconductor architectures, dictating the necessity of synthetic macroscopic platforms to achieve robust topological protection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact diagonalization、Schrieffer-Wolff transformation、理论分析。；研究对象：两个相互作用的电子在深度互锁的Hopf链接量子环中的双粒子纠缠态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现一种精确的连续空间对称性可以几何上隔离正宇称Bell态，防止经典相互作用驱动的局域化；但这种几何保护存在根本性界限，不可消除的轨道间动量跃迁会不可避免地导致动力学宇称混合，从而定义了一个不可逆纠缠坍缩的临界相互作用阈值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现一种精确的连续空间对称性可以几何上隔离正宇称Bell态，防止经典相互作用驱动的局域化；但这种几何保护存在根本性界限，不可消除的轨道间动量跃迁会不可避免地导致动力学宇称混合，从而定义了一个不可逆纠缠坍缩的临界相互作用阈值。；创新点：揭示了Hopf链接量子环中双粒子纠缠的几何保护机制及其根本性界限，并指出该保护在介观半导体架构中存在缩放限制，需要合成宏观平台才能实现鲁棒的拓扑保护。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 通过未展开的三维库仑相互作用的精确对角化，以及高阶Schrieffer-Wolff变换进行理论分析。

papers.title: Designing Quantum Matter in Pyrochlore Iridates: A Perspective on Recent Thin-Film Advances
papers.abstract: The pyrochlore iridates R2Ir2O7 have emerged as a unique playground for exploring exotic quantum phenomena arising from the intricate interplay of strong spin-orbit coupling, electron correlations, and geometric frustration. While bulk crystals of these materials have revealed a rich landscape of correlated and topological states, recent breakthroughs in epitaxial thin-film synthesis and heterostructure engineering unlocked an entirely new dimension of discovery. This brief Perspective reviews recent advancements highlighting how new tuning knobs such as dimensional confinement, epitaxial strain, and interfacial coupling can be used to manipulate the delicate balance of competing interactions. We discuss several key discoveries enabled by this approach including the realization of the magnetic Weyl semimetal phase in (111) oriented films, strain-engineered magnetic multipolar orders, the emergence of a chiral spin liquid-like state in the quasi-2D limit, and the discovery of novel electronically anisotropic states at interfaces between pyrochlore iridates and other quantum materials, such as spin ice pyrochlores. These findings showcase that low-dimensional pyrochlore iridates provide ample opportunities for both theory and experiment to unravel, control and ultimately design novel quantum states of matter. We conclude by outlining key open questions and future directions ranging from the synthesis of new heterostructures to the application of advanced probes and the exploration of non-equilibrium phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述/展望文章（Perspective）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“This brief Perspective reviews recent advancements”，属于对近期进展的总结与展望，而非原创实验或计算研究。；研究对象：烧绿石铱氧化物（pyrochlore iridates，化学式R₂Ir₂O₇）薄膜及异质结体系，特别是其低维形式（如(111)取向薄膜、准二维极限、界面）中由强自旋-轨道耦合、电子关联和几何阻挫共同作用产生的奇异量子态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过维度约束、外延应变和界面耦合等新调控手段，在低维烧绿石铱氧化物中实现了磁性Weyl半金属相、应变调控的磁多极序、准二维极限下的手性自旋液体态，以及与其他量子材料（如自旋冰）界面处的新型电子各向异性态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过维度约束、外延应变和界面耦合等新调控手段，在低维烧绿石铱氧化物中实现了磁性Weyl半金属相、应变调控的磁多极序、准二维极限下的手性自旋液体态，以及与其他量子材料（如自旋冰）界面处的新型电子各向异性态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的单一创新点，但整体强调通过薄膜与异质结构工程引入的新调控自由度（如维度、应变、界面耦合）为设计和操控烧绿石铱氧化物中的量子态提供了全新维度，突破了块材研究的局限。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验或计算手段，但提及了“epitaxial thin-film synthesis and heterostructure engineering”（外延薄膜合成与异质结构工程）作为核心实验方法，并建议未来应用“advanced probes”（先进探测手段）和探索“non-equilibrium phenomena”（非平衡现象）。

papers.title: Ultrametricity of Energy Minimum Configurations of RNA Secondary Structures in the Nussinov Model
papers.abstract: We present a numerical study of the ultrametric properties of the set of RNA secondary structures with the maximum number of base pairs (energetically degenerate minima) within the maximum matching model (Nussinov algorithm). Using 18 natural small nuclear RNAs as examples, we show that the degree of nontrivial ultrametricity varies widely. We consider the optimization problem for the degree of nontrivial ultrametricity of RNA secondary structures with the maximum number of base pairs under a fixed nucleotide composition. It is found that permuting the nucleotide sequence can strongly change the degree of ultrametricity, indicating the key role of nucleotide order in shaping the hierarchical properties of RNA secondary structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：numerical study（数值研究）、maximum matching model（最大匹配模型）、Nussinov algorithm（Nussinov算法）。；研究对象：RNA二级结构在最大碱基配对（能量简并极小值）构型集合的超度量性质。具体以18种天然小核RNA为实例，研究其超度量性（ultrametricity）的分布与调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不同RNA二级结构能量极小构型集合的非平凡超度量程度差异很大；通过置换核苷酸序列可以显著改变超度量性，表明核苷酸顺序对RNA二级结构的层级性质起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不同RNA二级结构能量极小构型集合的非平凡超度量程度差异很大；通过置换核苷酸序列可以显著改变超度量性，表明核苷酸顺序对RNA二级结构的层级性质起关键作用。；创新点：首次系统研究了RNA二级结构能量极小构型集合的超度量性，并揭示了核苷酸顺序而非组成对超度量性的决定性影响。
papers.method_zh: 基于Nussinov算法（最大匹配模型）进行数值计算，分析RNA二级结构能量简并极小构型集合的超度量性质；通过固定核苷酸组成、置换序列来优化超度量性。

papers.title: Near-Infrared-Triggered Photodynamic Antibacterial Therapy Using Rose Bengal-Coated Upconverting Nanoparticles
papers.abstract: Antimicrobial photodynamic therapy (aPDT) is a promising modality for inactivation of antibiotic resistant bacteria, relying on the activation of a photosensitizer (PS) by light of a specific wavelength. This process results in the formation of reactive oxygen species, which ultimately induce cell death. However, aPDT in its conventional form, is limited by the shallow penetration of visible light, restricting its effectiveness for treatment of soft tissue and orthopaedic tissues. To overcome this limitation, near-infrared (NIR) absorbing PS can be used. However, poor stability in vivo after injection, ineffective microbial targeting due to hydrophilic nature and off-site tissue damage are the issues with use of NIR absorbing bare PSs. This issue can be mitigated by combining NIR light with a upconverting nanoparticles (UCNPs), which mediate in conversion of NIR into visible light for effective PS activation. In this study, LaF$_3$:Er$^{3+}$,Yb$^{3+}$ nanoparticles were synthesized using a hydrothermal method and coated with Rose Bengal (RB), a promising hydrophilic PS for aPDT, to evaluate the potential for NIR-triggered aPDT. Characterization of the synthesized UCNPs confirmed the crystalline structure, size distribution and successful RB functionalization. Photophysical studies demonstrated efficient energy transfer between UCNPs and RB, leading to singlet oxygen ($^1$O$_2$) generation in vitro. Antibacterial studies against Methicilin resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA), a superbug of implicated soft tissue and orthopaedic infections, revealed significant photo-bactericidal efficacy upon NIR irradiation, indicating the potential of RB-coated UCNPs for aPDT applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：synthesized（合成）、Characterization（表征）、Antibacterial studies（抗菌研究）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是涂覆了玫瑰红（Rose Bengal, RB）的镧系元素掺杂上转换纳米颗粒（LaF₃:Er³⁺,Yb³⁺ UCNPs），用于近红外光触发的光动力抗菌疗法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功制备的RB涂层上转换纳米颗粒在近红外光照射下，能有效产生单线态氧，并对耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）展现出显著的光致杀菌效果，证明了其在抗菌光动力疗法中的应用潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功制备的RB涂层上转换纳米颗粒在近红外光照射下，能有效产生单线态氧，并对耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）展现出显著的光致杀菌效果，证明了其在抗菌光动力疗法中的应用潜力。；创新点：利用上转换纳米颗粒将近红外光转换为可见光，以激活亲水性光敏剂玫瑰红，从而克服传统可见光光动力疗法组织穿透深度浅的局限性，并解决裸光敏剂稳定性差、靶向性不足和脱靶损伤的问题。
papers.method_zh: 采用水热法合成了LaF₃:Er³⁺,Yb³⁺上转换纳米颗粒，并通过涂层工艺负载玫瑰红光敏剂。通过结构表征确认了晶体结构、尺寸分布及RB的成功修饰。通过光物理研究验证了UCNPs与RB之间的能量转移及体外单线态氧的产生。最后，以MRSA为模型进行了抗菌实验。

papers.title: Super-Arrhenius Dynamic Slowdown Revealed by Slow Variable Modulation in the Fragile Supercooled Liquid
papers.abstract: The super-Arrhenius dynamic slowdown in fragile supercooled liquids remains one of the central unresolved questions in condensed matter physics. In this study, we analyze particle jump dynamics in a prototypical fragile glass-forming liquid, the Kob-Andersen Lennard-Jones (KALJ) model. Using the displacement of jumping particles as the reaction coordinate, we demonstrate the emergence of non-Poissonian dynamics as the temperature decreases. In the mildly supercooled regime, the outer region of the first coordination shell of a jumping particle exhibits a significant distribution shift during the jump motion. By comparing the survival probability with its slow-fluctuation limit using this distribution as a slow variable, we confirm that particles in this region modulate the jump dynamics, enhance the jump rate fluctuations, and thereby induce the dynamic slowdown as supercooling proceeds. As the temperature decreases, this behavior extends to the outer regions of the second coordination shell and beyond, intensifying the dynamic slowdown. This spatial growth of the slow variables responsible for dynamic disorder exhibits close correspondence with an increase in the static correlation length. These results provide a microscopic mechanism for the super-Arrhenius dynamic slowdown in the KALJ model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analyze particle jump dynamics in a prototypical fragile glass-forming liquid, the Kob-Andersen Lennard-Jones (KALJ) model”，属于分子动力学模拟分析。；研究对象：脆性过冷液体中的超Arrhenius动力学减速现象，具体以Kob-Andersen Lennard-Jones (KALJ)模型为研究对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将跳跃粒子的位移作为反应坐标，发现第一配位壳层外区域的粒子分布作为慢变量调制跳跃动力学，增强跳跃速率涨落，从而诱导超Arrhenius动力学减速；随着温度降低，该行为扩展到第二配位壳层及更远区域，且慢变量的空间增长与静态关联长度的增加密切相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将跳跃粒子的位移作为反应坐标，发现第一配位壳层外区域的粒子分布作为慢变量调制跳跃动力学，增强跳跃速率涨落，从而诱导超Arrhenius动力学减速；随着温度降低，该行为扩展到第二配位壳层及更远区域，且慢变量的空间增长与静态关联长度的增加密切相关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子动力学模拟分析KALJ模型中的粒子跳跃动力学，利用跳跃粒子的位移作为反应坐标，通过比较生存概率与其慢涨落极限来确认慢变量的调制作用。

papers.title: Conditions for domain-free negative capacitance
papers.abstract: While negative capacitance has been demonstrated in ferroelectric-dielectric heterostructures in the form of capacitance enhancement, all experimental evidence, to date, suggests the existence of domains therein. Here, we address the question: what are the conditions to achieve ideal, domain-free negative capacitance in ferroelectric-dielectric heterostructures? Our main claim is that for given thicknesses of the ferroelectric and the dielectric layers, there is a critical value of domain wall energy parameter -- above which the system would be stabilized in an ideal and robust domain-free negative capacitance state and would be robust against domain formation. Our analyses suggest that to achieve ideal negative capacitance, efforts should lie in understanding the means to control the domain wall energy on all fronts, both theory and experiments via high throughput design, discovery, and engineering of ferroelectrics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“our main claim”、“our analyses suggest”等理论分析表述，未提及具体实验或计算手段。；研究对象：铁电-介电异质结构中的无畴负电容状态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在铁电-介电异质结构中，存在一个临界畴壁能量参数；当实际畴壁能量高于该临界值时，系统可稳定在理想的无畴负电容状态，且该状态对畴的形成具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在铁电-介电异质结构中，存在一个临界畴壁能量参数；当实际畴壁能量高于该临界值时，系统可稳定在理想的无畴负电容状态，且该状态对畴的形成具有鲁棒性。；创新点：明确指出了实现理想无畴负电容状态的关键条件——畴壁能量必须超过某一临界值，并强调未来应通过高通量设计、发现和工程化铁电材料来调控畴壁能量。摘要未突出说明与已有实验或理论工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于对铁电-介电异质结构中畴壁能量参数与系统稳定性的关系进行推导和论证。摘要未明确说明具体理论框架（如朗道理论、相场模拟等）。

papers.title: Anharmonic Quantum Transport Analysis of Thermal Transport Anomalies in Ultrathin Silicon Nanowires
papers.abstract: Thermal transport in low-dimensional semiconductors is crucial for advancing thermal management in nanoelectronics, quantum devices, and thermoelectric devices. Recent molecular dynamics (MD) studies have identified a nonmonotonic dependence of thermal conductivity (k) on diameter in ultrathin silicon nanowires (NWs). However, classical MD methods are limited at low temperatures and in strongly confined regimes. This work introduces a fully quantum-mechanical perspective on this anomaly by employing anharmonic non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) simulations combined with density-functional-theory-trained neuroevolution potentials. For [001]- and [110]-oriented NWs, k decreases with diameter d to a minimum at d_c = 6.24 nm and 5.50 nm, respectively, then rises with d, for a temperature range of 10-300 K. At room temperature, this behavior arises from dominant momentum-conserving normal scattering relative to Umklapp processes in confined regimes, thereby enabling Poiseuille-like hydrodynamic phonon flow that competes with boundary scattering. At cryogenic temperatures, strong radial confinement quantizes the phonon spectrum, and only low-frequency phonons (< 2 THz) significantly contribute to heat transport through quasi-ballistic propagation of long-wavelength modes, as demonstrated by the spectral thermal conductance. In contrast to classical MD, which is inaccurate at low temperatures due to overexcitation of high-frequency vibrations by Boltzmann statistics, neglect of quantum suppression, and overestimation of thermal conductivity in thinner NWs with stronger quantum confinement, the NEGF framework provides quantitative accuracy even at low temperatures, such as 10 K.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：anharmonic non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) simulations、density-functional-theory-trained neuroevolution potentials。；研究对象：超薄硅纳米线（ultrathin silicon nanowires）中的热输运反常现象，具体研究热导率随直径的非单调依赖关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超薄硅纳米线中，热导率随直径减小先下降至一个最小值（[001]取向约6.24 nm，[110]取向约5.50 nm），随后随直径增大而上升。该反常行为在室温下源于受限体系中动量守恒的正常散射主导，形成类似泊肃叶流的水动力学声子流；在低温下则源于强径向约束对声子谱的量子化，仅低频声子（<2 THz）通过准弹道传播贡献热输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超薄硅纳米线中，热导率随直径减小先下降至一个最小值（[001]取向约6.24 nm，[110]取向约5.50 nm），随后随直径增大而上升。该反常行为在室温下源于受限体系中动量守恒的正常散射主导，形成类似泊肃叶流的水动力学声子流；在低温下则源于强径向约束对声子谱的量子化，仅低频声子（<2 THz）通过准弹道传播贡献热输运。；创新点：首次从全量子力学视角（而非经典分子动力学）揭示了超薄硅纳米线中热导率随直径非单调变化的反常行为，并定量解释了其在低温和强量子受限区域的行为机制，克服了经典MD在低温下因玻尔兹曼统计过激发高频振动、忽略量子抑制而导致的误差。
papers.method_zh: 采用非简谐非平衡格林函数（anharmonic NEGF）模拟，结合基于密度泛函理论训练的神经演化势（neuroevolution potentials）进行全量子力学计算。

papers.title: Modulation of charge density waves in a twisted vortex moire superlattice
papers.abstract: Twisted moire superlattices in van-der-Waals heterostructures provide a powerful platform for engineering correlated states through moire-band reconstruction. However, whether globally coherent electronic orders can be continuously manipulated at the nanoscale remains largely unexplored. Reconstructed moire structures in small-angle and near-commensurate regime feature continuously varying local environments, offering new opportunities for nanoscale manipulation of correlated phases. Here, we report the modulation of charge density wave (CDW) states in a twisted vortex moire superlattice formed between monolayer VTe2 and superconducting NbSe2. Scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy reveals that the intrinsic long-range CDW of monolayer VTe2 is reconstructed into inequivalent local phases with distinct stability and coherence within a single moire unit cell, including suppressed CDW order and enhanced short-range CDW correlations persisting to room temperature. First-principles calculations show that the reconstructed CDW landscape originates from strong local strain variation, where compressive strain substantially stabilizes the charge order. Furthermore, the modulated CDW states exhibit competing interplay with proximity-induced superconductivity. Our results establish vortex moire superlattices as a versatile platform for nanoscale manipulation of correlated electronic orders in low-dimensional quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（判断依据：Scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy，First-principles calculations，实验与计算结合，但以实验发现为主导）。；研究对象：由单层VTe₂与超导NbSe₂形成的扭转涡旋莫尔超晶格中的电荷密度波（CDW）态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在扭转涡旋莫尔超晶格中，单层VTe₂的本征长程CDW被重构为单个莫尔原胞内具有不同稳定性和相干性的局域相，包括被抑制的CDW序和增强的短程CDW关联（可持续至室温）。这种重构源于局域应变的强烈变化，其中压应变显著稳定了电荷序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在扭转涡旋莫尔超晶格中，单层VTe₂的本征长程CDW被重构为单个莫尔原胞内具有不同稳定性和相干性的局域相，包括被抑制的CDW序和增强的短程CDW关联（可持续至室温）。这种重构源于局域应变的强烈变化，其中压应变显著稳定了电荷序。；创新点：首次在实验上展示了通过扭转涡旋莫尔超晶格在纳米尺度上连续调控全局相干的电子有序态（如CDW），并揭示了局域应变作为关键调控机制。摘要未突出说明与之前扭转莫尔体系研究的具体区别，但核心创新在于实现了对CDW序的纳米级局域操控。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜/扫描隧道谱（STM/STS）实验，结合第一性原理计算（First-principles calculations）。

papers.title: Directional Symmetry Breaking of Spherical Active Colloids by Magnetoviscous Coupling
papers.abstract: Harnessing active matter requires strategies that break the directional symmetry of self-propelled motion without altering the propulsion mechanism itself. Here, we show that magnetically inert spherical active colloids can be steered through the anisotropic viscous response of a ferrofluid under a uniform magnetic field. Self-propelled Janus colloids exhibit robust cross-field motion transverse to the magnetic field, although the applied magnetic field directly controls neither the particles nor their propulsion speed. Quantitative measurements reveal an emergent reorientation torque that grows with propulsion speed and magnetic field strength. A squirmer model in a magnetoviscous medium captures these observations and shows that the torque arises from the coupling between swimmer-generated flow and anisotropic rotational viscosity. Our findings establish a hydrodynamic foundation for converting viscous dissipation into directional symmetry breaking through anisotropic rheology, providing a route to field-controlled material transport by active matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中提及“定量测量”（实验）和“squirmer模型”（理论建模）。；研究对象：球形活性胶体在磁流体中的定向运动，具体为自驱动Janus胶体在均匀磁场下的各向异性运动行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁惰性的球形活性胶体可通过磁流体的各向异性粘性响应实现定向对称性破缺，产生垂直于磁场方向的稳健横向运动，且该运动源于游泳者产生的流场与各向异性旋转粘度之间的耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁惰性的球形活性胶体可通过磁流体的各向异性粘性响应实现定向对称性破缺，产生垂直于磁场方向的稳健横向运动，且该运动源于游泳者产生的流场与各向异性旋转粘度之间的耦合。；创新点：首次通过磁流体的各向异性粘性（而非直接磁操控粒子或推进机制）实现活性胶体的定向对称性破缺，建立了将粘性耗散转化为定向运动的流体动力学基础。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用自驱动Janus胶体在铁磁流体中运动，施加均匀磁场并测量粒子运动轨迹与速度；理论上采用squirmer模型描述磁粘性介质中的游泳者，分析流场与各向异性旋转粘度的耦合机制。

papers.title: Structural Alter-Phononics: Sublattice-Momentum Locking in Spinless Lattice Dynamics
papers.abstract: The discovery of altermagnetism has shown that crystal symmetry can generate momentum-dependent internal polarization without net magnetization. Whether an analogous form of symmetry-organized momentum-space order can exist for spinless lattice vibrations remains unresolved. Here we identify a structural mechanism for $alter$-$phononics$, in which phonon eigenmodes formed from structurally equivalent sublattices acquire momentum-dependent sublattice polarization and frequency splitting in nonmagnetic crystals. The central quantity is the sublattice-resolved dynamical asymmetry $Δ(\mathbf q)=D_{AA}(\mathbf q)-D_{BB}(\mathbf q)$, which controls the associated eigenvector polarization. We show that this effect requires an alter-generator that maps equivalent sublattices onto one another while rotating the wave vector, together with the absence of inversion exchange and little-group sublattice-exchange constraints that would otherwise enforce sublattice equipartition. These symmetry rules generate nematic $d$-wave, tetragonal $d/g$-wave, and tripartite six-lobe phonon textures. First-principles calculations demonstrate the mechanism in representative nonmagnetic crystals and show how a symmetry-preserving structural distortion can unlock a hidden $d_{x^2-y^2}$-type texture by removing glide-induced equipartition traps while retaining the screw-axis alter-generator. We further show that the eigenvector texture is inherited by sublattice-projected electron-phonon coupling and anharmonic response functions. Our results establish structural alter-phononics as a spinless counterpart to altermagnetic momentum-space order and provide experimentally testable signatures in finite-$\mathbf q$ phonon spectra and displacement patterns.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有第一性原理计算）。判断依据：关键词“identify a structural mechanism”“symmetry rules”“First-principles calculations”。；研究对象：非磁性晶体中自旋为零的晶格振动（声子）的动量空间有序现象，具体为“结构交替声子学”（structural alter-phononics），即声子本征模式在结构等价子晶格上产生动量依赖的极化与频率分裂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非磁性晶体中，声子本征模式可以像交变磁体中的电子态一样，通过晶体对称性产生动量依赖的子晶格极化与频率分裂，形成d波、d/g波及三叶草型等声子纹理，且该纹理可被子晶格投影的电子-声子耦合与非简谐响应函数继承。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非磁性晶体中，声子本征模式可以像交变磁体中的电子态一样，通过晶体对称性产生动量依赖的子晶格极化与频率分裂，形成d波、d/g波及三叶草型等声子纹理，且该纹理可被子晶格投影的电子-声子耦合与非简谐响应函数继承。；创新点：首次提出并建立了“结构交替声子学”这一概念，作为交变磁动量空间有序的无自旋对应物，揭示了非磁性晶体中声子可产生类似交变磁体的动量依赖子晶格极化，并给出了有限波矢声子谱与位移模式中可实验检验的特征。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析（群论方法，定义“交替生成元”并推导约束规则）；第一性原理计算（具体方法摘要未明确说明，但提及在代表性非磁性晶体中演示机制）；通过保持对称性的结构畸变解除滑移面导致的等分陷阱，解锁隐藏的d_{x^2-y^2}型纹理。

papers.title: Direct Dispersion-Curve Engineering of Phononic Crystal Defect Modes for Prescribed Frequencies via Topology Optimization
papers.abstract: Phononic crystals enable precise manipulation of elastic wave propagation through engineered bandgaps; however, designing defect states within these bandgaps for frequency-selective applications remains a significant challenge. Existing design approaches, including prior optimization formulations, struggle to systematically resolve the competing objectives of attracting desired defect modes to target frequencies while simultaneously repelling unwanted modes from the bandgap region. This inability to suppress competing modes often results in spurious, undesired in-gap resonant modes, thereby limiting design purity. This paper presents a novel two-stage topology optimization framework that addresses this challenge through an innovative multi-objective formulation based on a selection function with Gaussian weighting. In the first stage, the unit cell topology is optimized to create a wide bandgap around a target frequency. In the second stage, a supercell containing a defect is optimized using a specially designed objective function that dynamically balances mode attraction and repulsion via a selection function $S(ω)$ with adaptive $σ$ parameters. This selection mechanism enables the optimizer to automatically identify and selectively attract the most suitable defect mode while repelling competing modes from the bandgap region, eliminating the need for manual mode tracking. Numerical examples demonstrate that the proposed framework successfully generates phononic crystals featuring engineered defect states that yield precisely positioned localized resonant modes at prescribed frequencies within wide bandgaps, with potential applications in frequency-selective filters and elastic wave manipulation devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：topology optimization（拓扑优化）、numerical examples（数值示例）、framework（框架设计）。；研究对象：声子晶体（phononic crystals）中的缺陷态（defect states），具体研究如何通过拓扑优化在声子晶体的带隙内设计特定频率的局域共振模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种两阶段拓扑优化框架，能够自动吸引目标缺陷模式到指定频率，同时排斥非期望的带隙内模式，从而在宽禁带内精确产生预设频率的局域共振模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种两阶段拓扑优化框架，能够自动吸引目标缺陷模式到指定频率，同时排斥非期望的带隙内模式，从而在宽禁带内精确产生预设频率的局域共振模式。；创新点：通过引入带高斯加权的选择函数与自适应参数，实现了对缺陷模式的自动识别与选择性吸引/排斥，解决了以往方法无法系统抑制带隙内非期望竞争模式的问题。
papers.method_zh: 两阶段拓扑优化框架：第一阶段优化单胞拓扑以在目标频率附近形成宽禁带；第二阶段优化含缺陷的超胞，采用基于高斯加权的选择函数 \( S(\omega) \) 与自适应 \( \sigma \) 参数的多目标目标函数，动态平衡模式吸引与排斥，无需手动模式追踪。

papers.title: Surface d-orbital order in intermetallic compound
papers.abstract: Orbital order describes a quantum state where occupied orbitals line up in a periodic pattern. While orbital physics plays a fundamental and universal role in strongly correlated electron systems, the existence and particularly the band structure fingerprint of orbital order remain a long-standing mystery. Here, we report the discovery of rare earth 5d-orbital order developed by the surface states of intermetallic compound Tb2CoAl4Ge2. Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy reveals characteristic nematic features like Fermi surface deformation and band split. These experimental observations can be described by a ferro-orbital order term in the mean-field Hamiltonian. The structural and magnetic origin of such order is excluded by systematic high-resolution neutron powder diffraction and scanning tunnelling microscopy measurements. Our results provide strong evidence for a pure surface orbital order scenario avoiding complications from structural distortion as in colossal magnetoresistance manganites, magnetic order as in iron-based superconductors, and charge transfer p-orbital order in cuprates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy（ARPES）、neutron powder diffraction、scanning tunnelling microscopy。；研究对象：金属间化合物Tb₂CoAl₄Ge₂的表面态中稀土5d轨道序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Tb₂CoAl₄Ge₂表面态中发现了纯轨道序（5d轨道序），表现为费米面变形和能带劈裂等向列相特征，且该轨道序并非由结构畸变或磁有序引起。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Tb₂CoAl₄Ge₂表面态中发现了纯轨道序（5d轨道序），表现为费米面变形和能带劈裂等向列相特征，且该轨道序并非由结构畸变或磁有序引起。；创新点：首次在金属间化合物表面态中实现纯轨道序，避免了庞磁电阻锰氧化物中的结构畸变、铁基超导体中的磁有序以及铜氧化物中的电荷转移p轨道序等复杂因素的干扰。
papers.method_zh: 角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）观测向列相特征；高分辨中子粉末衍射和扫描隧道显微镜（STM）排除结构相变和磁有序起源；平均场哈密顿量中的铁轨轨道序项描述实验现象。

papers.title: Ground state correlations in the one-dimensional Fermi one-component plasma
papers.abstract: Structural and dynamic correlations in the ground state of the one-dimensional Fermi one-component plasma are studied by Quantum Monte Carlo simulations. Results are presented for the pair correlation function, static structure factor, the one-particle density matrix and the momentum distribution, for the cases of full, partial and no polarization. Evidence is reported of density correlations slowly decaying with distance, with the concurrent emergence of quasi-crystalline order even in the weakly correlated regime. Effects of quantum statistics in the momentum distribution are discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Quantum Monte Carlo simulations）；研究对象：一维费米子单组分等离子体（Fermi one-component plasma）的基态关联性质，包括完全极化、部分极化和无极化三种情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使在弱关联区域，密度关联也随距离缓慢衰减，并同时出现准晶序；量子统计效应对动量分布有显著影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使在弱关联区域，密度关联也随距离缓慢衰减，并同时出现准晶序；量子统计效应对动量分布有显著影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 量子蒙特卡洛（Quantum Monte Carlo, QMC）模拟。

papers.title: Multi-Scale Coherence of Represented Flows
papers.abstract: Many problems in nonlinear and statistical physics are formulated through represented flows, including physical-space vector fields, phase-space drift fields, and truncated renormalization-group beta functions. We introduce a complementary representation-dependent diagnostic for testing whether finite-separation flow geometry is stable across observational resolution. For two separated points, states, or theories, the method compares the direction of the corresponding vector-field increment after the field has been smoothed at two resolutions. Averaging this normalized comparison over sampled separations gives a coherence matrix tied to the chosen variables, coarse graining, metric, and sampling protocol; it is a consistency test, not a coordinate-invariant quantity. We demonstrate the diagnostic in three settings. Synthetic divergence-free fields with identical Fourier amplitudes, spectra, and scalar two-point correlations nevertheless produce distinct coherence matrices, showing that second-order statistics do not determine cross-resolution increment geometry. Lorenz phase-space tests show that a smooth coordinate wrinkling changes represented drift geometry without changing the underlying dynamics, and that a weak model perturbation lowers finite-separation coherence even when local stretching proxies remain closely matched. Finally, for functional renormalization-group flows of the three-dimensional \(O(1)\) scalar theory, projected \(M=4,5,6\) LPA beta fields remain internally coherent, while cross-truncation coherence decreases as higher-order coupling directions are activated. The diagnostic provides a practical field-level check of how representations, models, and truncations preserve finite-separation flow geometry, complementing rather than replacing standard local, spectral, or fixed-point diagnostics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：introduce a complementary representation-dependent diagnostic、consistency test、demonstrate the diagnostic in three settings。；研究对象：论文研究的是“表示流”（represented flows）的几何结构，包括物理空间矢量场、相空间漂移场以及截断重正化群β函数。具体测试对象包括合成无散场、Lorenz相空间流以及三维O(1)标量理论的功能重正化群流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种新的诊断工具——相干矩阵（coherence matrix），用于检验有限分离流几何结构在不同观测分辨率下是否稳定。发现二阶统计量（如傅里叶振幅、谱、两点关联）无法决定跨分辨率的增量几何结构；在重正化群流中，不同截断阶数之间的相干性会随着高阶耦合方向被激活而降低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种新的诊断工具——相干矩阵（coherence matrix），用于检验有限分离流几何结构在不同观测分辨率下是否稳定。发现二阶统计量（如傅里叶振幅、谱、两点关联）无法决定跨分辨率的增量几何结构；在重正化群流中，不同截断阶数之间的相干性会随着高阶耦合方向被激活而降低。；创新点：摘要未突出说明该工作相对于已有研究的具体新意，但明确指出该方法是一种“互补性”诊断，而非替代标准局域、谱或不动点诊断。其创新在于提供了一个依赖于表示（representation-dependent）的场级一致性检验，能够揭示标准二阶统计量无法捕捉的跨分辨率几何结构差异。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一种基于方向比较的诊断方法：对两个分离的点（或状态、理论），在两种不同平滑分辨率下比较矢量场增量的方向，并通过采样平均得到相干矩阵。该方法在三个场景中演示：1）合成无散场；2）Lorenz系统相空间；3）三维O(1)标量理论的功能重正化群LPA截断（M=4,5,6）。

papers.title: Locally resolved electronic textures of reconstruction domains in marginally twisted monolayer-bilayer graphene
papers.abstract: Controlling the stacking and rotational registry of graphene layers provides a powerful handle on atomic-scale structural reconstructions that alter the electronic landscape at the nanoscale. In particular, this governs how massless and massive Dirac fermions coexist and interact at the monolayer-bilayer graphene interface. In the limit of marginal twist, the system reconstructs into domains of distinct vertical stacking order, introducing characteristic electronic properties and new electronic length scales, a regime that, despite its structural richness, remains largely unexplored. Here, using scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy, we demonstrate that at very low rotation angles the monolayer-bilayer graphene system relaxes into a network of three distinct stacking domains with individual electronic textures revealed through spatially resolved spectroscopic mapping and corroborated by computed local density of states. We report switching of the hierarchy of the tunnelling characteristics between Bernal and rhombohedral domains as a function of bias voltage. Furthermore, the measured spectroscopic maps exhibit theoretically anticipated domain wall 'twirling' around energetically unfavorable AAB stacking nodes, promoted by out-of-plane deformations. Our results shed light on fundamental structure-property relationships underpinning moiré-driven phenomena, opening new avenues for harnessing structural degrees of freedom in van der Waals heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy”（扫描隧道显微镜和光谱学）作为主要研究手段，并提及“spatially resolved spectroscopic mapping”（空间分辨光谱映射）和“computed local density of states”（计算的局域态密度）作为辅助验证。；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系是“marginally twisted monolayer-bilayer graphene”（边缘扭转的单层-双层石墨烯异质结），即单层石墨烯与双层石墨烯之间以极小扭转角堆叠形成的范德华异质结构，重点关注其重构域中的局域电子织构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在极低扭转角下，单层-双层石墨烯系统弛豫为三种不同堆叠序的畴网络，每种畴具有独特的电子织构；并且观测到伯纳尔堆叠与菱方堆叠畴的隧穿特性层级随偏压翻转，以及畴壁围绕能量不利的AAB堆叠节点发生“twirling”（扭转）现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在极低扭转角下，单层-双层石墨烯系统弛豫为三种不同堆叠序的畴网络，每种畴具有独特的电子织构；并且观测到伯纳尔堆叠与菱方堆叠畴的隧穿特性层级随偏压翻转，以及畴壁围绕能量不利的AAB堆叠节点发生“twirling”（扭转）现象。；创新点：首次在实验上以纳米级空间分辨率揭示了边缘扭转单层-双层石墨烯中三种不同堆叠畴的电子织构，并直接观测到畴壁的“twirling”行为以及堆叠畴间隧穿特性随偏压的层级翻转，这些结果阐明了莫尔驱动现象中结构-性能关系的基本原理。
papers.method_zh: 主要实验手段为扫描隧道显微镜（STM）和扫描隧道谱（STS），结合空间分辨的谱学映射；理论验证采用局域态密度（LDOS）计算。

papers.title: Finite Temperature Stacking Fault Stability in Random and Locally Ordered CoCrNi beyond the Harmonic Approximation
papers.abstract: Previous density functional theory (DFT) calculations for random solid solution (RSS) CoCrNi predict negative intrinsic stacking-fault energy (ISFE) at 0 K, contrary to experimental observations of finite stacking-fault widths. Two explanations have been proposed: finite-temperature stabilization of the RSS state, suggested by harmonic approximations showing increasing ISFE with temperature, and local chemical order (LCO), which shifts the ISFE to positive values at 0 K. Here, we compute temperature-dependent generalized stacking-fault free energies for RSS and LCO CoCrNi using a near-quantum-accuracy machine learning interatomic potential and the fully anharmonic projected average force integrator. Unlike harmonic approximations, our anharmonic calculations show that the RSS ISFE decreases with temperature and remains negative, indicating that RSS stacking faults are not thermally stabilized at elevated temperatures. By contrast, LCO maintains positive ISFE over 0-1000 K. Molecular dynamics simulations further confirm unbounded dislocation dissociation in RSS CoCrNi but finite stacking-fault widths in the LCO state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“density functional theory (DFT) calculations”、“machine learning interatomic potential”、“anharmonic projected average force integrator”、“Molecular dynamics simulations”。；研究对象：随机固溶体（RSS）和局部化学有序（LCO）状态下的CoCrNi合金，具体研究其层错稳定性随温度的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在完全非谐计算下，随机固溶体CoCrNi的层错能随温度升高而降低且始终为负，表明其层错无法通过热效应稳定；而局部化学有序状态在0-1000 K范围内保持正层错能，从而解释了实验中观察到的有限层错宽度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在完全非谐计算下，随机固溶体CoCrNi的层错能随温度升高而降低且始终为负，表明其层错无法通过热效应稳定；而局部化学有序状态在0-1000 K范围内保持正层错能，从而解释了实验中观察到的有限层错宽度。；创新点：超越了以往仅基于谐波近似的有限温度计算，首次采用完全非谐方法揭示了随机固溶体CoCrNi层错能随温度下降而非上升的行为，澄清了谐波近似与实验之间的矛盾。
papers.method_zh: 使用近量子精度的机器学习原子间势，结合完全非谐的投影平均力积分器（projected average force integrator）计算温度依赖的广义层错自由能；同时采用分子动力学模拟验证位错解离行为。

papers.title: Phase behavior of solvent-nematogen mixtures
papers.abstract: Liquid mixtures with a nematogen can undergo both fluid phase separation and a transition from an isotropic to a nematic state. These phase transitions can couple and lead to phase behavior distinct from simple liquid mixtures or pure liquid crystals. We measured the phase behavior of mixtures of a nematogen (5CB) with simple liquid solvents (squalane and/or squalene). We observed two distinct kinds of binary phase diagrams: with and without a region of isotropic-isotropic coexistence. Varying the ratio of squalene to squalane, we continuously tuned the phase boundaries of the apparent binary system and revealed a region of three-phase coexistence. A mean-field model combining classical models of liquid mixing and nematic ordering quantitatively describes both binary and ternary phase behavior. This simple model predicts a range of topologically complex ternary phase diagrams and extends naturally to systems with more components.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。关键词：measured（实验测量）、mean-field model（平均场模型）、quantitatively describes（定量描述）。；研究对象：溶剂-向列相液晶混合物的相行为。具体体系为向列相液晶5CB与简单液体溶剂（角鲨烷和/或角鲨烯）的二元及三元混合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 观测到两种不同类型的二元相图：存在或不存在各向同性-各向同性共存区。通过改变角鲨烯与角鲨烷的比例，可连续调控相边界，并揭示出三相共存区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：观测到两种不同类型的二元相图：存在或不存在各向同性-各向同性共存区。通过改变角鲨烯与角鲨烷的比例，可连续调控相边界，并揭示出三相共存区。；创新点：通过连续调控溶剂组成（角鲨烯/角鲨烷比例），实现了对二元体系相边界的连续调谐，并揭示了三相共存区；该平均场模型可预测拓扑复杂的三元相图，并能自然推广至多组分体系。
papers.method_zh: 实验上测量了5CB与角鲨烷/角鲨烯混合物的相行为；理论上采用结合经典液体混合模型与向列相有序模型的平均场理论，定量描述了二元和三元相行为。

papers.title: Cylindrical Trap Dependence in the Unitary Fermi Gas
papers.abstract: The unitary Fermi gas serves as a tunable realization of a strongly coupled CFT, making it a powerful system for probing universal quantum many-body phenomena. Precise measurement of its properties remains experimentally challenging: finite-temperature effects and spatial inhomogeneity introduced by external trapping potentials can significantly distort observables. Cylindrical trap geometries are commonly used in experiments. This note extends an existing theoretical framework to this geometry, deriving how the cylindrical confinement modifies the dynamic structure factor at zero temperature. These results provide a necessary correction for the interpretation of experimental spectra in trapped unitary gases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：extends an existing theoretical framework、deriving、modifies。；研究对象：圆柱形阱中的幺正费米气体（unitary Fermi gas），具体研究其动态结构因子（dynamic structure factor）在零温下受圆柱形囚禁势影响的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 圆柱形囚禁势会修正幺正费米气体的动态结构因子，该修正对于正确解释囚禁幺正气体实验谱是必要的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：圆柱形囚禁势会修正幺正费米气体的动态结构因子，该修正对于正确解释囚禁幺正气体实验谱是必要的。；创新点：将现有理论框架从其他几何结构推广到实验常用的圆柱形阱，并给出了该几何下动态结构因子的修正结果。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。在已有理论框架基础上，将其扩展到圆柱形阱几何结构，推导出零温下圆柱形囚禁对动态结构因子的具体修正形式。

papers.title: Resilience of the physicochemical properties of graphene-based materials for applications in harsh radiation environments
papers.abstract: The development of radiation-tolerant materials capable of maintaining structural, electrical, and thermal stability in extreme, radiation-rich environments remains a critical challenge in materials science. In this work, the effects of 60 MeV 35Cl ion irradiation on highly oriented pyrolytic graphite (HOPG) and multilayer reduced graphene oxide (ML-rGO) were investigated. The samples were exposed to fluences of 5.11 x 10^9 and 1.3 x 10^10 ions/cm^2 and characterized by X-ray diffraction (XRD), Raman spectroscopy, scanning electron microscopy (SEM), atomic force microscopy (AFM), and electrical transport measurements. The results show that the irradiation response is strongly influenced by the initial structural organization of the material. In HOPG, ion exposure leads to a progressive loss of crystalline order, evidenced by XRD peak broadening and an increase in the Raman ID/IG ratio, accompanied by a reduction in electrical transport performance. In contrast, ML-rGO exhibits distinct behavior at higher fluences, suggesting partial structural reorganization. The appearance of more defined graphitic features in XRD and Raman analyses, along with changes in surface morphology and electrical response, suggests the formation of more ordered sp2 domains. These findings indicate that irradiation effects vary with the initial degree of order, providing useful insights for selecting carbon-based materials for devices operating under severe radiation conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：ion irradiation、characterized by XRD、Raman spectroscopy、SEM、AFM、electrical transport measurements。；研究对象：高定向热解石墨（HOPG）和多层还原氧化石墨烯（ML-rGO）两种碳基材料在强辐射环境下的物理化学性质变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 材料对辐照的响应强烈依赖于其初始结构有序度：HOPG在辐照后晶格有序度持续下降，电输运性能降低；而ML-rGO在较高辐照通量下反而出现部分结构重组，形成更有序的sp²碳域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：材料对辐照的响应强烈依赖于其初始结构有序度：HOPG在辐照后晶格有序度持续下降，电输运性能降低；而ML-rGO在较高辐照通量下反而出现部分结构重组，形成更有序的sp²碳域。；创新点：揭示了初始结构有序度不同的碳基材料（高度有序的HOPG与缺陷较多的ML-rGO）在相同高能离子辐照下表现出截然相反的演化趋势，为在极端辐射环境中选择碳基材料提供了依据。
papers.method_zh: 使用60 MeV ³⁵Cl离子束对样品进行辐照（通量为5.11×10⁹和1.3×10¹⁰ ions/cm²），并通过X射线衍射（XRD）、拉曼光谱、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、原子力显微镜（AFM）以及电输运测量进行表征。

papers.title: Extended Bose-Hubbard Model on Small Grids: Exact Diagonalization and Monte Carlo Studies
papers.abstract: The superfluid-insulator transition in systems of lattice bosons is usually analyzed in the framework of the Bose-Hubbard model, and has been extensively studied by theory and simulations. Less attention has been paid to the remnants of the transition in truncated lattices, with or without periodic boundary conditions. Here we consider the hard-core limit of the extended Bose-Hubbard model on small square and triangular grids -- i.e., sections of the square and triangular lattices containing up to 13 sites. By mapping out the zero-temperature phase diagram through exact diagonalization, we find ground-state characteristics that are markedly different from those emerging in the thermodynamic limit, together with similarities. The dichotomy between superfluid-like and insulating-like behavior is then investigated in two-dimensional systems of a few interacting bosons in the continuum, subject to confining and optical-lattice potentials mimicking the $3\times 3$ square grid. Using path-integral Monte Carlo simulations, we compute kinetic and potential energies, as well as superfluidity and exchange-cycle statistics, finding hints of Bose-Hubbard behavior even in systems of just five particles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：exact diagonalization、path-integral Monte Carlo simulations）；研究对象：小尺寸方格和三角格点上的扩展Bose-Hubbard模型（硬核极限），以及连续空间中受约束和光晶格势阱作用的少数相互作用玻色子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在小尺寸格点（最多13个位点）上，零温相图与热力学极限下的行为存在显著差异，但同时也保留了一些相似性；即使在仅含5个粒子的极小体系中，仍能观察到Bose-Hubbard行为的迹象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在小尺寸格点（最多13个位点）上，零温相图与热力学极限下的行为存在显著差异，但同时也保留了一些相似性；即使在仅含5个粒子的极小体系中，仍能观察到Bose-Hubbard行为的迹象。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 精确对角化（exact diagonalization）计算零温相图；路径积分蒙特卡洛（path-integral Monte Carlo）模拟计算动能、势能、超流性及交换环统计。

papers.title: Nematic Phase Transitions in Multilayer Graphene Systems
papers.abstract: Recent experiments on graphene multilayers under displacement field have demonstrated a wide variety of electronically ordered phases, including valley and/or spin polarized phases as well as potentially unconventional superconducting phases. In addition, quantum oscillation measurements in Bernal bilayer graphene and rhombohedral trilayer graphene showed the presence of electronic nematic states. Here, we investigate the emergence of nematic order in these systems, with emphasis on Bernal bilayer graphene, within a self-consistent Hartree--Fock framework, using a realistic band structure with trigonal warping and a dual-gate screened Coulomb interaction. We compute the phase diagram as carrier density and displacement field are varied, and find a sequence of isospin (spin and valley) polarized states consistent with experiment, including partially polarized phases with a large Fermi pockets for isospin-majority carriers and smaller Fermi pockets for isospin-minority carriers. Within these partially isospin polarized states, we identify regions with three $C_3$-symmetric pockets for the minority carriers and regions with only one or two such pockets, implying that the system develops a spontaneous nematic order that breaks $C_3$ symmetry. We find numerically that nematicity emerges near the boundary between fully and partially polarized phases and is controlled by the strength of the screened interaction. We analytically derive a criterion for the nematic order, which agrees with our numerical results.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“self-consistent Hartree--Fock framework”、“compute the phase diagram”、“numerically find”、“analytically derive”。；研究对象：多层石墨烯体系（特别是Bernal双层石墨烯）中的电子向列相（nematic phase）及其相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在部分同位旋极化态中，少数载流子的费米口袋会自发从三个C3对称口袋变为一个或两个口袋，从而打破C3对称性，形成向列相；该向列相出现在完全极化与部分极化相的边界附近，并受屏蔽相互作用强度调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在部分同位旋极化态中，少数载流子的费米口袋会自发从三个C3对称口袋变为一个或两个口袋，从而打破C3对称性，形成向列相；该向列相出现在完全极化与部分极化相的边界附近，并受屏蔽相互作用强度调控。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽Hartree-Fock框架，结合包含三角翘曲的真实能带结构以及双栅极屏蔽库仑相互作用，计算了随载流子密度和位移场变化的相图。

papers.title: Taming non-equilibrium thermal fluctuations in subthreshold CMOS circuits
papers.abstract: As CMOS technology scales down, thermal fluctuations increasingly impact circuit behavior, posing challenges to conventional circuit design. However, the inherent stochasticity introduced by thermal noise is now being explored as a potential resource in the emerging field of probabilistic computing. This work presents a fully CMOS experimental platform that enables direct control over its intrinsic thermal fluctuations. These devices function as programmable multivariate Gaussian samplers, offering a hardware primitive for energy-efficient stochastic computing and serving as an experimental platform for studies in electronic noise and stochastic thermodynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“experimental platform”、“devices function as”、“fully CMOS”。；研究对象：亚阈值CMOS电路中的非平衡热涨落，以及其在概率计算中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作构建了一个全CMOS实验平台，能够直接控制电路固有的热涨落，使器件作为可编程的多变量高斯采样器，为节能随机计算提供了硬件原语。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作构建了一个全CMOS实验平台，能够直接控制电路固有的热涨落，使器件作为可编程的多变量高斯采样器，为节能随机计算提供了硬件原语。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用全CMOS工艺构建实验平台，通过电路设计实现对内部热涨落的直接调控，并测量其作为多变量高斯采样器的功能特性。

papers.title: GPU-accelerated finite-temperature Lanczos method for spin Hamiltonians
papers.abstract: We present a GPU implementation of the finite-temperature Lanczos method (FTLM) for Heisenberg spin Hamiltonians that targets workstation hardware rather than distributed-memory clusters. The Hamiltonian action is evaluated matrix-free in a row-wise gather formulation. We introduce and compare two state-to-index strategies: a compressed lookup table (CLT), which reduces lookup memory by a factor of 16 relative to a full table while retaining a fixed, branch-light access pattern, and a GPU-adapted combinatorial-ranking scheme that removes the lookup table altogether. Numerical tests against FP64 CPU references show that FP32 GPU arithmetic changes heat capacities and magnetic susceptibilities by amounts several orders of magnitude below the stochastic uncertainty of the FTLM trace estimator at typical sample sizes. Benchmarks show speedups of up to about one order of magnitude over optimized multicore CPU calculations and enable Hilbert-space sectors of dimension ~10^8 on a single workstation GPU. The MATLAB/CUDA implementation, including example input files and benchmark scripts, is openly available at https://github.com/ghasdeke/ftlm-gpu (archived at DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20378647) under the Apache-2.0 license.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：GPU implementation, finite-temperature Lanczos method, numerical tests, benchmarks。；研究对象：Heisenberg自旋哈密顿量（Heisenberg spin Hamiltonians）的有限温度性质，具体为热容和磁化率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在典型样本量下，FP32 GPU算术运算引起的热容和磁化率误差比FTLM迹估计器的随机不确定性低数个数量级；在单工作站GPU上可实现约10^8维希尔伯特空间扇区的计算，速度比优化多核CPU计算快约一个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在典型样本量下，FP32 GPU算术运算引起的热容和磁化率误差比FTLM迹估计器的随机不确定性低数个数量级；在单工作站GPU上可实现约10^8维希尔伯特空间扇区的计算，速度比优化多核CPU计算快约一个数量级。；创新点：针对工作站硬件（而非分布式内存集群）设计了GPU加速的FTLM实现；提出了两种减少内存访问和分支开销的状态索引策略，其中CLT将查找内存减少至全表的1/16，组合排序方案则完全消除了查找表。
papers.method_zh: 有限温度Lanczos方法（FTLM）的GPU实现。采用无矩阵（matrix-free）的行式收集（row-wise gather）公式计算哈密顿量作用；引入并比较两种状态到索引（state-to-index）策略：压缩查找表（CLT）和GPU适配的组合排序方案（combinatorial-ranking scheme）。

papers.title: Diamond compound refractive lenses for high energy Dark Field X-ray Microscopy
papers.abstract: Compound-refractive lenses (CRL) are a type of x-ray optics that find widespread applications as focusing and imaging lenses. The choice of material is one of the most defining properties of these lenses. In this work, we present a CRL made out of diamond. It provides an advantageous balance between refractivity and absorption, along with good manufacturability. Compared to Be CRLs, it features a higher optical density and thus enables application at higher photon energies without relying on large lens stacks or very small radii of curvature, which are challenging to manufacture. A diamond CRL is characterized for use as an objective for Dark-field X-ray Microscopy (DFXM) at the ID03 beamline of the European Synchrotron Radiation Facility (ESRF) and compared to Al and Be CRLs at 17 keV, 33 keV and 37 keV. Increasing the photon energy in DFXM from 17 keV to 37 keV opens up the possibility to investigate new sample systems, that were previously opaque to low energy x-ray radiation. The capability of the diamond CRL at 33 keV is illustrated through DFXM measurements on two 0.5 mm-thick iron-based samples, which cannot be probed at 17 keV.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了实际制造（present a CRL made out of diamond）、表征（characterized for use as an objective）和测量（DFXM measurements on two 0.5 mm-thick iron-based samples）过程。；研究对象：金刚石（diamond）制成的复合折射透镜（CRL），及其在高能暗场X射线显微镜（Dark Field X-ray Microscopy, DFXM）中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 金刚石CRL在折射率与吸收之间提供了有利的平衡，且具有良好的可制造性；将其用于DFXM可将光子能量从17 keV提升至37 keV，从而能够探测之前对低能X射线不透明的厚样品（如0.5 mm厚的铁基样品）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：金刚石CRL在折射率与吸收之间提供了有利的平衡，且具有良好的可制造性；将其用于DFXM可将光子能量从17 keV提升至37 keV，从而能够探测之前对低能X射线不透明的厚样品（如0.5 mm厚的铁基样品）。；创新点：首次展示了金刚石制成的复合折射透镜，并证明其在高能DFXM中能够替代传统铍或铝透镜，使探测更高光子能量成为可能，从而拓展了可研究的样品体系（如厚铁基样品）。
papers.method_zh: 实验上制造了金刚石CRL，并在欧洲同步辐射装置（ESRF）ID03光束线上将其作为DFXM物镜进行表征，同时与铝（Al）和铍（Be）CRL在17 keV、33 keV和37 keV能量下进行了对比。

papers.title: Slave-boson Formalism for Superconducting Pairing at Strong Coupling
papers.abstract: We study the emergence of superconductivity in the one-band Hubbard model using the spin-rotation-invariant Kotliar-Ruckenstein slave-boson (SB) approach. Motivated by its intrinsically renormalized mean-field ground state, we construct an effective pairing vertex from dynamical fluctuations about the saddle point. Solving the anisotropic, frequency-dependent gap equation on the square lattice, we map the pairing instabilities across doping, interaction, temperature and real-frequency gap structure that qualitatively match experimental cuprate observations.
