This framework merges strong-correlation SB-type renormalizations with RPA-type pairing transparency, providing a scalable route to modeling multi-orbital superconductivity at strong coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：slave-boson approach、mean-field、gap equation、RPA-type。；研究对象：单带Hubbard模型中的超导配对现象，特别关注强耦合区域，并与铜氧化物超导体实验观测进行对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过自旋旋转不变的Kotliar-Ruckenstein slave-boson方法，从鞍点附近的动力学涨落构造有效配对顶点，求解各向异性、频率依赖的能隙方程，得到的配对不稳定性随掺杂、相互作用、温度和实频能隙结构的变化与铜氧化物实验定性一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过自旋旋转不变的Kotliar-Ruckenstein slave-boson方法，从鞍点附近的动力学涨落构造有效配对顶点，求解各向异性、频率依赖的能隙方程，得到的配对不稳定性随掺杂、相互作用、温度和实频能隙结构的变化与铜氧化物实验定性一致。；创新点：将强关联的slave-boson型重整化与RPA型配对透明性融合，为建模强耦合下的多轨道超导提供了一条可扩展的路径。
papers.method_zh: 自旋旋转不变的Kotliar-Ruckenstein slave-boson（SB）方法，结合鞍点附近的动力学涨落构造有效配对顶点，并在正方晶格上求解各向异性、频率依赖的能隙方程。

papers.title: Competition between pair and single-particle superfluidity in bosonic quasi-flat bands: A Gaussian state approach
papers.abstract: The interplay between interactions and quantum geometry can drive weakly dispersive bosons into different exotic many-body phases. In this work we study a quasi flat-band model in one dimension that exhibits an extended pair-superfluid phase in the all-flat-band limit. Introducing single-particle hopping leads to an intriguing competition with a more conventional single-particle superfluid: we find that the pair superfluid remains stable for a finite range of the hopping strength until the system eventually transitions into the conventional superfluid phase. In our study, we make use of a variational Gaussian state approach that provides a unified description of the single-particle and pair superfluid phases, regarding both the ground state wavefunction and the collective excitation spectrum. In particular, we derive a general relation between the speed of sound and a ``quantum geometric kernel'', thereby extending earlier connections to the quantum metric, which relied on single-particle mean-field theory. This approach is combined with insights from the two-boson problem and exact diagonalization to map out the full phase diagram of the model. Our results show that the Gaussian approach is a versatile tool for studying a broad range of superfluid phases of interacting bosons in multi-orbital lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“Gaussian state approach”（高斯态方法）、“variational”（变分）、“exact diagonalization”（精确对角化）等理论计算与分析方法。；研究对象：一维准平带模型中的玻色子超流相。具体研究在准平带极限下，由相互作用与量子几何竞争所导致的配对超流相与单粒子超流相之间的竞争与相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在全平带极限下，系统存在一个扩展的配对超流相。引入单粒子跃迁后，配对超流相在有限跃迁强度范围内保持稳定，最终系统转变为常规的单粒子超流相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在全平带极限下，系统存在一个扩展的配对超流相。引入单粒子跃迁后，配对超流相在有限跃迁强度范围内保持稳定，最终系统转变为常规的单粒子超流相。；创新点：推导出声速与“量子几何核”之间的普适关系，将此前仅基于单粒子平均场理论建立的声速与量子度量的联系推广到了更一般的框架。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用变分高斯态方法，统一描述单粒子超流相和配对超流相的基态波函数与集体激发谱。同时结合双玻色子问题分析与精确对角化方法，绘制出完整的相图。

papers.title: Hydrodynamic Cooperons in Electron Fluids: Schwinger--Keldysh Derivation and Quantum Corrections to Magnetoresistance
papers.abstract: We develop a Schwinger--Keldysh effective theory for quantum-interference corrections in a two-dimensional electron system in the hydrodynamic regime. Starting from the clean hydrodynamic fixed point, we introduce a minimal random-friction disorder model that generates a finite momentum-relaxation time within the self-consistent Born approximation. The disorder-averaged theory then allows us to construct a hydrodynamic Cooperon and to compute the associated self-energy corrections to the collective modes. Conservation laws protect the density and momentum sectors, so that the leading quantum-coherence correction is forced into the spin-two stress sector. The associated stress self-energy renormalizes the shear viscosity and modifies both the Gurzhi response and its low-field magnetohydrodynamic signatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Schwinger–Keldysh effective theory”“self-consistent Born approximation”等理论框架，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：二维电子系统在流体动力学（hydrodynamic）区域中的量子干涉修正，特别是磁电阻的量子修正。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在流体动力学二维电子系统中，守恒律保护了密度和动量扇区，因此主导的量子相干修正被迫进入自旋-2应力扇区，该修正会重整化剪切黏度，并改变Gurzhi响应及其低场磁流体动力学特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在流体动力学二维电子系统中，守恒律保护了密度和动量扇区，因此主导的量子相干修正被迫进入自旋-2应力扇区，该修正会重整化剪切黏度，并改变Gurzhi响应及其低场磁流体动力学特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Schwinger–Keldysh有效场论，从清洁流体动力学不动点出发，引入最小随机摩擦无序模型，在自洽Born近似下生成有限动量弛豫时间，进而构建流体动力学Cooperon并计算集体模的自能修正。

papers.title: Quantum Interference Corrections in Electron Hydrodynamics
papers.abstract: We show that quantum-interference corrections in an electron fluid are tightly constrained by hydrodynamic Ward identities: charge and momentum conservation protect the $m=0,\pm1$ sectors, so the leading correction first appears in the spin-two $m=\pm2$ stress sector. The resulting hydrodynamic Cooperon has a robust infrared structure that renormalizes stress relaxation, and hence the viscosity. In channel flow this lowers the viscous resistivity, producing a hydrodynamic interference signature with the opposite sign to ordinary weak localization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、hydrodynamic Ward identities、resulting hydrodynamic Cooperon、renormalizes。；研究对象：电子流体中的量子干涉修正，具体涉及电子流体动力学中的弱局域化效应及其与粘度的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子流体中的量子干涉修正受到流体动力学Ward恒等式的严格约束，导致领先修正出现在自旋二（m=±2）应力扇区，并通过重整化应力弛豫（即粘度）产生与普通弱局域化符号相反的流体动力学干涉特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子流体中的量子干涉修正受到流体动力学Ward恒等式的严格约束，导致领先修正出现在自旋二（m=±2）应力扇区，并通过重整化应力弛豫（即粘度）产生与普通弱局域化符号相反的流体动力学干涉特征。；创新点：揭示了电子流体中量子干涉修正与普通固体中弱局域化的关键差异：由于守恒律的保护，领先修正出现在应力扇区而非电荷扇区，且产生的干涉信号符号相反。
papers.method_zh: 基于流体动力学Ward恒等式（电荷和动量守恒）的理论分析，推导了流体动力学Cooperon的红外结构，并计算其对应力弛豫和粘度的重整化效应。

papers.title: Conserving relaxation-time approximation for electron-electron collisions
papers.abstract: We develop a conserving relaxation-time approximation (cRTA), which explicitly enforces conservation of particle number, energy, and momentum and employs an energy-resolved projection onto the full space of collision invariants. This makes the cRTA applicable to transport quantities sensitive to the energy dependence of the nonequilibrium quasiparticle distribution near the Fermi surface. We benchmark the cRTA against several exact and asymptotically exact results. In particular, it reproduces the low- and high-temperature limits of the dc conductivity of a non-Galilean-invariant Fermi liquid (FL) with disorder, the hydrodynamic and collisionless limits of the finite wavevector longitudinal conductivity of a clean Galilean-invariant FL, and the asymptotic scaling forms of the optical conductivity of a clean non-Galilean-invariant FL beyond the semiclassical limit. For several observables, the agreement with exact solutions is quantitative at the percent level. These results demonstrate that the cRTA provides a simple and accurate framework for transport beyond the Fermi surface projection approximation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop（发展）、conserving relaxation-time approximation（守恒弛豫时间近似）、benchmark（基准测试）。；研究对象：电子-电子碰撞下的输运现象，具体包括非伽利略不变费米液体（non-Galilean-invariant Fermi liquid）的直流电导率、伽利略不变费米液体的有限波矢纵向电导率，以及非伽利略不变费米液体的光学电导率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发展了一种守恒弛豫时间近似（cRTA），该近似明确守恒粒子数、能量和动量，并通过对碰撞不变量的全空间进行能量分辨投影，使得cRTA能够适用于对费米面附近非平衡准粒子分布能量依赖性敏感的输运量。与精确解或渐近精确解的对比表明，cRTA在多个可观测量的计算中达到了百分之几的定量精度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发展了一种守恒弛豫时间近似（cRTA），该近似明确守恒粒子数、能量和动量，并通过对碰撞不变量的全空间进行能量分辨投影，使得cRTA能够适用于对费米面附近非平衡准粒子分布能量依赖性敏感的输运量。与精确解或渐近精确解的对比表明，cRTA在多个可观测量的计算中达到了百分之几的定量精度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于弛豫时间近似的改进，引入能量分辨投影到碰撞不变量全空间，构建守恒弛豫时间近似（cRTA）。通过与精确解和渐近精确解（如直流电导率的低温和高温极限、流体动力学和碰撞极限、光学电导率的渐近标度形式）进行基准测试来验证其准确性。

papers.title: AutoDFT: A Closed-Loop Multi-Agent Framework for Autonomous DFT Calculations
papers.abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) serves as the basis for computational discovery in materials science and chemistry, yet each calculation demands extensive human effort: adjusting algorithms when convergence stalls, revising plans when unexpected physics emerges, and inserting steps as intermediate results reshape the problem. Existing LLM-based agents automate only the initial planning stage, producing a full execution plan upfront and leaving all subsequent adaptation to hand-crafted rules. As a result, these workflows remain fragile, do not generalize well beyond pre-planned scenarios, and often require expert intervention when failures or unexpected intermediate results require changes to the calculation path. Here, we introduce AutoDFT, a closed-loop multi-agent framework that embeds LLM reasoning into every stage of the DFT lifecycle, where a strategic planner produces a skeletal plan of step objectives; a step planner generates numerical parameters just in time from preceding results; and a monitor-recover-reflect cycle diagnoses failures, repairs them, and revises the plan when the evidence justifies it. We demonstrate both breadth and depth: breadth on VASPBench, a purpose-built benchmark spanning 34 tasks and 9 DFT calculation types, where AutoDFT achieves 94.1% task-level success with GPT-5.2; and depth on established materials databases, where AutoDFT produces quantitatively reliable property predictions across electronic, magnetic, and energetic properties. By closing the loop between planning and execution, AutoDFT enables experimentalists without deep computational expertise to obtain reliable first-principles results.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Density functional theory (DFT)、multi-agent framework、autonomous DFT calculations。；研究对象：论文研究的是密度泛函理论（DFT）计算流程的自动化，而非特定材料或物理体系。其测试对象包括自建的VASPBench基准测试（涵盖34个任务和9种DFT计算类型）以及已有的材料数据库。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: AutoDFT框架通过闭环多智能体架构，将大语言模型（LLM）推理嵌入DFT计算全生命周期，实现了94.1%的任务级成功率（使用GPT-5.2），并能可靠预测电子、磁性和能量性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：AutoDFT框架通过闭环多智能体架构，将大语言模型（LLM）推理嵌入DFT计算全生命周期，实现了94.1%的任务级成功率（使用GPT-5.2），并能可靠预测电子、磁性和能量性质。；创新点：现有基于LLM的智能体仅自动化初始规划阶段（一次性生成完整执行计划），后续调整依赖手工规则；AutoDFT则将LLM推理嵌入规划、执行、监控、恢复和反思的每一个阶段，实现了规划与执行之间的闭环反馈，从而能够自适应处理收敛失败、意外物理现象和中间结果变化，无需专家干预。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一种名为AutoDFT的闭环多智能体框架，包含三个核心模块：战略规划器（生成步骤目标的骨架计划）、步骤规划器（根据前序结果即时生成数值参数）、以及监控-恢复-反思循环（诊断失败、修复问题并在证据充分时修订计划）。框架基于VASP（Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package）进行DFT计算。

papers.title: Postselection-free ballistic-diffusive transition in monitored spin chains
papers.abstract: We study spin and entanglement dynamics in spin-1/2 XXZ chains under periodic monitoring and show that this system exhibits two measurement-induced phase transitions: a steady-state entanglement phase transition similar to those in monitored quantum circuits and a ballistic-to-diffusive transition in transient dynamics. Specifically, we discover that at low monitoring rate, an initial configuration containing a domain wall $|\uparrow\uparrow\uparrow\ldots \downarrow\downarrow\downarrow\ldots\rangle$ spreads ballistically while, at large monitoring rates, the domain melting is diffusive. Extensive numerical simulations, supported by theoretical arguments, indicate that the ballistic-diffusive transition is intimately interlinked with the entanglement phase transition. In contrast to the entanglement phase transitions, which require exponentially complex postselection, the ballistic-diffusive transition can be observed without postselection and constitutes an experimentally accessible manifestation of the many-body Zeno effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要中提及“数值模拟”和“理论论证”，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：受周期性监测的自旋-1/2 XXZ链中的自旋动力学与纠缠动力学。具体物理现象包括：稳态纠缠相变、瞬态动力学中的弹道-扩散转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该体系存在两种测量诱导的相变：一是与监测量子电路中类似的稳态纠缠相变；二是在瞬态动力学中，从弹道传播到扩散的转变。后者与纠缠相变紧密相关，且无需后选择即可观测，是实验上可触及的多体Zeno效应体现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该体系存在两种测量诱导的相变：一是与监测量子电路中类似的稳态纠缠相变；二是在瞬态动力学中，从弹道传播到扩散的转变。后者与纠缠相变紧密相关，且无需后选择即可观测，是实验上可触及的多体Zeno效应体现。；创新点：发现并表征了一种无需后选择的弹道-扩散转变，该转变与纠缠相变相关联，但克服了纠缠相变需要指数复杂后选择的实验障碍，为实验观测多体Zeno效应提供了可行途径。
papers.method_zh: 通过大规模数值模拟（具体方法如张量网络、量子轨迹模拟等摘要未明确说明）结合理论论证，研究不同监测率下畴壁初始态的演化。

papers.title: Autonomous oscillations in quantum electromechanics: tensor network treatment
papers.abstract: Transport-induced self-sustained oscillations in electromechanical systems convert a static electrochemical bias into robust, autonomous oscillatory motion in the absence of any external periodic drive. However, an exact description of such self-oscillations remains challenging in nanoscale electromechanical devices featuring a simultaneously large bosonic Hilbert space, strong interactions, and structured fermionic leads. We formulate a tensor-network framework that combines a binary representation of the vibrational mode with mesoscopic reservoir embeddings that enable controlled access to the self-oscillatory steady states and relevant transport observables without explicit real-time propagation. We demonstrate the emergence of mechanical self-oscillations across a broad set of operating conditions, in which strong electromechanical backaction, nonadiabatic oscillator dynamics, and energy-dependent electronic tunneling processes compete. Furthermore, we observe that for both slow and fast vibrating mechanical modes, suppressed vibrational occupation fluctuations in the self-oscillation window along the electromechanical coupling strength sweep is preceded by a peak in the occupation fluctuations. Collectively, we explore how both intrinsic system properties and environmental parameters govern such autonomous oscillations over a broad range of operating conditions. The generality of our framework will enable the method to be employed straightforwardly to more complicated or experimentally relevant scenarios.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：tensor-network framework、formulate、demonstrate、explore。；研究对象：量子电机械系统中的自持振荡（self-sustained oscillations）现象，具体为在静态电化学偏压下，由输运诱导产生的机械自主振荡。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在宽泛的工作条件下，机械自持振荡可以稳定出现，且慢速与快速振动模式下，在电机械耦合强度扫描中，自振荡窗口内的振动占据数涨落被抑制之前，会出现一个占据数涨落的峰值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在宽泛的工作条件下，机械自持振荡可以稳定出现，且慢速与快速振动模式下，在电机械耦合强度扫描中，自振荡窗口内的振动占据数涨落被抑制之前，会出现一个占据数涨落的峰值。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 张量网络框架（tensor-network framework），具体包括：将振动模式用二进制表示（binary representation），并结合介观储层嵌入（mesoscopic reservoir embeddings），从而无需显式实时传播即可可控地获取自振荡稳态及相关输运可观测量。

papers.title: Bose-Einstein thermal operators for semidefinite optimization
papers.abstract: We establish that semidefinite programs (SDPs) over the unbounded positive semidefinite cone are mathematically equivalent to thermodynamic systems of independent bosonic modes: the eigenvalues of the optimization variable play the role of expected occupation numbers, the linear objective plays the role of total expected energy, and the linear equality constraints play the role of conserved non-commuting charges. Building on this perspective, we recast general SDPs as bosonic free-energy minimization problems at strictly positive temperature, regularized by the Bose-Einstein entropy; the original SDP is recovered in the zero-temperature limit. The optimal primal variable takes the form of a Bose-Einstein thermal operator parametrized by the dual variables. We prove an approximation-error bound that depends on the ground-space degeneracy and the spectral gap of the dual slack operator, improving on the linear-in-dimension worst-case duality gap of interior-point methods. We also introduce the Bose-Einstein quantum relative entropy as a Bregman divergence on the unbounded positive semidefinite cone, generated by the negative Bose-Einstein entropy. We propose it as a natural divergence for unnormalized positive operators, for which the standard Umegaki relative entropy can become negative, and we show that it satisfies a restricted monotonicity property under affine maps modeling bosonic Gaussian channels. Finally, we develop hybrid quantum-classical algorithms for the regularized SDP using only Hamiltonian simulation, Hadamard tests, and classical sampling, and bound their runtime in closed form. Unlike existing quantum SDP solvers, whose runtimes scale polynomially with an a priori upper bound on the primal trace, our framework operates directly on the unbounded cone, replacing this bound with a dependence on the spectral structure of the dual slack operator.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：建立数学等价性、提出理论框架、推导误差界、设计算法。；研究对象：半定规划（SDP）与独立玻色子热力学系统之间的数学等价性，以及基于此的量子-经典混合算法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了无界正半定锥上的半定规划在数学上等价于独立玻色子模式的热力学系统，原始SDP可在零温极限下恢复；最优原始变量具有玻色-爱因斯坦热算符形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了无界正半定锥上的半定规划在数学上等价于独立玻色子模式的热力学系统，原始SDP可在零温极限下恢复；最优原始变量具有玻色-爱因斯坦热算符形式。；创新点：首次将无界正半定锥上的SDP与玻色子热力学系统建立严格等价，并利用该视角提出无需先验原始迹上界的量子SDP求解器，其运行时间依赖于对偶松弛算符的谱结构而非问题维度。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：将SDP重写为玻色子自由能最小化问题，引入玻色-爱因斯坦熵作为正则化项；提出玻色-爱因斯坦量子相对熵作为无界正算符上的Bregman散度；设计混合量子-经典算法，仅使用哈密顿量模拟、Hadamard测试和经典采样。

papers.title: Time Crystals on Quantum Devices
papers.abstract: Time crystals are nonequilibrium phases of matter characterized by the emergence of temporal ordering, in which an interacting many-body system develops robust structure in its time evolution that is not trivially dictated by the external driving or environment. While related phenomena have long been studied in classical nonlinear systems, their realization in entangled quantum matter represents a distinct frontier. The theoretical understanding of discrete time crystals has substantially advanced, yet recent experiments using modern quantum devices and quantum processors reveal regimes beyond established paradigms. These developments call for an extended classification of time-crystalline phases according to both their stabilization mechanisms and their physical character, including discrete and continuous, closed and open, critical, topological, quasiperiodic, and controlled realizations. We review recent implementations of time crystals on quantum platforms and propose such a classification framework, identifying promising directions for the discovery of novel time-crystalline phases of matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验综述）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“theoretical understanding...substantially advanced”和“review recent implementations”，并提出分类框架，属于理论分析与实验总结相结合的混合类型。；研究对象：时间晶体（time crystals），即非平衡多体量子系统中呈现时间有序性的物相，包括离散/连续、封闭/开放、临界、拓扑、准周期及受控实现等多种类型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 现有量子器件实验揭示了超出已有理论范式的时间晶体行为，因此需要根据稳定机制和物理特征对时间晶相进行扩展分类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：现有量子器件实验揭示了超出已有理论范式的时间晶体行为，因此需要根据稳定机制和物理特征对时间晶相进行扩展分类。；创新点：提出一个系统性的时间晶相扩展分类方案，将稳定机制与物理特征（如临界性、拓扑性、准周期性等）相结合，以指导未来新型时间晶相的发现。
papers.method_zh: 基于对近期量子平台（如量子处理器）上时间晶体实验实现的综述，提出新的分类框架，涵盖离散/连续、封闭/开放、临界、拓扑、准周期及受控实现等类别。

papers.title: Queue & AI: When Faster Tasks Slow Down the Workflow
papers.abstract: Quantifying the workplace productivity effects of Generative Artificial Intelligence is now central to economics, management, and public policy. The deployment of AI tools in customer service, writing, software development, and consulting operations has been reported to generate large per-task productivity gains, typically measured as tasks completed per worker-hour or reductions in mean handle time. We argue that such mean-based metrics can misrepresent AI's effects in workflows where tasks accumulate and compete for scarce human attention. AI assistance can generate a deceptive productivity signature: average completion times fall because AI tools typically supply a fast first draft, yet workflow-level performance deteriorates when a subset of AI errors escapes review and returns as costly downstream rework. We call this divergence between mean task speed and system-level delay the variance wedge. Depending on the operational parameters, the most time-efficient way to complete a workflow may undergo a transition between two task-processing regimes, a fully AI-assisted and a fully manual one. We formalize the mechanism as a queueing model and derive two main implications analytically. First, under congestion, reviewers rationally raise the risk threshold for checking AI outputs, reducing scrutiny precisely when it would matter the most. Second, AI assistance can stabilize an overloaded workflow only when (i) the fraction of tasks handled by AI exceeds a critical threshold, and (ii) the human attention required for review and expected rework is lower than the attention for manual completion, a requirement substantially more stringent than faster draft generation. These results suggest that AI deployment should be evaluated not only by average task speed, but by its overall effects on congestion, rework, and the robustness of human oversight under load.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：queueing model（排队模型）、analytically derive（解析推导）、formalize（形式化）。；研究对象：论文研究的对象并非传统凝聚态物理中的材料或体系，而是**生成式人工智能（AI）工具在客服、写作、软件开发等知识工作流程中的部署效应**。具体物理现象是**任务处理流程中的拥塞（congestion）与返工（rework）导致的系统级延迟**。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: AI辅助虽然能降低单个任务的平均完成时间，但可能因部分AI错误未被审查而引发下游返工，导致整个工作流性能恶化。这种“平均任务速度”与“系统级延迟”之间的背离被称为**方差楔（variance wedge）**。在拥塞条件下，最省时的处理模式可能在“全AI辅助”与“全人工”之间发生相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：AI辅助虽然能降低单个任务的平均完成时间，但可能因部分AI错误未被审查而引发下游返工，导致整个工作流性能恶化。这种“平均任务速度”与“系统级延迟”之间的背离被称为**方差楔（variance wedge）**。在拥塞条件下，最省时的处理模式可能在“全AI辅助”与“全人工”之间发生相变。；创新点：该工作指出，仅用平均任务速度（如每工时完成数）衡量AI的生产力效应具有误导性，首次从排队论角度系统揭示了AI辅助在拥塞条件下因审查不足和返工导致的“方差楔”效应，并给出了AI稳定过载工作流的严格条件（AI处理任务比例需超过临界阈值，且审查与返工所需人力需低于纯人工完成所需人力）。
papers.method_zh: 采用**排队论（queueing theory）** 建立数学模型，通过解析推导分析AI辅助对工作流拥塞、审查阈值和系统稳定性的影响。

papers.title: A Levitated Random Telegraph Noise Spectrometer
papers.abstract: Random Telegraph Noise is a ubiquitous process manifesting across technology and the natural world. It is characterized by random jumps between two distinct states with Poissonian waiting times, and is the origin of 1/f noise. Understanding and characterizing this noise is critical for the reliable operation of micro-, nano- and quantum-technologies. In this work we probe random telegraph noise using a levitated microparticle sensor whose dynamics are driven almost entirely by this non-white source of noise. We observe a startling resonant behaviour, characterized by a thousand-fold increase in the underdamped sensor's position fluctuations, enabling us to measure the spectral properties of the noise over six decades of timescale. This work not only provides a unique way to probe random telegraph noise, but also demonstrates a platform for studying non-equilibrium stochastic dynamics in the presence of realistic non-white noise, with applications from biology to social behaviour.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用悬浮微粒传感器进行探测”（probe random telegraph noise using a levitated microparticle sensor），并描述了实验观测到的共振行为。；研究对象：随机电报噪声（Random Telegraph Noise），这是一种在两个状态之间随机跳变的噪声过程，是1/f噪声的起源。研究对象本身是一种噪声现象，而非特定材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用悬浮微粒传感器，观察到随机电报噪声驱动下欠阻尼传感器的位置涨落出现千倍增强的共振行为，从而能够在六个时间尺度数量级上测量该噪声的频谱特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用悬浮微粒传感器，观察到随机电报噪声驱动下欠阻尼传感器的位置涨落出现千倍增强的共振行为，从而能够在六个时间尺度数量级上测量该噪声的频谱特性。；创新点：提供了一种独特的探测随机电报噪声的方法，并建立了一个研究非白噪声驱动下非平衡随机动力学的实验平台，其应用可延伸至生物学和社会行为等领域。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：使用悬浮微粒（levitated microparticle）作为传感器，其动力学几乎完全由非白噪声（即随机电报噪声）驱动，通过测量传感器位置涨落的共振增强来表征噪声的频谱性质。

papers.title: Quantifying the liquid flow between a soap film and a vertical meniscus
papers.abstract: Fluid exchange between a soap film and its bounding menisci governs film drainage and stability, with direct implications for the lifetime of surface bubbles and liquid foams. Despite recent advances, a quantitative characterization of this coupling, associated with the phenomenon of marginal regeneration, remains incomplete. The volumetric flux per unit length of contact follows a well-established scaling law involving geometrical parameters such as the film height and the meniscus radius of curvature. However, the dimensionless prefactor of this relation - the flux coefficient - remains difficult to determine for vertical menisci because of the complex and intermittent flows occurring at the film-meniscus interface. Here, we quantify this flux into the meniscus generated by inserting a solid plate into a vertical soap film. We consider both vertical and inclined plates and further investigate the effects of plate inclination, height, and width. Focusing on the dynamics of the growth of the meniscus driven by liquid supplied by the film, we analyze both steady and transient regimes resulting from the interplay between capillary pressure, gravity, and liquid exchange. Combining experiments, numerical simulations, and theoretical modelling, we determine the flux coefficient using three independent methods and show that it remains constant over the range of parameters explored.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验、数值模拟、理论建模）。关键词：experiments, numerical simulations, theoretical modelling。；研究对象：肥皂膜与垂直弯月面之间的液体流动，具体涉及膜-弯月面界面的液体交换、边际再生现象以及由此驱动的弯月面生长动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过三种独立方法确定了单位接触长度的体积通量（通量系数），并证明在所探索的参数范围内该系数保持恒定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过三种独立方法确定了单位接触长度的体积通量（通量系数），并证明在所探索的参数范围内该系数保持恒定。；创新点：针对垂直弯月面中因界面处复杂间歇流动而难以确定的通量系数，提供了定量表征，并验证了其在不同几何参数下的恒定性。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过将固体板插入垂直肥皂膜来生成弯月面，并改变板的倾斜角度、高度和宽度；结合数值模拟与理论建模，分析稳态和瞬态流动，量化毛细压力、重力与液体交换的相互作用。

papers.title: Probing the Effects of Heat Treatment Atmosphere on the Structural and Electrical Properties of NBT via Eu Photoluminescence
papers.abstract: The effect of oxygen partial pressure during the pre-calcination step (high vacuum, air, nitrogen, and oxygen) on the crystal structure, microstructure, and electrical properties of Na0.5Bi0.465Sr0.02Eu0.005TiO3 oxide-ion-conducting ceramics was systematically investigated. Dense ceramic samples were prepared by a conventional solid-state reaction route under different atmospheres. The results show that the oxygen partial pressure strongly affects Bi volatilization, grain growth, and oxygen-vacancy concentration. The largest average grain size was obtained for the nitrogentreated sample, whereas the oxygen-treated sample exhibited the finest grains but the highest grain-boundary conductivity. X-ray diffraction and Raman spectroscopy indicate that low oxygen partial pressure enhances structural disorder, while high oxygen partial pressure stabilizes the lattice and promotes charge-transfer transitions. Eu3+ photoluminescence further reveals the correlation between local structural evolution and oxygen-vacancy concentration. These findings clarify how oxygen partial pressure regulates grain-boundary behavior and ion-transport mechanisms in NBT-based oxide-ion conductors, providing guidance for optimizing the total conductivity of polycrystalline electrolytes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“制备了致密的陶瓷样品”、“X射线衍射和拉曼光谱”、“Eu3+光致发光”等实验手段。；研究对象：Na0.5Bi0.465Sr0.02Eu0.005TiO3 (NBT基) 氧化物离子导电陶瓷。具体研究了预煅烧步骤中不同氧分压（高真空、空气、氮气、氧气）对其晶体结构、微观结构和电学性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氧分压强烈影响NBT基陶瓷中Bi的挥发、晶粒生长和氧空位浓度，进而调控其晶界行为和离子输运机制。高氧分压能稳定晶格并提高晶界电导率，而低氧分压则增强结构无序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氧分压强烈影响NBT基陶瓷中Bi的挥发、晶粒生长和氧空位浓度，进而调控其晶界行为和离子输运机制。高氧分压能稳定晶格并提高晶界电导率，而低氧分压则增强结构无序。；创新点：利用Eu3+光致发光作为局域探针，揭示了氧分压如何通过调控氧空位浓度来影响NBT基氧化物离子导体的局域结构演变，从而将宏观电学性能与微观缺陷化学联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 采用传统固相反应法在不同气氛下制备样品；使用X射线衍射和拉曼光谱分析晶体结构；利用Eu3+光致发光谱探测局域结构演变与氧空位浓度的关联；通过电学性能测试（摘要未明确说明具体测试方法，如阻抗谱）分析电导率。

papers.title: Looking for Condensed Gluons: A Cross-Scale Journey from the Deep Structure of Protons to High-Energy Cosmic Rays -- A Mini-Review
papers.abstract: Quark-gluon dynamics within protons and high-energy radiation phenomena in the universe are typically regarded as two entirely distinct fields. This paper aims to demonstrate that gluon condensation (GC) may serve as a direct bridge between these two fields. We review three key aspects of GC research: first, the Zhu-Shen-Ruan (ZSR) equation, as a nonlinear evolution equation based on structural symmetry, exhibits self-consistent connections with the DGLAP, BFKL and GLR-MQ-ZRS equations, providing a theoretical foundation for the generation of GC; second, the chaotic solutions and the shadowing-antishadowing synergy inherent in this equation can drive gluons to aggregate near the critical momentum, thereby forming a novel type of high-density, strongly interacting matter; third, these changes in microstructure manifest themselves as a broken-power-law feature in high-energy cosmic gamma-ray spectra, thereby offering new insights into the hadronic scenarios underlying certain astrophysical sources. Consequently, GC not only concerns the novel behaviour of quantum chromodynamics under extreme conditions but may also serve as a vital window for probing the deep structure of protons using cosmic-ray signals. With the advancement of higher-precision gamma-ray observations, hadron collision experiments and related theoretical research, the physical picture of GC and its observational criteria are expected to undergo more rigorous testing. Should this picture be confirmed, certain features in the high-energy gamma-ray spectrum will need to be re-examined within the deeper context of hadronic dynamics; simultaneously, GC may also provide a new entry point for research into pion condensation in nuclear physics and even condensed matter physics. Consequently, the significance of the search for GC extends beyond the model itself, reaching into multiple fields of natural science.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：mini-review、理论框架、非线性演化方程、物理图像）；研究对象：胶子凝聚（gluon condensation, GC）现象，及其在质子内部结构与高能宇宙射线之间的跨尺度联系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 胶子凝聚可能作为连接质子内部夸克-胶子动力学与高能宇宙伽马射线谱的桥梁，其微观结构变化表现为高能宇宙伽马射线谱中的破缺幂律特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：胶子凝聚可能作为连接质子内部夸克-胶子动力学与高能宇宙伽马射线谱的桥梁，其微观结构变化表现为高能宇宙伽马射线谱中的破缺幂律特征。；创新点：提出胶子凝聚不仅涉及极端条件下量子色动力学的新奇行为，还可能通过宇宙射线信号探测质子深层结构，并将胶子凝聚与核物理中的π凝聚乃至凝聚态物理研究建立潜在联系。
papers.method_zh: 基于Zhu-Shen-Ruan（ZSR）方程的非线性演化理论分析，并与DGLAP、BFKL、GLR-MQ-ZRS等方程进行自洽性比较；通过混沌解与阴影-反阴影协同机制研究胶子在临界动量附近的聚集行为。

papers.title: Sampling Data with Chains of Forward-Backward Diffusion Steps
papers.abstract: Sampling from learned high-dimensional distributions is a foundational computational problem. We introduce U-turn chains: Markov chains obtained by iterating short forward-backward steps of a diffusion model, in which each step proposes a move that remains on the learned data manifold and, paired with a Metropolis-Hastings correction, samples from energy-modified targets. For synthetic languages, we show that minimal U-turn dynamics undergoes an ergodicity-breaking phase transition driven by fragmentation of the data manifold; ergodicity is restored at larger U-turn magnitude. In the non-ergodic regime, low-level features relax faster than high-level ones, an ordering that inverts only at sufficiently large U-turn magnitude. We test these predictions on natural language and natural images. In both modalities, minimal U-turns relax slowly, especially for high-level features approximated by deep representations in CNNs or LLMs. The layer-ordering inversion appears only at large noise when mixing is efficient -- signatures consistent with strongly constrained, weakly mixing local dynamics. We discuss the implications of these results for sampling with diffusion models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算与实验验证）。判断依据：引入马尔可夫链的数学框架（U-turn chains）、相变分析（ergodicity-breaking phase transition），并在合成语言、自然语言和自然图像上进行数值测试。；研究对象：基于扩散模型的高维分布采样问题，具体研究数据流形上的采样动力学行为，包括遍历性破缺、特征松弛顺序反转等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 最小U-turn动力学在数据流形碎片化时发生遍历性破缺相变，导致低层特征比高层特征松弛更快；仅在足够大的U-turn幅度下，遍历性恢复且特征松弛顺序反转。在自然语言和图像中，最小U-turn松弛缓慢，层序反转仅在大噪声、高效混合时出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：最小U-turn动力学在数据流形碎片化时发生遍历性破缺相变，导致低层特征比高层特征松弛更快；仅在足够大的U-turn幅度下，遍历性恢复且特征松弛顺序反转。在自然语言和图像中，最小U-turn松弛缓慢，层序反转仅在大噪声、高效混合时出现。；创新点：提出U-turn链这一新型马尔可夫链采样方法，揭示了扩散模型采样中数据流形碎片化导致的遍历性破缺相变，并系统刻画了特征松弛顺序与U-turn幅度、噪声水平的关系。摘要未突出说明与已有采样方法（如Langevin动力学、MCMC）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：构造U-turn链（前向-反向扩散步骤迭代+Metropolis-Hastings校正）并分析其遍历性。数值测试：在合成语言、自然语言（CNN/LLM深度表示）和自然图像上进行采样动力学模拟，比较不同U-turn幅度下的特征松弛速率。

papers.title: Signal-to-Noise Ratio and Sample Size Govern Representational Alignment in Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Neural networks are known to develop latent representations that are $aligned$, namely structurally similar across networks trained with different architectures, training protocols, or training datasets. We study this phenomenon in a controlled setting, where we train an ensemble of networks on regression and classification tasks using training sets perturbed by independent realizations of a noise process. We show that the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and the training sample size influence the alignment in qualitatively similar ways in networks trained on real-world datasets and in an extremely simple $linear$ network with a single hidden layer, for which the alignment can be estimated analytically. Across linear and nonlinear networks, regression and classification tasks, and both synthetic and real-world data, we consistently observe that alignment varies monotonically with SNR but non-monotonically with training sample size. In particular, the alignment is minimized near the interpolation threshold, and a stronger alignment does not necessarily correspond to better generalization error. These findings reveal a non-trivial dependence of alignment on data quality and quantity, decoupled from generalization performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：analytically estimated、linear network、ensemble of networks、regression and classification tasks。；研究对象：神经网络中潜在表征的“对齐”现象（representational alignment），即不同网络在训练后其内部表征结构趋于相似的现象。研究对象包括线性网络与非线性网络，以及合成数据与真实世界数据集。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 表征对齐程度随信噪比（SNR）单调变化，但随训练样本量非单调变化，在插值阈值（interpolation threshold）附近对齐最弱；更强的对齐并不必然对应更优的泛化误差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：表征对齐程度随信噪比（SNR）单调变化，但随训练样本量非单调变化，在插值阈值（interpolation threshold）附近对齐最弱；更强的对齐并不必然对应更优的泛化误差。；创新点：揭示了数据质量（信噪比）与数据量（样本量）对表征对齐的非平凡依赖关系，并指出对齐与泛化性能可以解耦。摘要未突出说明与已有对齐研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 通过训练一组神经网络（ensemble）在回归与分类任务上，使用被独立噪声扰动后的训练集；对单隐层线性网络进行解析估计，并与非线性网络、真实数据集上的结果进行对比。

papers.title: Constrained Symplectic Quantization II: The Free Scalar Field
papers.abstract: Constrained symplectic quantization is a functional formulation of quantum field theory in which quantum fluctuations are sampled through a deterministic Hamiltonian flow in an auxiliary intrinsic time $τ$. In this paper we extend the quantum-mechanical framework introduced in [1] to a relativistic scalar quantum field theory in Minkowski space-time. The construction is based on the analytic continuation of fields and action from $\mathbb{R}$ to $\mathbb{C}$ together with constraints that select stable intrinsic-time trajectories and, at the same time, define convergent integration cycles for the corresponding microcanonical functional. We show that, in the continuum limit, the microcanonical generating functional reproduces the Feynman generating functional. For the free scalar field in $1+1$ dimensions we derive the constrained equations of motion, implement the resulting dynamics numerically, and verify real-time two-point correlators, equal-time commutator relations, and Dyson--Schwinger equations including the expected contact terms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：functional formulation of quantum field theory, Hamiltonian flow, analytic continuation, microcanonical functional）；研究对象：自由标量场在闵可夫斯基时空中的相对论性量子场论，具体在1+1维空间中进行数值验证。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过约束辛量子化方法，在连续极限下微正则生成泛函能够复现费曼生成泛函，并数值验证了实时两点关联函数、等时对易关系以及Dyson-Schwinger方程（包括接触项）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过约束辛量子化方法，在连续极限下微正则生成泛函能够复现费曼生成泛函，并数值验证了实时两点关联函数、等时对易关系以及Dyson-Schwinger方程（包括接触项）。；创新点：将此前在量子力学中建立的约束辛量子化框架[1]扩展至相对论性标量量子场论，并首次在连续极限下证明其与标准费曼生成泛函的等价性，同时通过数值模拟验证了实时关联函数和量子场论基本关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用约束辛量子化框架，将量子涨落通过辅助内禀时间τ中的确定性哈密顿流进行采样；对场和动作从实数域到复数域进行解析延拓，并引入约束条件以选择稳定的内禀时间轨迹并定义收敛的微正则泛函积分路径；在1+1维自由标量场中推导约束运动方程并进行数值模拟。

papers.title: Nonclassical energy-change distribution as a witness of non-Markovian quantum dynamics
papers.abstract: We address the problem of identifying non-Markovian quantum time evolutions of an open quantum system by only performing measurements of the system's energy. We demonstrate that violations of CP-divisibility are always witnessed by non-positive values of the energy-change Kirkwood-Dirac quasiprobability distribution associated with the system's Hamiltonian, evaluated at consecutive times. The link between non CP-divisibility and non-positivity of the system's energy-change distribution is stronger when the system-environment interactions are energy-preserving. The witness works whenever anomalous energy fluxes, due to non-Markovianity, are realized. Anomalous fluxes are also detected by the non-Markovianity measure built over the quantum mutual information between the states of the open system and of a quantum correlated reference.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：addressing the problem of identifying、demonstrate、link between、witness works。；研究对象：开放量子系统中的非马尔可夫量子动力学，具体关注系统能量的变化分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非CP可分的量子时间演化总是可以通过系统能量变化的Kirkwood-Dirac准概率分布的非正值来识别；当系统-环境相互作用能量守恒时，这种关联更强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非CP可分的量子时间演化总是可以通过系统能量变化的Kirkwood-Dirac准概率分布的非正值来识别；当系统-环境相互作用能量守恒时，这种关联更强。；创新点：提出仅通过测量系统能量（而非环境）即可检测非马尔可夫动力学的新方法，建立了能量变化准概率分布的非正性与非CP可分性之间的直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于Kirkwood-Dirac准概率分布和量子互信息构建非马尔可夫性判据与度量。

papers.title: Exact Solution for Non-Hermitian Free Fermions: A Case Study of the XY Chain
papers.abstract: We consider the non-Hermitian XY spin chain with open boundary conditions when the anisotropy parameter is extended to complex values. By analyzing the quasi-Hamiltonian matrix, we demonstrate that the free-fermion structure of the quasi-energy spectrum coincides with that of the Hermitian model and construct the corresponding biorthogonal fermionic basis away from exceptional points (EPs). We make use of an explicit Chebyshev-polynomial representation of the open-boundary eigenvectors in which the quasi-energy $\varepsilon$ is the natural spectral variable. This quasi-energy polynomial form is particularly useful at EPs, because EPs correspond to repeated roots of the same boundary polynomial, making the construction of generalized eigenvectors by $\varepsilon$-differentiation transparent. At EPs, where the quasi-Hamiltonian becomes defective, we derive the Jordan normal form and construct the associated generalized eigenvectors, which yields the correct counting of independent many-body eigenstates. We further show that EPs act as branch points in the complex anisotropy plane, leading to the characteristic permutation of eigenenergies and eigenstates upon encirclement. The branch-cut structure of the biorthogonal eigenstates provides direct evidence for the exchange of eigenstates when an EP is encircled. These results provide an analytically controlled many-body platform for studying EP physics and non-Hermitian topology beyond momentum-space descriptions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“分析”“推导”“构造”等理论方法，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：非厄米XY自旋链（open boundary conditions），各向异性参数取复数值时的非厄米自由费米子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非厄米XY链的准能谱在远离奇异点（EPs）时保持与厄米模型相同的自由费米子结构，并可通过切比雪夫多项式显式构造双正交费米子基；在奇异点处，准哈密顿量变为亏损，通过ε微分构造广义本征向量，并证明奇异点作为复各向异性平面上的分支点，导致绕行时本征能量与本征态的置换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非厄米XY链的准能谱在远离奇异点（EPs）时保持与厄米模型相同的自由费米子结构，并可通过切比雪夫多项式显式构造双正交费米子基；在奇异点处，准哈密顿量变为亏损，通过ε微分构造广义本征向量，并证明奇异点作为复各向异性平面上的分支点，导致绕行时本征能量与本征态的置换。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 准哈密顿量矩阵分析、切比雪夫多项式表示开边界本征向量、ε作为自然谱变量、Jordan标准型推导、广义本征向量构造、复平面分支点与绕行分析。

papers.title: Analytical Singular-Value Structure of Analytic-Continuation Kernels from Slepian Information Theory
papers.abstract: Analytic continuation from imaginary-time Green's functions to real-frequency spectra is a central ill-posed inverse problem in quantum many-body physics. We show that the thermal kernel admits an analytical generalized singular-value structure once its purely dynamical part is separated from the statistical weight imposed by the heat bath. The dynamical kernel is the imaginary-bandwidth continuation of Slepian's finite Fourier transform and is governed by the same Sturm-Liouville algebra that yields prolate spheroidal wave functions. Fermionic and bosonic statistics then enter as gauge transformations of the frequency-space inner product, producing self-adjoint effective potentials but no numerical kernel diagonalization. The Shannon number, $N_c=β\wmax/π$, fixes the upper information capacity of this pure Laplace channel. Finally, the optimal sampling points are obtained as eigenvalues of a Legendre colleague matrix, giving a deterministic compressed-sensing grid without iterative root searches.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical generalized singular-value structure、Sturm-Liouville algebra、gauge transformations、theoretical framework。；研究对象：量子多体物理中解析延拓问题的数学内核，具体为从虚时格林函数到实频率谱的逆问题中的热核（thermal kernel）及其奇异值结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热核在分离纯动力学部分与热浴统计权重后，具有解析的广义奇异值结构；该动力学核是Slepian有限傅里叶变换的虚频带延拓，受同一Sturm-Liouville代数支配，且费米子和玻色子统计效应表现为频率空间内积的规范变换，无需数值对角化核。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热核在分离纯动力学部分与热浴统计权重后，具有解析的广义奇异值结构；该动力学核是Slepian有限傅里叶变换的虚频带延拓，受同一Sturm-Liouville代数支配，且费米子和玻色子统计效应表现为频率空间内积的规范变换，无需数值对角化核。；创新点：首次揭示了解析延拓核的解析奇异值结构，将热核分解为纯动力学部分与统计权重，并证明其与Slepian有限傅里叶变换的数学同源性；同时，通过规范变换统一处理费米子和玻色子统计，避免了数值核对角化，并给出了确定性压缩感知网格（无需迭代求根）。
papers.method_zh: 基于Slepian信息论框架，通过解析推导热核的广义奇异值分解，利用Sturm-Liouville理论（产生长椭球波函数）分析动力学核，并引入Legendre伴随矩阵的特征值确定最优采样点。

papers.title: Random neural networks match observed dimensionality of neural population recordings and motivate stronger experimental tests
papers.abstract: Randomly connected neural networks have long served as a theoretical tool for studying collective dynamics in neural populations, yet quantitative comparisons to experiments remain limited. Recent technological advances have made it possible to resolve population-wide correlations across neurons, and minimal models such as random neural networks predict their generic structure. Whether the two agree quantitatively remains untested. In this work, we examine whether a minimally structured random neural network can account for the low dimensionality of activity in neural population recordings by building on recent developments in Dynamical Mean-Field Theory and incorporating two additional experimentally relevant features into the model: finite measurement time and variability across behavioral contexts. We show that, when these factors are included, the dimensionality measured from large-scale recordings is consistent with the values predicted by random models. However, current recording durations make it difficult to use dimensionality to discriminate among connectivity structures. We further show that analytically predicted dimensionality varies non-monotonically with external input strength, and that the orientation similarity between neural manifolds recorded under different behavioral contexts can be more sensitive to network structure than dimensionality is. Together, these results provide quantitative guidance for experimental design to infer the connectivity structure underlying population activity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：random neural networks、Dynamical Mean-Field Theory、analytically predicted、quantitative comparisons。；研究对象：随机连接的神经网络模型，以及神经群体记录中活动维度的统计特性。具体物理现象为：神经群体活动的低维流形与网络连接结构之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当考虑有限测量时间和行为背景变异性时，随机神经网络预测的活动维度与大规模神经记录实测值一致；但当前记录时长不足以通过维度区分不同连接结构；流形在不同行为背景下的方向相似性比维度对网络结构更敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当考虑有限测量时间和行为背景变异性时，随机神经网络预测的活动维度与大规模神经记录实测值一致；但当前记录时长不足以通过维度区分不同连接结构；流形在不同行为背景下的方向相似性比维度对网络结构更敏感。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于动力平均场理论（Dynamical Mean-Field Theory）构建最小结构随机神经网络模型，并引入两个实验相关特征：有限测量时间和跨行为背景的变异性。通过解析计算预测维度，并与大规模神经记录数据进行比较。

papers.title: Selective Biexciton Generation Under Energy-Time Entangled Quantum Light in Quantum Dots
papers.abstract: Energy-time entangled photons provide new opportunities for controlling multiphoton absorption beyond classical limits. Here, we investigate biexciton generation in nanocrystal quantum dots driven by energy-time-entangled quantum light generated via a spontaneous parametric down-conversion process. We show that quantum correlations can enhance biexciton production while suppressing excitonic populations. By employing a three-level model, we demonstrate that biexciton generation depends nontrivially on the photon arrival-time entanglement and the pump bandwidth. Consequently, we find that maximizing efficiency requires an optimally shaped entangled photon field rather than simply scaling parameters for a monotonic improvement. Extending to a realistic CdSe/CdS core-shell quantum dots containing many excitonic states coupled to the quantum field, we demonstrate that increasing the bi-photon arrival time entanglement (closer arrival time) enhances constructive pathway interference and expands accessible excitation channels while preserving a better energy conservation excitation than classical light when generating biexciton. Furthermore, tuning the time correlation properties enables selective excitation of closely spaced biexciton states. These results establish entangled quantum light as a powerful tool for selective excitation and control of nonlinear optical processes in quantum-confined systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“investigate”、“employing a three-level model”、“demonstrate”等词汇，主要基于模型计算和理论分析，未提及具体实验操作或数据。；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系是纳米晶量子点（nanocrystal quantum dots），特别是CdSe/CdS核壳量子点（core-shell quantum dots）中的双激子（biexciton）生成过程。物理现象是能量-时间纠缠量子光驱动下的多光子吸收与非线性光学过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子光的光子到达时间纠缠可以增强双激子产生，同时抑制单激子（激子）布居。通过优化纠缠光子场的形状（而非简单缩放参数），可以实现双激子生成效率的最大化，并实现对能量相近的双激子态的选择性激发。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子光的光子到达时间纠缠可以增强双激子产生，同时抑制单激子（激子）布居。通过优化纠缠光子场的形状（而非简单缩放参数），可以实现双激子生成效率的最大化，并实现对能量相近的双激子态的选择性激发。；创新点：揭示了量子光的时间关联特性（而非仅强度或频率）可作为调控量子点中非线性光学过程（特别是双激子生成）的新自由度，并证明了通过优化纠缠光场可以实现超越经典光的能量守恒激发和选择性激发。摘要未突出说明与已有理论工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用三能级模型（three-level model）描述量子点，并考虑通过自发参量下转换（spontaneous parametric down-conversion, SPDC）过程产生的能量-时间纠缠量子光。研究分析了光子到达时间纠缠和泵浦带宽对双激子生成的非平凡依赖关系。对于更真实的体系，扩展模型至包含多个激子态的CdSe/CdS核壳量子点。

papers.title: Scar Full Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis
papers.abstract: The eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH) provides a fundamental mechanism for emergent statistical mechanics in isolated chaotic quantum systems, asserting that individual energy eigenstates behave as pseudorandom vectors within an energy window. This enables a complete characterization of nontrivial correlations among matrix elements in the energy eigenbasis, as described by the full ETH ansatz. Nevertheless, this description breaks down in systems exhibiting quantum many-body scars, which host non-thermal eigenstates with extensive energy. In this Letter, we address this problem by formulating the \textit{scar full ETH}, which captures correlations among matrix elements involving scar states. The corresponding scaling forms and factorization properties are established using typicality arguments. Multi-time correlation functions for scar states are then organized in terms of both thermal and scar cumulants, providing a nontrivial reorganization of higher-order correlations. We numerically demonstrate the validity of this framework in the paradigmatic model of quantum scars, the PXP model. Our results pave the way for a systematic understanding of intriguing correlations in systems with quantum many-body scars.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“formulating the scar full ETH”、“typicality arguments”、“numerically demonstrate”，属于理论框架构建与数值验证。；研究对象：量子多体疤痕（quantum many-body scars）系统中的能量本征态热化行为，具体以PXP模型为范例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了“疤痕全本征态热化假说”（scar full ETH），该假说能够刻画涉及疤痕态的能量本征基矩阵元之间的关联，并利用典型性论证建立了相应的标度形式和因子化性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了“疤痕全本征态热化假说”（scar full ETH），该假说能够刻画涉及疤痕态的能量本征基矩阵元之间的关联，并利用典型性论证建立了相应的标度形式和因子化性质。；创新点：将传统全ETH框架扩展到存在量子多体疤痕的系统，首次系统描述了疤痕态与热态之间以及疤痕态之间的矩阵元关联，并给出了高阶关联函数的重整化组织方式（热累积量与疤痕累积量）。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（典型性论证）结合数值模拟（在PXP模型中进行验证）。

papers.title: Programming nanomechanical computation with light
papers.abstract: Looking at physical systems as computers allows us to regard physical properties, such as thermal noise, symmetry or topology, as unconventional resources for computation. However, harnessing these resources requires programming computational functionality through strong, controllable nonlinearities in the system. Here, we show that cavity optomechanical interactions allow laser-controlled computation with nanomechanical degrees of freedom. We demonstrate a set of basic digital logic gates with level restoration and controlled mechanical couplings as essential ingredients for arbitrary computing networks. Owing to the strong optomechanical nonlinearity and precise readout, the system operates close to thermal amplitudes, in the regime where thermodynamic stochasticity governs its behavior. This opens a new path for the realization of physical computing with controlled nonlinear resonators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+实验）。判断依据：摘要提到“demonstrate a set of basic digital logic gates”（实验演示）和“owing to the strong optomechanical nonlinearity”（理论分析机制）。；研究对象：腔光力学系统中的纳米机械自由度，具体为通过激光控制实现纳米机械计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用腔光机械相互作用，通过激光编程实现了纳米机械自由度上的基本数字逻辑门（具备电平恢复功能），并展示了可控机械耦合作为构建任意计算网络的关键要素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用腔光机械相互作用，通过激光编程实现了纳米机械自由度上的基本数字逻辑门（具备电平恢复功能），并展示了可控机械耦合作为构建任意计算网络的关键要素。；创新点：将物理系统（纳米机械谐振子）视为计算机，利用热噪声、对称性等非常规资源，通过强可控非线性实现编程计算，并在接近热振幅的随机性主导区域运行。摘要未突出说明与已有光机械计算工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 腔光机械相互作用（cavity optomechanical interactions），激光控制（laser-controlled），精确读出（precise readout），以及通过强光机械非线性实现逻辑门操作。

papers.title: Krylov Complexity in Periodically Driven CFTs and Critical Fermions
papers.abstract: We study Krylov construction in periodically driven conformal field theories and their lattice realisations via critical fermions. Two types of driving are considered: a square-wave drive and a continuous sinusoidal drive. Using the Arnoldi construction, we examine Arnoldi coefficients and return amplitudes in periodically driven conformal field theories in the heating and non-heating phases. In the heating phase, the Arnoldi coefficients approach unity exponentially; in contrast, in the non-heating phase, they exhibit oscillatory behaviour. For the lattice realisations, we further analyse the Krylov complexity of the correlation matrix, quasi energy level statistics, and the graph structure induced by the Floquet operator. Although the two drives exhibit similar Krylov growth on the CFT side, their lattice realisations exhibit markedly different spectral and graph signatures, indicating distinct mechanisms governing the transition between the heating and non-heating phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算分析）。判断依据：研究基于“共形场论”和“Arnoldi构造”等理论框架，并结合了“晶格实现”的数值计算分析。；研究对象：周期性驱动的共形场论及其通过临界费米子实现的晶格模型。具体研究了方波驱动和连续正弦波驱动两种驱动方式下的系统行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在加热相中，Arnoldi系数呈指数趋近于1；在非加热相中，Arnoldi系数呈现振荡行为。尽管两种驱动在共形场论侧表现出相似的Krylov复杂度增长，但在晶格实现中展现出截然不同的谱和图形特征，表明加热与非加热相之间的转变由不同的机制主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在加热相中，Arnoldi系数呈指数趋近于1；在非加热相中，Arnoldi系数呈现振荡行为。尽管两种驱动在共形场论侧表现出相似的Krylov复杂度增长，但在晶格实现中展现出截然不同的谱和图形特征，表明加热与非加热相之间的转变由不同的机制主导。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：Krylov构造（Arnoldi构造）、共形场论。数值分析：对晶格模型计算关联矩阵的Krylov复杂度、准能级统计、以及由Floquet算子诱导的图结构。

papers.title: Preparing thermal states of frustrated quantum spin systems using 139 qubits
papers.abstract: Finite-temperature properties of strongly correlated quantum matter are central to condensed matter, chemistry, and high-energy physics, yet are often inaccessible to classical methods such as quantum Monte Carlo (QMC). Here, we investigate dissipative thermal state preparation of frustrated spin systems using digital quantum computers. We focus on two paradigmatic models on the kagome lattice: the antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model (AFHM), whose finite-temperature properties are inaccessible to QMC due to a severe sign problem, and the antiferromagnetic Ising model (AFIM), which serves as a sign-problem-free benchmark. Using IBM quantum processors, we prepare approximate thermal states of the AFIM on kagome lattices with up to $79$ spins coupled to $60$ environment qubits. We observe the emergence of a robust steady state with an adjustable effective temperature that persists in circuits with over 1000 layers of two-qubit gates. We further study the scalability of the dissipative protocol through classical statevector simulations of the AFIM and AFHM. On lattices with up to 24 sites, we find that the circuit depth to reach thermal equilibrium is independent of system size and grows at most linearly with inverse temperature. These results establish engineered dissipation as a promising approach to finite-temperature quantum simulation of frustrated matter, and point toward regimes where quantum devices may outperform classical methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：使用了IBM量子处理器进行实验制备，同时结合经典态矢量模拟进行可扩展性研究。；研究对象：阻挫量子自旋系统的热态制备，具体聚焦于kagome晶格上的反铁磁海森堡模型（AFHM）和反铁磁伊辛模型（AFIM）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过耗散工程方法，在包含139个量子比特的IBM量子处理器上成功制备了kagome晶格阻挫自旋系统的近似热态，并观察到鲁棒的稳态行为；电路深度与系统尺寸无关，仅随逆温度线性增长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过耗散工程方法，在包含139个量子比特的IBM量子处理器上成功制备了kagome晶格阻挫自旋系统的近似热态，并观察到鲁棒的稳态行为；电路深度与系统尺寸无关，仅随逆温度线性增长。；创新点：首次在包含139个量子比特的量子处理器上，通过工程化耗散方法制备阻挫量子自旋系统的有限温度热态，并展示了该方法在量子蒙特卡洛存在符号问题的体系（如kagome AFHM）中的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 数字量子计算机上的耗散热态制备协议：使用IBM量子处理器，将79个自旋与60个环境量子比特耦合，通过超过1000层两量子比特门电路实现稳态；同时采用经典态矢量模拟对最多24个格点的AFIM和AFHM进行可扩展性分析。

papers.title: $S$-duality, boundary states, and higher-form symmetries on ALE spaces
papers.abstract: We study Abelian $S$-duality of Maxwell theory on $A$-type asymptotically locally Euclidean (ALE) spaces. Unlike on closed four-manifolds, the Maxwell path integral on an ALE space is not naturally a scalar partition function. Rather, it decomposes into theta-function blocks labeled by flat $U(1)$ holonomy sectors on the asymptotic lens-space boundary. We interpret these blocks as components of the Hilbert-space boundary state prepared by the ALE path integral. With this interpretation, the apparent failure of ordinary modularity is replaced by vector-valued modular covariance under the action of the modular group. We test this picture explicitly for Eguchi-Hanson space by gluing it to its orientation reversal. The resulting closed four-manifold is diffeomorphic to $S^2\times S^2$, and the natural pairing of the two ALE boundary states reproduces the standard Maxwell partition function on $S^2\times S^2$. We then refine the construction by turning on electric and magnetic $1$-form symmetry backgrounds. In their presence, the ALE theta blocks are not ordinary functions, but sections of a line bundle over the Cartan torus associated with the $A_{N-1}$ root lattice, reflecting the mixed electric-magnetic $1$-form anomaly. We also discuss gauging discrete $\mathbb Z_k$ subgroups of the $1$-form symmetries and show that the vector-valued boundary-state structure remains the natural covariant framework after gauging. In this sense, ALE spaces behave as chiral building blocks for four-dimensional Maxwell theory: individual ALE blocks carry sector-resolved boundary data, while gluing pairs these sectors to produce an ordinary closed-manifold partition function, much like the pairing of left- and right-moving conformal blocks in two-dimensional CFT.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Abelian S-duality、path integral、modular covariance、boundary state。；研究对象：A型渐近局部欧几里得（ALE）空间上的麦克斯韦理论，具体包括Eguchi-Hanson空间等非紧四维流形上的U(1)规范场。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: ALE空间上的麦克斯韦路径积分并非标量配分函数，而是分解为标记有平坦U(1)和乐扇区的theta函数块；这些块应解释为希尔伯特空间边界态的分量，在模群作用下呈现向量值模协变性，而非普通模性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：ALE空间上的麦克斯韦路径积分并非标量配分函数，而是分解为标记有平坦U(1)和乐扇区的theta函数块；这些块应解释为希尔伯特空间边界态的分量，在模群作用下呈现向量值模协变性，而非普通模性。；创新点：将ALE空间上的麦克斯韦路径积分重新解释为携带扇区分辨边界数据的“手征构建块”，其配对方式类似于二维CFT中左右手征共形块的配对，从而统一处理了非紧流形上模性失效与1-形式反常的问题。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用路径积分分解、边界态构造、模群协变性分析、以及通过将Eguchi-Hanson空间与其定向反转体粘合得到S²×S²闭流形来检验边界态配对。进一步引入1-形式对称性背景场，分析theta块作为Cartan环面上线丛截面的性质，并讨论离散Z_k子群规范。

papers.title: Entanglement Pattern Transition of Quantum States from Directed Percolation
papers.abstract: Changes in the entanglement structure and critical phenomena are hallmarks of quantum phase transitions. Here, we discuss how they appear in transitions between classes of states with distinct entanglement patterns beyond the paradigm of stable equilibrium phases of matter. Using a mapping between stochastic automata and isometric Tensor Network States (isoTNS), we construct a two-dimensional quantum state from the Domany-Kinzel automaton, which is a (1+1)D process with an absorbing phase transition in the directed percolation class. At the critical point of the automaton, the corresponding isoTNS hosts algebraic correlations in all spatial directions. The continuous parent Hamiltonian of this state has a degenerate ground state manifold. It consists of a product state (the absorbing state) and a second state that undergoes a transition from pairwise entanglement between distant regions, similarly to the W state, to a state with trivial entanglement. Our results demonstrate how the correspondence between isoTNS and classical stochastic evolution can be used to probe the Hilbert space structure beyond stable ground state manifolds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“映射”（mapping）、“构造”（construct）、“连续父哈密顿量”（continuous parent Hamiltonian）等理论推导关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：基于有向逾渗（Directed Percolation）类吸收相变构造的二维量子态，具体为Domany-Kinzel自动机对应的等距张量网络态（isoTNS），以及其纠缠结构转变和临界现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在等距张量网络态与经典随机演化的对应关系下，发现该量子态在自动机临界点处具有所有空间方向上的代数关联；其连续父哈密顿量的基态流形包含一个乘积态（吸收态）和另一个经历从W态类似的长程配对纠缠到平凡纠缠转变的态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在等距张量网络态与经典随机演化的对应关系下，发现该量子态在自动机临界点处具有所有空间方向上的代数关联；其连续父哈密顿量的基态流形包含一个乘积态（吸收态）和另一个经历从W态类似的长程配对纠缠到平凡纠缠转变的态。；创新点：将等距张量网络态与经典随机演化（有向逾渗类吸收相变）的对应关系拓展到稳定平衡相范式之外，用于探测超越稳定基态流形的希尔伯特空间结构。
papers.method_zh: 利用随机自动机（Domany-Kinzel自动机）与等距张量网络态（isoTNS）之间的映射，通过构造二维量子态并分析其父哈密顿量的基态性质来研究纠缠模式转变。

papers.title: Practical Tests and Witnesses of Fermionic non-Gaussianity
papers.abstract: Detecting when a quantum state leaves the efficiently simulable fermionic Gaussian regime is a central task for benchmarking quantum devices and certifying fermionic magic resources. We develop practical tests and witnesses based on fermionic antiflatness (FAF), a covariance-matrix-based measure of non-Gaussianity. For $n$-qubit states, we estimate FAF using two complementary protocols: two-copy Bell measurements and a single-copy scheme based on commuting matchings of Majorana bilinears. These yield testers that distinguish pure Gaussian states from states $ε$-far from the Gaussian set, using $O(n^2/ε^2)$ two-copy Bell measurements or $O(n^3/ε^4)$ single-copy measurements, improving the state of the art in the dependence on both $n$ and $ε$. For mixed states, we introduce a purity-corrected FAF witness that certifies non-Gaussianity and is highly robust to noise. With our witness, we demonstrate on the IQM quantum computer that noise can both reduce and enhance non-Gaussianity. Finally, by examining pseudo non-Gaussianity, we show that the cryptographic task of pseudorandom-state generation requires extensive fermionic non-Gaussianity. Together, these results provide experimentally accessible tools for detecting, witnessing, and quantifying non-Gaussian fermionic resources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中提出了理论测试方案（FAF度量、两种协议），并在IQM量子计算机上进行了实验演示。；研究对象：费米子非高斯性（fermionic non-Gaussianity）的检测与度量，具体针对量子态是否可被经典高效模拟的费米子高斯态集合所描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了基于费米子反平坦度（FAF）的实用测试与见证方案，能够高效区分纯高斯态与远离高斯集的量子态，并发现噪声既可降低也可增强非高斯性；此外，伪随机态生成需要大量费米子非高斯性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了基于费米子反平坦度（FAF）的实用测试与见证方案，能够高效区分纯高斯态与远离高斯集的量子态，并发现噪声既可降低也可增强非高斯性；此外，伪随机态生成需要大量费米子非高斯性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于协方差矩阵的费米子反平坦度（FAF）度量；实验协议：双副本贝尔测量方案（需O(n²/ε²)次测量）和基于马约拉纳双线性对易匹配的单副本方案（需O(n³/ε⁴)次测量）；实验平台：IQM量子计算机；混合态分析：引入纯度修正的FAF见证。

papers.title: Mapping twist fields to local operators via tensor networks
papers.abstract: Twist fields are a powerful formal tool to compute Rényi entropies in quantum many-body systems, but their conventional formulation in tensor network states involves operations acting on virtual degrees of freedom, which are not directly accessible in experiments. In this work, we construct explicit local operators acting on the physical Hilbert space whose expectation values reproduce the action of twist fields in matrix product states. Our construction is exact in the injectivity limit and when the tensor is chosen at the center of orthogonality, and provides a direct operational method to evaluate Rényi entropies without accessing auxiliary tensor indices. We test our formulation numerically in the transverse-field Ising model, demonstrating rapid convergence to the exact entanglement entropy as the injectivity scale is reached. Furthermore, we show that twist operators determined from relatively small reference systems can be reliably transferred to larger systems, once the reference size exceeds a characteristic scale set by the correlation length. Since the resulting operators admit a decomposition in terms of a finite number of local observables, our results provide a scalable and experimentally accessible framework to probe entanglement in quantum simulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：tensor network states, matrix product states, theoretical construction, numerical test）；研究对象：量子多体系统中Rényi熵的计算，具体针对矩阵乘积态（MPS）中的twist场算符。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构造了作用于物理希尔伯特空间的局域算符，其期望值可精确复现twist场在矩阵乘积态中的作用，从而无需访问辅助张量指标即可直接计算Rényi熵。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构造了作用于物理希尔伯特空间的局域算符，其期望值可精确复现twist场在矩阵乘积态中的作用，从而无需访问辅助张量指标即可直接计算Rényi熵。；创新点：将原本作用于虚拟自由度的twist场转化为物理空间中的局域算符，使得Rényi熵的测量在实验上可直接实现，且算符可分解为有限个局域可观测量，为量子模拟器中的纠缠探测提供了可扩展框架。
papers.method_zh: 基于张量网络理论，在注入性极限和正交中心张量选择下进行精确构造；数值测试采用横场伊辛模型，通过注入性尺度收敛性分析验证；并研究了参考系统尺寸与关联长度对算符可迁移性的影响。

papers.title: Exact strong zero modes are generic in integrable spin systems with large anisotropy
papers.abstract: Strong zero modes (SZMs) are edge-localized operators that commute with the Hamiltonian up to corrections exponentially small in system size, yielding anomalously long edge coherence times. In some settings, notably certain integrable models, this commutator can be made to vanish exactly at finite size, defining an exact SZM (ESZM). Existing ESZM constructions in the integrable setting, however, have proceeded model by model and have not been unified into a common framework. Here, I show that ESZMs arise generically in a broad family of integrable spin models with anisotropic interactions. Their existence follows from two algebraic properties of the underlying R- and K-matrices -- quasi-periodicity in the spectral parameter and tracelessness, respectively -- providing a uniform, model-independent mechanism. The framework recovers the known ESZM in XXZ chain and its higher-spin generalizations as special cases and predicts ESZMs in previously unrecognized models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：algebraic properties、R- and K-matrices、model-independent mechanism。；研究对象：可积自旋系统中的精确强零模（Exact Strong Zero Modes, ESZMs），特别是具有大各向异性相互作用的可积自旋模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 精确强零模（ESZM）广泛存在于一大类具有各向异性相互作用的自旋可积模型中，其存在性源于底层R矩阵的准周期性和K矩阵的无迹性这两个代数性质，从而提供了一个统一、与模型无关的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：精确强零模（ESZM）广泛存在于一大类具有各向异性相互作用的自旋可积模型中，其存在性源于底层R矩阵的准周期性和K矩阵的无迹性这两个代数性质，从而提供了一个统一、与模型无关的机制。；创新点：将此前逐模型构造的精确强零模（ESZM）统一到一个共同的代数框架下，揭示了其存在的普适代数根源，并预言了此前未被识别的模型中也存在ESZM。
papers.method_zh: 基于可积系统的代数结构分析，具体利用R矩阵和K矩阵的代数性质（准周期性与无迹性）进行理论推导，并回现了XXZ链及其高自旋推广等已知特例。

papers.title: Local network evolution rules drive shortest path multiplicity
papers.abstract: The shortest path multiplicity is an important metric of complex networks. The shortest path multiplicity of real networks is high and it correlates with their community structure. Since local network evolution induces network communities, it is possible that a high shortest path multiplicity is the natural expectation of local evolution rules. Here I demonstrate, by means of numerical simulations, that this is indeed the case.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“by means of numerical simulations”。；研究对象：复杂网络。具体研究的是网络中的最短路径多重性（shortest path multiplicity）这一度量指标，以及其与网络局部演化规则和社区结构的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过数值模拟证明，局部网络演化规则（local network evolution rules）确实会导致复杂网络中出现高的最短路径多重性。这意味着高最短路径多重性是局部演化规则的自然结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过数值模拟证明，局部网络演化规则（local network evolution rules）确实会导致复杂网络中出现高的最短路径多重性。这意味着高最短路径多重性是局部演化规则的自然结果。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据摘要内容，其创新点在于通过模拟验证了“局部演化规则导致高最短路径多重性”这一假设，从而将网络社区结构、局部演化规则和最短路径多重性这三个概念联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（numerical simulations）。摘要未明确说明具体的网络模型或模拟算法。

papers.title: Local Impurity Induced Growth and Scrambling in Clean Free Fermions
papers.abstract: We study impurity-induced particle growth and scrambling in clean one-dimensional free-fermion systems. We show that a single local impurity can act as a branching source: particle or operator weight propagates coherently into the free bulk, returns to the impurity, and is locally converted into additional degrees of freedom. We develop this branching picture in three complementary settings: a monitored free-fermion model with feedback, a fully unitary interacting particle model, and Heisenberg operator dynamics with an interacting impurity. In the monitored model, we find a feedback-driven transition for both boundary and bulk impurities. In the unitary particle and operator models, a boundary impurity gives rise to an analogous transition from saturation to sustained growth and scrambling. These results reveal how a single impurity can generate complex many-body dynamics in an otherwise clean and free quantum system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study, show, develop, model, transition。；研究对象：一维无相互作用费米子体系中，单个局域杂质诱导的粒子增长与量子搅乱（scrambling）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单个局域杂质可作为“分支源”，使粒子或算符权重相干地传播到自由体区、返回杂质，并局域转化为额外自由度，从而在原本干净自由的量子系统中产生复杂多体动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单个局域杂质可作为“分支源”，使粒子或算符权重相干地传播到自由体区、返回杂质，并局域转化为额外自由度，从而在原本干净自由的量子系统中产生复杂多体动力学。；创新点：揭示了在完全干净且无相互作用的费米子系统中，仅通过单个局域杂质即可诱导出类似多体系统的持续增长与量子搅乱行为，并发现从饱和到持续增长/搅乱的类比相变。
papers.method_zh: 采用三种互补的理论模型：1）带反馈的受控自由费米子模型；2）完全幺正的相互作用粒子模型；3）含相互作用杂质的海森堡算符动力学。通过分析边界杂质与体杂质情形，研究反馈驱动的相变。

papers.title: AI-Enabled Decoding of Qubit Loss for Quantum Error-Correcting Codes
papers.abstract: Qubit loss is a major source of error in quantum computation, as it invalidates the algebraic structure of the standard stabilizer formalism for quantum error-correcting codes. On the one hand, it complicates decoding; on the other hand, it introduces stochastic flicker patterns in stabilizers as a hallmark of qubit loss. Here, we develop an artificial-intelligence-enabled decoder based on a spatiotemporal Graph Neural Network (STGNN) architecture to extract spatial and temporal correlations from syndrome histories. Our decoder performs a dual-head task, simultaneously correcting standard Pauli errors and identifying the locations of qubit loss. Our decoder achieves significantly higher logical accuracy than both the traditional minimum-weight perfect matching (MWPM) algorithm and even delayed-erasure MWPM decoders that use qubit loss information from the final round as input. Our decoder can also identify more than 90% of loss locations after accumulating stabilizer measurements over the subsequent ten rounds, thereby facilitating qubit reinitialization, for instance, via the continuous loading technique on the atom array platform. For both tasks, our STGNN performs nearly identically to a modified version of AlphaQubit, but it employs a parallel input structure, giving it an advantage in inference time over modified AlphaQubit's recurrent input structure. This work provides a robust and scalable framework for correcting qubit loss errors, paving the way for more efficient fault-tolerant quantum computation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：开发了基于图神经网络（STGNN）的AI解码器，属于算法设计与数值模拟研究，未提及实验操作。；研究对象：量子纠错码中的量子比特丢失（qubit loss）问题，以及如何通过稳定子测量历史中的时空相关性进行解码与丢失位置识别。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于时空图神经网络（STGNN）的解码器能够同时纠正标准泡利错误和识别量子比特丢失位置，其逻辑准确率显著优于传统最小权重完美匹配（MWPM）算法和延迟擦除MWPM解码器；在累积十轮稳定子测量后，可识别超过90%的丢失位置。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于时空图神经网络（STGNN）的解码器能够同时纠正标准泡利错误和识别量子比特丢失位置，其逻辑准确率显著优于传统最小权重完美匹配（MWPM）算法和延迟擦除MWPM解码器；在累积十轮稳定子测量后，可识别超过90%的丢失位置。；创新点：首次将时空图神经网络（STGNN）应用于量子比特丢失的解码任务，实现了双头并行输出（错误纠正+丢失定位），并在推理时间上优于具有循环输入结构的改进版AlphaQubit。摘要未突出说明与传统解码器在可扩展性或硬件适配性上的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用时空图神经网络（STGNN）架构，从稳定子测量历史中提取空间和时间相关性；解码器执行双头任务（dual-head task），同时处理泡利错误纠正与丢失位置识别。与改进版AlphaQubit进行性能对比，并分析了推理时间优势。
